chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بنى االسالم عىل خمس: عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والحج، والصوم، والوالية.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Islam is built upon five things: salat, zakat, hajj, sawm (fasting), and wilayah (*). Translator: * Wilayah: Allegiance and obedience to the divine leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بنى االسالم عىل خمسة أشياء: عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والحج، والصوم، والوالية. اقل زرارة: فقلت: وأي شئ من ذلك أفضل؟ فقال: الوالية أفضل ألنها مفتاحهن، والوالي هو الدليل عليهن، قلت: ثم الذي ييل ذلك في الفضل؟ فقال: الصالة، قلت ثم الذي يليها في الفضل؟ اقل الزكاة: ألنه قرنها بها، وبدأ ابلصالة قبلها، قلت: افلذي يليها في الفضل؟ اقل: الحج. قلت: ماذا يتبعه؟ اقل: الصوم.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Islam is built upon five things: upon salat, zakat, hajj, sawm (fasting), and wilayah. Zurarah said: I asked: Which of these is most excellent? He said: Wilayah is most excellent because it is the key to them, and the wali is the guide to them. I said: Then what follows it in excellence? He said: Salat. I said: Then what follows it in excellence? He said: Zakat, because He (Allah) paired it with salat, and mentioned with salat before it. I said: Then what follows it in excellence? He said: Hajj. I said: What follows it? He said: Sawm (fasting).

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: أال أخبرك ابإلسالم، أصله وفرعه وذروة سنامه؟ قلت بىل جعلت فداك، اقل: أما أصله افلصالة، وفرعه الزكاة، وذروة سنامه الجهاد. ثم اقل: إن شئت أخبرتك أببواب الخير، قلت نعم، اقل: الصوم جنة.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Shall I inform you about Islam, its root, its branch, and its highest peak? I said: Yes, may I be sacrificed for you. He said: As for its root, it is salat; its branch is zakat; and its highest peak is jihad. Then he said: If you wish, I shall inform you about the gates of goodness. I said: Yes. He said: Fasting is a shield.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن عمرو بن حريث أنه اقل ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): أال أقص عليك ديني؟ فقال: بىل، قلت: أدين هللا بشهادة أن ال إله إال هللا وحده ال شريك له، وان محمدا رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله)، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصوم شهر رمضان، وحج البيت، والوالية - وذكر األئمة (عليهم السالم). فقال: اي عمرو، هذا دين هللا ودين آابئي الذي أدين هللا به في السر والعالنية.
englishText: From Amr bin Hurayth that he said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Shall I tell you about my religion? He said: Yes. I said: I follow Allah's religion by testifying that there is no god but Allah alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and establishing prayer, and giving zakat, and fasting the month of Ramadan, and performing pilgrimage (hajj) to the House, and Wilayah - and he mentioned the Imams (peace be upon them). He said: O Amr, this is the religion of Allah and the religion of my forefathers by which I worship Allah privately and publicly.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بنى اإلسالم عىل خمسة أشياء: عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والحج، والصوم، والوالية.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Islam is built upon five things: salat, zakat, hajj, sawm (fasting), and wilayah.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في جملة حديث، اقل: إن هللا افترض عىل أمة محمد (صىل هللا عليه وآله) خمس فرائض: الصالة، والزكاة، والصيام، والحج، وواليتنا. أقول: الجهاد من توابع الوالية ولوازمها، لما أيتي، ويدخل فيه االمر ابلمعروف، والنهى عن المنكر، وأيتي ما يدل عليه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said in a hadith: Allah has made five obligations mandatory upon the nation of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family): salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), hajj, and our wilayah. I (Hurr Amili) say: Jihad is among the consequences and requirements of Wilayah, as will be explained, and this includes commanding good and forbidding evil, and evidence for this will come.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: الصادق (عليه السالم) اقل: أاثفي االسالم ثالثة: الصالة، والزكاة، والوالية، ال تصح واحدة (منها إال بصاحبتها)
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The tripods of Islam are three: salat, zakat, and wilayah; none of them is valid without its companion. Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ان هللا أعطى محمدا (صىل هللا عليه وآله) شرائع نوح وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى - إلى أن اقل - ثم افترض عليه فيها الصالة، والزكاة، والصيام، والحج، واألمر ابلمعروف، والنهى عن المنكر، والجهاد في سبيل هللا، وزاده الوضوء، وأحل له الغنم والفئ، وجعل له األرض مسجدا وطهورا، وأعطاه الجزية واسر المشركين وفداهم، الحديث.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah gave Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) the laws of Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus - then he said - Then He obligated upon him within them salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), hajj, commanding good and forbidding evil, jihad in the way of Allah, and added ablution, and made permissible for him the spoils of war and booty, and made the earth a place of prostration and purification, and gave him the right to collect jizyah and take polytheists as captives and ransom them.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن عجالن أبي صالح اقل: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) أوقفني عىل حدود اإليمان، فقال شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله)، واإلقرار بما جاء من عند هللا، وصالة الخمس، وأداء الزكاة، وصوم شهر رمضان، وحج البيت، ووالية ولينا، وعداوة عدوان، والدخول مع الصادقين.
englishText: From Ajlan Abu Salih who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Show me the boundaries of faith. He said: Testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), acknowledging what has come from Allah, the five prayers, paying zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, pilgrimage to the House, wilayah to our wali (allies), enmity to our enemies, and joining with the truthful.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بني االسالم عىل خمس: عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والصوم، والحج، والوالية، ولم يناد بشئ ما نودي ابلوالية.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Islam is built upon five: upon salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), hajj, and wilayah, and nothing was proclaimed as much as wilayah was proclaimed.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بنى االسالم عىل خمس: الوالية، والصالة، والزكاة، وصوم شهر رمضان، والحج.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Islam is built upon five things: wilayah, salat, zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, and hajj.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أبي بصير اقل: سمعته يسأل أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الدين الذي افترض هللا عز وجل عىل العباد، ماال يسعهم جهله، وال يقبل منهم غيره، ما هو؟ فقال: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت من استطاع إليه سبيال، وصوم شهر رمضان، والوالية.
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I heard him asking Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the religion that Allah the Mighty and Majestic has made obligatory upon the servants, which they cannot afford to be ignorant of, and nothing else is accepted from them, what is it? He said: Testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, giving zakat, pilgrimage (hajj) to the House (Ka'bah) for whoever is able to find a way to it, fasting the month of Ramadan, and wilayah.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: اإلسالم هو الظاهر الذي عليه الناس، شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا (رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله)، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصيام شهر رمضان، فهذا اإلسالم.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - who said: Islam is the outward which people follow: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), establishing prayer, giving zakat, pilgrimage to the House, and fasting the month of Ramadan - this is Islam.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - في حديث اإلسالم واإليمان - اقل: واجتمعوا عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والصوم، والحج، فخرجوا بذلك من الكفر، وأضيفوا إلى اإليمان.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) - in a hadith about Islam and faith - who said: And they agreed upon salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), and hajj, and by that they came out of kufr (disbelief) and were added to imaan (faith).

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: بنى االسالم عىل خمس: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا عبده ورسوله، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصيام شهر رمضان.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - who said: Islam is built upon five things: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, establishing prayer, giving zakat, pilgrimage to the House, and fasting the month of Ramadan. Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: إن الشيعة لو أجمعوا عىل ترك الصالة لهلكوا، ولو أجمعوا عىل ترك الزكاة لهلكوا، ولو أجمعوا عىل ترك الحج لهلكوا.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said in a hadith: If all Shia were to agree on abandoning prayer, they would perish; if they were to agree on abandoning zakat, they would perish; and if they were to agree on abandoning hajj, they would perish.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اخبرني عن الفرائض التي افترض هللا عىل العباد ما هي؟ فقال: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا، وإاقم الصلوات الخمس، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصيام شهر رمضان، والوالية، فمن أاقمهن، وسدد، واقرب، واجتنب كل مسكر، دخل الجنة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) to tell me about the obligations that Allah has prescribed for His servants. He said: Testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His messenger, establishing the five daily prayers, giving zakat, performing hajj to the House, fasting in Ramadan, and wilayah (guardianship). Whoever establishes these, remains steadfast, draws near, and avoids all intoxicants will enter Paradise.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر (عليه السالم): بنى االسالم عىل خمسة أشياء: عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والحج، والصوم، والوالية.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Islam is built upon five things: salat, zakat, hajj, sawm (fasting), and wilayah.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: خطب أمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم) يوم الفطر، فقال: الحمد هلل الذي خلق السماوات واألرض - إلى أن اقل - وأطيعوا هللا فيما فرض عليكم، وأمركم به، من إاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصوم شهر رمضان، واالمر ابلمعروف، والنهي عن المنكر.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) delivered a sermon on Eid al-Fitr, saying: Praise be to Allah who created the heavens and earth... and obey Allah in what He has prescribed and commanded you regarding establishing prayer, giving zakat, performing hajj to the House, fasting in Ramadan, enjoining good, and forbidding evil.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: اقل دخلت عىل سيدي عيل بن محمد (عليهما السالم)، فقلت: إني أريد أن أعرض عليك ديني، فقال: هات اي أاب القاسم، فقلت: إني أقول: إن هللا واحد - إلى أن اقل - وأقول: إن الفرائض الواجبة بعد الوالية: الصالة، والزكاة، والصوم، والحج والجهاد، واالمر ابلمعروف، والنهى عن المنكر. فقال عيل بن محمد (عليهما السالم): اي أاب القاسم، هذا وهللا دين هللا الذي ارتضاه لعباده، أفثبت عليه، ثبتك هللا ابلقول الثابت في الحياة الدنيا وفي اآلخرة.
englishText: He said: I entered upon my master Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) and said: I want to present my religious beliefs to you. He said: Proceed, O Abu al-Qasim. I said: I say that Allah is One... and I say that the obligatory duties after wilayah are: salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), hajj, jihad, enjoining good, and forbidding evil. Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said: O Abu al-Qasim, this, by Allah, is the religion of Allah which He has chosen for His servants, so remain firm upon it. May Allah keep you firm with the firm word in this life and in the Hereafter.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عيل بن محمد، (عليهما السالم) ورد في رسالة: :- إن هللا لما فرض عليكم الفرائض لم يفرض ذلك عليكم بحاجة منه إليه، بل رحمة منه إليكم، ال إله إال هو، ليميز الخبيث من الطيب - إلى أن اقل - ففرض عليكم الحج، والعمرة، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، والصوم، والوالية.
englishText: Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) stated in a letter: When Allah prescribed obligations upon you, He did not prescribe them out of need for them, but as mercy from Him to you. There is no god but He, to distinguish the evil from the good... He prescribed for you hajj, umrah, establishing prayer, giving zakat, fasting, and wilayah.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن زينب بنت عيل (عليه السالم) اقلت: اقلت افطمة (عليها السالم) في خطبتها: فرض هللا االيمان تطهيرا من الشرك، والصالة تنزيها عن الكبر، والزكاة زايدة في الرزق، والصيام تثبيتا لإلخالص، والحج تسنية للدين، والجهاد عزا لالسالم، واالمر ابلمعروف مصلحة للعامة.
englishText: From Zainab bint Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Fatima (peace be upon her) said in her sermon: Allah prescribed faith to purify from polytheism, prayer to eliminate arrogance, zakat for increasing sustenance, fasting to establish sincerity, hajj to strengthen the religion, jihad for the glory of Islam, and enjoining good for the benefit of the public. Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أنس اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): جاءني جبرئيل فقال لي: اي أحمد، االسالم عشرة أسهم، وقد خاب من ال سهم له فيها، أولها: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وهي الكلمة، والثانية: الصالة، وهي الطهر، والثالثة: الزكاة، وهي الفطرة، والرابعة: الصوم، وهو الجنة، والخامسة: الحج، وهو الشريعة، والسادسة: الجهاد، وهو العز، والسابعة: االمر ابلمعروف، وهو الوافء، والثامنة: النهى عن المنكر، وهو الحجة، والتاسعة: الجماعة، وهي األلفة، والعاشرة: الطاعة، وهي العصمة.
englishText: From Anas who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel came to me and said: O Ahmad, Islam has ten parts, and whoever has no share in them has failed. First: testifying that there is no god but Allah, which is the Word. Second: salat, which is purity. Third: zakat, which is natural disposition. Fourth: fasting, which is protection. Fifth: hajj, which is the law. Sixth: jihad, which is honor. Seventh: enjoining good, which is fulfillment. Eighth: forbidding evil, which is the proof. Ninth: congregation, which is harmony. Tenth: obedience, which is protection.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر (عليه السالم): بنى االسالم عىل خمس: إاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وحج البيت، وصوم شهر رمضان، والوالية لنا أهل البيت، فجعل في أربع منها رخصة، ولم يجعل في الوالية رخصة، من لم يكن له مال لم تكن عليه الزكاة، ومن لم يكن له مال فليس عليه حج، ومن كان مريضا صىل اقعدا، وأفطر شهر رمضان، والوالية صحيحا كان أو مريضا أو ذا مال أو ال مال له فهي الزمة.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Islam is built upon five pillars: establishing prayer, giving zakat, pilgrimage to the House (Ka'bah), fasting during the month of Ramadan, and Wilayah to us, the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House). He granted concession in four of them but did not grant any concession in Wilayah. Whoever has no wealth is not obligated to pay zakat. Whoever has no wealth is not obligated to perform pilgrimage. Whoever is ill may pray sitting and break the fast during the month of Ramadan. But Wilayah is obligatory whether one is healthy or ill, wealthy or poor.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) اقل: أيها الناس، إنه ال نبي بعدي، وال أمة بعدكم، أال افعبدوا ربكم، وصلوا خمسكم، وصوموا شهركم، وحجوا بيت ربكم، وأدوا زكاة أموالكم، طيبت بها نفوسكم، وأطيعوا والة أمركم، تدخلوا جنة ربكم.
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: O people, there is no prophet after me and no nation after you. Indeed, worship your Lord, pray your five prayers, fast your month, perform pilgrimage to your Lord's House, pay the zakat of your wealth - purifying yourselves through it, and obey those in authority among you; you will enter your Lord's paradise.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: المحمدية السمحة: إاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصيام شهر رمضان، وحج البيت الحرام، والطاعة لالمام، وأداء حقوق المؤمن.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said in a hadith: The lenient Muhammadan way includes: establishing prayer, giving zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, pilgrimage to the Sacred House, obedience to the Imam, and fulfilling the rights of believers.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: وهللا ما كلف هللا العباد إال دون ما يطيقون، إنما كلفهم في اليوم والليلة خمس صلوات، وكلفهم في كل ألف درهم خمسة وعشرين درهما، وكلفهم في السنة صيام ثالثين يوما، وكلفهم حجة واحدة، وهم يطيقون أكثر من ذلك.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: By Allah, Allah has not burdened His servants beyond what they can bear. He only obligated them with five prayers in day and night, obligated twenty-five dirhams for every thousand dirhams, obligated thirty days of fasting in a year, and obligated one pilgrimage, while they can bear more than that.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أاب الحسن (عليه السالم) اقل: من عادى شيعتنا فقد عاداان - إلى أن اقل - شعيتنا الذين يقيمون الصالة، ويؤتون الزكاة، ويحجون البيت الحرام، ويصومون شهر رمضان، ويوالون أهل البيت، ويبرؤون من أعدائنا، أولئك أهل االيمان، والتقى، واألمانة، من رد عليهم فقد رد عىل هللا، ومن طعن عليهم فقد طعن، عىل هللا.
englishText: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: Whoever shows enmity to our Shia (followers) has shown enmity to us - until he said - our Shia are those who establish prayer, give zakat, perform hajj to Bayt al-Haram (Sacred House - Ka'bah), fast the month of Ramadan, maintain loyalty (love/support) to the Ahl al-Bayt, and disassociate from our enemies. Those are the people of faith, piety, and trust. Whoever rejects them has rejected Allah, and whoever slanders them has slandered Allah.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: الصادق جعفر بن محمد (عليهما السالم) اقل: بنى االسالم عىل خمس دعائم، عىل الصالة، والزكاة، والصوم، والحج، ووالية أمير المؤمنين واألئمة من ولده (عليهم السالم).
englishText: Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said: Islam is built upon five pillars: salat, zakat, sawm (fasting), hajj, and wilayah to Amir al-Mu'minin and the Imams from his descendants (peace be upon them). Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: إمام عيل (عليه السالم) إنه كان يقول: إن أفضل ما يتوصل به المتوسلون إلى هللا: االيمان ابهلل ورسوله، والجهاد في سبيل هللا ، وكلمة االخالص، إفنها الفطرة، وإاقم الصالة إفنها الملة، وإيتاء الزكاة إفنها من فرائض هللا، وصوم شهر رمضان إفنه جنة من عذابه، وحج البيت إفنه منفاة للفقر ومدحضة.
englishText: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: The best means by which seekers of nearness to Allah seek proximity: belief in Allah and His Messenger, striving in Allah's path, the word of sincerity for it is the natural disposition, establishing prayer for it is the religion, giving zakat for it is among Allah's obligations, fasting the month of Ramadan for it is a shield from His punishment, and pilgrimage to the House for it removes poverty and sin.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: بني اإلسالم عىل خمس دعائم: إاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصوم شهر رمضان، وحج بيت هللا الحرام، والوالية لنا أهل البيت.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Islam is built upon five pillars: establishing prayer, giving zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, pilgrimage to Allah's Sacred House, and the wilayah to us, the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House).

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر، عن آابئه (عليهم السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): بنى االسالم عىل عشرة أسهم: عىل شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا وهي الملة، والصالة وهي الفريضة، والصوم وهي الجنة، والزكاة وهي المطهرة، والحج وهو الشريعة، والجهاد وهو العز، واالمر ابلمعروف وهو الوافء، والنهي عن المنكر وهو الحجة، والجماعة وهي األلفة، والعصمة وهي الطاعة.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Islam is built upon ten pillars: testifying that there is no god but Allah which is the religion, prayer which is the obligation, fasting which is the shield, zakat which is the purifier, hajj which is the law, jihad which is honor, commanding good which is fulfillment, forbidding evil which is the proof, congregation which is harmony, and infallibility which is obedience.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن الرضا، عن آابئه (عليهم السالم)، عن رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) اقل: بنى اإلسالم عىل خمس خصال: عىل الشهادتين، والقرينتين، قيل له: اما الشهاداتن فقد عرفناهما، فما القرينتان؟ اقل: الصالة، والزكاة، إفنه ال تقبل إحداهما إال ابألخرى، والصيام، وحج البيت من استطاع إليه سبيال، وختم ذلك ابلوالية.
englishText: From Al-Ridha, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Islam is built upon five characteristics: the two testimonies and the two companions. He was asked: We know the two testimonies, but what are the two companions? He said: Prayer and zakat, for one is not accepted without the other, and fasting, and pilgrimage to the House for those who are able to make their way to it, and this is sealed with wilayah (guardianship).

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: قلت له: أي االعمال أفضل بعد المعرفة؟ فقال: ما من شئ بعد المعرفة يعدل هذه الصالة، وال بعد المعرفة والصالة شئ يعدل الزكاة، وال بعد ذلك شئ يعدل الصوم، وال بعد ذلك شئ يعدل الحج، وافتحة ذلك كله معرفتنا، وخاتمته معرفتنا، وال شئ بعد ذلك كبر االخوان، والمواساة ببذل الدينار والدرهم - إلى أن اقل - وما رأيت شيئا أسرع غنى، وال أنفى للفقر من إدمان حج هذا البيت، وصالة فريضة تعدل عند هللا الف حجة والف عمرة، مبرورات، متقبالت، ولحجة عنده خير من بيت مملو ذهبا، ال بل خير من ملء الدنيا ذهبا وفضة ينفقه في سبيل هللا، والذي بعث محمدا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) ابلحق بشيرا ونذيرا لقضاء حاجة امرء، مسلم، وتنفيس كربته، أفضل من حجة، وطواف، وحجة، وطواف - حتى عقد عشرة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: Which deeds are best after ma'rifah (*) (divine recognition)? He said: Nothing after ma'arifah equals prayer, and nothing after ma'arifah and prayer equals zakat, and nothing after that equals fasting, and nothing after that equals hajj. The beginning of all that is ma'arifah of us, and its end is ma'arifah of us, and nothing after that is greater than brotherhood and helping others with dinar and dirham - until he said - And I have not seen anything bringing wealth faster or removing poverty better than frequent pilgrimage to this House, and an obligatory prayer equals a thousand accepted pilgrimages and a thousand accepted umrahs in Allah's sight. And one pilgrimage in His sight is better than a house full of gold, rather better than the whole world filled with gold and silver spent in Allah's way. By the One who sent Muhammad with truth as a bearer of good news and warner, fulfilling the need of a Muslim brother and relieving his distress is better than pilgrimage and tawaf, and pilgrimage and tawaf - until he counted ten. Translator: * The term "al-ma'rifah" translated as "divine recognition", carries a deeper theological significance and specifically refers to the recognition and knowledge of the divine authority of the Holy Prophet (s) and Ahl al-Bayt (as). Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: وأما ما فرضه هللا عز وجل من الفرائض في كتابه فدعائم االسالم، وهي خمس دعائم، وعىل هذه الفرائض بنى االسالم، فجعل سبحانه لكل، فريضة من هذه الفرائض أربعة حدود، ال يسع أحدا جهلها، أولها الصالة، ثم الزكاة، ثم الصيام، ثم الحج، ثم الوالية، وهي خاتمتها، والحافظة لجميع الفرائض والسنن.
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: As for what Allah has made obligatory among the obligations in His Book, they are the pillars of Islam, and they are five pillars, and upon these obligations Islam is built. The Glorified One has made for each obligation among these obligations four bounds that no one can be excused for not knowing. First is salat, then zakat, then sawm (fasting), then hajj, then wilayah which is their seal and the protector of all fara'idh (obligations) and sunan (traditions).

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): إن هللا يدفع بمن يصيل من شيعتنا عمن ال يصيل من شيعتنا، ولو أجمعوا عىل ترك الصالة لهلكوا، وإن هللا يدفع بمن يزيك من شيعتنا عمن ال يزيك من شيعتنا، ولو أجمعوا عىل ترك الزكاة لهلكوا، وإن هللا ليدفع بمن يحج من شيعتنا عمن ال يحج من شيعتنا، ولو أجمعوا عىل ترك الحج لهلكوا، وهو قوله: ولوال دفع هللا الناس بعضهم ببعض لفسدت األرض. المحكم.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed Allah defends those among our Shia who do not pray through those who pray among our Shia, and if they all agreed to abandon prayer they would perish. And indeed Allah defends those among our Shia who do not give zakat through those who give zakat among our Shia, and if they all agreed to abandon zakat they would perish. And indeed Allah defends those among our Shia who do not perform Hajj through those who perform Hajj among our Shia, and if they all agreed to abandon Hajj they would perish. And this is in His saying "And if Allah had not repelled some people by others, the earth would have been corrupted" [Quran, 2:251]. The decisive.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ما كلف هللا العباد إال ما يطيقون، إنما كلفهم في اليوم والليلة خمس صلوات، وكلفهم من كل مأتي درهم خمسة دراهم، وكلفهم صيام شهر في السنة، وكلفهم حجة واحدة، وهم يطيقون أكثر من ذلك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Allah has not burdened the servants except with what they can bear. He only required them to pray five prayers in day and night, required them to pay five dirhams from every two hundred dirhams, required them to fast one month in the year, and required them to perform hajj once, while they can bear more than that.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) إنه سئل عن الدين الذي ال يقبل هللا من العباد غيره، وال يعذرهم عىل جهله؟ فقال: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم)، والصلوات الخمس، وصيام شهر رمضان، والغسل من الجنابة، وحج البيت، واإلقرار بما جاء من عند هللا جملة، واالئتمام أبئمة الحق من آل محمد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who was asked about the religion which Allah does not accept any other from His servants and does not excuse them for being ignorant of it. He said: Testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, the five prayers, fasting the month of Ramadan, washing from major impurity, pilgrimage to the House, acknowledging what has come from Allah in general, and following the rightful Imams from the family of Muhammad.

chapter: Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Hajj, And Jihad
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: عشر من لقي هللا بهن دخل الجنة: شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا، واالقرار بما جاء من عند هللا، وإاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصوم شهر رمضان، وحج البيت، والوالية ألولياء هللا، والبراءة من أعداء هللا، واجتناب كل مسكر.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ten things that whoever meets Allah with them will enter Paradise: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, acknowledging what has come from Allah, establishing prayer, giving zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, performing pilgrimage to the House, wilayah to the awliyah of Allah, disavowal from Allah's enemies, and avoiding all intoxicants. Sheikh Hurr Amili: The narrations on this topic are very abundant, surpassing the level of being mutawatir (widely transmitted), and what I have presented is sufficient, God willing. Evidence supporting this is found in the narrations concerning funeral prayers, the method of performing ablution, and other matters. Obligation Of The Five Acts Of Ibadaah: Prayer, Zakat, Fasting, Haj...

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أاب جعفر (عليه السالم) يقول: كل شئ يجره اإلقرار والتسليم فهو اإليمان، وكل شئ يجره االنكار والجحود فهو الكفر.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Everything that leads to acknowledgment and submission is faith, and everything that leads to denial and rejection is disbelief.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): سنن رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) كفرائض هللا عز وجل؟ فقال: إن هللا عز وجل فرض فرائض موجبات عىل العباد، فمن ترك فريضة من الموجبات فلم يعمل بها وجحدها كان كافرا، وأمر رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) أبمور كلها حسنة، فليس من ترك بعض ما أمر هللا عز وجل به عباده من الطاعة بكافر، ولكنه اترك للفضل، منقوص من الخير.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Are the traditions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) like the obligations of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime? He said: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has prescribed mandatory obligations upon His servants. Whoever abandons an obligation from these mandatory duties and does not act upon it while denying it, is considered a disbeliever. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded matters that are all good, but one who abandons some of what Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has commanded His servants regarding obedience is not a disbeliever; rather, he has abandoned virtue and is deficient in goodness.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: الكفر أعظم من الشرك، فمن اختار عىل هللا عز وجل وأبى الطاعة، وأاقم عىل الكبائر، فهو كافر. ومن نصب دينا غير دين المؤمنين فهو مشرك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Disbelief is greater than polytheism. So whoever chooses against Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, refuses obedience, and persists in major sins is a disbeliever. And whoever establishes a religion other than the religion of the believers is a polytheist.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) إنه اقل: الكفر أقدم من الشرك - ثم ذكر كفر إبليس، ثم اقل: فمن اجترى عىل هللا أفبى الطاعة، وأاقم عىل الكبائر فهو كافر، يعنى مستخف كافر.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Disbelief is older than polytheism - then he mentioned the disbelief of Iblis, then said: So whoever dares to disobey Allah and persists in committing major sins is a disbeliever, meaning a disbeliever who takes his disbelief lightly.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا(عليه السالم) عن قوله: عز وجل: إان هديناه السبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا. اقل: إما آخذ فهو شاكر، وإما اترك فهو كافر. أقول: الترك هنا مخصوص بما كان عىل وجه اإلنكار، أو الكفر بمعنى آخر غير معنى اإلرتداد، لما مضي وأيتي.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about His, the Mighty and Majestic, saying: "Indeed, We have shown him the way: be he grateful or be he ungrateful" [Quran, 76:3]. He said: Either he accepts it and thus he is grateful, or he leaves it and thus he is ungrateful. I (Hurr Amili) say: Abandonment here is specific to what is done in denial, or disbelief in another sense other than apostasy, as has passed and will come.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن قول هللا عز وجل: ومن يكفر اباليمان فقد حبط عمله. فقال: ترك العمل الذي أقر به، منه الذي يدع الصالة متعمدا، ال من سكر وال من علة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: "And whoever disbelieves in faith, his work has become worthless" [Quran, 5:5]. He said: It means abandoning the deed which one has acknowledged, including one who deliberately leaves prayer, not due to intoxication or illness.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، مثله، إال أنه اقل: من ذلك أن يترك الصالة من غير سقم وال شغل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), similar to the previous narration, except that he said: Among that is to abandon prayer without illness or occupation.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: لو أن العباد إذا جهلوا وقفوا ولم يجحدوا لم يكفروا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If people, when they are ignorant of something, would pause (withhold judgment) and not deny it, they would not fall into Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessit... disbelief.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: الكفر في كتاب هللا عز وجل عىل خمسة أوجه: فمنها كفر الجحود عىل وجهين، والكفر بترك ما أمر هللا عز وجل به، وكفر البراءة، وكفر النعم، أفما كفر الجحود فهو الجحود ابلربوبية، والجحود عىل معرفة، وهو أن يجحد الجاحد وهو يعلم أنه حق قد استقر عنده، وقد اقل هللا تعالى وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها أنفسهم إلى أن اقل: - والوجه الرابع من الكفر ترك ما أمر هللا عز وجل به، وهو قول هللا عز وجل: أفتؤمنون ببعض الكتاب وتكفرون ببعض؟ فكفرهم بترك ما أمرهم هللا عز وجل به، ونسبهم إلى االيمان ولم يقبله منهم، ولم ينفعهم عنده، فقال: فما جزاء من يفعل ذلك منكم إال خزي في الحياة الدنيا ويوم القيامة يردون إلى أشد العذاب.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Disbelief in the Book of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, is of five types: Among them is the disbelief of denial, which is of two kinds; disbelief by abandoning what Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has commanded; disbelief by disassociation; and disbelief in blessings. As for the disbelief of denial, it is the denial of Lordship, and denial with knowledge. It is when the denier denies while knowing that it is the truth that has been established with him. And Allah the Most High said: "And they rejected them, while their souls were convinced thereof." [Quran, 27:14] And up to where He said: - And the fourth type of disbelief is abandoning what Allah the Mighty and Majestic commanded, and it is the saying of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: "So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part?" [Quran, 2:85] He declared them disbelievers for abandoning what Allah the Mighty and Majestic commanded them with, and He attributed faith to them but did not accept it from them, and it did not benefit them with Him, so He said: "And what is the recompense of those who do so among you except disgrace in worldly life, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be consigned to the severest punishment." [Quran, 2:85]

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يرتكب الكبيرة فيموت، هل يخرجه ذلك من االسالم؟ وإن عذب كان عذابه كعذاب المشركين، أم له مدة وانقطاع؟ فقال: من ارتكب كبيرة من الكبائر فزعم أنها حالل أخرجه ذلك من االسالم، وعذب أشد العذاب، وإن كان معتراف أنه ذنب ومات عليها، أخرجه من االيمان ولم يخرجه من االسالم، وكان عذابه أهون من عذاب األول.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who commits a major sin and then dies. Does that remove him from Islam? And if he is punished, would his punishment be like that of the polytheists, or does it have a duration and an end? Whoever commits a major sin and claims that it is permissible, this removes him from Islam, and he will be punished with the severest punishment. And if he acknowledges that it is a sin and dies in that state, it removes him from faith but does not remove him from Islam, and his punishment will be lighter than the punishment of the first one.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: فقيل ل أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): أرأيت المرتكب للكبيرة يموت عليها أتخرجه من االيمان؟ وإن عذب بها فيكون عذابه كعذاب المشركين، أو له انقطاع؟ اقل: يخرج من االسالم إذا زعم أنها حالل، ولذلك يعذب أبشد العذاب، وإن كان معتراف أبنها كبيرة، وأنها عليه حرام، وأنه يعذب عليها، وأنها غير حالل، إفنه معذب عليها، وهو أهون عذااب من األول، ويخرجه من اإليمان، وال يخرجه من اإلسالم.
englishText: It was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about one who commits a major sin and dies (persisting) upon it, does it remove him from faith? And if he is punished for it, would his punishment be like the punishment of the polytheists, or will it have an end? He said: He exits from Islam if he claims it is permissible, and for that he will be punished with the severest punishment. And if he acknowledges that it is a major sin, and that it is forbidden for him, and that he will be punished for it, and that it is not permissible, then he will be punished for it, though his punishment will be lighter than the first one, and it removes him from faith but does not remove him from Islam.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث طويل في رجلين من أصحابنا بينهما منازعة في دين أو ميراث - اقل: ينظران إلى من كان منكم قد روى حديثنا، ونظر في حاللنا وحرامنا، وعرف أحكامنا، فليرضوا به حكما، إفني قد جعلته عليكم حاكما، إفذا حكم بحكمنا فلم يقبل منه إفنه استخف بحكم هللا، وعلينا رد، والراد علينا الراد عىل هللا، وهو عىل حد الشرك ابهلل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a long hadith regarding two men from our companions who had a dispute concerning debt or inheritance - he said: They should look for someone among you who has narrated our hadith, and has studied our permissible and forbidden matters, and knows our rulings. So let them be pleased with him as a judge, for I have appointed him as a judge over you. If he judges with our judgement and it is not accepted from him, then he has belittled the judgement of Allah, and has rejected us, and whoever rejects us has Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessit... rejected Allah, and he is at the border of associating partners with Allah.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: قيل ألمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم): من شهد أن ال إله إال هللا، وأن محمدا رسول هللا )صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم( كان مؤمنا؟ اقل: أفين فرائض هللا - إلى أن اقل - ثم اقل: فما ابل من جحد الفرائض كان كافرا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: It was said to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): Is one who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) considered a believer? He said: Then where are the obligations (fara'idh) of Allah - until he said - then he said: So how is it that one who denies the obligations is considered a disbeliever.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - في حديث طويل - اقل: إن هللا لما أذن لمحمد (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) في الخروج من مكة إلى المدينة أنزل عليه الحدود، وقسمة الفرائض، وأخبره ابلمعاصي التي أوجب هللا عليها وبها النار لمن عمل بها، وأنزل في بيان القاتل: ومن يقتل مؤمنا متعمدا فجزاؤه جهنم خالدا فيها وغضب هللا عليه ولعنه وأعد له عذااب عظيما وال يلعن هللا مؤمنا، واقل هللا عز وجل: إن هللا لعن الكافرين وأعد لهم سعيرا خالدين فيها أبدا ال يجدون وليا وال نصيرا، وأنزل في مال اليتامى: إن الذين أيكلون أموال اليتامى ظلما إنما أيكلون في بطونهم انرا وسيصلون سعيرا، وأنزل في الكيل: ويل للمطففين، ولم يجعل الويل ألحد حتى يسميه كافرا، اقل هللا تعالى: فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم، وأنزل في العهد: إن الذين يشترون بعهد هللا وأيمانهم ثمنا قليال أولئك ال خالق لهم في اآلخرة، اآلية، والخالق: النصيب، فمن لم يكن له نصيب في اآلخرة فبأي شئ يدخل الجنة؟! وأنزل ابلمدينة الزاني ال ينكح إال زانية أو مشركة، والزانية ال ينكحها إال زان أو مشرك وحرم ذلك عىل المؤمنين، فلم يسم هللا الزاني مؤمنا وال الزانية مؤمنة، واقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم - ليس يمتري فيه أهل العلم إنه اقل :- ال يزني الزاني حين يزني وهو مؤمن إفنه إذا فعل ذلك خلع عنه االيمان كخلع القميص، ونزل ابلمدينة: والذين يرمون المحصنات - إلى قوله - وأولئك هم الفاسقون إال الذين اتبوا، فبرأه هللا ما كان مقيما عىل الفرية من أن يسمى اباليمان اقل هللا عز وجل: أفمن كان مؤمنا كمن كان افسقا ال يستون، وجعله هللا منافقا، اقل هللا: إن المنافقين هم الفاسقون، وجعله ملعوان، فقال: إن الذين يرمون المحصنات الغافالت المؤمنات لعنوا في الدنيا واآلخرة.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) - in a long hadith - said: When Allah permitted Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to leave Makkah for Medina, He revealed to him the legal punishments, the division of obligations, and informed him of the sins for which Allah has made Hell obligatory for those who commit them. He revealed regarding the explanation of the killer: "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell to abide therein, and the wrath and the curse of Allah are upon him, and a great punishment is prepared for him (Quran 4:93)." And Allah does not curse a believer. And Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, said: "Verily, Allah has cursed the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a flaming Fire wherein they will abide forever, and they will find neither a protector nor a helper (Quran And concerning the wealth of orphans, Allah revealed: "Indeed, those who devour the property of orphans unjustly are only consuming into their bellies fire. And they will be burned in a Blaze (Quran 4:10)." And concerning cheating in measurement, Allah revealed: "Woe to those who give less [than due] (Quran 83:1)." And the woe is not directed towards anyone until they are called disbelievers. Allah, the Exalted, said: "Then woe to those who disbelieve in the scene (mashad) of the great day (Quran 19:37)." And concerning the breach of covenant, Allah revealed: 'Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter.' (Quran 3:77) The share is the portion. So, if one has no portion in the Hereafter, how will they enter Paradise? And He revealed in Medina: "The adulterer does not marry except an adulteress or a polytheist, and the adulteress none marries her except an adulterer or a polytheist, and that is forbidden to the believers." (Quran 24:3) So, Allah did not call the adulterer a believer nor the adulteress a believer, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said - it is not questionable among the knowledgeable that he said: "The adulterer does not commit adultery while he is a believer. For when he does that, faith is stripped off from him as a garment is stripped off." And He revealed in Medina: "And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient, except for those who repent thereafter..." (Quran 24:4-5) So Allah exonerated what was imposed on them in the charge that they are believers. Allah, Almighty, said: "Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal." (Quran 32:18) And Allah made them hypocrites. Allah said: " Indeed, the hypocrites are the sinners”. And Allah made them cursed. So, He said: "Indeed, those who falsely accuse chaste, unaware, and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter." chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: عن الصادق (عليه السالم) اقل: ويخرج من االيمان بخمس جهات من الفعل، كلها متشابهات معروافت: الكفر، والشرك، والضالل، والفسق، وركوب الكبائر، فمعنى الكفر: كل معصية عصى هللا بها بجهة الجحد واالنكار واالستخفاف والتهاون في كل ما دق وجل، وافعله كافر، ومعناه معنى كفر من أي ملة كان ومن أي فرقة كان بعد أن يكون بهذه الصفات فهو كافر إلى أن اقل - إفن كان هو الذي مال بهواه إلى وجه من وجوه المعصية بجهة الجحود واالستخفاف والتهاون فقد كفر، وإن هو مال بهواه إلى التدين بجهة التأويل والتقليد والتسليم والرضا بقول اآلابء واألسالف فقد أشرك.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: One leaves faith through five aspects of action, all of which are similar and well-known: disbelief, polytheism, misguidance, transgression, and committing major sins. The meaning of disbelief is every disobedience to Allah through juhud (denial), inkaar (rejection), istikhfaf (belittling), and tahavan (negligence) in everything minor and major, and its doer is a disbeliever. Its meaning is the meaning of disbelief from any religion or sect, as long as he has these attributes, he is a disbeliever. - Until he said - If he is the one who inclined with his desires towards a form of disobedience through juhud (denial), istikhfaf (belittlement), and tahavan (negligence, disregard), then he has disbelieved. And if he inclined with his desires towards religious practice through ta'wil (interpretation), taqlid (imitation), tasleem (submission), and ridha (satisfaction) with the sayings of forefathers and ancestors, then he has committed shirk.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر (عليه السالم): قول هللا عز وجل: إان هديناه السبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا. اقل: إما آخذ فشاكر، وإما اترك فكافر.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): regarding Allah's words, Mighty and Majestic: "Indeed We showed him the way: be he grateful or ungrateful" [Quran, 76:3]. He said: Either he accepts it and is grateful, or he abandons it and is ungrateful.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في حديث - اقل: ال ينظر هللا إلى عبده، وال يزكيه إذا ترك فريضة من فرائض هللا، أو ارتكب كبيرة من الكبائر، اقل: قلت: ال ينظر هللا إليه؟! اقل: نعم، قد أشرك ابهلل، قلت: أشرك ابهلل؟! اقل: نعم، إن هللا أمره أبمر وأمره إبليس أبمر، فترك ما أمر هللا عز وجل وبه، وصار إلى ما أمر به إبليس، فهذا مع إبليس في الدرك السابع من النار.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith - he said: Allah does not look at His servant, nor purify him when he abandons an obligation from Allah's obligations, or commits a major sin from the major sins. He said: I said: Allah does not look at him?! He said: Yes, he has associated partners with Allah. I said: Associated partners with Allah?! He said: Yes, indeed Allah commanded him with a command and Iblis commanded him with a command, so he abandoned what Allah the Mighty and Majestic commanded him with, and followed what Iblis commanded him with, so this person will be with Iblis in the seventh level of the Fire.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: عن عبد الرحيم القصير عن أبي عبد هللا )عليه السالم( في حديث - اقل: االسالم قبل اإليمان، وهو يشارك اإليمان، إفذا أتى العبد بكبيرة من كبائر المعاصي، أو صغيرة من صغائر المعاصي التي نهى هللا عنها، كان خارجا من االيمان، واثبتا عليه اسم االسالم، إفن اتب واستغفر عاد إلى االيمان، ولم يخرجه إلى الكفر والجحود واالستحالل، وإذا اقل للحالل: هذا حرام، وللحرام: هذا حالل، ودان بذلك، فعندها يكون خارجا من اإليمان واإلسالم إلى الكفر.
englishText: From Abdul Rahim Al-Qaseer from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith - he said: Islam comes before faith, and it shares with faith, so when a servant commits a major sin from among the major sins, or a minor sin from among the minor sins which Allah has forbidden, he exits from faith while the name of Islam remains established upon him. If he repents and seeks forgiveness, he returns to faith, and it does not take him out to disbelief, denial, and considering it permissible. And when he says about the permissible: "This is forbidden," and about the forbidden: "This is permissible," and makes it his religion, then at that point he leaves faith and Islam to disbelief.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: اقل: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): أرأيت من لم يقر أبنكم في ليلة القدر كما ذكرت ولم يجحده؟ اقل: أما إذا اقمت عليه الحجة ممن يثق به في علمنا فلم يثق به فهو كافر، وأما من لم يسمع ذلك فهو في عذر حتى يسمع، ثم اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): يؤمن ابهلل ويؤمن للمؤمنين.
englishText: Narrator said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about someone who neither acknowledges your status during the Laylat al-Qadr (Night of Power) as you mentioned, nor denies it? He said: If proof has been established upon him through someone he trusts regarding our knowledge, yet he does not trust it, then he is a disbeliever. As for one who has not heard about it, he is excused until he hears it. Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: He believes in Allah and believes the believers. chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): أرأيت الراد عىل هذا االمر كالراد عليكم؟ فقال: اي أاب محمد من رد عليك هذا االمر فهو كالراد عىل رسول هللا وعىل هللا عز وجل.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Do you think that rejecting this Amr (meaning Wilayah) is like rejecting you? He said: O Abu Muhammad, whoever rejects this Amr from you is like one who rejects the Messenger of Allah and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: من اجترى عىل هللا في المعصية وارتكاب الكبائر فهو كافر، ومن نصب دينا غير دين هللا فهو مشرك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever is audacious against Allah in disobedience and committing major sins is a disbeliever, and whoever establishes a religion other than the religion of Allah is a polytheist.

chapter: Establishing Disbelief And Apostasy Through Denial Of Some Necessities And Other Matters Wherein Proof Is Established Through Reliable Transmission
arabicText: ورد توقيع عىل القاسم بن العالء: إفنه ال عذر الحد من موالينا في التشكيك فيما يؤديه عنا ثقاتنا، قد عرفوا أبان نفاوضهم سران ونحملهم إايه إليهم.
englishText: A Tawqi (directive in the form of a signed letter from the 12th Imam) was sent to AlQasim bin Al-Ala: None of our followers have any excuse to doubt what our trustworthy (thiqaah) [narrators] convey from us, as they are known to be those whom we disclose our secrets to, and whom we entrust with, to deliver them to the people. Translator: This hadith establishes trust in the transmission of religious knowledge (in the form of the hadith or akhbar) and also establishes an obligation on the Shias to accept them (the hadith/akhbar) when transmitted/narrated by the recognized trustworthy (thiqaah) individuals of the community. Our hadith are originally sourced from hundreds of "usul" (the books of hadith) of the close and trustworthy companions of the Imams. After the ghaybah of our 12th Imam, the early muhadditheen (all of whom are recognized as thiqaah) compiled them methodically into the primary canonical collections (kutub-e-araba) from where Wasa'il al-Shia is in turn sourced from.

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: لما خلق هللا العقل استنطقه، ثم اقل له: اقبل أفقبل، ثم اقل له: ادبر أفدبر، ثم اقل: وعزتي وجاللي ما خلقت خلقا هو أحب إلى منك، وال أكملتك إال فيمن أحب، أما اني إايك آمر، وإايك أنهى، وإايك أعاقب، وإايك أثيب.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When Allah created the intellect, He asked it to speak, then said to it: "Come forward," and it came forward. Then He said to it: "Go back," and it went back. Then He said: "By My Honor and Majesty, I have not created any creation more beloved to Me than you, and I have not perfected you except in those whom I love. Indeed, it is you whom I command, you whom I forbid, you whom I punish, and you whom I reward."

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: لما خلق هللا العقل اقل له: أقبل أفقبل، ثم اقل له: أدبر أفدبر، فقال: وعزتي ما خلقت خلقا أحسن منك، إايك آمر، وإايك أنهى، وإايك أثيب وإايك أعاقب.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When Allah created the intellect, He said to it: "Come forward," and it came forward. Then He said to it: "Go back," and it went back. Then He said: "By My Honor, I have not created anything more beautiful than you. It is you whom I command, you whom I forbid, you whom I reward, and you whom I punish."

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: إنما يداق هللا العباد في الحساب يوم القيامة عىل قدر ما آاتهم من العقول في الدنيا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Allah will hold His servants accountable on the Day of Judgment according to the intellect He gave them in this world.

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن الثواب عىل قدر العقل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, reward is according to the measure of intellect.

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): إذا بلغكم عن رجل حسن حال، افنظروا في حسن عقله، إفنما يجازى بعقله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When you hear of a man's good condition, then look at his good intellect, for he will only be rewarded according to his intellect.

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): لما خلق هللا العقل اقل له: أقبل أفقبل ثم اقل له: أدبر أفدبر، ثم اقل: وعزتي وجاللي ما خلقت خلقا هو أحب إلى منك، بك آخذ، وبك أعطى، وعليك أثيب.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When Allah created the intellect, He said to it: "Come forward," and it came forward. Then He said to it: "Go back," and it went back. Then He said: "By My Honor and Majesty, I have not created any creation more beloved to Me than you. Through you I take, through you I give, and upon you I bestow reward."

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: أوىح هللا إلى موسى (عليه السالم): أان أؤاخذ عبادي عىل قدر ما أعطيتهم من العقل.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Allah revealed to Moses (peace be upon him): I hold My servants accountable according to the measure of intellect I have given them.

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن هللا خلق العقل، فقال له: أقبل أفقبل، ثم اقل له. أدبر أفدبر، ثم اقل له: أقبل، ثم اقل: ال وعزتي وجاللي، ما خلقت شيئا أحب إلى منك، لك الثواب، وعليك العقاب.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah created the intellect, and said to it: "Come forward" so it came forward, then He said to it: "Go back" so it went back, then He said to it: "Come forward", then He said: "By My Honor and My Majesty, I have not created anything more beloved to Me than you. For you is the reward, and upon you is the punishment."

chapter: Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation
arabicText: وعن بعض أصحابنا، رفعه، عنهم (عليهم السالم) - في حديث :- إن هللا خلق العقل، فقال له.: أقبل أفقبل، ثم اقل له: أدبر أفدبر، فقال: وعزتي وجاللي ما خلقت شيئا أحسن منك، وأحب إلي منك، بك آخذ وبك أعطى.
englishText: And from some of our companions, raising it to them (peace be upon them) - in a hadith -: Indeed Allah created the intellect, and said to it: "Come forward" so it came forward, then He said to it: "Go back" so it went back, then He said: "By My Honor and My Majesty, I have not created anything more beautiful than you, and more beloved to Me than you. Through you I take, and through you I give." Requirement Of Intellect In Religious Obligation

chapter: Requirement Of Obligation Regarding Duties And Prohibitions Upon Reaching Puberty Or By Wet Dreams Or Growing Body Hair In General, Or Upon Males Reaching Fifteen Years And Females Reaching Nine Years, And The Recommendation Of Training Children In Worship Before That  Hadith - 71 أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن أوالد المسلمين موسومون عند هللا، شافع ومشفع، إفذا بلغوا اثنتي عشرة سنة كتبت لهم الحسنات، إفذا بلغوا الحلم كتبت عليهم السيئات. From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The children of Muslims are marked by Allah, as intercessors and those interceded for. When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر (عليه السالم): متى يجب عىل الغالم أن يؤخذ ابلحدود التامة، وتقام عليه، ويؤخذ بها؟ اقل: إذا خرج عنه اليتم وأدرك، قلت: فلذلك حد يعرف به؟ فقال: إذا احتلم، أو بلغ خمس عشرة سنة، أو أشعر أو أنبت قبل ذلك، أقيمت عليه الحدود التامة، واخذ بها وأخذت له، قلت: افلجارية، متى تجب عليها الحدود التامة وتؤخذ بها، ويؤخذ لها اقل: إن الجارية ليست مثل الغالم، إن الجارية إذا تزوجت ودخل بها ولها تسع سنين ذهب عنها اليتم، ودفع إليها مالها، وجاز أمرها في الشراء والبيع، وأقيمت عليها الحدود التامة، واخذ لها بها، اقل: والغالم ال يجوز أمره في الشراء والبيع، وال يخرج من اليتم، حتى يبلغ خمس عشرة، أو يحتلم أو يشعر أو ينبت قبل ذلك.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When do complete legal punishments become obligatory upon a boy and when are they implemented on him and applied to him? He said: When orphanhood ends for him and he matures. I asked: Is there a specific sign for that? He said: When he has a wet dream, or reaches fifteen years, or grows hair, or develops pubic hair before that, the complete legal punishments are implemented on him and applied to and for him. I asked: And for the girl, when do complete legal punishments become obligatory upon her and applied to and for her? He said: The girl is not like the boy. When the girl marries and is consummated with at nine years, her orphanhood ends, her property is handed to her, her transactions in buying and selling become valid, and complete legal punishments are implemented on her and applied for her. He said: As for the boy, his transactions in buying and selling are not valid, and his orphanhood does not end until he reaches fifteen, or has a wet dream, or grows hair, or develops pubic hair before that.

From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The children of Muslims are marked by Allah, as intercessors and those interceded for. When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: الجارية إذا بلغت تسع سنين ذهب عنها اليتم، وزوجت، وأقيمت عليها الحدود التامة لها وعليها.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When a girl reaches nine years, her orphanhood ends, she can be married, and complete legal punishments are implemented for and against her.

arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - في غالم صغير لم يدرك ابن عشر سنين، زان ابمرأة محصنة، اقل: ال ترجم، ألن الذي زان بها ليس بمدرك، ولو كان مدركا رجمت.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - regarding a young boy who had not reached maturity at ten years who committed adultery with a married woman, he said: She is not stoned, because the one who committed adultery with her is not mature, and if he were mature she would be stoned.

englishText: From Isma'il ibn Ja'far - in a hadith - that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) consummated marriage with Aisha when she was ten years old, and he would not consummate marriage with a girl until she became a woman.

arabicText: وعن عيل بن الفضل، أنه كتب إلى أبي الحسن (عليه السالم): ما حد البلوغ؟ اقل: ما أوجب عىل المؤمنين الحدود.
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Fadhl, that he wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): What is the limit of puberty? He said: What makes legal punishments obligatory upon the believers.

When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه (عليه السالم) أنه اقل: عرضهم رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) يومئذ - يعني بني قريظة - عىل العاانت، فمن وجده أنبت قتله، ومن لم يجده أنبت ألحقه ابلذراري.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) examined them that day - meaning Bani Qurayza - for pubic hair, so whoever he found had grown it was executed, and whoever had not grown it was classified with the children.

When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه عن آابئه (عليهم السالم) - في وصية النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) لعيل (عليه السالم) - اقل: اي عيل، ال يتم بعد احتالم.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them) - in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him) - he said: O Ali, there is no orphanhood after puberty.

When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: اقل(عليه السالم): وفي خبر آخر عىل الصبي إذا احتلم الصيام، وعىل المرأة إذا حاضت الصيام.
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: And in another narration, fasting becomes obligatory upon the boy when he reaches puberty, and upon the woman when she menstruates.

chapter: Requirement Of Obligation Regarding Duties And Prohibitions Upon Reaching Puberty Or By Wet Dreams Or Growing Body Hair In General, Or Upon Males Reaching Fifteen Years And Females Reaching Nine Years, And The Recommendation Of Training Children In Worship Before That  Hadith - 71 أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن أوالد المسلمين موسومون عند هللا، شافع ومشفع، إفذا بلغوا اثنتي عشرة سنة كتبت لهم الحسنات، إفذا بلغوا الحلم كتبت عليهم السيئات. From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The children of Muslims are marked by Allah, as intercessors and those interceded for. When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: أتى عمر ابمرأة مجنونة قد زنت أفمر برجمها، فقال عيل (عليه السالم): أما علمت أن القلم يرفع عن ثالثة: عن الصبي حتى يحتلم، وعن المجنون حتى يفيق، وعن النائم حتى يستيقظ؟!
englishText: Umar was brought a mentally ill woman who had committed adultery and he ordered her stoning, so Ali (peace be upon him) said: Don't you know that the pen (judgement) is lifted from three: from the child until he reaches puberty, from the insane until he regains sanity, and from the sleeping until he wakes up?!

When they reach twelve years, good deeds are recorded for them, and when they reach puberty, bad deeds are recorded against them.
arabicText: سألت أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الغالم متى تجب عليه الصالة؟ فقال (عليه السالم): إذا أتى عليه ثالث عشرة سنة، إفن احتلم قبل ذلك فقد وجبت عليه الصالة، وجرى عليه القلم، والجارية مثل ذلك إن أتى لها ثالث عشرة سنة، أو حاضت قبل ذلك، فقد وجبت عليها الصالة، وجرى عليها القلم. أقول: هذا محمول عىل حصول االحتالم أو اإلنبات للغالم في الثالث عشرة سنة، وعدم عقل الجارية قبلها، لما مضى، وأيتي ما يدل عىل ذلك وعىل التمرين في محله. ويمكن حمل حكم الغالم عىل االستحباب وحكم الجارية عىل أن مفهوم الشرط غير مراد.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about when prayer becomes obligatory upon the boy? He (peace be upon him) said: When he reaches thirteen years, and if he reaches puberty before that then prayer becomes obligatory upon him and the pen flows [accountability begins], and the girl is similar if she reaches thirteen years, or menstruates before that, then prayer becomes obligatory upon her and the pen flows. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as the occurrence of puberty or growth of pubic hair for the boy at thirteen years, and the girl's lack of maturity before it, based on what preceded, and what will come indicating that and about training at its proper place. chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: عيل بن الحسين (عليه السالم) اقل: ال عمل إال بنية.
englishText: Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: There is no deed except with intention.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): ال قول إال بعمل، وال قول و عمل إال بنية، وال قول و عمل و نية إال بإصابة السنة.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no saying except with action, and no saying and action except with intention, and no saying and action and intention except by following (isaabat, also means striking) the Sunnah.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: عيل بن الحسين (عليه السالم) اقل: ال حسب لقرشي وال عربي إال بتواضع، وال كرم إال بتقوى، وال عمل إال بنية، وال عبادة إال بتفقه.
englishText: Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: There is no nobility for a Qurayshi or an Arab except through humility, and no honor except through piety, and no deed except with intention, and no worship except with understanding of religion.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): ال قول إال بعمل ونية والقول وعمل إال بنية.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no saying except with action and intention, and no saying and action except with intention.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، اقل: إن هللا يحشر الناس عىل نياتهم يوم القيامة.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed Allah will gather people according to their intentions on the Day of Judgment.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) أنه اقل: األعمال ابلنيات.
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Deeds are judged by intentions.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: أنه اقل: إنما األعمال ابلنيات، وإنما المرئ ما نوى.
englishText: He said: Indeed, deeds are only by intentions, and for every person is what he intended.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: عن رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) في وصيته له، اقل: اي أاب ذر ليكن لك في كل شئ نية، حتى في النوم واالكل.
englishText: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in his advice to him, he said: O Abu Dharr, you should have an intention in everything, even in sleeping and eating.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: عن الرضا عن آابئه (عليهم السالم)، اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): ال حسب إال ابلتواضع، وال كرم إال ابلتقوى، وال عمل إال بنية.
englishText: From Al-Ridha from his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no nobility except through humility, no honor except through piety, and no deed except with intention.

chapter: Obligation Of Intention In Obligatory Acts Of Worship And Its Requirement Therein
arabicText: عن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم - في حديث - اقل: إنما األعمال ابلنيات، ولكل امرء ما نوى، فمن غزى ابتغاء ما عند هللا فقد وقع أجره عىل هللا عز وجل، ومن غزى يريد عرض الدنيا أو نوى عقاال، لم يكن له إال ما نوى.
englishText: Narrated from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, who said: Actions are only by intentions, and each person will have what they intended. So whoever emigrated seeking what is with Allah, then their reward is incumbent upon Allah, the Mighty and Sublime. And whoever emigrated seeking worldly gains or intending to acquire a camel's tether, they will have nothing except what they intended. chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، اقل: إن العبد المؤمن الفقير ليقول: اي رب ارزقني حتى أفعل كذا وكذا من البر ووجوه الخير، إفذا علم هللا ذلك منه بصدق نية كتب هللا له من االجر مثل ما يكتب له لو عمله، إن هللا واسع كريم.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, when a believing servant who is poor says, "O Lord, grant me sustenance so that I may do such and such acts of righteousness and good deeds," then if Allah knows the sincerity of his intention, Allah writes for him the same reward as if he had actually done those deeds. Indeed, Allah is All-Encompassing, Most Generous.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن حد العبادة التي إذا فعلها افعلها كان مؤداي؟ فقال: حسن النية ابلطاعة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the minimum level of worship that, when performed by someone, would be considered sufficient. He said: Good intention with obedience.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): نية المؤمن خير من عمله، ونية الكافر شر من عمله، وكل عامل يعمل عىل نيته.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The intention of a believer is better than his action, and the intention of a disbeliever is worse than his action, and every doer acts according to his intention.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): إنما خلد أهل النار في النار، الن نياتهم كانت في الدنيا أن لو خلدوا فيها أن يعصوا هللا أبدا، وإنما خلد أهل الجنة في الجنة ألن نياتهم كانت في الدنيا أن لو بقوا فيها أن يطيعوا هللا أبدا، فبالنيات خلد هؤالء وهؤالء، ثم تال قوله تعالى: قل كل يعمل عىل شاكلته اقل: عىل نيته.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The people of Hell were made eternal in Hell because their intentions in this world were such that if they were to live forever in it, they would disobey Allah forever. And the people of Paradise were made eternal in Paradise because their intentions in this world were such that if they were to remain in it, they would obey Allah forever. So by their intentions these and those were made eternal. Then he recited the words of the Almighty: "Say, each works (acts) according to his disposition" [Quran, 17:84]. [This means] he said: According to his intention.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): والنية أفضل من العمل، أال وإن النية هي العمل، ثم تال. قوله تعالى: قل كل يعمل عىل شاكلته, يعنى عىل نيته.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): And the intention is better than the action. Indeed, the intention is the action itself. Then he recited the words of the Almighty: "Say, each works (acts) according to his disposition [Quran, 17:84]," meaning according to his intention.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: عن أحدهما (عليه السالم)، اقل: إن هللا تبارك وتعالى جعل آلدم في ذريته أن من هم بحسنة فلم يعملها كتبت له حسنة، ومن هم بحسنة وعملها كتبت له عشرا، ومن هم بسيئة لم تكتب عليه، ومن هم بها وعملها كتبت عليه سيئة.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon him), he said: Indeed Allah blessed and exalted made for Adam in his progeny that whoever intends a good deed but doesn't do it, a good deed is recorded for him. And whoever intends a good deed and does it, ten are recorded for him. And whoever intends an evil deed but doesn't do it, it is not recorded against him. And whoever intends it and does it, one evil deed is recorded against him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، اقل: إن المؤمن ليهم ابلحسنة وال يعمل بها فتكتب له حسنة، وإن هو عملها كتبت له عشر حسنات، وإن المؤمن ليهم ابلسيئة أن يعملها فال يعملها فال تكتب عليه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Indeed a believer intends a good deed but doesn't do it, so a good deed is recorded for him. And if he does it, ten good deeds are recorded for him. And indeed a believer intends an evil deed to do it but doesn't do it, so it is not recorded against him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم): إن هللا تعالى اقل الدم (عليه السالم): اي آدم، جعلت لك أن من هم من ذريتك بسيئة لم تكتب عليه، إفن عملها كتبت عليه سيئة، ومن هم منهم بحسنة إفن لم يعملها كتبت له حسنة، وإن هو عملها كتبت له عشرا.
englishText: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It From Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him): Allah Almighty said to Adam (peace be upon him): O Adam, I have decreed for you that whoever among your offspring intends an evil deed, it will not be recorded against them, but if they do it, one evil deed will be recorded. And whoever intends a good deed but does not do it, one good deed will be recorded, and if they do it, ten good deeds will be recorded.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى (عليه السالم) - في حديث - أنه اقل: رحم هللا فالان، اي عيل لم تشهد جنازته؟ قلت: ال، قد كنت أحب أن أشهد جنازة مثله، فقال: قد كتب لك ثواب ذلك بما نويت.
englishText: From Abi Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: May Allah have mercy on so-and-so. O Ali, why didn't you attend his funeral? I said: No, I would have loved to attend the funeral of someone like him. He said: You have been recorded the reward for that due to your intention.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا هم العبد ابلسيئة لم تكتب عليه، وإذا هم بحسنة كتبت له.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When a servant intends an evil deed, it is not recorded against them, and when they intend a good deed, it is recorded for them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): من حسنت نيته زاد هللا تعالى في رزقه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever has good intentions, Allah Almighty increases their sustenance.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: سألنا أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن قول هللا عز وجل: خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة أقوة في األبدان، أو قوة في القلب؟ اقل: فيهما جميعا.
englishText: We asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about Allah's saying: "Take what We have given you with determination" [Surah Al-Baqarah: 63], is it determination in body or determination in heart? He said: In both of them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Good Intention And Determination Upon It
arabicText: سأل أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم): ما العبادة؟ فقال: حسن النية ابلطاعة من الوجه الذي يطاع هللا منه. وفي حد آخر: اقل: حسن النية ابلطاعة من الوجه الذي أمر به.
englishText: He asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What is worship? He said: Good intention in obedience from the aspect through which Allah is obeyed. And in another definition: He said: Good intention in obedience from the aspect which He commanded.
