englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: How ugly is poverty after wealth, and how ugly is sin after piety, and uglier than that is one who worships Allah and then abandons his worship.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل لبعض ولده: اي بنى عليك ابلجد، ال. تخرجن نفسك من حد التقصير في عبادة هللا عز وجل وطاعته، إفن هللا ال يعبد حق عبادته.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), he said: He said to one of his children: O my son, you must be diligent. Do not let yourself fall short in worshipping Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and in obeying Him, for Allah cannot be worshipped as He truly deserves to be worshipped.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن (عليه السالم) اقل: أكثر من أن تقول: اللهم ال تجعلني من المعارين، وال تخرجني من التقصير، اقل: قلت: أما المعارون فقد عرفت، أن الرجل يعار الدين، ثم يخرج منه، فما معنى: ال تخرجني من التقصير؟ فقال: كل عمل تريد به هللا عز وجل فكن فيه مقصرا عند نفسك، إفن الناس كلهم في أعمالهم فيما بينهم وبين هللا مقصرون، اال من عصمه هللا عز وجل.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: Say often: "O Allah, do not make me among those who are borrowed, and do not remove me from falling short." I said: As for those who are borrowed, I know that it refers to a man who is lent the religion and then leaves it. But what is the meaning of "do not remove me from falling short"? He said: In every deed you intend for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, consider yourself falling short in it. For all people, in their deeds between them and Allah, are falling short, except those whom Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has protected.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: اقل: سمعت أاب الحسن (عليه السالم)، يقول: ال تستكثروا كثير الخير، وال تستقلوا قليل الذنوب.
englishText: He said: I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: Do not consider much good as too much, and do not consider few sins as insignificant.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر (عليه السالم): اي جابر ال أخرجك هللا من النقص والتقصير.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: O Jabir, may Allah not remove you from deficiency and shortcoming.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم)، اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): اقل هللا عز وجل: ال يتكل العاملون لي عىل أعمالهم التي يعملونها لثوابي، إفنهم لو اجتهدوا وأتعبوا أنفسهم، أعمارهم في عبادتي، كانوا مقصرين، غير ابلغين في عبادتهم كنه عبادتي، فيما يطلبون عندي من كرامتي، والنعيم في جناتي (٢)، ورفيع الدرجات العىل في جواري، ولكن برحمتي فليثقوا، وفضيل فليرجوا، وإلى حسن الظن بي فليطمئنوا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: Those who work for Me should not rely on their deeds which they do for My reward, for even if they strive and exhaust themselves throughout their lives in My worship, they would still be falling short, not reaching the essence of My worship in what they seek from Me of My honor, blessings in My gardens, and the elevation of high ranks in My proximity. Rather, let them trust in My mercy, hope for My grace, and be reassured by having good thoughts about Me.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: ثالث اقصمات الظهر: رجل استكثر عمله، ونسي ذنوبه، وأعجب برأيه.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Three things break the back: a man who thinks highly of his deeds, forgets his sins, and is impressed with his own opinion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Acknowledging Shortcomings In Worship
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل إبليس: إذا استمكنت من ابن آدم في ثالث لم أابل ما عمل، إفنه غير مقبول منه: إذ استكثر عمله، ونسي ذنبه، ودخله العجب.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Iblis said: When I get control over the son of Adam in three things, I don't care what he does, for it will not be accepted from him: when he considers his deeds too much, forgets his sin, and becomes selfconceited (filled with self-admiration).

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): اقل هللا تعالى: إن من عبادي المؤمنين لمن يجتهد في عبادتي، فيقوم من راقده ولذيذ وساده، فيجتهد لي الليالي، فيتعب نفسه في عبادتي، أفضربه ابلنعاس الليلة والليلتين نظرا مني له، وإبقاء عليه، فينام حتى يصبح، فيقوم وهو ماقت لنفسه زارئ، عليها، ولو أخيل بينه وبين ما يريد من عبادتي لدخله العجب من ذلك، فيصيره العجب إلى الفتنة أبعماله، فيأتيه من ذلك ما فيه هالكه لعجبه أبعماله، ورضاه عن نفسه، حتى يظن أنه قد افق العابدين، وجاز في عبادته حد التقصر، فيتباعد مني عند ذلك، وهو يظن أنه يتقرب إلى.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah the Exalted said: Among My believing servants are those who strive in My worship, rising from their sleep and comfortable beds, exerting themselves for Me at nights, tiring themselves in My worship. So I cause drowsiness to overcome them for one or two nights out of My care and preservation for them. They sleep until morning, then rise while hating and finding fault with themselves. If I were to leave them to what they desire of My worship, self-admiration would enter them from that, and this self-admiration would lead them to trial through their deeds, bringing them destruction due to their self-admiration and self-satisfaction, until they think they have surpassed the worshippers and exceeded the bounds of shortcoming in their worship. Thus they distance themselves from Me while thinking they are drawing closer to Me.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: اقل: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) الرجل يعمل العمل وهو خائف مشفق، ثم يعمل شيئا من البر فيدخله شبه العجب به، فقال: هو في حاله األولى وهو خائف أحسن حاال منه في حال عجبه.
englishText: He said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who performs a deed while being fearful and apprehensive, then does something good and experiences a kind of self-admiration with it. He said: His first state when he was fearful is better than his state of self-admiration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا(عليه السالم)، اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) في حديث: اقل موسى بن عمران (عليه السالم) إلبليس: أخبرني ابلذنب الذي إذا أذنبه ابن آدم استحوذت عليه اقل: إذا أعجبته نفسه، واستكثر عمله، وصغر في عينه ذنبه، واقل: اقل هللا عز وجل لداود: اي داود، بشر المذنبين، وأنذر الصديقين، اقل كيف أبشر المذنبين، وأنذر الصديقين؟ اقل: اي داود، بشر المذنبين أني أقبل التوبة وأعفو عن الذنب، وأنذر الصديقين أن ال يعجبوا أبعمالهم، إفنه ليس عبد أنصبه للحساب إال هلك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said in a hadith: Moses son of Imran (peace be upon him) said to Iblis: Tell me about the sin which when committed by the son of Adam gives you control over him. He said: When he admires himself, considers his deeds abundant, and his sin appears small in his eyes. And he said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic said to David: O David, give glad tidings to the sinners and warn the truthful ones. He said: How do I give glad tidings to the sinners and warn the truthful ones? He said: O David, give glad tidings to the sinners that I accept repentance and pardon sins, and warn the truthful ones not to become self-admired with their deeds, for there is no servant whom I subject to reckoning except that he is ruined.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن الرجل ليذنب الذنب فيندم عليه، ويعمل العمل فيسره ذلك، فيتراىخ عن حاله تلك، فالن يكون عىل حالة تلك خير له مما دخل فيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man may commit a sin and regret it, and perform a deed and become pleased with it, then he becomes lax in that state. Being in his first state is better for him than what he has entered into.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن (عليه السالم) اقل: سألته عن العجب الذي يفسد العمل؟ فقال: العجب درجات، منها أن يزين للعبد سوء عمله فيراه حسنا فيعجبه، ويحسب أنه يحسن صنعا، ومنها أن يؤمن العبد بربه، فيمن عىل هللا عز وجل، وهلل عليه فيه المن.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I asked him about the self-admiration that corrupts deeds. He said: Self-admiration has levels. Among them is that a servant's evil deed is adorned for him so he sees it as good and admires it, thinking he is doing well. And among them is that a servant believes in his Lord, then considers it a favor upon Allah the Mighty and Majestic, while the favor in it belongs to Allah.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم): إعجاب المرء بنفسه دليل عىل ضعف عقله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: A person's self-admiration is evidence of his weak intellect (aql).

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إن هللا علم أن الذنب خير للمؤمن من العجب ولوال ذلك ما ابتىل مؤمن بذنب أبدا.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Allah knows that sin is better for the believer than self-admiration, and were it not for that, no believer would ever be tested with sin.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: من دخله العجب هلك.
englishText: From Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever is afflicted with selfadmiration is ruined.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: أتى عالم عابدا فقال له: كيف صالتك؟ فقال: مثيل يسئل عن صالته، وأان أعبد هللا منذ كذا وكذا؟! اقل: فكيف بكاؤك؟ فقال أبيك حتى تجرى دموعي، فقال له العالم: إفن ضحكك - وأنت خائف - أفضل من بكاؤك وأنت مدل، إن المدل ال يصعد من عمله شئ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A scholar came to a worshipper and asked him: How is your prayer? The worshipper replied: Someone like me is being asked about his prayer, while I have been worshipping Allah for so long?! He asked: How is your crying? He said: I cry until my tears flow. The scholar said to him: Your laughter while you are fearful is better than your crying while you are boastful, for indeed the boastful person, none of his deeds ascend (to Allah).

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أحدهما (عليهما السالم)، اقل: دخل رجالن المسجد أحدهما عابد واآلخر افسق، فخرجا من المسجد والفاسق صديق، والعابد افسق، وذلك أنه يدخل العابد المسجد مدال بعبادته، يدل بها فتكون فكرته في ذلك، وتكون فكرة الفاسق في التندم عىل فسقه، ويستغفر هللا عز وجل مما صنع من الذنوب.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both), he said: Two men entered the mosque, one of them was a worshipper and the other was a sinner. They left the mosque with the sinner becoming righteous and the worshipper becoming a sinner. This is because Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And... the worshipper entered the mosque proud of his worship, showing it off, and his thoughts were focused on that, while the sinner's thoughts were on regretting his sins and seeking forgiveness from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for the sins he committed.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: إن هللا فوض األمر إلى ملك من المالئكة، فخلق سبع سماوات وسبع أرضين، فلما أن رأى أن األشياء قد انقادت له، اقل: من مثيل؟ أفرسل هللا إليه نويرة من النار، قلت: وما النويرة؟ اقل: انر مثل األنملة، افستقبلها بجميع ما خلق فتخيل لذلك حتى وصلت إلى نفسه لما دخله العجب.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Allah delegated authority to one of the angels, and he created seven heavens and seven earths. When he saw that things had submitted to him, he said: Who is like me? So Allah sent to him a tiny flame of fire. I asked: What is the tiny flame? He said: A fire the size of a fingertip. It confronted everything he had created, and he was frightened by that until it reached his own self when self-admiration had entered him.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا، أو عيل بن الحسين (عليهما السالم)، اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): ثالث مهلكات: شح مطاع، وهوى متبع، وإعجاب المرء بنفسه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, or Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Three things are destructive: obeyed stinginess, followed desires, and a person's self-admiration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: ثالث موبقات: شح مطاع، وهوى متبع، وإعجاب المرء بنفسه.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Three are destructive: obeyed stinginess, followed desires, and a person's self-admiration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليهم السالم)، في وصية النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) ألمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم)، اقل: ال مال أعود من العقل، وال وحدة أوحش من العجب.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them), in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), who said: No wealth is more beneficial than intellect, and no loneliness is more desolate than self-conceit.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن آابئه (عليهم السالم) - في وصية النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) لعيل (عليه السالم) - اقل: اي عيل ثالث مهلكات: شح مطاع، وهوى متبع، وإعجاب المرء بنفسه.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) - in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him) - who said: O Ali, three things are destructive: obeyed miserliness, followed desires, and a person's self-admiration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن الصادق (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: وإن كان الممر عىل الصراط حقا افلعجب لماذا؟!
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: And if the passage over the Sirat (bridge) is true, then why the self-admiration (ujb)?!

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم)، عن جبرئيل - في حديث - اقل: اقل هللا تبارك وتعالى: ما يتقرب إلى عبدي بمثل أداء ما افترضت عليه، وإن من عبادي المؤمنين لمن يريد الباب من العبادة أفكفه عنه لئال يدخله عجب فيفسده.
englishText: From the Prophet (peace be upon him), from Gabriel - in a hadith - he said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: My servant does not draw near to Me with anything more beloved to Me than the religious duties I have enjoined upon him, and indeed among My believing servants are those who desire a certain act of worship, but I prevent them from it lest self-admiration enter their hearts and corrupt them.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن عيل بن محمد الهادي، (عليهم السالم)، اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: من دخله العجب هلك.
englishText: From Ali bin Muhammad al-Hadi, (peace be upon them), who said: Amir alMu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is afflicted by self-admiration is ruined.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن الصادق، (عليهم السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): لوال أن الذنب خير من العجب ما خال هللا بين عبده المؤمن وبين ذنب أبدا.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon them), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: If sin were not better than self-admiration, Allah would never leave His believing servant between himself and sin. Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And...

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن أحدهما (عليهما السالم)، اقل: إن هللا تعالى يقول: إن من عبادي لمن يسألني الشئ من طاعتي ألحبه أفصرف ذلك عنه لكيال يعجبه عمله.
englishText: From one of them both (peace be upon them), he said: Allah the Exalted says: Among My servants are those who ask Me for something from My obedience because I love them, so I turn that away from them lest they become conceited with their deeds.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): ثالث منجيات: خوف هللا في السر والعالنية، والعدل في الرضا والغضب، والقصد في الغنى والفقر، وثالث مهلكات: هوى متبع، وشح مطاع، وإعجاب المرء بنفسه.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Three things are salvific: fearing Allah in private and public, justice in contentment and anger, and moderation in wealth and poverty. And three things are destructive: following desires, obeying greed, and a person's self-admiration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: في (نهج البالغة) عن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم اقل: سيئة تسوؤك خير عند هللا من حسنة تعجبك.
englishText: In Nahj al-Balagha, from Amir al-Mu'minin peace be upon him, he said: A bad deed that saddens you is better in the sight of Allah than a good deed that makes you proud.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: واقل (عليه السالم): اإلعجاب يمنع االزدايد.
englishText: And he (peace be upon him) said: Self-admiration prevents increase.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: واقل (عليه السالم): عجب المرء بنفسه أحد حساد عقله.
englishText: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) said: A person's self-admiration is one of the enviers of his intellect.

chapter: Prohibition Of Self-Admiration, Being Pleased With One's Deeds, And Showing Them Off
arabicText: عن الرضا، عن عيل (عليهم السالم)، اقل: الملوك حكام عىل الناس، والعلم حاكم عليهم، وحسبك من العلم أن تخشى هللا، وحسبك من الجهل أن تعجب بعلمك.
englishText: From Al-Ridha, from Ali (peace be upon them), he said: Kings are rulers over people, and knowledge is a ruler over them, and it is sufficient knowledge for you to fear Allah, and it is sufficient ignorance for you to be impressed with your own knowledge.

chapter: Permissibility Of Feeling Joy In Worship Without Self-Conceit, And The Ruling On The Occurrence Of Self-Conceit During Prayer
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): من سرته حسنته وساءته سيئته فهو مؤمن.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is pleased by his good deed and saddened by his bad deed is a believer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Feeling Joy In Worship Without Self-Conceit, And The Ruling On The Occurrence Of Self-Conceit During Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: سئل النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) عن خيار العباد؟ فقال: الذين إذا أحسنوا استبشروا، وإذا أساؤا استغفروا، وإذا أعطوا شكروا، وإذا ابتلوا صبروا وإذا غضبوا غفروا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about the best of servants? He said: Those who when they do good they feel glad, and when they do wrong they seek forgiveness, and when they are given they show gratitude, and when they are tested they show patience, and when they become angry they forgive.

chapter: Permissibility Of Feeling Joy In Worship Without Self-Conceit, And The Ruling On The Occurrence Of Self-Conceit During Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: قيل له وأان حاضر: الرجل يكون في صالته خاليا فيدخله العجب، فقال: إذا كان أول صالته بنية يريد بها ربه فال يضره ما دخله بعد ذلك، فليمض في صالته، وليخسأ الشيطان.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked while I was present: A man is alone in his prayer and pride enters him. He said: If the beginning of his prayer was with an intention seeking his Lord, then whatever enters him after that does not harm him, so let him continue in his prayer, and let Satan be driven away.

chapter: Permissibility Of Feeling Joy In Worship Without Self-Conceit, And The Ruling On The Occurrence Of Self-Conceit During Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): من سرته حسنته وساءته سيئته فهو مؤمن.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever is pleased by his good deed and saddened by his bad deed is a believer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Taqiyyah In Acts Of Worship, And Its Obligation When Fearing Harm
arabicText: عن عيل (عليه السالم)، اقل: وأما الرخصة التي صاحبها فيها ابلخيار إفن هللا نهى المؤمن أن يتخذ الكافر وليا، ثم من عليه بإطالق الرخصة له عند التقية في الظاهر أن يصوم بصيامه، ويفطر بإفطاره، ويصيل بصالته، ويعمل بعلمه، ويظهر له استعمال ذلك موسعا عليه فيه، وعليه أن يدين هللا تعالى في الباطن بخالف ما يظهر لمن يخافه من المخالفين المستولين عىل األمة، اقل هللا تعالى: ال يتخذ المؤمنون الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين، ومن يفعل ذلك فليس من هللا في شئ إال أن تتقوا منهم تقاة ويحذركم هللا نفسه فهذه رحمة تفضل هللا بها عىل المؤمنين رحمة لهم، ليستعملوها عند التقية في الظاهر، واقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): إن هللا يحب أن يؤخذ برخصه كما يحب أن يؤخذ بعزائمه.
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him), he said: As for the concession in which one has a choice, Allah has forbidden the believer from taking the disbeliever as an ally. Then He granted him the permission during taqiyyah to outwardly fast when they fast, break fast when they break fast, pray when they pray, and act according to their knowledge, and show them that he follows these practices with ease, while inwardly worshipping Allah differently from what he shows to those opponents he fears who have authority over the community. Allah the Most High said [Let not the believers take the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers. And whoever does that has nothing with Allah, except when taking precaution against them in prudence] [Quran, 3:28]. This is a mercy that Allah has bestowed upon the believers as mercy for them, to practice it during taqiyyah outwardly. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed Allah loves that His concessions be taken just as He loves that His strict commands be taken.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل:أجهدت في العبادة - وأان شاب فقال لي أبي: اي بنى! دون ما أراك تصنع، إفن هللا عز وجل إذا أحب عبدا رضى منه ابليسير.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I exerted myself in worship while I was young, so my father said to me: O my son! Do less than what I see you doing, for when Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, loves a servant, He is pleased with little from him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: وابإلسناد عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ال تكرهوا إلى أنفسكم العبادة.
englishText: Through the same chain from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not make worship hateful to yourselves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: مربى أبي - وأان ابلطواف وأان حدث وقد اجتهدت في العبادة، فرآني وأان أتصاب عراقء فقال لي: اي جعفر اي بنى إن هللا إذا أحب عبدا يدخله الجنة، ورضى عنه ابليسير.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father passed by me while I was performing tawaf when I was young and I had exerted myself in worship. He saw me dripping with sweat and said to me: O Ja'far, O my son, when Allah loves a servant, He admits him to Paradise and is pleased with little from him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: اقل: سمعت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) يقول: إن هللا إذا أحب عبدا فعمل عمال قليال جزاه ابلقليل الكثير، ولم يتعاظمه أن يجزى ابلقليل الكثير له.
englishText: He said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When Allah loves a servant who does a small deed, He rewards the small with much, and it is not too great for Him to give much reward for little.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): أال إن لكل عبادة شرة ثم تصير إلى فترة، فمن صارت شرة عبادته إلى سنتي فقد اهتدى، ومن خالف سنتي فقد ضل، وكان عمله في تبار، أما أني أصيل، وأانم وأصوم، وأفطر وأضحك، وأبيك، فمن رغب عن منهايج وسنتي فليس منى، واقل: كفى ابلموت موعظة، وكفى ابليقين غنى، وكفى ابلعبادة شغال.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, every worship has a period of enthusiasm which then turns to fatigue. So whoever's enthusiasm in worship turns to my way has been guided, and whoever opposes my way (sunnah) has gone astray and his deeds are in ruin. As for me, I pray and sleep, fast and break fast, laugh and cry. So whoever disdains my method and my sunnah is not from me. And he said: Death is sufficient as an admonition, certainty is sufficient as wealth, and worship is sufficient as an occupation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): إن هذا الدين متين أفوغلوا فيه برفق، وال تكرهوا عبادة هللا إلى عباد هللا، فتكونوا كالراكب المنبت الذي السفرا قطع، وال ظهرا أبقى.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed this religion is strong, so delve into it gently, and do not make Allah's worship hateful to Allah's servants, lest you become like the exhausted rider who neither completed his journey nor preserved his mount.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): اي عيل، إن هذا الدين متين أفوغل فيه برفق، وال تبغض إلى نفسك عبادة ربك، إن المنبت يعنى - المفرط - ال ظهرا أبقى، وال أرضا قطع، أفعمل عمل من يرجو أن يموت هرما، واحذر حذر من يتخوف أن يموت غدا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali, indeed this religion is strong, so delve into it gently, and do not make yourself hate the worship of your Lord. Indeed, the one who exhausts himself - meaning the excessive one - neither keeps his mount nor crosses the land. So perform deeds like one who hopes to die of old age, and be cautious like one who fears dying tomorrow.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: كان أبي يقول: ما من أحد أبغض إلى هللا عز وجل من رجل يقال له: كان رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) يفعل كذا وكذا، فيقول: ال يعذبني هللا عىل أن أجتهد في الصالة والصوم، كأنه يرى أن رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) ترك شيئا من الفضل عجزا عنه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - said: My father used to say: There is no one more hateful to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, than a man who is told: "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to do such and such," and he replies: "Allah will not punish me for striving in prayer and fasting," as if he sees that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) left something virtuous due to inability.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness
arabicText: عن عبد هللا، عن عيل (عليه السالم) اقل: اقتصاد في سنة خير من اجتهاد في بدعة، ثم اقل: تعلموا ممن علم فعمل.
englishText: From Abdullah, from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Moderation in following the Sunnah is better than striving hard in innovation (bid'ah), then he said: Learn from those who have knowledge and (those who) act upon it. Recommendation Of Moderation In Worship When Fearing Weariness

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) يقول: إذا هم أحدكم بخير فال يؤخره إفن العبد ربما صىل الصالة، أو صام اليوم، فيقال له: اعمل ما شئت بعدها فقد غفر لك.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: If one of you intends to do good, do not delay it, for sometimes a servant prays a prayer or fasts a day, and it is said to him: Do what you wish after this, for you have been forgiven.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: كان أبي يقول: إذا هممت بخير فبادر، إفنك ال تدري ما يحدث.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father used to say: When you intend to do good, hasten to it, for you do not know what may happen.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: اقل: سمعت أاب جعفر عليه السالم يقول: إن هللا ثقل الخير عىل أهل الدنيا كثقله في موازينهم يوم القيامة،. وإن هللا خفف الشر عىل أهل الدنيا كخفته في موازينهم يوم القيامة.
englishText: He said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed Allah made good deeds heavy upon the people of this world just as they will be heavy in their scales on the Day of Judgment, and indeed Allah made evil light upon the people of this world just as it will be light in their scales on the Day of Judgment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): افتتحوا نهاركم بخير، وأملوا عىل حفظتكم في أوله خيرا، وفى آخره خيرا، يغفر لكم ما بين ذلك إنشاء هللا.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Begin your day with good, and dictate good to your record keepers at its beginning and at its end, Allah willing, what is between them will be forgiven.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): إن هللا يحب من الخير ما يعجل.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed Allah loves good deeds that are hastened.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا هممت بشئ من الخير فال تؤخره، إفن هللا عز وجل ربما اطلع عىل العبد وهو عىل شئ من الطاعة، فيقول: وعزتي وجاللي، ال أعذبك بعدها أبدا، وإذا هممت بسيئة فال تعملها، إفنه ربما اطلع هللا عىل العبد وهو عىل شئ من المعصية، فيقول: وعزتي وجاللي ال أغفر لك بعدها أبدا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you intend to do something good, do not delay it, for perhaps Allah observes His servant while he is in an act of obedience, and He says: By My Honor and Majesty, I will never punish you after this. And when you intend to do evil, do not do it, for perhaps Allah observes His servant while he is in an act of disobedience, and He says: By My Honor and Majesty, I will never forgive you after this.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا أردت شيئا من الخير فال نؤخره، افن العبد يصوم اليوم الحار يريد ما عند هللا فيعتقه هللا به من النار.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you want to do something good, do not delay it, for indeed a servant fasts on a hot day seeking what is with Allah, and Allah frees him from the Fire because of it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: من هم بخير فليعجله ويؤخره، إفن العبد ربما عمل العمل فيقول هللا تبارك وتعالى: قد غفرت لك، وال أكتب عليك شيئا أبدا، ومن هم بسيئة فال يعملها إفنه ربما عمل العبد السيئة فيراه الرب سبحانه فيقول: ال وعزتي وجاللي، ال أغفر لك بعدها أبدا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever intends good should hasten to do it and not delay it, for when a servant does a deed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, may say: "I have forgiven you, and I shall not record anything against you ever." And whoever intends evil should not do it, for when a servant commits an evil deed, the Lord, Glory be to Him, may see him and say: "By My Might and Majesty, I shall never forgive you after this." Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delayin...

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا هم أحدكم بخير أو صلة إفن عن يمينه وشماله شيطانين، فليبادر ال يكفاه عن ذلك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When one of you intends good or maintaining ties, there are two devils on his right and left, so he should hasten before they prevent him from it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر (عليه السالم) يقول: من هم بشئ من الخير فليعجله، إفن كل شئ فيه أتخير إفن للشيطان فيه نظرة.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever intends any good should hasten to do it, for in every delay there is an opportunity for Satan to interfere.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن زرارة عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: اعلم أن أول الوقت أبدا أفضل، فتعجل الخير ما استطعت.
englishText: From Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Know that the beginning of time is always better, so hasten to do good as much as you can.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: عن الحسن بن عيل، عن أبيه عليهما السالم اقل: إذا عرض لك شئ من أمر اآلخرة افبدأ به، وإذا عرض لك شئ من أمر الدنيا فتأنه حتى تصيب رشدك.
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Ali, from his father (peace be upon them both) who said: When something related to the Hereafter presents itself to you, start with it, and when something related to worldly matters presents itself, be patient until you find the right course.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delaying Them
arabicText: في وصية رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) - اقل: اي أاب ذر، اغتنم خمسا قبل خمس: شبابك قبل هرمك، وصحتك قبل سقمك، وغناك قبل فقرك، وفراغك قبل شغلك، وحياتك قبل موتك، اي أاب ذر، إايك والتسويف أبملك، إفنك بيومك ولست بما بعده، اي أاب ذر إذا أصبحت فال تحدث نفسك ابلمساء وإذا أمسيت فال تحدث نفسك ابلصباح، وخذ من صحتك قبل سقمك.
englishText: From the advice of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) - He said: O Abu Dharr, take advantage of five before five: Your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your busyness, and your life before your death. O Abu Dharr, beware of procrastination with your hopes, for you have your day and you don't have what comes after it. O Abu Dharr, when you wake up in the morning, don't talk to yourself about the evening, and when you reach the evening, don't talk to yourself about the morning, and take from your health before your sickness. Recommendation Of Hastening To Do Good Deeds And Dislike Of Delayin...

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: وال تستقل ما يتقرب به إلى هللا عز وجل ولو شق تمرة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not consider anything that brings you closer to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, as insignificant, even if it is half a date.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: حديث روي لنا أنك قلت: إذا عرفت افعمل ما شئت، فقال: قد قلت ذلك، اقل: قلت وإن زنوا أو سرقوا، أو شربوا الخمر؟ فقال لي - إان هلل وإان إليه راجعون! وهللا ما أنصفوان أن نكون أخذان ابلعمل، ووضع عنهم، إنما قلت، إذا عرفت افعمل ما شئت من قليل الخير وكثيره إفنه يقبل منك.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A hadith narrated to us that you said, "When you know, then do whatever you wish." He said: I did say that. I said: Even if they commit adultery, theft, or drink wine? He said to me: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return!" By Allah, they have not been fair to us that we should be bound by deeds while they are excused from them. I only said when you know, then do whatever you wish of good deeds, little or much, for it will be accepted from you.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) أنه اقل - في حديث :- تصدق ابلشئ وإن قل، إفن كل شئ يراد به هللا وإن قل - بعد أن تصدق النية فيه - عظيم، إن هللا تعالى يقول: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره، ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said in a hadith: Give sadaqah even if it is little, for everything done for Allah's sake, even if little - when the intention is sincere - is great. Indeed Allah the Most High says: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it [Quran, 99:7-8].

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: اقل سمعت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) يقول: إايكم والكسل، إن ربكم رحيم يشكر القليل، إن الرجل يصيل الركعتين تطوعا يريد بهما وجه هللا فيدخله هللا بهما الجنة، وإنه ليتصدق ابلدرهم تطوعا يريد به وجه هللا فيدخله هللا به الجنة، وإنه ليصوم اليوم تطوعا يريد به وجه هللا فيدخله هللا به الجنة.
englishText: He said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Beware of laziness, for your Lord is Merciful and appreciates even the little. Indeed, a man prays two voluntary rak'ah seeking Allah's pleasure, so Allah admits him to Paradise because of them. And he gives a dirham in voluntary sadaqah seeking Allah's pleasure, so Allah admits him to Paradise because of it. And he fasts one voluntary day seeking Allah's pleasure, so Allah admits him to Paradise because of it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: اقل: سئل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عما روى عن أبيه: إذا عرفت افعمل ما شئت، وأنهم يستحلون بعد ذلك كل محرم؟ فقال: ما لهم لعنهم هللا! إنما اقل أبي (عليه السالم): إذا عرفت الحق افعمل ما شئت من خير يقبل منك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who was asked about what was narrated from his father: When you know, then do as you wish, and that they make permissible after that every forbidden thing? He said: What is wrong with them, may Allah curse them! My father (peace be upon him) only said: When you know the truth, then do whatever good you wish, it will be accepted from you.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: عن عيل (عليهم السالم) اقل: إن هللا أخفى أربعة في أربعة: أخفى رضاه في طاعته فال تستصغرن شيئا من طاعته، فربما وافق رضاه وأنت ال تعلم، وأخفى سخطه في معصيته فال تستصغرن شيئا من معصيته، فربما وافق سخطه معصيته وأنت ال تعلم، وأخفى إجابته في دعوته فال تستصغرن شيئا من دعائه، فربما وافق إجابته وأنت التعلم، وأخفى وليه في عباده فال تستصغرن عبدا من عبيد هللا فربما يكون وليه وأنت ال تعلم.
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Allah has hidden four things in four: He has hidden His pleasure in His obedience, so do not consider any act of obedience insignificant, for perhaps it coincides with His pleasure while you do not know; and He has hidden His displeasure in His disobedience, so do not consider any act of disobedience insignificant, for perhaps it coincides with His displeasure while you do not know. And He has hidden His response in His supplication, so do not consider any supplication insignificant, for perhaps it coincides with His response while you do not know; and He has hidden His friend among His servants, so do not consider any Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insig... servant of Allah insignificant, for perhaps he is His friend while you do not know.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: عن محمد بن عيل (عليه السالم) أنه اقل لمحمد بن مسلم: اي محمد بن مسلم! ال يغرنك الناس من نفسك، إفن األمر يصل إليك دونهم، وال تقطعن النهار عنك كذا وكذا، إفن معك من يحصى عليك وال تستصغرن حسنة تعملها إفنك تراها حيث تسرك، وال تستصغرن سيئة تعمل إفنك تراها حيث تسوؤك، وأحسن، افني لم أر شيئا قط أشد طلبا وال أسرع دركا من حسنة محدثة لذنب قديم.
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon him) that he said to Muhammad bin Muslim: O Muhammad bin Muslim! Do not let people deceive you about yourself, for the matter reaches you without them. Do not spend your day doing such and such, for with you is one who counts against you. Do not belittle any good deed you do, for you will see it where it pleases you. Do not belittle any bad deed you do, for you will see it where it grieves you. And do good, for I have never seen anything more persistent in pursuit nor quicker in catching up than a new good deed seeking an old sin.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل عىل (عليه السالم): اعلموا أنه ال يصغر ما ضر يوم القيامة، وال يصغر ما ينفع يوم القيامة، فكونوا فيما أخبركم هللا كمن عاين.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: Know that nothing that harms on the Day of Judgment is small, and nothing that benefits on the Day of Judgment is small, so be in what Allah has informed you like one who has witnessed.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: في (نهج البالغة) عن أمير المؤمنين (عليه) السالم أنه اقل افعلوا الخير وال تحقروا منه شيئا، إفن صغيره كبير، وقليله كثير، وال يقولن أحدكم: إن أحدا أولى بفعل الخير مني فيكون وهللا كذلك، إن للخير وللشر أهال. فمهما تركتموه منهما كفاكموه أهله.
englishText: From Nahj al-Balagha, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: Do good deeds and do not belittle any of them, for their small is great and their little is much. Let none of you say: Someone else is more worthy of doing good than me, for by Allah it will become so. Indeed, good and evil each have their people. Whatever you leave of either of them, its people will suffice you in it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: واقل (عليه السالم): قليل مدوم عليه خير من كثير مملول منه.
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: A small amount done consistently is better than a large amount that becomes wearisome.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insignificant Which Leads To Abandonment
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا أحسن العبد المؤمن ضاعف هللا عمله بكل حسنة سبعمأة ضعف، وذلك قول هللا عز وجل: وهللا يضاعف لمن يشاء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a believing servant does good, Allah multiplies his deed by seven hundred times for each good deed, and that is the saying of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: And Allah multiplies [the reward] for whom He wills [Quran, 2:261]. Impermissibility Of Considering Any Act Of Worship Or Deed As Insig...

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر (عليه السالم) يقول: كل من دان هللا عز وجل بعبادة يجهد فيها نفسه، وال إمام له من هللا، فسعيه غير مقبول، وهو ضال متحير، وهللا شانئ ألعماله - إلى أن اقل - وإن مات عىل هذه الحال مات ميتة كفر ونفاق، واعلم اي محمد أن أئمة الجور وأتباعهم لمعزولون عن دين هللا، قد ضلوا وأضلوا، أفعمالهم التي يعملونها كرماد اشتدت به الريح في يوم عاصف، ال يقدرون مما كسبوا عىل شئ ذلك هو الضالل البعيد.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say: Anyone who worships Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, with devotion in which he exerts himself, without (acknowledging the) Imam appointed by Allah, his efforts are not accepted, and he is astray and confused, and Allah detests his deeds - until he said - and if he dies in this state, he dies a death of disbelief and hypocrisy. Know, O Muhammad, that the unjust rulers and their followers are isolated from the religion of Allah. They have gone astray and led others astray. Their deeds which they perform are like ashes blown forcefully by the wind on a stormy day. They have no power over anything they have earned. That is the extreme misguidance.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: ذروة األمر وسنامه، ومفتاحه، وابب األشياء ورضى الرحمن، الطاعة لإلمام بعد معرفته، أما لو أن رجال اقم ليله، وصام نهاره، وتصدق بجميع ماله وحج جميع دهره، ولم يعرف والية ولي هللا فيواليه، ويكون جميع أعماله بداللته إليه، ما كان له عىل هللا حق في ثوابه، وال كان من أهل اإليمان.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him - in a hadith - he said: The peak of the matter, its pinnacle, its key, the gateway to all things, and the pleasure of the Most Merciful is obedience to the Imam after recognizing him. If a man were to stand in prayer all night, fast during the day, give all his wealth in sadaqah, and perform Hajj throughout his entire life, but he does not recognize the Wilayah (authority) of the Wali (guardian) of Allah to follow him, and all his deeds are not guided by him, he would have no right to reward from Allah, nor would he be among the people of faith.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: من لم أيت هللا عز وجل يوم القيامة بما أنتم عليه لم تقبل منه حسنة، ولم يتجاوز له عن سيئة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Whoever does not come to Allah the Mighty and Majestic on the Day of Resurrection with what you are upon, no good deed will be accepted from him, and no evil deed will be overlooked for him.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم) لعباد بن كثير: إعلم أنه ال يتقبل هللا منك شيئا حتى تقول قوال عدال.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to Abbad bin Kathir: Know that Allah will not accept anything from you until you speak justly.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: وهللا لو أن إبليس سجد هلل بعد المعصية والتكبر عمر الدنيا ما نفعه ذلك، وال قبله هللا عز وجل ما لم يسجد آلدم كما أمره هللا عز وجل أن يسجد له. وكذلك هذه األمة العاصية المفتونة بعد نبيها (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم)، وبعد تركهم اإلمام الذي تصبه نبيهم صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم لهم، فلن يقبل هللا لهم عمال، ولن يرفع لهم حسنة حتى أيتوا هللا من حيث أمرهم، ويتولوا اإلمام الذي أمروا بواليته، ويدخلوا من الباب الذي فتحه هللا ورسوله لهم.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: By Allah, if Iblis were to prostrate to Allah after his disobedience and arrogance for the entire lifetime of this world, it would not benefit him, and Allah the Mighty and Majestic would not accept it from him unless he prostrated to Adam as Allah the Mighty and Majestic had commanded him to do. And likewise, this disobedient nation, which fell into trials after their Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and after abandoning the Imam whom their Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) appointed for them - Allah will not accept any of their deeds, nor will He elevate any of their good actions until they come to Allah from where He commanded them, and accept the authority of the Imam whose leadership they were ordered to follow, and enter through the gate which Allah and His Messenger opened for them.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - حديث - اقل: من ال يعرف هللا، وما يعرف اإلمام منا أهل البيت، إفنما يعرف ويعبد غير هللا، هكذا وهللا ضالال.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever does not know Allah, and Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Bel... does not know the Imam from us Ahl al-Bayt, then he only knows and worships other than Allah, by Allah this is misguidance.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: الناس سواد وأنتم الحاج،
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith that he said: The people are (just) a multitude but you (the Shias) are (truly) the pilgrims.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: أما وهللا، ماهلل عز ذكره حاج غيركم، وال يتقبل إال منكم.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: By Allah, Allah, exalted be His remembrance, has no pilgrims other than you (the Shias), and He does not accept except from you.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: أنه اقل ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث :- إن أهل الموقف لكثير، فقال: غثاء أيتي به الموج من كل مكان، ال وهللا، ما الحج إال لكم، ال وهللا ما، ما يتقبل هللا إال منكم.
englishText: From him that he said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith: Indeed the people at the standing place are many. He said: They are scum brought by the waves from every place. No by Allah, Hajj is only for you (the Shias). No by Allah, Allah does not accept except from you.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: ما أكثر السواد؟! يعنى الناس، قلت: أجل، فقال: أما وهللا ما يحج أحد هلل غيركم.
englishText: Abdullah (peace be upon him) said in a hadith: How numerous are the multitudes! meaning the people. I said: Indeed. Then he said: By Allah, no one performs Hajj for Allah except you (the Shias).

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: اقل لي أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): اي عباد، ما عىل ملة إبراهيم أحد غيركم، وما يقبل هللا إال منكم، وال يغفر الذنوب إال لكم.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: O Ibad! No one is upon the religion of Ibrahim except you (the Shias), and Allah does not accept except from you, and He does not forgive sins except for you.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: اقل لنا عيل بن الحسين (عليه السالم): أي البقاع أفضل؟ فقلنا: هللا ورسوله وابن رسوله أعلم، فقال لنا: أفضل البقاع ما بين الركن والمقام، ولو أن رجال عمر ما عمر نوح في قومه، ألف سنة إال خمسين عاما، يصوم النهار، ويقوم الليل في ذلك المكان، ثم لقى هللا بغير واليتنا لم ينفعه ذلك شيئا.
englishText: Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said to us: Which place is the most virtuous? We said: Allah, His Messenger, and the son of His Messenger know best. He then said to us: The most virtuous place is between the Corner (of the Ka'bah) and the Station (of Ibrahim). If a man were to live as long as Noah lived among his people, nine hundred and fifty years, fasting during the day and praying during the night in that place, then he met Allah without accepting our Wilayah (guardianship), that would not benefit him at all.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): اي معىل، لو أن عبدا عبد هللا مأة عام ما بين الركن والمقام، يصوم النهار، ويقوم الليل حتى يسقط حاجباه عىل عينيه، ويلتقى تراقيه هرما جاهال بحقنا لم يكن له ثواب.
englishText: Imam Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: O Mu'alla, if a servant were to worship Allah for a hundred years between the Corner (Rukn) and the Station (Maqam), fasting during the day and standing in prayer during the night until his eyebrows fall over his eyes and his collarbones meet due to old age, while being ignorant of our rights, there would be no reward for him.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: إن أفضل البقاع ما بين الركن األسود، والمقام، وابب الكعبة وذاك حطيم إسماعيل، ووهللا لو أن عبدا صف قدميه في ذلك المكان، واقم الليل مصليا حتى يجيئه النهار، وصام النهار حتى يجيئه الليل، ولم يعرف حقنا وحرمتنا أهل البيت، لم يقبل هللا منه شيئا أبدا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Indeed, the best places are between the Black Stone, the Maqam (Station of Ibrahim), and the door of the Ka'bah, and that is the Hateem of Isma'il. By Allah, if a servant were to align his feet in that place, and stand in prayer all night until daybreak, and fast all day until nightfall, but does not recognize our rights and sanctity as the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House), Allah would never accept anything from him.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه (عليه السالم) اقل: نزل جبرئيل عليه السالم عىل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم، فقال: اي محمد السالم يقرأك السالم، ويقول: خلقت السماوات السبع وما فيهن، واألرضين السبع وما عليهن، وما خلقت موضعا أعظم من الركن والمقام، ولو أن عبدا دعاني منذ خلقت السماوات واألرضين ثم لقيني جاحدا لوالية عيل ألكببته في سقر.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon him), who said: Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Bel... and said: O Muhammad, As-Salaam (*) conveys greetings of peace to you and says: I created the seven heavens and all that is in them, and the seven earths and all that is on them, and I have not created a place greater than the Rukn (Corner of the Ka'bah) and the Maqam (Station of Ibrahim). If a servant would have worshiped me since I created the heavens and earths, then meets me while denying the Wilayah (guardianship) of Ali, I would cast him into Saqar (Hell). Translator: * One of the names of Allah, meaning "The Source or Bestower of Peace".

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: أي البقاع أعظم حرمة؟ اقل: قلت: هللا ورسوله وابن رسوله أعلم، اقل: اي ميسر ما بين الركن والمقام روضة من رايض الجنة، وما بين القبر والمنبر روضة من رايض الجنة، ووهللا لو أن عبدا عمره هللا ما بين الركن والمقام، وما بين القبر والمنبر، يعبده ألف عام، ثم ذبح عىل فراشه مظلوما كما يذبح الكبش األملح، ثم لقى هللا عز وجل بغير واليتنا، لكان حقيقا عىل هللا عز وجل أن يكبه عىل منخريه في انر جهنم.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Which places are most sacred? I said: Allah, His Messenger, and the son of His Messenger know best. He said: O Muyassir, the area between the Rukn (Corner of the Ka'bah) and the Maqam (Station of Ibrahim) is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and the area between the grave (of the Prophet) and the pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise. By Allah, if a servant were to worship Allah between the Corner (of the Ka'bah) and the Maqam (of Ibrahim), and between the grave (of the Prophet) and his pulpit, for a thousand years, then was slaughtered unjustly on his bed like a white-colored ram is slaughtered, and then met Allah the Mighty and Majestic without having Wilayah (loyalty/obedience to Ahl al-Bayt), it would be fitting for Allah the Mighty and Majestic to throw him on his nose into the fire of Hell.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: اقل: سمعت أاب الحسن (عليه السالم) يقول: إن هلل في كل وقت صالة يصليها هذا الخلق لعنة اقل: قلت جعلت فداك، ولم؟ اقل بجحودهم حقنا، وتكذيبهم إايان.
englishText: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: Indeed Allah sends a curse, during every prayer time in which these creatures pray. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, and why? He said: Due to their denial of our rights and their rejection of us.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: أن أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) كتب إليه كتااب فيه: إن هللا لم يبعث نبيا قط يدعو إلى معرفة هللا ليس معها طاعة في أمر وال نهي، وإنما يقبل هللا من العباد ابلفرائض التي افترضها هللا عىل حدودها مع معرفة من دعا إليه ومن أطاع، وحرم الحرام ظاهره وابطنه، وصىل، وصام وحج واعتمر وعظم حرمات هللا كلها ولم يدع، منها شيئا وعمل ابلبر كله، ومكارم األخالق كلها، وتجنب سيئها، ومن زعم أنه يحل الحالل ويحرم الحرام بغير معرفة النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم) لم يحل هلل حالال، ولم يحرم له حراما، وأن من صىل وزىك وحج واعتمر وفعل ذلك كله بغير معرفة من افترض هللا عليه طاعته فلم يفعل شيئا من ذلك - إلى أن اقل - ليس له صالة وإن ركع وإن سجد، وال له زكاة وال حج، وإنما ذلك كله يكون بمعرفة رجل من هللا عىل خلقه بطاعته، وأمر ابألخذ عنه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) wrote to him a letter in which he said: Indeed, Allah has never sent a prophet who calls to the knowledge of Allah without it being accompanied by obedience in commands and prohibitions. Indeed, Allah only accepts from His servants the obligatory duties that He has prescribed within their limits, along with the knowledge of who called to Him and who obeyed Him. And he forbade what is unlawful, both outwardly and inwardly, and prayed, fasted, performed Hajj and Umrah, honored all the sacred limits of Allah without neglecting any of them, performed all righteous deeds, embodied all noble character traits, and avoided all evil ones. And whoever claims that he makes lawful what is permissible and makes unlawful what is forbidden without knowledge of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), has not made lawful what is permissible, nor has he made unlawful what is forbidden. And whoever prays, gives zakat, performs Hajj and Umrah, and does all of that without knowing the one whose obedience Allah has made obligatory upon him, has not done anything of that - until he said - he has no prayer even if he bows and prostrates, nor does he have zakat or Hajj. Rather, all of that is only valid through the Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Bel... recognition a man from Allah over His creation, whose obedience is obligatory, and who has been commanded to be followed.

chapter: Invalidity Of Worship Without The Wilayah Of The Imams, And The Belief In Their Imamate
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) في قوله تعالى: وإني لغفار لمن اتب وآمن وعمل صالحا ثم اهتدى اقل: أال ترى كيف اشترط، ولم تنفعه التوبة واإليمان والعمل الصالح، حتى اهتدى؟! وهللا، لو جهد أن يعمل ما قبل منه حتى يهتدي، اقل: قلت: إلى من جعلني هللا فداك؟ اقل: إلينا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding His saying: "And indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance" [Quran, 20:82], he said: Do you not see how He made conditions, and repentance, faith, and righteous deeds did not benefit him until he was guided?! By Allah, even if he strives to do good deeds, it would not be accepted from him until he is guided. I said: To whom, may Allah make me your ransom? He said: To us.

chapter: Whoever Was A Believer Then Disbelieved Then Believed, His Deeds During His Previous Belief Are Not Nullified
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: من كان مؤمنا فحج، وعمل في إيمانه، ثم أصابته في إيمانه فتنة، فكفر ثم اتب، وآمن اقل: يحسب له كل عمل صالح عمله في إيمانه، وال يبطل منه شئ.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever was a believer and performed Hajj, and did deeds during his belief, then was afflicted with a trial in his faith and disbelieved, then repented and believed, he said: Every good deed he performed during his belief will be counted for him, and nothing of it will be nullified.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When He Gains Insight, Except For Zakat If Given To Undeserving Recipients, And Hajj If A Pillar Is Omitted
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: كل عمل عمله وهو في حال نصبه وضاللته، ثم من هللا عليه وعرفه الوالية، إفنه يؤجر عليه، إال الزكاة إفنه يعيدها، ألنه وضعها في غير موضعها، ألنها ألهل الوالية، وأما الصالة، والحج والصيام فليس عليه قضاء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Every deed performed while in a state of hostility (nasbih) and misguidance, then Allah bestowed upon him and made him recognize the Wilayah, he will be rewarded for it, except Zakat which he must repeat because he placed it in other than its proper place, as it belongs to the people of Wilayah. As for prayer, Hajj and fasting, he does not need to make them up.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When He Gains Insight, Except For Zakat If Given To Undeserving Recipients, And Hajj If A Pillar Is Omitted
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل - في حديث - وكذلك الناصب إذا عرف، فعليه الحج وإن كان قد حج.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) he said - in a hadith - and likewise the nasib (hostile one) when he recognizes [the truth], he must perform Hajj even if he had performed it before.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When He Gains Insight, Except For Zakat If Given To Undeserving Recipients, And Hajj If A Pillar Is Omitted
arabicText: إلى أبي جعفر (عليه السالم): أني حججت وأان مخالف، وكنت صرورة فدخلت متمتعا ابلعمرة إلى الحج؟ اقل: فكتب إليه أعد حجك.
englishText: To Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): I performed Hajj while I was an opponent (mukhalif), and it was my first Hajj, and I entered into Tamattu with Umrah to Hajj? He wrote back to him: Repeat your Hajj.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When He Gains Insight, Except For Zakat If Given To Undeserving Recipients, And Hajj If A Pillar Is Omitted
arabicText: اقل سليمان بن خالد ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) وأان جالس: إني منذ عرفت هذا األمر أصيل في كل يوم صالتين، أقضي ما افتني قبل معرفتي، اقل: ال تفعل، إفن الحال التي كنت عليها أعظم من ترك ما تركت من الصالة.
englishText: Sulayman bin Khalid said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while I was sitting: Since [the time] I have come to recognize this Amr (Wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt), I have been praying two extra prayers every day, making up what I missed before my Ma'rifah (recognition of the Wilayah). He said: Do not do that, for the state you were in was greater than the prayers you missed.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When He Gains Insight, Except For Zakat If Given To Undeserving Recipients, And Hajj If A Pillar Is Omitted
arabicText: اقل: كنت عند أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) إذ دخل عليه كوفيان كاان زيديين، فقاال: إان كنا نقول بقول، وأن هللا من علينا بواليتك، فهل يقبل شئ من أعمالنا؟ فقال: أما الصالة، والصوم، والحج، والصدقة، إفن هللا يتبعكما ذلك ويلحق بكما، وأما الزكاة فال، ألنكما أبعدتما حق امرء مسلم، وأعطيتماه غيره.
englishText: He said: I was with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when two Kufans who were Zaydis entered and said: We used to follow a certain belief, and Allah bestowed upon us your Wilayah (allegiance to Ahl al-Bayt), so will any of our deeds be accepted? He said: As for prayer, fasting, Hajj, and sadaqah, Allah will make these follow you and attach them to you, but as for Zakat, no, because you kept away a Muslim person's right and gave it to another. Non-Obligation Of Making Up Acts Of Worship For The Opponent When H... Section 3 Pure Water

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل: إن هللا جعل التراب طهورا كما جعل الماء طهورا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Indeed Allah made soil purifying just as He made water purifying.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: اقل الصادق (عليه السالم) كل ماء طاهر إال ما علمت أنه قذر.
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: All water is pure except what you know to be impure.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: اقل: واقل (عليه السالم) الماء يطهر وال يطهر.
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Water purifies and is not purified.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان بنوا إسرائيل إذا أصاب أحدهم قطرة بول قرضوا لحومهم ابلمقاريض، وقد وسع هللا عليكم أبوسع ما بين السماء واألرض، وجعل لكم الماء طهورا، افنظروا كيف تكونون.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When any of the Children of Israel was touched by a drop of urine, they would cut their flesh with scissors. But Allah has given you vastness as vast as what is between the heaven and earth, and made water a purifying element for you, so be mindful of how you conduct yourselves.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: الماء كله طاهر حتى يعلم أنه قذر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: All water is pure until you know it is impure.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): الماء يطهر وال يطهر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Water purifies and is not purified. Translator: Forms I and II of the verb "tahara" are used here with different meanings.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل عىل (عليه السالم): الماء يطهر وال يطهر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: Water purifies and is not purified. Translator: Forms I and II of the verb "tahara" are used here with different meanings.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: أمير المؤمنين (عليه السالم) كان يقول - عند النظر إلى الماء - الحمد هلل الذي جعل الماء طهورا ولم يجعله نجسا.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to say - when looking at water - "Praise be to Allah who made water pure and did not make it impure."

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: اقل (عليه السالم): خلق هللا الماء طهورا ال ينجسه شئ إال ما غير لونه، أو طعمه، أو ريحه.
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Allah created water pure, nothing makes it impure except what changes its color, or taste, or smell.

chapter: That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And Eliminates Filth
arabicText: عن الباقر (عليه السالم) اقل: أفطر عىل الحلو، إفن لم تجده أففطر عىل الماء، إفن الماء طهور.
englishText: From Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said: Break your fast with something sweet, if you cannot find it then break your fast with water, for water is pure. That It (Water) Is Pure And Purifying, Removes Ritual Impurity, And...

chapter: That Seawater Is Pure And Purifying, And So Is Well Water And Snow Water
arabicText: عن عبد هللا بن سنان، عن أبي عبد هللا )عليه السالم( اقل: سئلته عن ماء البحر أطهور هو؟ اقل: نعم.
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about seawater, is it purifying? He said: Yes.

chapter: That Seawater Is Pure And Purifying, And So Is Well Water And Snow Water
arabicText: اقل: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، عن ماء البحر أطهور هو؟ اقل: نعم.
englishText: He said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about seawater, is it purifying? He said: Yes.

chapter: That Seawater Is Pure And Purifying, And So Is Well Water And Snow Water
arabicText: عن موسى بن جعفر (عليه السالم)، اقل: سألته عن ماء البحر أيتوضأ منه؟ اقل: ال أبس.
englishText: From Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about seawater, can one perform ablution with it? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: That Seawater Is Pure And Purifying, And So Is Well Water And Snow Water
arabicText: اقل (عليه السالم): وقد سئل عن الوضوء بماء البحر؟ فقال: هو الطهور ماؤه، الحل ميتته.
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: And he was asked about performing ablution with seawater? He said: Its water is purifying, its dead [creatures] are permissible.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم إنه اقل: كلما غلب الماء عىل ريح الجيفة فتوضأ من الماء واشرب، إفذا تغير الماء، وتغير الطعم، فال تتوضأ منه وال تشرب.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, that he said: Whenever water overpowers the smell of the carcass then perform ablution with the water and drink from it, but if the water changes and the taste changes, then do not perform ablution with it and do not drink from it.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، في الماء اآلجن: يتوضأ منه، إال أن تجد ماء غيره فتنزه منه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding stagnant water: perform ablution with it, unless you find other water, then avoid it. Translator: In the margin of the original manuscript, it is noted: Al-aajin : water whose taste and color have changed." Al-Qamus al-Muhit 4:196. The term "aajin" is derived from the Arabic root "a-ja-na", which means "to become stagnant" or "to be left standing." Stagnant water allows for the growth of microorganisms and potentially leading to changes in its smell, taste, or appearance. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Shaykh interpreted it as the occurrence of change by itself or by being adjacent to a pure body, based on what has been mentioned and will come, and it is good.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، أنه سأل عن الماء النقيع تبول فيه الدواب؟ فقال: إن تغير الماء فال تتوضأ منه، وإن لم تغيره أبوالها فتوضأ منه، وكذلك الدم إذا سال في الماء وأشباهه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he was asked about collected water in which animals urinate? He said: If the water changes then do not perform ablution with it, and if their urine does not change it then perform ablution with it, and likewise with blood when it flows into water and similar things. Translator: In the margin of the (original) manuscript, it is noted: "The intention may be the urine of animals whose meat is eaten, and the consideration of change may indicate the removal of the water's unconditional purity, turning the water into something considered mixed, even though the ruling on blood and similar substances is due to impurity. It is also possible that the intention is the urine of animals whose meat is not eaten, in which case the ruling would be due to impurity."

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: أنه سمع أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) يقول في الماء يمر به الرجل وهو نقيع فيه الميتة و الجيفة فقال أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): إن كان الماء قد تغير ريحه أو طعمه فال تشرب وال تتوضأ منه، وإن لم يتغير ريحه وطعمه افشرب وتوضأ.
englishText: He heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) speaking about water that a man passes by which contains dead and decaying matter, so Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If the water's smell or taste has changed then do not drink or perform ablution with it, and if its smell and taste have not changed then drink and perform ablution.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي بصير، اقل: سألته عن كر من ماء مررت به - وأان في سفر - قد ابل فيه حمار أو بغل، أو إنسان؟ اقل: ال توضأ منه وال تشرب منه. اقل الشيخ: المراد به إذا تغير لونه، أو طعمه، أو رائحته، واستدل أبحاديث كثيرة أتتي. أقول: ويمكن الحمل عىل الكراهة مع وجود غيره بقرينة اشتماله عىل ما ليس بنجاسة.
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked him about a kurr of water I passed by - while I was traveling - in which a donkey or mule or human had urinated? He said: Do not perform ablution with it and do not drink from it. The Shaykh said: What is meant is when its color, taste, or smell changes, and he cited many hadiths that will follow. I (Hurr Amili) say: It can be interpreted as disliked (makruh) when other water exists, as indicated by it including what is not impure.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: سألته عن الرجل يمر ابلماء وفيه دابة ميتة قد أنتنت؟ اقل: إذا كان النتن الغالب عىل الماء فال يتوضأ وال تشرب.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who passes by water containing a decaying dead animal? He said: If the stench dominates the water then do not perform ablution and do not drink.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الحياض يبال فيها؟ اقل: ال أبس إذا غلب لون الماء لون البول.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ponds that are urinated in? He said: There is no problem if the color of the water overpowers the color of urine.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: قلت له: رواية من ماء سقطت فيها افرة، أو جرذ، أو صعوة ميتة؟ اقل: إذا تفسخ فيها فال تشرب من مائها وال تتوضأ وصبها، وإن كان غير متفسخ افشرب منه وتوضأ، واطرح، الميتة إذا أخرجتها طرية، وكذلك الجرة وحب الماء والقربة وأشباه ذلك من أوعية الماء. واقل أبو جعفر (عليه السالم): إذا كان الماء أكثر من رواية لم ينجسه شئ تفسخ فيه أو لم يتفسخ، إال أن يئج له ريح تغلب عىل ريح الماء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), I asked him about a water container in which a dead mouse, rat, or small bird has fallen? He said: If it has decomposed in it, then do not drink from its water, do not perform ablution, and pour it out. If it has not decomposed, then drink from it and perform ablution, and throw out the dead animal when you remove it fresh. The same applies to jars, water containers, waterskins, and similar water vessels. Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If the water is more than a container's (*) worth, nothing makes it impure whether decomposed in it or not, unless an odor comes that overwhelms the water's smell. Translator: * "Riwaayah" is a unit of measurement for water volume. The exact size of a riwaayah is not clearly defined in the hadith itself, however a common understanding is that it reaches the level of a Kurr (approximately 216-288 liters), See comment on Hadith 344.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن زرارة اقل: إذا كان الماء أكثر من راوية، وذكر بقية الحديث.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: If the water is more than a container's worth, and he mentioned the rest of the hadith. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Shaykh Kulayni interpreted it to mean that it is referring to the amount reaching the level of a Kurr (approximately 216-288 liters), and similarly for water containers, interpreting them as holding a Kurr, due to what comes from explicit contradictions. With the possibility of this and similar [narrations] being subject to taqiyyah, it can be interpreted as such.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) اقل: ماء البئر واسع ال يفسده شئ إال أن يتغير.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Well water is expansive, nothing corrupts it except if it changes. Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Im...

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: اقل: سأل رجل أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - وأان حاضر - عن غدير أتوه وفيه جيفة؟ فقال: إن كان الماء اقهرا وال توجد منه الريح فتوضأ.
englishText: A man asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - while I was present - about a pond they came to which had a carcass in it? He said: If the water is abundant and no odor is detected from it, then perform ablution.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) اقل: ماء البئر واسع ال يفسده شئ إال أن يتغير ريحه أو طعمه فينزح حتى يذهب الريح ويطيب طعمه ألن له مادة.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Well water is expansive, nothing corrupts it except if its smell or taste changes, then it should be drawn out until the smell goes away and its taste becomes good, because it has a source.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: اقل: سأل الصادق (عليه السالم) عن غدير فيه جيفة، فقال، إن كان الماء اقهرا لها يوجد الريح منه فتوضأ واغتسل.
englishText: He said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about a pond containing a carcass, so he said: If the water overpowers it though its smell can be detected, then perform ablution and ghusl.

chapter: Impurity Of Water Due To Change In Its Taste, Color, Or Smell By Impurity, Regardless Of The Type Of Water
arabicText: اقل: واقل الرضا (عليه السالم): ليس يكره من قرب وال بعد، بئر - يعنى قريبة من الكنيف - يغتسل منها ويتوضأ، ما لم يتغير الماء.
englishText: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: It is not disliked, whether near or far, a well - meaning one that is close to the lavatory - to perform ghusl from it or make wudu, as long as the water has not changed. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What indicates this has been mentioned before, and what supports it will be mentioned. Some narrations of this chapter are general, and what indicates its specification in non-flowing water and the well is by reaching the amount of a Kurr.

chapter: Ruling On Water Being Pure Until Impurity Is Known To Have Affected It
