chapter: Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike Of Performing Ablution From Her Leftover Water If She Is Not Trustworthy
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن عليه السالم في الرجل يتوضأ بفضل الحائض، اقل: إذا كانت مأمونة فال أبس.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan, peace be upon him, regarding a man performing ablution with the leftover water of a menstruating woman, he said: If she is trustworthy, then there is no harm in it.

chapter: Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike Of Performing Ablution From Her Leftover Water If She Is Not Trustworthy
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سؤر الحائض تشرب منه، وال توضأ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The leftover drink of a menstruating woman can be drunk from, but not used for ablution.

chapter: Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike Of Performing Ablution From Her Leftover Water If She Is Not Trustworthy
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته: هل يتوضأ من فضل وضوء الحائض؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him: Can one perform ablution using the leftover water from a menstruating woman's ablution? He said: No.

chapter: Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike Of Performing Ablution From Her Leftover Water If She Is Not Trustworthy
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: المرأة الطامث أشرب من فضل شرابها، وال أحب أن أتوضأ منه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: I drink from the leftover drink of a menstruating woman, but I do not like to perform ablution with it.

chapter: Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike Of Performing Ablution From Her Leftover Water If She Is Not Trustworthy
arabicText: عن عبد هللا بن المغيرة، عن رافعة، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن سؤر الحائض ال أبس به أن تتوضأ منه، إذا كانت تغسل يديها.
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Mughirah, from Rifa'ah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: There is no harm in using the leftover water of a menstruating woman for ablution, if she washes her hands. Purity Of The Menstruating Woman's Leftover Water And The Dislike O...

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: سألته عن العظاية، والحية، والوزغ يقع في الماء، فال يموت أيتوضأ منه للصالة؟ اقل ال أبس به. وسألته عن أفرة وقعت في حب دهن وأخرجت قبل أن تموت، أيبيعه من مسلم؟ اقل: نعم، ويدهن منه.
englishText: Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him - in a hadith - said: I asked him about a lizard, a snake, and a gecko that fall into water but do not die, can one perform ablution from it for prayer? He said: There is no harm in it. And I asked him about a mouse that fell into a jar of oil and was taken out before it died, can it be sold to a Muslim? He said: Yes, and one can use it for oiling.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: أن أاب جعفر عليه السالم كان يقول: ال أبس بسؤر الفأرة إذا شربت من اإلانء أن يشرب منه ويتوضأ منه.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, used to say: There is no harm in drinking from or performing ablution with the leftover water in a vessel from which a mouse has drunk.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي بصير اقل: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن حية دخلت حبا فيه ماء، وخرجت منه؟ اقل: إذا وجد ماء غيره فليهرقه.
englishText: From Abu Basir, who said: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about a snake that entered a container with water in it and then came out of it. He said: If other water is found, then pour it out.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الفارة، والعقرب، وأشباه ذلك يقع في الماء فيخرج حيا هل يشرب من ذلك الماء ويتوضأ منه؟ اقل: يسكب منه ثالث مرات، وقليله وكثيره بمنزلة واحدة، ثم يشرب منه، ويتوضأ منه غير الوزغ إفنه ال ينتفع بما يقع فيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a mouse, a scorpion, and similar things that fall into water and come out alive, is it permissible to drink from that water and perform ablution with it? He said: Pour out from it three times, and its little and much are treated the same way, then drink from it and perform ablution with it, except for the gecko, for there is no benefit in what it falls into.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الخنفساء تقع في الماء أيتوضأ به؟ اقل: نعم ال أبس به. قلت: افلعقرب؟ اقل: ارقه.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a dung beetle falling into water, can one perform ablution with it? He said: Yes, there is no problem with it. I said: What about a scorpion? He said: Pour it out.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن جرة وجد فيه خنفساء قد مات؟ اقل: ألقه وتوضأ منه، وإن كان عقراب أفرق الماء وتوضأ من ماء غيره.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about a jar in which a dead beetle was found. He said: Remove it and perform ablution with the water. If it was a scorpion, pour out the water and perform ablution with water from another source.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن آابئه عليهم السالم - في حديث المناهي - أن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم نهى عن أكل سؤر الفأر.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers, peace be upon them - in the hadith of prohibitions - that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, forbade eating the leftover of a mouse.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Scorpion, And The Like, And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي البختري، عن جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه أن عليا (عليه السالم) اقل: ال أبس بسؤر الفأر أن تشرب منه ويتوضأ.
englishText: From Abu Al-Bakhtari, from Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, that Ali (peace be upon him) said: There is no harm in drinking from the leftover water of a mouse or performing ablution with it. Purity Of The Leftover Water From A Mouse, Snake, Lizard, Gecko, Sc...

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water Of Creatures Without Flowing Blood Even If They Die
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سئل عن الخنفساء والذابب، والجراد والنملة وما أشبه ذلك، يموت في البئر والزيت والسمن، وشبهه؟ اقل: كل ما ليس له دم فال أبس به.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: He was asked about beetles, flies, locusts, ants, and similar creatures that die in wells, oil, ghee, and the like? He said: Everything that does not have blood, there is no harm in it.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water Of Creatures Without Flowing Blood Even If They Die
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد عليهما السالم، اقل: ال يفسد الماء إال ما كانت له نفس سائلة.
englishText: From Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, he said: Nothing spoils water except that which has flowing blood.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water Of Creatures Without Flowing Blood Even If They Die
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: كل شئ يسقط في البئر ليس له دم مثل: العقارب والخنافس وأشباه ذلك، فال أبس.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: There is no harm in anything that falls into the well and has no blood, such as scorpions, beetles, and similar creatures.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water Of Creatures Without Flowing Blood Even If They Die
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال يفسد الماء إال ما كانت له نفس سائلة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Nothing spoils water except that which has flowing blood.

chapter: Purity Of The Leftover Water Of Creatures Without Flowing Blood Even If They Die
arabicText: موسى بن جعفر عليهما السالم اقل: سألته عن العقرب، والخنفساء، وأشباههن، تموت في الجرة أو الدن، يتوضأ منه للصالة؟ اقل: ال أبس به.
englishText: Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, said: I asked him about a scorpion, a beetle, and similar creatures that die in a jar or a large vessel, can one perform ablution from it for prayer? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Ruling Of Dough With Impure Water
arabicText: قيل ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في العجين يعجن من الماء النجس، كيف يصنع به؟ اقل: يباع ممن يستحل أكل الميتة.
englishText: It was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding dough that is kneaded with impure water, what should be done with it? He said: It should be sold to those who consider eating carrion permissible.

chapter: Ruling Of Dough With Impure Water
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: يدفن وال يباع.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: It (i.e. the dough made with impure water) should be buried and not sold. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is carried on the basis of recommendation, and the first (previous hadith) on the basis of permissibility.

chapter: Ruling Of Dough With Impure Water
arabicText: وقد تقدم في أحاديث البئر أن العجين المذكور إذا اصابته النار فال ابس أبكله، إال أن الماء هناك من ماء البئر، وقد عرفت عدم نجاسته ابلمالاقة.
englishText: It was previously mentioned in the hadiths about the well that if the mentioned dough is touched by fire then there is no harm in eating it, except that the water there is from the well water, and it is known that it does not become impure through contact. Section 6 What Invalidates Ablution

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: عن زرارة اقل قلت له: الرجل ينام وهو عىل وضوء، أتوجب الخفقة والخفقتان عليه الوضوء؟ فقال: اي زرارة؟ قد تنام العين وال ينام القلب واألذن، إفذا انمت العين، واالذن، والقلب، وجب الوضوء، قلت: إفن حرك عىل جنبه شئ ولم يعلم به؟ اقل: ال، حتى يستيقن أنه قد انم، حتى يئج من ذلك أمر بين، وإال إفنه عىل يقين من وضوئه، وال تنقض اليقين أبدا ابلشك، وإنما تنقضه بيقين آخر.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked him: If a man sleeps while he has wudu, does a nap or two naps invalidate his wudu? He said: O Zurarah, the eye may sleep while the heart and ear do not sleep. When the eye, ear, and heart sleep, then wudu becomes obligatory. I said: What if something moves against his side and he is unaware of it? He said: No, not until he is certain that he slept, until there comes clear evidence of that. Otherwise he remains upon the certainty of his wudu, and certainty is never invalidated by doubt, rather it is only invalidated by another certainty.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: عن زرارة عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال يوجب الوضوء إال من غائط أو بول، أو ضرطة تسمع صوتها، أو فسوة تجد ريحها.
englishText: From Zurarah from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Wudu is not obligatory except from defecation, or urination, or breaking wind with an audible sound, or passing gas with a detectable smell.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: اقل: أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إن الشيطان ينفخ في دبر اإلنسان حتى يخيل إليه أنه قد خرج منه ريح، وال ينقض الوضوء إال ريح تسمعها، أو تجد ريحها.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: Indeed Satan blows into the posterior of a person until he makes him imagine that wind has come out of him, but the ablution is not invalidated except by wind that you hear or smell its odor.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: سألته عما ينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: الحدث، تسمع صوته أو تجد ريحه.
englishText: I asked him about what invalidates wudu. He said: Hadath, when you hear its sound or find its smell.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: قلت للصادق عليه السالم: أجد الريح في بطني حتى أظن أنها قد خرجت؟ فقال: ليس عليك وضوء حتى تسمع الصوت، أو تجد الريح، ثم اقل: إن إبليس يجلس بين أليتي الرجل، فيحدث ليشككه.
englishText: I said to Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): I feel wind in my stomach until I think it has come out? He said: Wudu is not obligatory upon you until you hear the sound or smell the odor. Then he said: Indeed Iblis sits between a person's buttocks and creates hadath to cause doubt.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم - في حديث األربعمأة - اقل: من كان عىل يقين فشك فليمض عىل يقينه، إفن الشك ال ينقض اليقين، الوضوء بعد الطهور عشر حسنات، فتطهروا، وإايكم والكسل، إفن من كسل لم يؤد حق هللا عز وجل، تنظفوا ابلماء من نتن الريح الذي يتأذى به، تعهدوا أنفسكم إفن هللا يبغض من عباده القاذورة، الذي يتأنف به من جلس إليه، إذا خالط النوم القلب وجب الوضوء، إذا غلبتك عينك وأنت في الصالة افقطع الصالة ونم، إفنك ال تدري لعلك أن تدعو عىل نفسك.
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) - in the hadith of four hundred - he said: Whoever has certainty then doubts should proceed based on his certainty, for doubt does not invalidate certainty. Wudu after being pure is worth ten good deeds, so purify yourselves and beware of laziness, for whoever is lazy will not fulfill the rights of Allah the Mighty and Majestic. Clean yourselves with water from offensive odors that cause harm. Take care of yourselves for Allah dislikes from His servants the filthy one whom those who sit with find repulsive. When sleep overtakes the heart, wudu becomes obligatory. If sleep overcomes you while you are in prayer, break the prayer and sleep, for you do not know, perhaps you may invoke against yourself (*). Translator: * One may inadvertently pray for something harmful or negative against oneself.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: اقل لي أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إذا استيقنت أنك قد أحدثت فتوضأ، وإايك أن تحدث وضوءا أبدا حتى تستيقن أنك قد أحدثت.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said to me: When you are certain that you have Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath... invalidated your ablution, then perform ablution, and beware of making a new ablution ever until you are certain that you have invalidated it.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: أذانن وعينان، تنام العينان وال تنام األذانن. وذلك ال ينقض الوضوء، إفذا انمت العينان، واألذانن انتقض الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The ears and eyes - the eyes sleep but the ears do not sleep. This does not invalidate the ablution. However, when both the eyes and ears sleep, the ablution is invalidated.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: عن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل يتئك في المسجد فال يدرى انم، أم ال، هل عليه وضوء؟ اقل: إذا شك فليس عليه وضوء. اقل: وسألته عن رجل يكون في الصالة، فيعلم أن ريحا قد خرجت، فال يجد ريحها وال يسمع صوتها؟ اقل: يعيد الوضوء والصالة، وال يعتد بشئ مما صىل إذا علم ذلك يقينا.
englishText: From Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man who reclines in the mosque and does not know whether he slept or not, does he need to perform ablution? He said: If he is in doubt, then he does not need to perform ablution. He said: And I asked him about a man who is in prayer and knows that wind has passed, but he neither smells it nor hears its sound? He said: He should repeat both the ablution and the prayer, and nothing of what he prayed counts if he knows this with certainty.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated Except By Certainty Of Occurrence Of Hadath (Ritual Impurity), Not By Doubt Or Suspicion
arabicText: وروى المحقق في (المعتبر) عنه عليه السالم اقل: إذا وجد أحدكم في بطنه شيئا، أفشكل عليه، أخرج منه شئ، أم ال؟ لم يخرج من المسجد، حتى يسمع صوات، أو يجد ريحا.
englishText: Al-Muhaqqiq reported in (Al-Mu'tabar) from him (peace be upon him) who said: If one of you feels something in his stomach and is unsure whether something has come out or not, he should not leave the mosque until he hears a sound or finds a smell.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم اقل: ال ينقض الوضوء إال ما خرج من طرفيك، أو النوم.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) who said: Nothing invalidates ablution except what comes out from your two ends, or sleep.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر، وأبي عبد هللا عليهما السالم ما ينقض الوضوء؟ فقاال: ما يخرج من طرفيك األسفلين، من الذكر والدبر، من الغائط والبول، أو مني، أو ريح، والنوم حتى يذهب العقل، وكل النوم يكره إال أن تكون تسمع الصوت.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both: What nullifies wudu? They both said: What comes out from your two lower openings, from the front and back, of excrement and urine, or semen, or wind, and sleep until consciousness is lost, and all sleep is disliked except when you can still hear sound.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: أنه سمع أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: ليس تنقض الوضوء إال ما خرج من طرفيك األسفلين.
englishText: He heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Nothing invalidates ablution except what comes out from your two lower ends.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ليس ينقض الوضوء إال ما خرج من طرفيك األسفلين الذين أنعم هللا عليك بهما.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Nothing invalidates ablution except what comes out from your two lower ends which Allah has bestowed you with.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: سألته عن الرعاف، والحجامة، وكل دم سائل فقال: ليس في هذا وضوء، إنما الوضوء من طرفيك الذين أنعم هللا بهما عليك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about nosebleed, cupping, and all flowing blood. He said: These do not require ablution. Ablution is only from your two ends which Allah has bestowed you with.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: سألت الرضا عليه السالم عن الناصور، أينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: إنما ينقض الوضوء ثالث: البول، والغائط، والريح.
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about anal fistula, does it invalidate ablution? He said: Only three things invalidate ablution: urine, feces, and passing wind.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن الرضا عليه السالم اقل: إنما وجب الوضوء مما خرج من الطرفين خاصة، ومن النوم دون سائر األشياء، ألن الطرفين هما طريق النجاسة، وليس لإلنسان طريق تصيبه النجاسة من نفسه إال منهما، أفمروا ابلطهارة عندما تصيبهم تلك النجاسة من أنفسهم.
englishText: From Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, who said: Wudu was only made obligatory for what comes out from the two ends specifically, and from sleep but not other things, because the two ends are the paths of impurity, and there is no path through which impurity reaches a person from themselves except through these two. So they were commanded to purify themselves when that impurity reaches them from themselves.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: وفي (عيون األخبار): ابإلسناد اآلتي عن الفضل، اقل: سأل المأمون الرضا عليه السالم عن محض اإلسالم فكتب إليه - في كتاب طويل :- وال ينقض الوضوء إال غائط، أو بول، أو ريح، أو نوم، أو جنابة.
englishText: From (Uyun al-Akhbar): With the upcoming chain of narration from Al-Fadhl, who said: Al-Ma'mun asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about pure Islam, so he wrote to him - in a long letter: Nothing invalidates wudu except defecation, urination, passing wind, sleep, or janabah (ritual impurity).

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الرضا (عليه السالم) - في حديث طويل - اقل: اقل أبو جعفر (عليه السالم): ال ينقض الوضوء إال ما خرج من طرفيك الذين جعل هللا لك، أو اقل: الذين أنعم هللا بهما عليك.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) - in a long hadith - he said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Nothing invalidates wudu except what comes out from your two ends which Allah has made for you, or he said: which Allah has bestowed you with.

chapter: Urination, Defecation, Passing Wind, Seminal Emission, And Major Ritual Impurity Invalidating Ablution
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) اقل: وعلة التخفيف في البول والغائط، ألنه أكثر وأدوم من الجنابة، فرضى فيه ابلوضوء لكثرته ومشقته، ومجيئه بغير إرادة منهم وال شهوة، والجنابة ال تكون إال ابالستلذاذ منهم، واإلكراه ألنفسهم.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The reason for the lighter purification for urine and feces is because they occur more frequently and regularly than sexual impurity (janabah). Thus the requirement of ablution was accepted for them due to their frequency and hardship, and their occurrence without intention or desire from them, while sexual impurity only occurs through their seeking pleasure and their own willing involvement. chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم اقل: ال ينقض الوضوء إال ما خرج من طرفيك، أو النوم.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) who said: Nothing invalidates ablution except what comes out from your two ends, or sleep.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سألنا الرضا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل ينام عىل دابته؟ فقال: إذا ذهب النوم ابلعقل فليعد الوضوء.
englishText: We asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a man who sleeps while on his riding animal? He said: If sleep takes away consciousness, then he must repeat the ablution.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سمعته يقول: من انم وهو راكع، أو ساجد، أو ماش، عىل أي الحاالت، فعليه الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him saying: Whoever falls asleep while bowing, prostrating, or walking, in any of these states, must perform ablution.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ال ينقض الوضوء إال حدث، والنوم حدث.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Nothing invalidates ablution except hadath (impurity), and sleep is a hadath.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل ينام وهو ساجد؟ اقل: ينصرف ويتوضأ.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who falls asleep while prostrating? He said: He should leave (the prayer) and perform ablution.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: سألته عن الرجل يخفق وهو في الصالة؟ فقال: إن كان ال يحفظ حداث منه - إن كان - فعليه، الوضوء وإعادة الصالة، وإن كان يستيقن أنه لم يحدث فليس عليه وضوء وال إعادة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I asked him about a man who dozes while in prayer? He said: If he does not remember if he had invalidated his ablution - if it happened - then he must perform ablution and repeat the prayer. But if he is certain he did not invalidate his ablution, then he does not need to perform ablution or repeat the prayer.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): قوله تعالى: (إذا قمتم إلى الصالة) ما يعني بذلك إذا قمتم إلى الصالة؟ اقل: إذا قمتم من النوم، قلت: ينقض النوم الوضوء؟ فقال: نعم إذا كان يغلب عىل السمع، وال يسمع الصوت.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about Allah's saying "when you rise to prayer" [Quran, 5:6], what does it mean 'when you rise to prayer'? He said: When you rise from sleep. I asked: Does sleep invalidate ablution? He said: Yes, when it overtakes hearing and one cannot hear sounds.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الخفقة والخفقتين، فقال: ما أدري ما الخفقة والخفقتين، إن هللا تعالى يقول: (بل اإلنسان عىل نفسه بصيرة)، إن عليا (عليه السالم) كان يقول: من وجد طعم النوم إفنما أوجب عليه الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about dozing once or twice. He said: I do not know what dozing once or twice means. Allah says "Rather, man is evidence against himself" [Quran, 75:14]. Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: Whoever experiences the taste of sleep must perform ablution.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) وذكر مثله إال أنه اقل: من وجد طعم النوم اقئما أو اقعدا فقد وجب عليه الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and he mentioned similar to it except that he said: Whoever experiences sleep while standing or sitting, wudu becomes obligatory upon him. Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, A...

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ليس يرخص في النوم في شئ من الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no concession regarding sleep in any part of the prayer.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سئل موسى بن جعفر (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يرقد وهو اقعد، هل عليه وضوء؟ فقال: ال وضوء عليه ما دام اقعدا، إن لم ينفرج.
englishText: Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who sleeps while sitting, is wudu required of him? He said: No wudu is required of him as long as he remains sitting, if he does not sprawl out (*). Translator: * Meaning that their body does not spread apart or open up in a way that could indicate a deeper level of unconsciousness. And that they maintain a seated posture without the legs or arms spreading apart significantly which could suggest a loss of control.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: أنه سأله عن الرجل يخفق رأسه وهو في الصالة اقئما أو راكعا؟ فقال: ليس عليه وضوء.
englishText: From Imam Rida (peace be upon him), when asked about a person whose head nods while standing or bowing in prayer? He said: No ablution is required.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) اقل: (إنما وجب الوضوء مما خرج من الطرفين خاصة ومن النوم دون سائر األشياء، ألن الطرفين هما طريق النجاسة - إلى أن اقل - وأما النوم، إفن النائم إذا غلب عليه النوم يفتح كل شئ منه، واسترىخ، فكان أغلب األشياء عليه فيما يخرج منه الريح فوجب عليه الوضوء لهذه العلة.
englishText: From Imam Rida (peace be upon him) who said: Ablution is only required for what comes out of the two openings specifically, and from sleep but not other things, because the two openings are the path of impurity - until he said - and as for sleep, when sleep overcomes the sleeper, everything in him opens and relaxes, and the most likely thing to occur is the passing of wind, so ablution became obligatory for this reason.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن عمران بن حمران أنه سمع عبدا صالحا(عليه السالم) يقول: من انم وهو جالس ال يتعمد النوم فال و ضوء عليه.
englishText: From Imran bin Hamran that he heard a righteous servant (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever falls asleep while sitting without intending to sleep, no ablution is required of him.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) هل ينام الرجل وهو جالس فقال: كان أبي يقول: إذا انم الرجل وهو جالس مجتمع فليس عليه وضوء، وإذا انم مضطجعا فعليه الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Does a man's sleep while sitting invalidate his ablution? He said: My father used to say: If a man sleeps while sitting in a collected position, ablution is not required, but if he sleeps lying down, ablution is required.

chapter: Sleep Which Overwhelms Hearing Invalidates Ablution In Any State, And Nothing Invalidates Ablution Except For The Explicitly Mentioned Occurrences
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في الرجل هل ينقض وضوؤه إذا انم وهو جالس؟ اقل: إن كان يوم الجمعة في المسجد فال وضوء عليه، وذلك أنه في حال ضرورة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man, does his ablution become invalid if he sleeps while sitting? He said: If it is Friday and he is in the mosque, no ablution is required upon him, because this is a state of necessity. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The reasoning is known and it can be assumed that it means he should perform tayammum (dry ablution) due to the impossibility of performing ablution, as explicitly stated to be due to necessity, and what comes in the section on tayammum has been previously mentioned and will be addressed further.
