chapter: Ruling On What Removes Sanity From Fainting, Insanity, Intoxication, And Others
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن (عليه السالم) عن رجل به، علة ال يقدر عىل االضطجاع، والوضوء يشتد عليه وهو اقعد مستند ابلوسائد، فربما اغفى وهو اقعد عىل تلك الحال؟ اقل: يتوضأ، قلت له: إن الوضوء يشتد عليه لحال علته؟ فقال: إذا خفى عليه الصوت فقد وجب عليه الوضوء، واقل: يؤخر الظهر ويصليها مع العصر، يجمع بينهما، وكذلك المغرب والعشاء.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man with an illness who is unable to lie down, and performing ablution is difficult for him while he is sitting supported by pillows, and sometimes he dozes off while sitting in that condition? He said: He should perform ablution. I said to him: Performing ablution is difficult for him due to his illness? He said: When sound becomes unclear to him (when he loses consciousness), ablution becomes obligatory upon him. And he said: He should delay Dhuhr prayer and pray it with Asr prayer, combining them together, and likewise for Maghrib and Isha prayers.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في الرجل يخرج منه مثل حب القرع، اقل: ليس عليه وضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who discharges something like gourd seeds, he said: He does not need to perform ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: In the margin of the manuscript, it is stated: If from one of the two paths (anus or urethra) exits worms or other insects, stones, blood other than the three (conditions that traditionally require ablution), a hair, a blade of grass, or oil dripped into one's urethra, it does not nullify ablution unless it is accompanied by something from the nullifiers. Our scholars unanimously agree on this principle, based on the original texts and what has been mentioned in the narrations.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: اقل الكليني: وروي: إذا كانت متلطخة ابلعذرة أعاد الوضوء.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And it is narrated: If it is contaminated with feces, he must repeat the ablution.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ليس في حب القرع والديدان الصغار وضوء، إنما هو بمنزلة القمل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no need for ablution due to intestinal worms and small worms, as they are of the same status as lice.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، في الرجل يسقط منه الدواب وهو في الصالة، اقل: يمضي في صالته، وال ينقض ذلك وضوؤه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man from whom creatures fall while he is in prayer, he said: He should continue his prayer, and this does not invalidate his ablution.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: سئل عن الرجل يكون في صالته، فيخرج منه حب القرع كيف يصنع؟ اقل: إن كان خرج نظيفا من العذرة فليس عليه شئ، ولم ينقض وضوؤه، وإن خرج متلطخا ابلعذرة فعليه أن يعيد الوضوء، وإن كان في صالته قطع الصالة وأعاد الوضوء والصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked about a man who is in his prayer, and pumpkin seeds come out from him, what should he do? He said: If it comes out clean from feces, then nothing is required of him, and his ablution is not nullified. But if it comes out contaminated with feces, then he must repeat the ablution, and if he was in prayer, he should break the prayer and repeat both the ablution and prayer.

chapter: That Which Comes Out From The Posterior Such As Pumpkin Seeds And Worms Does Not Invalidate Ablution Unless It Is Contaminated With Feces
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: اقل في الرجل يخرج منه مثل حب القرع اقل: عليه وضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He said regarding a man from whom something like pumpkin seeds comes out, he said: He must perform ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as being smeared with feces due to the previous detail, which is plausible and can also be considered as taqiyyah for its agreement with it, and the reason for its general statement is considering this dissimulation. It can also be interpreted as a rhetorical question, and it's possible that a mistake occurred from the copier based on what was previously mentioned through Al-Kulayni's path in the narration of this very hadith, where it states no ablution is required. Thus, it seems the word "not" (laysa) might have been dropped from the Sheikh's version. Several narrations have already restricted the nullifiers, which indicate the intended meaning here.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يتجشأ فيخرج منه شئ، أيعيد الوضوء؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who burps and something comes out, should he repeat wudu? He said: No.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا اقء الرجل، وهو عىل طهر فليتمضمض.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man vomits while he is in a state of purity, he should rinse his mouth.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن القئ، هل ينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: ال
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about vomiting, does it invalidate wudu? He said: No.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: القهقهة ال تنقض الوضوء، وينقض الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Guffawing does not invalidate wudu, but it invalidates prayer.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سماعة اقل: سألته عن القلس وهي الجشأة، يرتفع الطعام من جوف الرجل، من غير أن يكون تقيأ، وهو اقئم في الصالة؟ اقل: ال ينقض ذلك وضوؤه.
englishText: Sama'ah said: I asked him about regurgitation which is burping, when food rises from a man's stomach without being vomit, while he is standing in prayer? He said: This does not invalidate his wudu.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت الرضا (عليه السالم) عن القئ، والرعاف، والمدة، أينقض الوضوء أم ال؟ اقل: ال تنقض شيئا.
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about vomiting, nosebleed, and pus, do they invalidate wudu or not? He said: They do not invalidate anything.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن (عليه السالم) عن الرعاف والحجامة والقئ؟ اقل: ال ينقض هذا شيئا من الوضوء، ولكن ينقض الصالة.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting? He said: None of these invalidate wudu, but they invalidate prayer.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن القئ؟ اقل: ليس فيه وضوء، وإن تقيأت متعمدا.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about vomiting? He said: It does not require ablution, even if you vomit intentionally.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ليس في القئ وضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Vomiting does not require ablution.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: وابسناده: إن التبسم في الصالة، ال ينقض الصالة، وال ينقض الوضوء، إنما يقطع الضحك الذي فيه القهقهة.
englishText: And with its chain of narration: Smiling during prayer does not invalidate the prayer, nor does it invalidate the ablution. Only laughter that contains guffaw breaks it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh mentioned that the interruption is specific to the prayer because it is only applicable in it, not in ablution.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألته عما ينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: الحدث تسمع صوته، أو تجد ريحه، والقرقرة في البطن إال شيئا تصبر عليه، والضحك في الصالة، والقئ.
englishText: I asked him about what invalidates ablution? He said: Breaking wind where you hear its sound or smell it, gurgling in the stomach except what you can bear, laughing during prayer, and vomiting. Shaykh Hurr Amili: His saying, "except for something you can tolerate," means: you restrain it and do not release it, and it's known that this refers to wind, so releasing it nullifies ablution, not just mere rumbling.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الرعاف، والقئ والتخليل يسيل الدم، إذا استكرهت شيئا ينقض الوضوء، وإن لم تستكرهه لم ينقص الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Nosebleed, vomiting, and blood flowing from tooth cleaning - if you force any of these it invalidates ablution, and if you don't force it, it doesn't invalidate ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Its interpretation can be based on taqiyyah for its agreement with the general populace's views, and it might also be considered recommended practice.

chapter: Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stomach Gurgling - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: ال يقطع التبسم الصالة، وتقطعها القهقهة، وال تنقض الوضوء.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Smiling does not break the prayer, but guffawing breaks it, and does not invalidate ablution. Vomiting, Pus, Suppuration, Burping, Laughing, Guffawing, And Stoma...

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن الرجل أيخذه الرعاف، والقئ، في الصالة كيف يصنع؟ اقل: ينفتل، فيغسل أنفه، ويعود في صالته، وإن تكلم فليعد صالته، وليس عليه وضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who gets a nosebleed and vomits during prayer, what should he do? He said: He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to his prayer. If he speaks, he must repeat his prayer, but he does not need to perform wudu.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: سألته عن رجل رعف فلم يرق رعافه حتى دخل وقت الصالة؟ اقل: يحشو أنفه بشئ ثم يصيل، ويطيل إن خشي أن يسبقه الدم.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: I asked him about a man who had a nosebleed that did not stop until the prayer time entered? He said: He should stuff his nose with something then pray, and he should pray slowly if he fears the blood will flow.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم اقل: سألته عن الرجل تخرج به القروح، ال تزال تدمي كيف يصيل؟ اقل: يصيل وإن كانت الدماء تسيل.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about a man who has ulcers that continue to bleed, how should he pray? He said: He should pray even if blood is flowing.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سمعته يقول: لو رعفت دوراق ما زدت عىل أن أمسح مني الدم واصيل.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him say: If I were to have a nosebleed filling a pot, I would not do more than wipe away the blood from me and pray.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: اقل: سمعته يقول: إذا اقء الرجل وهو عىل طهر فليتمضمض، وإذا رعف وهو عىل وضوء فليغسل أنفه، إفن ذلك يجزيه وال يعيد وضوءه.
englishText: He said: I heard him saying: If a man vomits while in a state of purity, he should rinse his mouth, and if he gets a nosebleed while having wudu, he should wash his nose, for that suffices him and he does not need to repeat his wudu.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الحجامة، أفيها وضوء؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about cupping (hijamah), is ablution required for it? He said: No.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سمعته يقول في الرجل يرعف وهو عىل وضوء، اقل: يغسل آاثر الدم ويصيل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: I heard him speaking about a man who gets a nosebleed while having wudu, he said: He should wash the traces of blood and pray.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم أينقض الرعاف، والقئ، ونتف اإلبط الوضوء؟ فقال: وما تصنع بهذا؟ هذا قول المغيرة بن سعيد، لعن هللا المغيرة، يجزيك من الرعاف والقئ أن تغسله وال تعيد الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) if nosebleed, vomiting, and plucking armpit hair nullify ablution? He said: "What do you have to do with this? This is the saying of Al-Mughira bin Sa'id, may Allah curse Al-Mughira. For nosebleed and vomiting, it suffices to wash it and you don't need to repeat ablution."

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سألته عن رجل أخذه تقطير من قرحه إما دم، وإما غيره؟ اقل: فليضع خريطة، وليتوضأ وليصل، إفنما ذلك بالء ابتىل به، فال يعيدن إال من الحدث الذي يتوضأ منه.
englishText: I asked him about a man who had dripping from his wound, whether blood or something else? He said: Let him place a pad, perform ablution and pray, for this is only a trial he has been afflicted with, and he should not repeat except for the hadath (occurrences) for which ablution is normally performed. Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other ...

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الرعاف والحجامة وكل دم سائل؟ فقال: ليس في هذا وضوء، إنما الوضوء من طرفيك الذين أنعم هللا بهما عليك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about nosebleed, cupping, and all flowing blood? He said: There is no need for ablution in these cases. Ablution is only required from your two ends which Allah has bestowed upon you.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سمعت أاب الحسن عليه السالم يقول: كان أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: في الرجل يدخل يده في أنفه فيصيب خمس أصابعه الدم، اقل: ينقيه، وال يعيد الوضوء.
englishText: I heard Abu al-Hasan, peace be upon him, saying: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, used to say regarding a man who puts his finger in his nose and blood gets on his five fingers, he said: He should clean it, and does not need to repeat the ablution.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن رجل أصابه دم سائل؟ اقل: يتوضأ ويعيد، اقل: وإن لم يكن سائال توضأ وبنى، اقل: ويصنع ذلك بين الصفا والمروة.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, was asked about a man who was touched by flowing blood? He said: He should perform ablution and restart. He said: And if it was not flowing, he should perform ablution and continue. He said: And he does that between Safa and Marwa. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Its interpretation will come.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: سمعته يقول: رأيت أبي صلوات هللا عليه وقد رعف - بعد ما توضأ - دما سائال فتوضأ.
englishText: I heard him saying: I saw my father (peace be upon him) get a flowing nosebleed after performing ablution, so he performed ablution again. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh has interpreted them as being due to taqiyyah, and it is permissible to interpret them as recommended actions, and as washing the area, for it is called ablution, in light of the preceding narrations from Abu Basir, Abu Habib, and others. The author of Al-Muntaqa said: Interpreting it as recommended is not actually an interpretation because mere action does not indicate obligation, end of discussion. It's also possible to interpret it as the occurrence of another event, such as passing wind or similar, and as renewing the ablution.

chapter: Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other Than Menstruation, Irregular Bleeding, And Postnatal Bleeding
arabicText: عن عيل بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم، اقل: سألته عن رجل استاك أو تخلل فخرج من فمه دم، أينقض ذلك الوضوء؟ اقل: ال، ولكن يتمضمض، اقل: وسألته عن رجل كان في صالته فرماه رجل فشجه، فسال الدم؟ فقال: ال ينقض الوضوء ولكنه يقطع الصالة.
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: I asked him about a man who used a tooth stick or picked his teeth and blood came from his mouth, does this invalidate the ablution? He said: No, but he should rinse his mouth. And I asked him about a man who was in his prayer when another man struck him causing a head wound, and blood flowed? He said: It does not invalidate the ablution but it breaks the prayer. Wudu Is Not Invalidated By Nosebleed, Cupping, Or Blood Flow Other ...

chapter: Poetry Recitation Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن إنشاد الشعر، هل ينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about reciting poetry, does it invalidate ablution? He said: No.

chapter: Poetry Recitation Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: وما روى من إنشاد أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم الشعر - في بعض الخطب عىل المنبر، ولم ينقل أنه خرج للوضوء.
englishText: And what has been narrated about Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) reciting poetry - in some sermons on the pulpit, and it was not transmitted that he left to perform ablution.

chapter: Poetry Recitation Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألته عن نشيد الشعر، هل ينقض الوضوء أو ظلم الرجل صاحبه، أو الكذب؟ فقال: نعم، إال أن يكون شعرا يصدق فيه، أو يكون يسيرا من الشعر األبيات الثالثة واألربعة، أفما أن يكثر من الشعر الباطل فهو ينقض الوضوء.
englishText: I asked him about reciting poetry, does it invalidate wudu, or a man wronging his companion, or lying? He said: Yes, except if it is poetry containing truth, or if it is a small amount of poetry like three or four verses. But if one recites much false poetry then it invalidates wudu. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as recommended (not obligatory), and some of our scholars have reported a consensus on the absence of obligation, which indicates the preference of the first interpretation.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، في المرأة تكون في الصالة فتظن أنها قد حاضت، اقل: تدخل يدها فتمس الموضع إفن رأت شيئا انصرفت، وإن لم تر شيئا أتمت صالتها.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a woman who is in prayer and thinks she is menstruating, he said: She should insert her hand and touch the area. If she sees anything, she should leave; if she doesn't see anything, she should complete her prayer.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ليس في المذي من الشهوة، وال من اإلنعاظ، وال من القبلة، وال من مس الفرج، وال من المضاجعة، وضوء، وال يغسل منه الثوب وال الجسد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: There is no need for ablution due to pre-seminal fluid from desire, nor from erection, nor from kissing, nor from touching the private parts, nor from lying together, and neither the clothing nor the body needs to be washed from it.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: ليس في القبلة، وال المباشرة، وال مس الفرج وضوء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: There is no wudu required for kissing, touching, or touching private parts.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم: ما تقول في الرجل يتوضأ ثم يدعو جاريته، فتأخذ بيده حتى ينتهي إلى المسجد؟ إفن من عندان يزعمون أنها المالمسة، فقال: ال وهللا، ما بذلك أبس، وربما فعلته، وما يعني )بهذا أو المستم النساء( إال المواقعة في الفرج.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: What do you say about a man who performs ablution then calls his slave girl, and she takes his hand until he reaches the mosque? For those among us claim that this is the touching (referred to in the Quran). He said: No, by Allah, there is nothing wrong with that, and I have sometimes done it. And what is meant by (this or you touched women) [Quran, 4:43] is only sexual intercourse.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن القبلة، تنقض الوضوء؟ اقل: ال أبس.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about kissing, does it invalidate wudu? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل مس فرج امرأته؟ اقل: ليس عليه شئ، وإن شاء غسل يده، والقبلة ال يتوضأ منها.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who touched his wife's private part? He said: There is nothing upon him, and if he wishes he may wash his hand, and the kiss does not invalidate ablution.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل يعبث بذكره في الصالة المكتوبة؟ فقال: ال أبس به.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: I asked him about a man who touches his private part during the obligatory prayer? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يمس ذكره أو فرجه أو أسفل من ذلك، وهو اقئم يصىل، يعيد وضوءه؟ فقال: ال أبس بذلك، إنما هو من جسده.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who touches his private parts or lower than that while standing in prayer, should he repeat his ablution? He said: There is no problem with that, as it is part of his body.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا قبل الرجل مرأة من شهوة، أو مس فرجها، أعاد الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a man kisses a woman with desire, or touches her private parts, he must repeat the ablution.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سئل عن الرجل يتوضأ ثم يمس ابطن دبره؟ اقل: نقض وضوءه، وإن مس ابطن إحليله فعليه أن يعيد الوضوء، وإن كان في الصالة قطع الصالة، ويتوضأ ويعيد الصالة، وإن فتح إحليله أعاد الوضوء وأعاد الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: He was asked about a man who performs ablution then touches the inside of his posterior? He said: It nullifies his ablution, and if he touches the inside of his private part then he must repeat the ablution, and if he is in prayer he should stop the prayer, perform ablution and repeat the prayer, and if he opens his private part he must repeat the ablution and repeat the prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The two narrations must be interpreted as practicing taqiyyah because they conform to it, as stated by a group of our companions.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم في قوله تعالى: أو المستم النساء فلم تجدوا ماء فتيمموا أن المراد به الجماع (خاصة) .
englishText: From Ali, peace be upon him, regarding His saying: or you have touched women and cannot find water, then do tayammum [Quran, 4:43], that what is meant by it is sexual intercourse (specifically).

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اللمس هو الجماع، ولكن هللا ستير يحب الستر، فلم يسم كما تسمون.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Al-lams (touching mentioned in the Quran, 4:43) means sexual intercourse, but Allah is concealing and loves concealment, so He did not name it as you name it.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اللمس الجماع.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Al-lams (touching mentioned in the Quran, 4:43) means sexual intercourse.

chapter: Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Similar Acts Other Than Intercourse Do Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سأله قيس بن رمانة فقال له: أتوضأ، ثم أدعو الجارية فتمسك بيدي، أفقوم أفصيل، أعىل وضوء؟ اقل: ال، اقل: إفنهم يزعمون أنه اللمس؟ اقل: ال وهللا، ما اللمس إال الواقع - يعني الجماع - ثم اقل: كان أبو جعفر عليه السالم - بعد ما كبر - يتوضأ، ثم يدعو الجارية، فتأخذ بيده، فيقوم فيصيل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Qays bin Rumanah asked him saying: I perform ablution, then I call the maid who holds my hand, then I stand to pray - am I still in a state of ablution? He said: Yes. He said: But they claim it is touching? He said: No, by Allah, Al-lams (touching mentioned in the Quran, 4:43) refers only to intercourse - meaning sexual intercourse. Then he said: Abu Ja'far Kissing, Touching, Lying Together, Touching Private Parts And Simil... (peace be upon him) - after he became old - would perform ablution, then call the maid who would take his hand, and he would stand and pray.

chapter: Contact Of Urine And Excrement With The Body Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم: رجل وطئ عىل عذرة، فساخت رجله فيها، أينقض ذلك وضوءه؟ وهل يجب عليه غسلها؟ فقال: ال يغسلها، إال أن يقذرها، ولكنه يمسحها حتى يذهب أثرها، ويصيل.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: A man stepped on excrement, and his foot sank into it - does this invalidate his ablution? And is it obligatory for him to wash it? He said: He does not need to wash it except if it soils it, but he should wipe it until its trace is gone, and then he can pray.

chapter: Contact Of Urine And Excrement With The Body Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يطأ في العذرة، أو البول أيعيد الوضوء؟ اقل: ال، ولكن يغسل ما أصابه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who steps in excrement or urine, should he repeat the ablution? He said: No, but he should wash what was affected by it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And this is indicated by the narrations that specify the nullifiers of ablution, which have been mentioned before, and it is appropriate to reconcile them by giving the option between washing and wiping, or specifying washing for when impurity affects parts other than the bottom of the foot, as will be discussed in the section on impurities, God willing.

chapter: Touching A Dog Or A Disbeliever Does Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الكلب السلوقي؟ فقال: إذا مسسته افغسل يدك.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Saluqi dog? He said: If you touch it, wash your hand. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Saluq: A village in Yemen to which armors and dogs are attributed from, as mentioned in Al-Sahah, Volume 4, Page 1498.

chapter: Touching A Dog Or A Disbeliever Does Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألته عن رجل صافح مجوسيا؟ اقل: يغسل يده وال يتوضأ.
englishText: I asked him about a man who shook hands with a Magian? He said: He should wash his hand but not perform wudu.

chapter: Touching A Dog Or A Disbeliever Does Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الكلب يصيب شيئا من جسد الرجل؟ اقل: يغسل المكان الذي أصابه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a dog touching a part of a man's body? He said: Wash the place it touched.

chapter: Touching A Dog Or A Disbeliever Does Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من مس كلبا فليتوضأ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever touches a dog should perform wudu.

chapter: Touching A Dog Or A Disbeliever Does Not Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: أنه سأل أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل يحل له أن يصافح المجوسي؟ فقال: ال، فسأله: أيتوضأ إذا صافحهم؟ اقل: نعم، إن مصافحتهم تنقض الوضوء.
englishText: He asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about whether it is permissible for a man to shake hands with a Magian? He said: No. He then asked: Should he perform wudu if he shakes hands with them? He said: Yes, shaking hands with them invalidates wudu. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted ablution in these two narrations as washing the hand, because that is called ablution, due to the consensus of the group that this does not invalidate ablution.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أحدهما عليهما السالم عن المذي؟ فقال: ال ينقض الوضوء وال يغسل منه ثوب وال جسد، إنما هو بمنزلة المخاط، والبصاق.
englishText: I asked one of them (peace be upon them both) about pre-ejaculatory fluid? He said: It does not invalidate ablution, and neither clothes nor body need to be washed from it. It is merely like mucus and saliva.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن سال من ذكرك شئ من مذي، أو ودي، وأنت في الصالة فال تغسله، وال تقطع له الصالة، وال تنقض له الوضوء، وإن بلغ عقبيك، إفنما ذلك بمنزلة النخامة، وكل شئ خرج منك بعد الوضوء إفنه من الحبائل، أو من البواسير، وليس بشئ، فال تغسله من ثوبك إال أن تقذره.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: If something flows from your private part like madhy or wady while you are in prayer, do not wash it, do not break your prayer for it, and do not invalidate your ablution for it, even if it reaches your heels, for it is like phlegm. And everything that comes out of you after wudu is from the urethral discharge or from hemorrhoids, and it is nothing, so do not wash it from your clothes unless you find it disgusting.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن المذي يسيل حتى يصيب الفخذ؟ اقل: ال يقطع صالته، وال يغسله من فخذه، إنه لم يخرج من مخرج المني، إنما هو بمنزلة النخامة.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, he was asked about pre-seminal fluid that flows until it reaches the thigh? He said: It does not invalidate his prayer, and he does not need to wash it from his thigh, as it does not come from the same passage as semen, rather it is like mucus.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: ال نرى في المذي وضوءا وال غسال ما أصاب الثوب منه، إال في الماء األكبر.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: We do not see that madhi requires wudu or washing what it touches of clothes, except in case of major discharge.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: المذي ينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: ال، وال يغسل منه الثوب وال الجسد، إنما هو بمنزلة البزاق، والمخاط.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: Does pre-seminal fluid invalidate wudu? He said: No, and neither the clothes nor the body need to be washed from it. It is only like saliva and mucus.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: يخرج من اإلحليل المنى، والوذي، والمذي، والودي، أفما المني فهو الذي يستريخ له العظام، ويفتر منه الجسد، وفيه الغسل، وأما المذي يخرج من شهوة وال شئ فيه، وأما الودي فهو الذي يخرج بعد البول، وأما الوذي فهو الذي يخرج من األدواء وال شئ فيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: From the urethra comes forth semen, wathi, madhi, and wadi. As for semen, it is that which causes the bones to become relaxed and the body to become languid, and it requires ghusl (ritual bath). As for madhi, it comes out from desire and nothing is required for it. As for wadi, it is what comes out after urination. As for wathi, it is what comes out due to ailments and nothing is required for it.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: سألته عن المذي؟ فقال: إن عليا عليه السالم كان رجال مذاء، افستحيى أن يسأل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم لمكان افطمة عليها السالم، أفمر المقداد أن يسأله وهو جالس، فسأله، فقال له النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم: ليس بشئ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about pre-seminal fluid (madhi)? He said: Ali peace be upon him was a man who had frequent pre-seminal discharge, and he was shy to ask the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family due to Fatima's position peace be upon her, so he instructed Al-Miqdad to ask him while he was sitting. He asked him, and the Prophet peace be upon him and his family said: It is nothing.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن المذي؟ فقال: ما هو عندي إال كالنخامة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pre-seminal fluid (madhi)? He said: In my view it is nothing more than phlegm.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن المذي؟ أفمرني ابلوضوء منه، ثم أعدت عليه سنة أخرى، أفمرني ابلوضوء منه، واقل: إن عليا عليه السالم أمر المقداد أن يسأل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم واستحيى أن يسأله، فقال: فيه الوضوء. قلت: وإن لم أتوضأ، اقل: ال أبس.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about pre-seminal fluid (madhi)? He ordered me to perform ablution because of it. Then I asked him again another year, and he ordered me to perform ablution because of it, and said: Indeed Ali, peace be upon him, asked Al-Miqdad to ask the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, as he was shy to ask him, so he said: For it is ablution. I said: What if I do not perform ablution? He said: There is no harm.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: المذي يخرج من الرجل؟ اقل: أحد لك فيه حدا؟ اقل: قلت: نعم، جعلت فداك، اقل: فقال: إن خرج منك عىل شهوة فتوضأ، وإن خرج منك عىل غير ذلك فليس عليك فيه وضوء.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: What about the pre-seminal fluid that comes out from a man? He said: Should I set a ruling for you regarding it? I said: Yes, may I be sacrificed for you. He said: If it comes out from you with desire then perform ablution, and if it comes out from you without that then ablution is not required of you for it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And it was mentioned in the narrations about kissing that pre-ejaculate due to desire does not invalidate ablution, so this and similar [narrations] are to be understood as pertaining to taqiyyah or as recommended (mustahab).

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن المذي، أينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: إن كان من شهوة نقض.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about pre-seminal fluid, does it invalidate ablution? He said: If it is due to desire, it invalidates it.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن المذي؟ فقال: ما كان منه لشهوة فتوضأ منه.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about pre-seminal fluid (madhy)? He said: If it comes from desire, then perform ablution for it. Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid)...

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: اقل: اغتسلت يوم الجمعة ابلمدينة، ولبست أثوابي، وتطيبت، فمرت بي وصيفة، ففخذت لها، أفمذيت أان وأمنت هي، فدخلني من ذلك ضيق، فسألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن ذلك؟ فقال: ليس عليك وضوء، وال عليها غسل.
englishText: From him saying: I performed ghusl on Friday in Medina, wore my clothes, and applied perfume. Then a young maid passed by me, and I spread my thighs for her, so I had pre-seminal fluid and she had vaginal discharge. I felt distressed about that, so I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about it. He said: Neither do you need to perform wudu, nor does she need to perform ghusl.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ثالث يخرجن من اإلحليل: وهن: المني، وفيه الغسل، والودي فمنه الوضوء، ألنه يخرج من دريرة البول، اقل: والمذي ليس فيه وضوء، إنما هو بمنزلة ما يخرج من األنف.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Three things come out from the urethra, and they are: semen, which requires ghusl, and wadi which requires wudu because it comes out from the urinary passage. He said: And madhi does not require wudu, it is only like what comes out from the nose. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: This is applicable to someone who does not perform istibra (urine extraction) after urinating, and something comes out, because it would be from the remnants of urine in the end. This can also be interpreted as taqiyyah, and as recommended (mustahabb).

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الودي ال ينقض الوضوء، إنما هو بمنزلة المخاط والبزاق.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: Pre-ejaculatory fluid does not invalidate ablution, it is merely like mucus and saliva.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن الرجل يمذي - فهو في الصالة - من شهوة، أو من غير شهوة؟ اقل: المذي منه الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about a man who has pre-seminal fluid discharge - while he is in prayer - from desire or without desire? He said: Pre-seminal fluid discharge requires ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as an expression of astonishment, not a statement of fact. He said: It can also be interpreted as taqiyyah because it aligns with the majority of the general populace. This interpretation concludes. And it can be considered as a rhetorical question.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: سألت الرضا عليه السالم عن المذي؟ أفمرني ابلوضوء منه، ثم أعدت عليه في سنة أخرى، أفمرني ابلوضوء منه، واقل: إن عليا عليه السالم أمر المقداد بن األسود أن يسأل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم واستحيى أن يسأله، فقال: فيه الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about pre-seminal fluid? He instructed me to perform ablution from it. Then I asked him again in another year, and he instructed me to perform ablution from it, and he said: Indeed Ali, peace be upon him, ordered Al-Miqdad ibn Al-Aswad to ask the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, as he was shy to ask him himself, and he (the Prophet) said: It requires ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as recommended. He said: It's possible that the narrator left out part of the report, as what has been mentioned in the narration of this very report allows for omitting the ablution. And interpreting it as taqiyyah is possible, and the command to Miqdad might have been abrogated.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: كان أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم ال يرى في المذي وضوءا، وال غسل ما أصاب الثوب منه.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, did not consider wudu necessary for preseminal fluid (madhi), nor washing the clothing that it touched.

chapter: Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid), Erection, Phlegm, Saliva, And Mucus - None Of These Invalidate Wudu
arabicText: اقل: وروى أن المذي والودي، بمنزلة البصاق والمخاط، فال يغسل منهما الثوب وال اإلحليل.
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that madhi and wadi are of the status of saliva and mucus, so neither the garment nor the private part needs to be washed from them. Madhi (Pre-Seminal), Wadhi (Post-Ejaculate), Wadi (Prostatic Fluid)...

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن رجل ابل ثم توضأ، ثم اقم إلى الصالة، ثم وجد بلال؟ اقل: ال يتوضأ، إنما ذلك من الحبائل.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about a man who urinated then performed ablution, then stood for prayer, then found moisture? He said: He does not need to perform ablution again, that is only from the residual drops (from the urinary ducts).

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يبول ثم يستنيج، ثم يجد بعد ذلك بلال، اقل: إذا ابل فخرط ما بين المقعدة واألنثيين ثالث مرات، وغمز ما بينهما، ثم استنىج، إفن سال حتى يبلغ السوق فال يبالي.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who urinates then performs istinja (cleaning), then finds wetness after that. He said: When he urinates, he should press between the anus and testicles three times, and squeeze between them, then perform istinja. Then even if it continues flowing until it reaches the shin (*), he need not worry about it. Translator: * The term "suq" (plural of "saq") denotes the portion of the leg that extends from the knee to the ankle.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يبول، اقل: ينتره ثالاث، ثم إن سال حتى يبلغ السوق فال يبالي.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who urinates, he said: He should shake it three times, then if it drips even if it reaches the shin (*), he should not worry about it. Translator: * Refer to the comment in Hadith 745.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: قلت ألبي الحسن موسى (عليه السالم): إني أبول ثم أتمسح ابألحجار، فيئج مني البلل ما يفسد سراوييل، اقل؟: ليس به أبس.
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him: I urinate then wipe with stones, then moisture comes from me that spoils my trousers. He said: There is no problem with that.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: من اغتسل وهو جنب قبل أن يبول ثم يجد بلال، فقد انتقض غسله، وإن كان ابل ثم اغتسل ثم، ثم وجد بلال، فليس ينقض غسله، ولكن عليه الوضوء، ألن البول لم يدع شيئا.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Whoever performs ghusl while in a state of janabah before urinating then finds moisture, his ghusl is invalidated. But if he urinated then performed ghusl then finds moisture, his ghusl is not invalidated, but he must perform wudu, because the urine left nothing behind.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: اقل: إفن كان ابل قبل أن يغتسل فال يعيد غسله، ولكن يتوضأ ويستنيج.
englishText: He said: If one urinates before performing ghusl (ritual bath), he does not need to repeat his ghusl, but he should perform wudu and perform istinja (cleansing process after urination). Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh mentioned that these [instructions] are considered recommended, or due to the discharge of something that nullifies ablution, as indicated by the need for istinja.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: سمعت رجال سأل أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) فقال: إني ربما بلت فال أقدر عىل الماء، ويشتد ذلك عيل؟ فقال: إذا بلت، وتمسحت، افمسح ذكرك بريقك، إفن وجدت شيئا فقل: هذا من ذاك.
englishText: From a man who asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I sometimes urinate and cannot get water, and this becomes difficult for me? He replied: When you urinate and wipe yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva, and if you find something afterwards, say: This is from that. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And the wiping with saliva should be done in a place other than where impurity is, so as not to spread it.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: كتبت إلى أبي الحسن عليه السالم في الخصي يبول فيلقى من ذلك شدة، ويرى البلل بعد البلل؟ اقل: يتوضأ، وينتضح في النهار مرة واحدة.
englishText: I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding a eunuch who urinates and faces difficulty with it, and sees moisture after moisture? He replied: He should perform wudu, and sprinkle water once during the day. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It is possible that the moisture is doubtful, and sprinkling is recommended, and ablution is not commanded except once due to urination, so it is not obligatory because of Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen the moisture. It is possible that the moisture is known to be from urine, and in that case, ablution is obligatory, as is sprinkling.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: كتب إليه رجل، هل يجب الوضوء مما خرج من الذكر بعد االستبراء؟ فكتب - نعم.
englishText: A man wrote to him asking if wudu is required for what comes out of the penis after cleansing (istibra). He wrote back - Yes. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as recommended at times, and as taqiyyah at other times to align with the A'amma (general muslims), and Al-Allamah interpreted it as being due to the remnants of urine, and all interpretations are plausible. There have been narrations previously about the requirement of certainty for the occurrence of an event that invalidates ablution, and narrations that specify what invalidates ablution, which indicate what is required here.

chapter: Ruling On Uncertain Moisture After Discharge Of Urine And Semen
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) قلت: الرجل - يبول، وينتقض، ويتوضأ ثم يجد البلل بعد ذلك؟ اقل: ليس ذلك شيئا، إنما ذلك من الحبائل.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said: A man urinates, cleanses himself, and performs wudu, then finds wetness after that? He said: That is nothing, it is only from the urinary tract.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يكون عىل طهر، فيأخذ من أظفاره، أو شعره، أيعيد الوضوء؟ فقال: ال، ولكن يمسح رأسه وأظفاره ابلماء، اقل: قلت: إفنهم يزعمون أن فيه الوضوء؟ فقال: إن خاصموكم فال تخاصموهم، وقولوا: هكذا السنة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who is in a state of ritual purity, then he cuts his nails or hair, does he need to renew his ablution? He said: No, but he should wipe his head and nails with water. I said: But they claim that it requires ablution? He said: If they argue with you, do not argue with them, and say: This is the sunnah.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر (عليه السالم): الرجل يقلم أظفاره، ويجز شاربه، وأيخذ من شعر لحيته، ورأسه، هل ينقض ذلك وضوءه؟ فقال: اي زرارة كل هذا سنة، والوضوء فريضة، وليس شئ من السنة ينقض الفريضة، وإن ذلك ليزيده تطهيرا.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): A man trims his nails, cuts his mustache, and takes from the hair of his beard and head. Does this invalidate his ablution? He said: O Zurarah, all of this is Sunnah, and ablution is obligatory. Nothing from the Sunnah invalidates the obligatory, and indeed that increases his purification.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): آخذ من أظفاري ومن شاربي، وأحلق رأسي، أأفغتسل؟ اقل: ال ليس عليك غسل، قلت أفتوضأ؟ اقل: ال، ليس عليك وضوء، قلت: أفمسح عىل أظفاري الماء؟ فقال: هو طهور ليس عليك مسح.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): When I cut my nails and my mustache, and shave my head, should I perform ghusl? He said: No, ghusl is not required of you. I said: Should I perform wudu? He said: No, wudu is not required of you. I said: Should I wipe my nails with water? He said: It is purification, you are not required to wipe.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: الرجل يقرض من شعره أبسنانه، أيمسحه ابلماء قبل أن يصىل؟ اقل: ال أبس إنما ذلك في الحديد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: A man cuts his hair with his teeth, should he wipe it with water before praying? He said: There is no harm. That [ruling] is only for [cutting with] iron. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh mentioned that the wiping referred to in the context of cutting with metal is considered recommended, and this is good.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: وابإلسناد عن عمار، عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في الرجل إذا قص أظفاره ابلحديد، أو جز شعره، أو حلق قفاه، إفن عليه أن يمسحه ابلماء قبل أن يصىل، سئل: إفن صىل ولم يمسح من ذلك ابلماء؟ اقل: يعيد الصالة ألن الحديد نجس. واقل ألن الحديد لباس أهل النار، والذهب لباس أهل الجنة.
englishText: And with the chain of narration from Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who cuts his nails with iron, or trims his hair, or shaves his nape, he should wipe it with water before praying. He was asked: What if he prays without wiping that with water? He said: He should repeat the prayer because iron is impure. And he said: Because iron is the clothing of the people of Hell, and gold is the clothing of the people of Paradise. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And with the chain from Ishaq bin Ammar, from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, the same except that he said: He wipes with water and redoes the prayer. I say: The Sheikh mentioned that it is to be interpreted as recommended rather than obligatory, because it is unusual, contradicting many narrations. And it can be interpreted as taqiyyah as mentioned in the first narration, and there will also come what indicates the purity of metal. And in the narrations specifying what nullifies ablution previously, there is evidence for what is intended here, and what was mentioned in the narrations about nosebleed also indicates this.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: سأل أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل أيخذ من أظفاره، وشاربه، أيمسحه ابلماء؟ فقال: ال هو طهور.
englishText: A man asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a person who trims his nails and moustache, should he wipe them with water? He said: No, it is pure.

chapter: Trimming Nails, Shaving, Plucking Underarm Hair, And Removing Hair Does Not Invalidate Ablution, But Recommended To Wipe The Area With Water If Done With Metal
arabicText: عن موسى بن جعفر (عليه السالم) عن رجل أخذ من شعره ولم يمسحه ابلماء، ثم يقوم، فيصيل، اقل: ينصرف، فيمسحه ابلماء، وال (يعيد صالته) تلك.
englishText: From Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding a man who took some of his hair and did not wipe it with water, then stood up and prayed, he said: He should leave, wipe it with water, and not (repeat that prayer).

chapter: Eating What Has Been Changed By Fire, Or Eating And Drinking In General, And Introducing Anything Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن ألبان اإلبل والبقر والغنم وأبوالها ولحومها؟ فقال: ال توضأ منه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the milk of camels, cows and sheep, and their urine and meat? He said: No ablution is required from it.

chapter: Eating What Has Been Changed By Fire, Or Eating And Drinking In General, And Introducing Anything Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) هل - يتوضأ من الطعام، أو شرب اللبن: ألبان البقر واإلبل والغنم وأبوالها، ولحومها؟ فقال: ال يتوضأ منه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) if ablution is required from food, or drinking milk: the milk of cows, camels and sheep, and their urine, and their meat? He said: No ablution is required from it.

chapter: Eating What Has Been Changed By Fire, Or Eating And Drinking In General, And Introducing Anything Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر (عليه السالم) عن الوضوء مما غيرت النار؟ فقال: ليس عليك فيه وضوء، إنما الوضوء مما يخرج، ليس مما يدخل.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about performing ablution after eating food touched by fire? He said: You do not need to perform ablution for it. Ablution is only required for what comes out, not for what goes in.

chapter: Eating What Has Been Changed By Fire, Or Eating And Drinking In General, And Introducing Anything Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن رجل توضأ ثم أكل لحما، وسمنا، هل له أن يصىل من غير أن يغسل يده؟ اقل: نعم. وإن كان لبنا لم يصل حتى يغسل يده، ويتمضمض، وكان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم يصيل وقد أكل اللحم من غير أن يغسل يده، وإن كان لبنا لم يصل حتى يغسل يده ويتمضمض.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who performed ablution then ate meat and clarified butter (ghee) - can he pray without washing his hands? He said: Yes. But if it was milk, he should not pray until he washes his hands and rinses his mouth. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would pray after eating meat without washing his hands, but if it was milk he would not pray until he washed his hands and rinsed his mouth. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as recommended, and in any case, it indicates the negation of ablution being nullified.

chapter: Eating What Has Been Changed By Fire, Or Eating And Drinking In General, And Introducing Anything Does Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا (صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم): توضؤا مما يخرج منكم، وال توضؤا مما يدخل، إفنه يدخل طيبا ويخرج خبيثا.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Perform ablution for what comes out of you, and do not perform ablution for what goes in, for it enters pure and exits impure. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what indicates this has been mentioned in the narrations specifying the nullifiers of ablution, and in the narrations about food regarding the non-obligation of washing hands before eating and after it, what indicates this will come.

chapter: Insertion Of Medicine, Discharge Of Moisture And Yellowish Fluid From The Rectum And Fistula Do Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألته عن الرجل، هل يصلح أن يستدخل الدواء ثم يصيل وهو معه أينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: ال ينقض الوضوء وال يصيل حتى يطرحه.
englishText: I asked him about a man - is it permissible for him to insert medicine then pray while it is with him, does it invalidate ablution? He said: It does not nullify ablution but he should not pray until he removes it.

chapter: Insertion Of Medicine, Discharge Of Moisture And Yellowish Fluid From The Rectum And Fistula Do Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سألت الرضا (عليه السالم) عن الناصور، أينقض الوضوء؟ اقل: إنما ينقض الوضوء ثالث: البول، والغائط، والريح.
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about fistula - does it nullify ablution? He said: Only three things invalidate ablution: urine, feces, and passing wind.

chapter: Insertion Of Medicine, Discharge Of Moisture And Yellowish Fluid From The Rectum And Fistula Do Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سأل رجل أاب الحسن (عليه السالم) وأان حاضر فقال: إن بي جرحا في مقعدتي أفتوضأ ثم أستنيج، ثم أجد بعد ذلك الندى والصفرة تخرج من المقعدة أأفعيد الوضوء؟ اقل: قد أيقنت؟ اقل: نعم، اقل: ال، ولكن رشه ابلماء وال تعد الوضوء.
englishText: A man asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) while I was present, saying: I have a wound in my posterior, and I perform ablution then clean myself, then after that I find moisture and yellowish discharge coming from the posterior - should I repeat the ablution? He said: Are you certain? He replied: Yes. He said: No, but sprinkle it with water and do not repeat the ablution.

chapter: Insertion Of Medicine, Discharge Of Moisture And Yellowish Fluid From The Rectum And Fistula Do Not Invalidate Ablution
arabicText: سأل الرضا (عليه السالم) رجل، ونحو حديث صفوان.
englishText: A man asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), and it is similar to the hadith of Safwan (hadith 768). Translator: No actual hadith has been quoted here, but only the reference to previous hadith.

chapter: Killing Bugs, Fleas, Lice, And Flies Does Not Invalidate Ablution, And Likewise Lying About Allah, His Messenger, And The Imams
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) في الرجل يقتل البقة، والبرغوث والقملة، والذابب في الصالة أينقض صالته ووضوؤه؟ اقل: ال. أقول: أحاديث حصر النواقض السابقة دالة عىل جميع مضمون الباب، وأيتي في كتاب الصوم إن شاء هللا ما ظاهره انتقاض الوضوء ابلكذب عىل هللا، وعىل رسوله (صىل هللا عليه وآله) وعىل األئمة (عليهم السالم)، وأن الشيخ حمله عىل االستحباب، وعىل نقص الثواب.
englishText: From Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding the man who kills a gnat, a flea, a louse, and a fly during prayer, does it nullify his prayer and his ablution? He said: No. I (Hurr Amili) say: The previously mentioned hadiths restricting the nullifiers indicate the entire content of this chapter. And there will come in the Book of Fasting, insha'Allah, what apparently indicates the nullification of ablution through lying about Allah, about His Messenger (peace be upon him), and about the Imams (peace be upon them), and that the Shaykh interpreted it as relating to recommendation and to the reduction of reward.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن (عليه السالم)، في الرجل يبول فينسى غسل ذكره، ثم يتوضأ وضوء الصالة، اقل: يغسل ذكره وال يعيد الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), regarding a man who urinates and forgets to wash his private part, then performs ablution for prayer, he said: He should wash his private part and does not need to repeat the ablution.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، في الرجل يبول وينسى أن يغسل ذكره حتى يتوضأ ويصيل، اقل: يغسل ذكره ويعيد الصالة وال يعيد الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who urinates and forgets to wash his private part until after he performs ablution and prays, he said: He should wash his private part and repeat the prayer but does not need to repeat the ablution.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): أبول وأتوضأ وأنسى، استنجائي ثم أذكر بعد ما صليت، اقل: اغسل ذكرك وأعد صالتك وال تعد وضوءك.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I urinate and perform ablution and forget to clean myself, then I remember after I have prayed. He said: Wash your private part and repeat your prayer but do not repeat your ablution.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: ذكر أبو مريم األنصاري أن الحكم بن عتيبة ابل يوما ولم يغسل ذكره متعمدا فذكرت ذلك ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) فقال: بئس ما صنع، عليه أن يغسل ذكره ويعيد صالته وال يعيد وضوءه.
englishText: Abu Maryam al-Ansari mentioned that Al-Hakam bin Utayba once urinated and deliberately did not wash his private part. I mentioned this to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and he said: What he did was wrong. He must wash his private part and repeat his prayer but not repeat his ablution.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الرجل يبول فينسى أن يغسل ذكره ويتوضأ؟ اقل: يغسل ذكره وال يعيد وضوئه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who urinates and forgets to wash his private part and performs ablution? He said: He should wash his private part but not repeat his ablution.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): إني صليت فذكرت أني لم أغسل ذكري بعد ما صليت، أأفعيد؟ اقل: ال. أقول: حمله الشيخ عىل عدم إعادة الوضوء دون الصالة، وهو جيد جدا لما صرح به هذا الراوي بعينه سابقا، ولما أيتي.
englishText: I said to Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him): I prayed, then I remembered that I had not washed my private part after I prayed. Should I repeat it? He said: No. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as not repeating the ablution rather than the prayer, and this is very good due to what this very same narrator explicitly stated previously, and due to what follows.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: عن زرارة اقل: توضأت يوما ولم أغسل ذكري ثم صليت فسألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) فقال: اغسل ذكرك وأعد صالتك.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: One day I performed ablution and did not wash my private part then I prayed, so I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and he said: Wash your private part and repeat your prayer.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا (عليه السالم): إن أهرقت الماء ونسيت أن تغسل ذكرك حتى صليت - فعليك إعادة الوضوء وغسل ذكرك. اقل الشيخ: يعني إذا لم يكن قد توضأ، أفما إذا توضأ ونسي غسل الذكر، ال غير، فال يجب عليه إعادة الوضوء، ثم استدل بما تقدم. أقول: ويجوز أن يراد ابلوضوء االستنجاء، إفنه يطلق عليه كثيرا في األحاديث، ويكون العطف تفسيراي، ويحتمل الحمل عىل خروج شيء من البول عند االستبراء، بعد الوضوء، إفنه أكثري غالب.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If you urinate and forget to wash your private part until you have prayed, then you must repeat the ablution and wash your private part. The Shaykh said: He means if he had not performed ablution. But if he had performed ablution and only forgot to wash the private part, then he is not required to repeat the ablution. Then he provided evidence with what was previously mentioned. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible that what is meant by ablution here is istinja, as it is frequently used for that purpose in the hadiths, and the conjunction would be explanatory. It is also possible to interpret it as applying when some urine exits during istibra after ablution, as this is commonly the case.

chapter: Not Having To Repeat Ablution For One Who Omits Istinja (Cleansing Of Private Parts) After Urination And Performs Ablution And Prays, But Having To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم)، في الرجل يتوضأ فينسى غسل ذكره، اقل: يغسل ذكره ثم يعيد الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding a man who performs ablution but forgets to wash his private part, he said: He should wash his private part then repeat the ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as recommended, and it might also be interpreted as taqiyyah, in this and the previous case, due to what was mentioned earlier about touching the private parts. And God knows best. Narrations regarding this matter will come in the rulings on privacy and impurities, God willing, and what was previously mentioned in the narrations specifying what nullifies ablution indicates the intended meaning. chapter: Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) أنه اقل: إذا كان الرجل يقطر منه البول والدم، إذا كان حين الصالة أتخذ كيسا، وجعل فيه قطنا ثم علقه عليه، وأدخل ذكره فيه ثم صىل، يجمع بين الصالتين، الظهر والعصر، يؤخر الظهر ويعجل العصر أبذان وإاقمتين، ويؤخر المغرب ويعجل العشاء أبذان وإاقمتين ويفعل ذلك في الصبح.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a man has continuous dripping of urine and blood, at the time of prayer he should take a pouch, put cotton in it, then hang it on himself and insert his private part in it, then pray. He should combine two prayers - Dhuhr and Asr, delaying Dhuhr and hastening Asr with one adhan and two iqamas. And delay Maghrib and hasten Isha with one adhan and two iqamas, and do the same for Fajr.

chapter: Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم): الرجل يعتريه البول وال يقدر عىل حبسه، اقل: فقال لي: إذا لم يقدر عىل حبسه افهلل أولى ابلعذر يجعل خريطة.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What about a man who experiences urinary incontinence and cannot control it? He said to me: If he cannot control it, then Allah is most worthy of accepting his excuse. He should use a pouch.

chapter: Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر (عليه السالم): عن المبطون فقال يبني عىل صالته.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the one with stomach illness, and he said: He continues his prayer from where he left off.

chapter: Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence
arabicText: عن عبد هللا بن بكير، عن محمد بن مسلم، عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: صاحب البطن الغالب يتوضأ ثم يرجع في صالته فيتم ما بقي.
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bukayr, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The one who is overcome with stomach illness should perform ablution then return to his prayer and complete what remains.

chapter: Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: سئل عن تقطير البول، اقل: يجعله خريطة إذا صىل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked about urine dripping, he said: He should use a bag/pouch when he prays. Ruling For One With Urinary And Bowel Incontinence Section 7 Rulings Of Privacy

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Awrah And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Awrah Of A Muslim (Male Or Female) Without Legal Permission
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: ال ينظر الرجل إلى عورة أخيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man should not look at his brother's awrah (private parts).

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Awrah And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Awrah Of A Muslim (Male Or Female) Without Legal Permission
arabicText: عن آابئه (عليهم السالم)، عن آابئه عليهم السالم، عن النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله) في حديث المناهي اقل: إذا اغتسل أحدكم في فضاء من األرض فليحاذر عىل عورته. واقل: ال يدخل أحدكم الحمام إال بميزر، ونهى أن ينظر الرجل إلى عورة أخيه المسلم واقل: من أتمل عورة أخيه المسلم لعنه سبعون ألف ملك، ونهى المرأة أن تنظر إلى عورة المرأة، واقل: من نظر إلى عورة أخيه المسلم، أو عورة غير أهله متعمدا أدخله هللا مع المنافقين الذين كانوا يبحثون عن عورات الناس، ولم يخرج من الدنيا حتى يفضحه هللا إال أن يتوب.
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them), from their forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in the hadith of prohibitions, he said: When one of you bathes in an open space, he should be cautious of his awrah (private parts). And he said: None of you should enter the public bath without a waist wrapper, and he prohibited a man from looking at his Muslim brother's awrah and said: Whoever deliberately looks at his Muslim brother's awrah, seventy thousand angels curse him, and he prohibited a woman from looking at another woman's awrah. And he said: Whoever deliberately looks at his Muslim brother's awrah, or the awrah of someone not permissible for him, Allah will place him with the hypocrites who used to seek out people's private matters, and he will not leave this world until Allah exposes him, unless he repents.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Awrah And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Awrah Of A Muslim (Male Or Female) Without Legal Permission
arabicText: وسئل الصادق عليه السالم عن قول هللا عز وجل: قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم ذلك أزىك لهم فقال كل ما كان في كتاب هللا من ذكر حفظ الفرج فهو من الزان إال في هذا الموضع إفنه للحفظ من أن ينظر إليه.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about Allah's saying: "Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts. That is purer for them" [Quran, 24:30]. He said: Every mention of guarding private parts in Allah's Book refers to zinaa (adultery) except in this instance, for here it means guarding them from being looked at.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Awrah And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Awrah Of A Muslim (Male Or Female) Without Legal Permission
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من دخل الحمام فغض طرفه عن النظر إلى عورة أخيه آمنه هللا من الحميم يوم القيامة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Whoever enters the bath and lowers his gaze from looking at his brother's private parts (awrah), Allah will protect him from boiling water on the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Awrah And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Awrah Of A Muslim (Male Or Female) Without Legal Permission
arabicText: عيل بن الحسين المرتضى في رسالة (المحكم والمتشابه) نقال من تفسير النعماني بسنده اآلتي عن عيل عليه السالم في قوله عز وجل: قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم ذلك أزىك لهم معناه ال ينظر أحدكم إلى فرج أخيه المؤمن، أو يمكنه من النظر إلى فرجه، ثم اقل: قل للمؤمنات يغضضن من أبصارهن ويحفظن فروجهن أي: ممن يلحقهن النظر كما جاء في حفظ الفروج، افلنظر سبب إيقاع الفعل من الزان وغيره.
englishText: Ali bin Al-Husayn Al-Murtadha in his treatise (Al-Muhkam wal-Mutashabih), transmitting from Tafsir Al-Nu'mani through his chain from Ali, peace be upon him, regarding the words of the Almighty: "Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts. That is purer for them" [Quran, 24:30] - its meaning is that none of you should look at the private parts of his believing brother, nor should he allow him to look at his private parts. Then He said: Tell the believing women to lower their gaze and guard their private parts [Quran, 24:31], meaning: from those who look at them, as mentioned regarding guarding private parts, for looking is a cause of committing acts of fornication and other sins.
