chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: خرج أبو حنيفة من عند أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم وأبو الحسن موسى عليه السالم اقئم وهو غالم فقال له أبو حنيفة: اي غالم أين يضع الغريب ببلدكم؟ فقال: اجتنب أفنية المساجد، وشطوط األنهار، ومساقط الثمار، ومنازل النزال، وال تستقبل القبلة بغائط وال بول، وارفع ثوبك، وضع حيث شئت.
englishText: Abu Hanifah left from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, while Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him, was standing and he was a young boy. Abu Hanifah said to him: O boy, where does a stranger relieve himself in your city? He replied: Avoid the courtyards of mosques, riverbanks, places where fruits fall, travelers' rest stops, do not face the qibla while defecating or urinating, lift your garment, and relieve yourself wherever you wish besides these places.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: سئل أبو الحسن عليه السالم ما حد الغائط؟ اقل: ال تستقبل القبلة، وال تستدبرها، وال تستقبل الريح، وال تستدبرها.
englishText: Abu al-Hasan, peace be upon him, was asked: What are the limits regarding defecation? He said: Do not face the qibla, do not turn your back to it, do not face the wind, and do not turn your back to it.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: عن الصادق، عن آابئه عليهم السالم أن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل في حديث المناهي: إذا دخلتم الغائط فتجنبوا القبلة.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said in hadith of prohibitions: When you enter the lavatory, avoid facing the qibla.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: اقل: ونهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله عن استقبال القبلة ببول أو غائط.
englishText: He said: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade facing the qibla while urinating or defecating.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم اقل: اقل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: إذا دخلت المخرج فال تستقبل القبلة وال تستدبرها، ولكن شرقوا أو غربوا.
englishText: From Ali, peace be upon him, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: When you enter the lavatory, do not face the qibla nor turn your back to it, but face east or west.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: سئل الحسن بن عيل (عليه السالم): ما حد الغائط؟ اقل: ال تستقبل القبلة وال تستدبرها، وال تستقبل الريح، وال تستدبرها.
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) was asked: What are the limits regarding defecation? He said: Do not face the qibla nor turn your back to it, and do not face the wind nor turn your back to it.

chapter: Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When Relieving Oneself, The Dislike Of Facing The Wind Or Turning One's Back To It, And The Recommendation Of Facing The East Or The West
arabicText: دخلت عىل أبي الحسن الرضا عليه السالم وفي منزله كنيف مستقبل القبلة، وسمعته يقول: من ابل حذاء القبلة ثم ذكر افنحرف عنها إجالال للقبلة وتعظيما لها لم يقم من مقعده ذلك حتى يغفر له.
englishText: I entered upon Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, and in his house was a latrine facing the qibla, and I heard him say: Whoever urinates facing the qibla then remembers and turns away from it out of respect and reverence for the qibla, will not rise from that position until he is forgiven. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The beginning of the hadith is not explicitly contradictory because it is possible that the latrine came into his possession in that state, or it was not his property, and not changing it could be due to its recent acquisition, impossibility of alteration, constraints of the building, or taqiyyah, or because it was possible to sit with a deviation from the qiblah, or due to the availability of another latrine, or similar reasons. The difference between facing the qiblah and the wind is in the prohibition and dislike; the sanctity and honor of the qiblah are established by necessity, the practice of the companions, additional texts, emphasis, caution, and other factors. Further evidence will also be provided, insha Allah. Prohibition Of Facing Or Turning One's Back Towards The Qibla When ...

chapter: Desirability Of Covering The Head And Veiling When Relieving Oneself
arabicText: محمد بن محمد بن النعمان المفيد في (المقنعة) اقل: إن تغطية الرأس إن كان مكشواف عند التخيل سنة من سنن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله
englishText: Muhammad bin Muhammad bin al-Nu'man al-Mufid said in (Al-Muqni'ah): Covering the head, if it was uncovered during defecation, is a Sunnah (tradition) of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family.

chapter: Desirability Of Covering The Head And Veiling When Relieving Oneself
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم أنه (كان يعمله) إذا دخل الكنيف يقنع رأسه، ويقول - سرا في نفسه: - بسم هللا وابهلل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, that he (used to do it) when entering the lavatory, he would cover his head and say - secretly to himself: In the name of Allah and by Allah.

chapter: Desirability Of Covering The Head And Veiling When Relieving Oneself
arabicText: عن أبي ذر، عن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله في وصيته له اقل: اي أاب ذر استحيي من هللا إفني والذي نفسي بيده الظل حين أذهب إلى الغائط متقنعا بثوبي، استحياء من الملكين الذين معي، اي أاب ذر أتحب أن تدخل الجنة؟ فقلت: نعم فداك أبي وأمي، اقل: افقصر األمل، واجعل الموت نصب عينك، واستحيي من هللا حق الحياء.
englishText: From Abu Dharr, from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, in his advice to him, he said: O Abu Dharr, be modest before Allah, for by Him in whose hand my soul is, I cover myself with my garment when I go to relieve myself, out of modesty before the two angels who are with me. O Abu Dharr, would you like to enter Paradise? I said: Yes, may my father and mother be sacrificed for you. He said: Then shorten your hopes, keep death before your eyes, and have true modesty before Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Distancing Oneself From People When Relieving Oneself, The Importance Of Covering Oneself Thoroughly, And Being Cautious
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل لقمان البنه: إذا سافرت مع قوم أفكثر استشارتهم - إلى أن اقل - وإذا أردت قضاء حاجتك افبعد المذهب في األرض.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Luqman said to his son: When you travel with a group of people, consult with them frequently - until he said - and when you want to relieve yourself, go far away into the land.

chapter: Recommendation Of Distancing Oneself From People When Relieving Oneself, The Importance Of Covering Oneself Thoroughly, And Being Cautious
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا )عليه السالم( اقل: ما أوتى لقمان الحكمة لحسب وال مال، وال بسط في جسم وال جمال، ولكنه كان رجال قواي في أمر هللا، متورعا في هللا، ساكنا سكيتا - وذكر جملة من أوصافه ومدائحه إلى أن اقل - ولم يره أحد من الناس عىل بول وال غائط قط، وال اغتسال لشدة تستره، وتحفظه في أمره - إلى أن اقل - فبذلك اوتى الحكمة، ومنح القضية.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Luqman was not given wisdom due to lineage, wealth, physical stature, or beauty. Rather, he was a man strong in the matter of Allah, pious for Allah's sake, calm and quiet - and he mentioned a number of his qualities and praises until he said - No one ever saw him urinating, defecating, or bathing due to his intense modesty and carefulness in his affairs - until he said - For this reason, he was given wisdom and granted judgment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Distancing Oneself From People When Relieving Oneself, The Importance Of Covering Oneself Thoroughly, And Being Cautious
arabicText: وروى الشهيد الثاني في )شرح النفلية( عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أنه لم ير عىل بول وال غائط.
englishText: Shahid-e-thaani narrated in "Sharh al-Nafliyyah" from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, that he was never seen urinating or defecating.

chapter: Recommendation Of Distancing Oneself From People When Relieving Oneself, The Importance Of Covering Oneself Thoroughly, And Being Cautious
arabicText: اقل: واقل عليه السالم، من أتى الغائط فليستتر.
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever goes to relieve himself should conceal himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Distancing Oneself From People When Relieving Oneself, The Importance Of Covering Oneself Thoroughly, And Being Cautious
arabicText: نزلنا النهروان فبرزت عن الصفوف وركزت رميح، ووضعت ترسي إليه، واستترت من الشمس، إفني لجالس إذ ورد عيل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم فقال: اي أخا األزد، معك طهور؟ قلت: نعم، فناولته اإلداوة، فمضى حتى لم أره، وأقبل وقد تطهر فجلس في ظل الترس.
englishText: We arrived at Nahrawan and I stepped away from the ranks, planted my spear, placed my shield against it, and took shelter from the sun. While I was sitting, Amir alMu'minin, peace be upon him, came to me and said: O brother of Al-Azd, do you have water for purification? I said: Yes. I handed him the water container. He went until I could not see him, then returned after performing ablution and sat in the shade of the shield.

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: إذا دخلت المخرج فقل: بسم هللا اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الخبيث المخبث الرجس النجس الشيطان الرجيم. إفذا خرجت فقل: بسم هللا، الحمد هلل الذي عاافني من الخبيث المخبث وأماط عني األذى، وإذا توضأت فقل: أشهد أن ال إله إال هللا، اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين والحمد هلل رب العالمين.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, say: When you enter the lavatory (*), say: "In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil, the harmful, the filthy, the impure, the accursed Satan." And when you exit, say: "In the name of Allah, all praise be to Allah who relieved me from the harmful and removed harm from me." And when you perform ablution, say: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah. O Allah, make me among those who repent and purify themselves, and all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds." Translator: * The words Al Makhraj, Al-Gha'it and Al-Khala' are often translated to English as "lavatory" or "place for relieving oneself," but they carry slightly different connotations. 1. AlMakhraj: Literally, this word means "exit" or "way out" and refers to a place where one causes to exit or remove waste from the body. 2. Al-Gha'it: This term is more directly associated with the physical act and the place for defecation. 3. Al-Khala: This word means "emptiness" or "solitude" and is used to denote a place of isolation where one goes to relieve themselves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم اقل: إذا دخلت الغائط فقل: أعوذ ابهلل من الرجس النجس الخبيث المخبث، الشيطان الرجيم. وإذا فرغت فقل: الحمد هلل الذي عاافني من البالء وأماط عني األذى.
englishText: From one of them, peace be upon him, he said: When you enter the lavatory, say: "I seek refuge in Allah from filth, impurity, evil, wickedness, and the accursed Satan." And when you have finished, say: "Praise be to Allah who has relieved me of affliction and removed harm from me."

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا، عن آابئه عن عيل عليهم السالم أنه كان إذا خرج من الخالء اقل: الحمد هلل الذي رزقني لذته وأبقى قوته في جسدي، وأخرج عني أذاه، اي لها نعمة ثالاث.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) that when he would exit from the toilet, he would say: "Praise be to Allah who has provided me its pleasure, kept its strength in my body, and removed from me its harm. What a blessing!" (saying 'What a blessing' three times)

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: عن جعفر عليهم السالم اقل: اقل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: إذا انكشف أحدكم لبول أو غير ذلك فليقل: بسم هللا. إفن الشيطان يغض بصره.
englishText: Narrated from Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: When one of you uncovers himself for urination or other than that, then let him say: "In the name of Allah," for indeed Satan will avert his gaze. (*) Translator: * By mentioning the name of Allah (saying "In the name of Allah") before exposing oneself to urinate or for any other reason, it is believed that Satan will lower or avert his gaze, thereby respecting the privacy of the individual and not witnessing their nakedness.

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: اقل: كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله إذا أراد دخول المتوضأ اقل: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الرجس النجس، الخبيث المخبث الشيطان الرجيم، اللهم أمط عني األذى وأعذني من الشيطان الرجيم. وإذا استوى جالسا للوضوء اقل: اللهم أذهب عني القذى واألذى واجعلني من المتطهرين، وإذا تزحر (انزجر - ل) اقل: اللهم كما أطعمتنيه طيبا في عافية أفخرجه مني خبيثا في عافية.
englishText: When the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, intended to enter the place for ablution, he would say: 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from impurity and uncleanliness, from evil and malice, from the accursed Satan. O Allah, remove harm from me and protect me from the accursed Satan.' And when he settled down to perform ablution, he would say: 'O Allah, remove from me dirt and harm, and make me among those who are purified.' And when he burped, he would say: 'O Allah, as You have fed me this food in wellbeing, and expel from me what is evil/harmful (*) for my well being.'

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: وكان عليه السالم إذا دخل الخال يقول: الحمد هلل الحافظ المؤدي. إفذا خرج مسح بطنه واقل: الحمد هلل الذي أخرج عني أذاه، وأبقى في قوته، فيالها من نعمة ال يقدر القادرون قدرها.
englishText: When he, peace be upon him, would enter the toilet, he would say: "Praise be to Allah, the Protector, the Fulfiller." And when he would exit, he would wipe his stomach and say: "Praise be to Allah who has removed from me what was harmful and retained in me its strength. What a blessing it is, the value of which those who are capable cannot estimate."

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: وكان الصادق عليه السالم إذا دخل الخال يقنع رأسه، ويقول في نفسه: بسم هللا وابهلل وال إله إال هللا، رب أخرج مني األذى، سرحا بغير حساب، واجعلني لك من الشاكرين فيما تصرفه عني من األذى والغم الذي لو حبسته عني هلكت، لك الحمد أعصمني من شر ما في هذه البقعة وأخرجني منها سالما وحل بيني وبين طاعة الشيطان الرجيم.
englishText: When Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) would enter the lavatory, he would cover his head and say to himself: In the name of Allah, and by Allah, and there is no god but Allah. O Lord, remove from me the harmful matter, easily and without reckoning, and make me among those who are grateful to You for what You have removed from me of harm and distress, which if You had withheld from me, I would have perished. Praise be to You, protect me from the evil in this place and take me out of it safely, and place a barrier between me and obedience to the accursed Satan.

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: الصادق عليه السالم اقل: من كثر عليه السهو في الصالة فليقل إذا دخل الخالء: بسم هللا وابهلل أعوذ ابهلل من الرجس النجس الخبيث المخبث الشيطان الرجيم.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Whoever frequently experiences forgetfulness in prayer should say when entering the toilet: "In the name of Allah, and by Allah. I seek refuge in Allah from the filthy, impure, wicked, corrupting, accursed Satan."

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: اقل: واقل أبو جعفر الباقر عليه السالم: إذا انكشف أحدكم لبول، أو لغير ذلك فليقل: بسم هللا إفن الشيطان يغض بصره عنه حتى يفرغ.
englishText: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir, peace be upon him, said: When one of you uncovers himself for urination or for any other reason, he should say: "In the name of Allah," for Satan will avert his gaze from him until he finishes. Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And ...

chapter: Recommendation Of Mentioning Allah's Name, Seeking Protection, And Supplicating With Transmitted Supplications When Entering And Exiting The Restroom, Upon Completion, Looking At Water, And During Ablution.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في حديث أنه سئل وهو عنده، ما السنة في دخول الخالء؟ اقل: تذكر هللا وتتعوذ ابهلل من الشيطان الرجيم إفذا فرغت قلت: الحمد هلل عىل ما أخرج مني من األذى في يسر وعافية.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, in a hadith that he was asked while with him: What is the sunnah regarding entering the toilet? He said: Remember Allah and seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan, and when you finish say: All praise is due to Allah for what He has removed from me of harm in ease and well-being.

chapter: Dislike Of Speaking While On The Toilet
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الرضا عليه السالم أنه اقل: نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يجيب الرجل آخر وهو عىل الغائط، أو يكلمه حتى يفرغ
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha, peace be upon him, that he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, prohibited a man from responding to another while he is defecating, or speaking to him until he is finished.

chapter: Dislike Of Speaking While On The Toilet
arabicText: اقل لي أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: ال تتكلم عىل الخال إفنه من تكلم عىل الخال لم تقض له حاجة.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: Do not speak in the lavatory, for whoever speaks in the lavatory will not have their need fulfilled.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: مكتوب في التوراة التي لم تغير أن موسى سأل ربه فقال: إلهي إنه أيتي عىل مجالس أعزك وأجلك أن أذكرك فيها فقال: اي موسى إن ذكري حسن عىل كل حال.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: It is written in the Torah that has not been altered that Moses asked his Lord saying: My God, there come times in gatherings where I consider You too honored and exalted to mention You. He said: O Moses, indeed mentioning Me is good in all circumstances.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال أبس بذكر هللا وأنت تبول، إفن ذكر هللا حسن عىل كل حال فال تسأم من ذكر هللا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: There is no harm in remembering Allah while urinating, for remembering Allah is good in all circumstances, so do not tire of remembering Allah.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر أبيه عليهما السالم اقل: إن هللا أوىح إلى موسى عليه السالم اي موسى: ال تفرح بكثرة المال وال تدع ذكري عىل كل حال، إفن كثرة المال تنسي الذنوب، وإن ترك ذكري يقسي القلوب.
englishText: From his brother Musa ibn Ja'far from his father, peace be upon them both, who said: Allah revealed to Musa, peace be upon him: O Musa, do not rejoice in abundance of wealth and do not abandon My remembrance in any state, for abundance of wealth makes one forget sins, and abandoning My remembrance hardens the hearts.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن عيل بن موسى الرضا عن آابئه عليهم السالم عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أن موسى لما انىج ربه اقل: اي رب أبعيد أنت مني أفانديك، أم قريب أفانجيك؟ أفوىح هللا إليه أان جليس من ذكرني، فقال موسى: اي رب إني أكون في حال اجلك أن أذكرك فيها، اقل: اي موسى اذكرني عىل كل حال
englishText: From Ali bin Musa al-Ridha from his forefathers peace be upon them from the Prophet peace be upon him and his family: When Moses conversed with his Lord, he said: O Lord, are You far from me so that I should call out to You, or are You near so that I should whisper to You? So Allah revealed to him: I am the companion of whoever remembers Me. Moses said: O Lord, I am sometimes in a state in which I consider You too exalted to remember You in it. He said: O Moses, remember Me in all states.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل إن موسى عليه السالم اقل: اي رب، تمر بي حاالت استحيي أن أذكرك فيها، فقال اي موسى ذكري عىل كل حال حسن.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Moses, peace be upon him, said: O Lord, I experience states in which I feel shy to mention You. He said: O Moses, mentioning Me is good in every state.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: قلت: الحائض والجنب يقرءان شيئا؟ اقل: نعم ما شاءا إال السجدة، ويذكران هللا تعالى عىل كل حال.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked: Can the menstruating woman and the person in a state of major impurity (junub) recite anything? He said: Yes, whatever they wish except the verses requiring prostration, and they can remember Allah the Most High in all conditions.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن التسبيح في المخرج، وقراءة القرآن اقل: لم يرخص في الكنيف في أكثر من آية الكرسي، ويحمد هللا، وآية.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about glorifying Allah in the lavatory and reciting the Quran. He said: It is not permitted in the lavatory to recite more than Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), praising Allah, and one verse.

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: سألته أتقرأ النفساء والحائض والجنب والرجل يتغوط، القرآن؟ اقل: يقرؤن ما شاؤوا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him whether a postpartum woman, a menstruating woman, one in a state of major ritual impurity, and a man defecating can recite the Quran? He said: They may recite whatever they wish. Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reci...

chapter: Absence Of Disapproval For Mentioning Allah, Praising Him, And Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن جعفر، عن أبيه عليهما السالم اقل: كان أبي يقول: إذا عطس أحدكم وهو عىل خالء فليحمد هللا في نفسه.
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said: My father used to say: When one of you sneezes while relieving himself, he should praise Allah within himself (silently).

chapter: Non-disapproval Of Reciting The Call To Prayer In The Restroom, And Its Desirability
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) أنه اقل له: اي محمد بن مسلم ال تدعن ذكر هللا عىل كل حال. ولو سمعت المنادي ينادي ابألذان وأنت عىل الخال افذكر هللا عز وجل وقل كما يقول المؤذن.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said to him: O Muhammad bin Muslim, do not abandon the remembrance of Allah in any state. Even if you hear the muezzin calling for prayer (adhan) while you are in the toilet, remember Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and say as the muezzin says.

chapter: Non-disapproval Of Reciting The Call To Prayer In The Restroom, And Its Desirability
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إن سمعت االذان وأنت عىل الخال فقل مثل ما يقول المؤذن وال تدع ذكر هللا عز وجل في تلك الحال، الن ذكر هللا حسن عىل كل حال ثم ذكر حديث موسى عليه السالم كما سبق.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If you hear the call to prayer (adhan) while you are in the lavatory, say the same as what the muezzin says and do not abandon the remembrance of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, in that state, because the remembrance of Allah is good in all circumstances. Then he mentioned the hadith of Moses (peace be upon him) as previously stated.

chapter: Non-disapproval Of Reciting The Call To Prayer In The Restroom, And Its Desirability
arabicText: قلت ألبي الحسن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم: علة يستحب لالنسان إذا سمع االذان أن يقول كما يقول المؤذن وإن كان عىل البول والغائط؟ فقال: الن ذلك يزيد في الرزق.
englishText: I said to Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him: What is the reason it is recommended for a person to repeat what the muezzin says when hearing the call to prayer, even if one is urinating or defecating? He said: Because that increases one's sustenance.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: ال صالة إال بطهور، ويجزيك من االستنجاء ثالثة أحجار بذلك جرت السنة من رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، وأما البول إفنه البد من غسله.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: There is no prayer except with purification, and three stones suffice for istinja (cleaning oneself after defecation). This was the established practice of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. As for urine, it must be washed off.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: عن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل، ذكر وهو في صالته أنه لم يستنج من الخال اقل: ينصرف، ويستنيج من الخالء، ويعيد الصالة.
englishText: From Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a man who remembered while he was in his prayer that he had not performed istinja (cleansing) after defecation. He said: He should leave, perform istinja after defecation, and repeat the prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل لبعض نسائه مري نساء المؤمنين أن يستنجين ابلماء ويبالغن إفنه مطهرة للحواشي ومذهبة للبواسير.
englishText: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said to some of his wives: Tell the wives of the believers to clean themselves with water after relieving themselves and to do it thoroughly, for it purifies the private parts and prevents hemorrhoids.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله إذا استنىج أحدكم فليوتر بها وترا إذا لم يكن الماء.
englishText: Ali, peace be upon him, reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: When one of you performs istinja (cleaning oneself after relieving oneself), let him use an odd number of stones if water is not available.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: الوضوء الذي افترضه هللا عىل العباد لمن جاء من الغائط، أو ابل. اقل: يغسل ذكره ويذهب الغائط ثم يتوضأ مرتين مرتين.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: The ablution that Allah has made obligatory upon His servants for those who have come from defecation or urination. He said: He should wash his private part and remove the feces, then washes twice for each part.

chapter: Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم أنه اقل: يجزي من الغائط المسح ابألحجار وال يجزي من البول إال الماء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, that he said: Wiping with stones suffices for defecation, but for urine, only water is sufficient. Obligation Of Istinja And Removing Impurities For Prayer

chapter: Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Performing Ablution And Praying
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل ينسى أن يغسل دبره ابلماء حتى صىل إال أنه قد تمسح بثالثة أحجار اقل: إن كان في وقت تلك الصالة فليعد الصالة وليعد الوضوء، وإن كان قد مضى وقت تلك الصالة التي صىل فقد جازت صالته وليتوضأ لما يستقبل من الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who forgets to wash his rear with water until after he prayed, though he had wiped with three stones, he said: If he is still within the time of that prayer, he should repeat the prayer and repeat the ablution, but if the time of that prayer which he performed has passed, then his prayer is valid and he should perform ablution for future prayers. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It is possible that the ablution mentioned here refers to istinja, as it is often used in this context, or redoing the prayer and ablution might be recommended, or similar, as will be discussed, God willing.

chapter: Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Performing Ablution And Praying
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يتوضأ وينسى أن يغسل ذكره وقد ابل، فقال: يغسل ذكره وال يعيد الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who performs ablution and forgets to wash his genitals after urinating, he said: He should wash his genitals and does not need to repeat the prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This can be understood in the context of what will come in the narrations about impurities, God willing.

chapter: Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Performing Ablution And Praying
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: لو أن رجال نسي أن يستنىج من الغائط حتى يصيل لم يعد الصالة.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, say: If a man forgets to clean himself after defecation until he prays, he does not need to repeat the prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets this as forgetting to cleanse with water while he has cleansed with stones, and it can be considered in the context of the time having passed for what will come.

chapter: Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Performing Ablution And Praying
arabicText: موسى بن جعفر عليهما السالم، سألته عن رجل ذكر وهو في صالته أنه لم يستنج من الخالء، اقل: ينصرف ويستنيج من الخالء ويعيد الصالة، وإن ذكر وقد فرغ من صالته فقد أجزأه ذلك وال إعادة عليه.
englishText: Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, I asked him about a man who remembered while he was in his prayer that he had not performed istinja (cleaning oneself after using the toilet) after relieving himself. He said: He should leave, perform istinja after relieving himself, and repeat the prayer. If he remembers after he has finished his prayer, then that is sufficient for him and he does not need to repeat it.

chapter: Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Performing Ablution And Praying
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إذا دخلت الغائط فقضيت الحاجة فلم تهرق الماء ثم توضأت ونسيت أن تستنىج فذكرت بعدما صليت فعليك اإلعادة وإن كنت أهرقت الماء، فنسيت أن تغسل ذكرك حتى صليت فعليك إعادة الوضوء والصالة، وغسل ذكرك، الن البول مثل البراز.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If you enter the toilet and relieve yourself but do not pour water, then perform ablution and forget to clean yourself (with water), and you remember after you have prayed, then you must repeat (the prayer). If you have poured water but forgot to wash your private part until after you prayed, then you must repeat the ablution and the prayer, and wash your private part, because urine is like feces. Ruling For Someone Who Forgets To Perform Istinja Until After Perfo...

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Istibra' (Ensuring The Urethra Is Empty) For A Man Before Istinja' From Urine
arabicText: سألت أاب إبراهيم عليه السالم عن رجل يبول ابلليل فيحسب أن البول أصابه فال يستيقن فهل يجزيه أن يصب عىل ذكره إذا ابل وال يتنشف؟ اقل: يغسل ما استبان أنه أصابه وينضح ما يشك فيه من جسده أو ثيابه ويتنشف قبل أن يتوضأ.
englishText: I asked Abu Ibrahim, peace be upon him, about a man who urinates at night and thinks that urine has touched him but is not certain. Is it sufficient for him to pour water on his private part after urinating without drying it? He said: He should wash what he is certain was touched by urine, sprinkle water on the areas of his body or clothes where he is doubtful, and dry himself before performing ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The author of Al-Muntaqa said: What is meant by drying here is performing Istibra' (ensuring the urethra is empty), and by ablution: performing Istinja' (cleansing).

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Istibra' (Ensuring The Urethra Is Empty) For A Man Before Istinja' From Urine
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم: رجل ابل ولم يكن معه ماء، اقل: يعصر أصل ذكره إلى طرفه ثالث عصرات، وينتر طرفه إفن خرج بعد ذلك شئ فليس من البول ولكنه من الحبائل.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: A man urinated and had no water with him. He said: He should squeeze the base of his private part to its tip three times, and flick its tip. If anything comes out after that, it is not urine, but rather from the urethral glands.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل، نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يستنىج الرجل بيمينه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) narrated: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade a man from cleansing himself with his right hand after relieving himself.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: االستنجاء ابليمين من الجفاء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Cleaning oneself after relieving with the right hand is from rudeness (*). Translator: * Al-Jafa'a refers to harshness, insensitivity, or rudeness. It implies that using the right hand for cleansing is seen as a rough or disrespectful practice in Islamic etiquette.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: اقل الكليني: وروى أنه إذا كانت ابليسار علة.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And it has been narrated that if there is an ailment in the left hand (*). Translator: * In which case it is permissible to clean using the right hand.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: اقل عليه السالم: االستنجاء ابليمين من الجفاء.
englishText: He, peace be upon him, said: Cleaning oneself after relieving nature with the right hand is a sign of harshness.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: اقل: وقد روى أنه ال أبس إذا كانت اليسار معتلة.
englishText: He said: It has been narrated that there is no harm if the left hand is impaired.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: واقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: إذا ابل الرجل فال يمس ذكره بيمينه.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: When a man urinates, he should not touch his private part with his right hand.

chapter: Disliked Nature Of Cleansing With The Right Hand Except In Necessity And Similarly, Touching The Private Part With The Right Hand While Urinating
arabicText: عن عيل عليهم السالم، عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل: البول اقئما من غير علة من الجفاء، واالستنجاء ابليمين من الجفاء.
englishText: From Ali, peace be upon him, from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, who said: Urinating while standing without a reason is from harshness, and cleaning oneself after relieving with the right hand is from harshness.

chapter: Obligation In Cleaning Oneself Is To Remove The Substance Of Impurity, Not The Odor, With The Achievement Of What Is Named As Washing.
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن عليه السالم اقل: قلت له: لالستنجاء حد؟ اقل: ال، ينقي ماثمة، قلت: إفنه ينقي ماثمة ويبقى الريح اقل: الريح؟ ال ينظر إليها.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, who said: I said to him: Is there a limit for istinja (cleaning after relieving oneself)? He said: No, just clean what is there. I said: But if one cleans what is there and the smell remains? He said: The smell? Do not pay attention to it.

chapter: Obligation In Cleaning Oneself Is To Remove The Substance Of Impurity, Not The Odor, With The Achievement Of What Is Named As Washing.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: يجزيك من الغسل واالستنجاء ما بلت يمينك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: What your right hand (*) reaches is sufficient for washing and istinja (cleaning oneself after relieving oneself). Translator: * The hadith mentioning the right hand in the context of washing and istinja (cleansing after relieving oneself) might seem confusing given the general guideline that recommends using the left hand for personal hygiene purposes. This specific hadith does not explicitly instruct using the right hand for istinja; rather, it's possibly focusing on the act of washing and the sufficiency of the amount of water used. The "right hand" is often associated with purity and good deeds in Islamic tradition, so the expression might be aiming to highlight the importance of purification rather than literal use.

chapter: Recommendation To Begin Cleaning Oneself From The Anus, Then The Urethra, And The Recommendation For Women To Be Thorough In This Process
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الرجل إذا أراد أن يستنىج ابلماء يبدء ابلمقعدة أو ابإلحليل؟ فقال: ابلمقعدة ثم ابإلحليل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about a man when he wants to perform istinja (cleansing after relieving oneself) with water, should he start with the anus or the urethra? He said: With the anus, then the urethra.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رجل لعيل بن الحسين عليه السالم أين يتوضأ الغرابء؟ اقل: يتقي شطوط األنهار، والطرق النافذة، وتحت األشجار المثمرة، ومواضع اللعن، فقيل له: وأين مواضع اللعن؟ اقل: أبواب الدور.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: A man said to Ali bin Al-Husayn, peace be upon him: Where do strangers perform ablution? He said: They should avoid riverbanks, through streets, under fruit-bearing trees, and places of curse. He was asked: And where are the places of curse? He said: The doorways of houses.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: خرج أبو حنيفة من عند أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم أبو الحسن موسى عليه السالم اقئم وهو غالم - فقال له أبو حنيفة: اي غالم أين يضع الغريب ببلدكم؟ فقال: اجتنب أفنية المساجد، وشطوط األنهار، ومساقط الثمار، ومنازل النزال، وال تستقبل القبلة بغائط وال بول، وارفع ثوبك، وضع حيث شئت.
englishText: Abu Hanifah left from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) was standing, and he was a young boy. Abu Hanifah said to him: O young boy, where does a stranger relieve himself in your town? He replied: Avoid the courtyards of mosques, riverbanks, places where fruits fall, places where travelers stay, do not face the qibla while defecating or urinating, lift your garment, and relieve yourself wherever you wish.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن جعفر، عن أبيه، عن آابئه عليهم السالم اقل: نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يتغوط عىل شفير بئر ماء يستعذب منها، أو نهر يستعذب، أو تحت شجرة فيها ثمرتها.
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade defecating on the edge of a well from which fresh water is drawn, or a river from which water is drawn, or under a tree bearing its fruit.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وسلم: ثالث ثالث ملعون من فعلهن: المتغوط في ظل النزال، والمانع الماء المنتاب، وساد الطريق المسلوك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Three, three, cursed is whoever does them: one who defecates in the shade of places where people rest, one who prevents access to water needed by travelers, and one who blocks the traveled path.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: وزاد في خبر آخر: من سد طريقا بتر هللا عمره.
englishText: And in another narration added: Whoever blocks a road, Allah cuts short his life.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن آابئه (عليهم السالم)، أن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله نهى أن يتغوط الرجل عىل شفير بئر يستعذب منها، أو عىل شفير نهر يستعذب منه، أو تحت شجرة فيها ثمرها.
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them), that the Prophet peace be upon him and his family prohibited a man from defecating at the edge of a well from which sweet water is drawn, or at the edge of a river from which sweet water is drawn, or under a tree bearing its fruit.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم، أن أاب حنيفة اقل له - وهو صبي :- اي غالم أيضيع الغريب في بلدتكم هذه؟ اقل: يتوارى خلف الجدار، ويتوقي أعين الجار، وشطوط األنهار، ومساقط الثمار، وال يستقبل القبلة وال يستدبرها، فحينئذ يضع حيث يشاء.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, that Abu Hanifah said to him - while he was a young boy -: O young lad, how does a stranger relieve himself in this city of yours? He replied: He should hide behind a wall, avoid the sight of neighbors, river banks, places where fruits fall, and neither face nor turn his back to the qibla, then at that point he may relieve himself wherever he wishes.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين، عن أبي جعفر الباقر عليه السالم اقل: إنما نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يضرب أحد من المسلمين خالءه تحت شجرة أو نخلة قد أثمرت لمكان المالئكة الموكلين بها، اقل: ولذلك يكون الشجرة والنخل انسا، إذا كان فيه حمله، ألن المالئكة تحضره.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn, from Abu Ja'far Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade any Muslim from relieving himself under a fruit-bearing tree or date palm because of the angels assigned to them. He said: That's why trees and date palms have a companionship when they bear fruit, because angels are present there.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن آابئه عليهم السالم - في وصية النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله لعيل عليه السالم - اقل: وكره البول عىل شط نهر جار، وكره أن يحدث إنسان تحت شجرة أو نخلة قد أثمرت، وكره أن يحدث الرجل وهو اقئم.
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them) - in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him) - he said: He disliked urinating on the bank of a flowing river, and disliked that a person relieve himself under a fruitbearing tree or date palm, and disliked that a man urinate while standing.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن أبيه، عن آابئه، عن أمير المؤمنين عليهم السالم - في حديث المناهي - اقل: نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يبول أحد تحت شجرة مثمرة، أو عىل اقرعة الطريق، الحديث.
englishText: From his father, from his forefathers, from Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon them) - in the hadith of prohibitions - said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade anyone from urinating under a fruit-bearing tree, or on the roadside.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن عبد هللا بن الحسين بن زيد بن عيل بن الحسين، عن أبيه، عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد، عن آابئه عليهم السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: إن هللا كره لكم أيتها األمة أربعا وعشرين خصلة، ونهاكم عنها - إلى أن اقل - وكره البول عىل شط نهر جار، وكره أن يحدث الرجل تحت شجرة مثمرة قد أينعت، أو نخلة قد أينعت، يعني أثمرت.
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Husayn bin Zayd bin Ali bin Al-Husayn, from his father, from Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah has disliked twentyfour characteristics for you, O nation, and has forbidden you from them - until he said - and disliked urinating on the bank of a flowing river, and disliked that a man relieve himself under a ripened fruit-bearing tree, or a ripened date palm, meaning bearing fruit.

chapter: Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Public Roads, Under Fruit-bearing Trees During Fruiting Season, At House Doors, Mosque Courtyards, Places Of Travelers' Rest, And Urinating While Standing
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم - في حديث األربعمائة - اقل: ال تبل عىل المحجة، وال تتغوط عليها.
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) - in the hadith of the four hundred - said: Do not urinate on the highway, nor defecate on it. Dislike Of Sitting For Relieving Oneself On Riverbanks, Wells, Publ...

chapter: Dislike Of Relieving Oneself Over A Grave And Defecating Among Graves, And That One Should Not Hasten While Defecating, And A Collection Of Other Disliked Actions
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: من تخىل عىل قبر، أو ابل اقئما، أو ابل في ماء اقئم، أو مشى في حذاء واحد، أو شرب اقئما، أو خال في بيت وحده، وابت عىل غمر، أفصابه شئ من الشيطان لم يدعه إال أن يشاء هللا، وأسرع ما يكون الشيطان إلى االنسان وهو عىل بعض هذه الحاالت.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: Whoever defecates on a grave, or urinates while standing, or urinates in still water, or walks wearing only one shoe, or drinks while standing, or stays alone in a house, and sleeps with food residue on his hands, if something from Satan afflicts him, it will not leave him except if Allah wills, and Satan is quickest to approach a person when he is in any of these states.

chapter: Dislike Of Relieving Oneself Over A Grave And Defecating Among Graves, And That One Should Not Hasten While Defecating, And A Collection Of Other Disliked Actions
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى عليه السالم اقل: ثالثة يتخوف منها الجنون: التغوط بين القبور، والمشي في خف واحد، والرجل ينام وحده.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him, who said: There are three things from which madness is feared: defecating between graves, walking with only one shoe on, and a man sleeping alone.

chapter: Dislike Of Relieving Oneself Over A Grave And Defecating Among Graves, And That One Should Not Hasten While Defecating, And A Collection Of Other Disliked Actions
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم في حديث األربعمائة، اقل: ال تعجلوا الرجل عند طعامه حتى يفرغ، وال عند غائطه حتى أيتي عىل حاجته.
englishText: From Ali, peace be upon him, in the hadith of the four hundred, he said: Do not rush a man during his meal until he finishes, nor during his answering the call of nature until he fulfills his need.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي أيوب اقل: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: أدخل الخالء وفي يدي خاتم فيه اسم من أسماء هللا تعالى؟ اقل: ال، وال تجامع فيه.
englishText: From Abu Ayyub who said: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: Can I enter the toilet while wearing a ring on my hand that has one of Allah's names on it? He said: No, and do not have intercourse while wearing it.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: اقل الكليني: وروى أيضا أنه إذا أراد أن يستنىج من الخالء فليحوله من اليد التي يستنيج بها.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It has also been reported that when one wants to clean himself after relieving nature (istinja), he should move it (the ring) from the hand which he uses for cleaning.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الثاني عليه السالم، اقل: قلت له: إان روينا في الحديث أن رسول هللا هللا عليه وآله كان يستنيج وخاتمه في أصبعه، وكذلك كان يفعل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم، وكان نقش خاتم رسول هللا: محمد رسول هللا، اقل: صدقوا، قلت: فينبغي لنا أن نفعل؟ اقل: إن أولئك كانوا يتختمون في اليد اليمنى، وإنكم أنتم تتختمون في اليسرى.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan the Second, peace be upon him, who said: I said to him: We have narrated in the hadith that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to clean himself after relieving nature while his ring was on his finger, and likewise Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, used to do so, and the inscription on the ring of the Messenger of Allah was: "Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." He said: They spoke the truth. I asked: Should we do the same? He replied: Those people used to wear rings on their right hand, while you wear them on your left hand.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم من نقش عىل خاتمه اسم هللا فليحوله عن اليد التي يستنيج بها في المتوضأ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: Whoever has the name of Allah engraved on his ring should move it away from the hand that he uses to clean himself in the bathroom.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم أنه اقل: ال يمس الجنب درهما، وال دينارا، عليه اسم هللا تعالى، وال يستنيج وعليه خاتم فيه اسم هللا،، وال يجامع وهو عليه، وال يدخل المخرج وهو عليه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: A person in a state of major ritual impurity should not touch a dirham or dinar that has the name of Allah, the Exalted, on it. Nor should they perform istinja (cleaning after relieving oneself) while wearing a ring with Allah's name on it. They should not engage in sexual intercourse while wearing it, nor should they enter the lavatory while wearing it.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: قلت له: الرجل يريد الخالء وعليه خاتم فيه اسم هللا تعالى؟ فقال: ما أحب ذلك، اقل: فيكون أسم محمد صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ اقل: ال أبس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: A man wants to relieve himself while wearing a ring with the name of Allah the Almighty on it? He said: I do not like that. I said: What if it has the name of Muhammad (may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him and his family)? He said: There is no harm in that. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The sheikh said: The meaning is that there is no harm in entering the lavatory with it, as long as one does not perform istinja (cleansing after defecation or urination) with it on his hand.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن جعفر، عن أبيه عليهما السالم، أنه كره أن يدخل الخالء ومعه درهم أبيض: إال أن يكون مصرورا.
englishText: Ja'far reported from his father, peace be upon them both, that he disliked entering the lavatory with a white dirham on him, unless it was wrapped up. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It appears that this is specifically regarding something that has the name of Allah on it, as mentioned by some of our scholars.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان نقش خاتم أبي: العزة هلل جميعا، وكان في يساره، يستنيج بها، وكان نقش خاتم أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: الملك هلل، وكان في يده اليسرى، يستنيج بها.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The engraving on my father's ring was: "All honor belongs to Allah," and it was on his left hand, which he used for cleansing himself. And the engraving on the ring of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was: "The kingdom belongs to Allah," and it was on his left hand, which he used for cleansing himself. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is either carried on taqiyyah due to its accordance with it and the narrator being from the general public, or it indicates permissibility and negates prohibition, without implying dislike, as pointed out by the Sheikh.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: قلت: ألبي الحسن عيل بن موسى الرضا عليه السالم: الرجل يستنيج وخاتمه في أصبعه، ونقشه ال إله إال هللا؟ فقال: أكره ذلك له، فقلت: جعلت فداك، أوليس كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، وكل واحد من آابئك، يفعل ذلك وخاتمه في أصبعه؟ اقل: بىل، ولكن أولئك كانوا يتختمون في اليد اليمنى، افتقوا هللا وانظروا ألنفسكم.
englishText: I said to Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha, peace be upon him: What about a man who performs istinja (cleansing after using the toilet) while wearing a ring on his finger that is inscribed with "La ilaha illa Allah"? He said: I dislike that for him. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, did not the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and each one of your forefathers do that while wearing their rings? He said: Yes, but they used to wear their rings on the right hand, so fear Allah and be mindful of yourselves.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing The Name Of Allah, And The Dislike Of Wearing It When Relieving Oneself Or During Sexual Intercourse
arabicText: سألت موسى عليه السالم، عن الرجل يجامع، ويدخل الكنيف وعليه الخاتم فيه ذكر هللا، أو الشئ من القرآن، أيصلح ذلك؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: I asked Musa, peace be upon him, about a man who engages in sexual intercourse, and enters the lavatory while wearing a ring that has the name of Allah or something from the Quran on it. Is this permissible? He said: No. Dislike Of Performing Istinja With A Hand That Has A Ring Bearing T...

chapter: Recommended For The One Who Enters The Lavatory To Remember What Necessitates Contemplation, Humility, Asceticism, And Abstaining From The Forbidden
arabicText: كان عيل عليه السالم يقول: ما من عبد إال وبه ملك موكل، يلوي عنقه حتى ينظر إلى حدثه، ثم يقول له الملك: اي بن آدم، هذا رزقك افنظر من أين أخذته وإلى ما صار، فينبغي للعبد عند ذلك أن يقول: اللهم ارزقني الحالل وجنبني الحرام.
englishText: Ali, peace be upon him, used to say: There is no servant except that an angel is appointed over him who turns his neck until he looks at his excrement, then the angel says to him: O son of Adam, this is your provision, so look where you took it from and what it has become. Therefore, the servant should say at that time: O Allah, grant me halal provision and keep me away from the haram.

chapter: Recommended For The One Who Enters The Lavatory To Remember What Necessitates Contemplation, Humility, Asceticism, And Abstaining From The Forbidden
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد عن أبيه عليهما السالم، اقل: سألته عن الغائط؟ فقال: تصغير البن آدم ليك ال يتكبر وهو يحمل غائطه معه.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad from his father, peace be upon them both, he said: I asked him about defecation? He said: It is a humiliation for the son of Adam so that he does not become arrogant while he carries his excrement with him.

chapter: Recommended For The One Who Enters The Lavatory To Remember What Necessitates Contemplation, Humility, Asceticism, And Abstaining From The Forbidden
arabicText: شهدت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم وسأله عمرو بن عبيد فقال: ما ابل الرجل إذا أراد أن يقضى حاجة إنما ينظر إلى سفله، وما يخرج من ثم؟ فقال: إنه ليس أحد يريد ذلك إال وكل هللا عز وجل به ملكا أيخذ بعنقه، ليريه ما يخرج منه، أحالل أو حرام؟
englishText: From Amr bin Ubayd who witnessed Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when he asked him: What is it about a man when he wants to relieve himself that he looks at his lower part and what comes out from there? He replied: There is no one who intends to do that except that Allah the Mighty and Majestic assigns an angel to him who holds his neck to show him what comes out of him, whether it is halal or haram.

chapter: Recommended For The One Who Enters The Lavatory To Remember What Necessitates Contemplation, Humility, Asceticism, And Abstaining From The Forbidden
arabicText: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: عجبت البن آدم، أوله نطفة، وآخره جيفة، وهو اقئم بينهما وعاء للغائط ثم يتكبر.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I am amazed at the son of Adam: his beginning is a drop of fluid (sperm), his end is a corpse, and while standing between these two states he is but a vessel for excrement, yet he is arrogant.

chapter: Recommended For The One Who Enters The Lavatory To Remember What Necessitates Contemplation, Humility, Asceticism, And Abstaining From The Forbidden
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - أنه قيل له: اإلنسان عىل تلك الحال - يعني الخالء - وال يصبر حتى ينظر إلى ما يخرج منه؟ فقال: إنه ليس في األرض آدمي إال ومعه ملكان موكالن به، إفذا كان عىل تلك الحال ثنيا رقبته، ثم اقال: اي بن آدم، انظر إلى ما كنت تكدح له في الدنيا، إلى ما هو صائر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him - in a hadith - that he was asked: What about a person in that state - meaning relieving himself - who cannot resist looking at what comes out of him? He said: There is not a human on earth except that two angels are assigned to watch over him. When he is in that state, they bend his neck and say: O son of Adam, look at what you strived for in this world, to what it has become.
