chapter: What Is Recommended To Say To The Guardian Angels When Intending To Relieve Oneself
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: إن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم كان إذا أراد قضاء الحاجة وقف عىل ابب المذهب ثم، التفت يمينا وشماال إلى ملكيه فيقول: أميطا عني، فلكما هللا عيل أن ال أحدث حديثا حتى أخرج إليكما.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, saying: When Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, wanted to relieve himself, he would stand at the door of the bathroom, then turn right and left to his two angels and say: Step aside from me, and I promise you by Allah that I will not say anything until I come back to you. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And al-Saduq narrated something similar from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), except that he said: I will not utter anything with my tongue.

chapter: Disapproval Of Sitting Too Long In The Lavatory
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر عليه السالم يقول: اقل لقمان البنه: طول الجلوس عىل الخالء يورث الباسور، اقل: فكتب هذا عىل ابب الحش.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, saying: Luqman said to his son: Prolonged sitting on the toilet causes hemorrhoids. He said: So this was written on the door of the lavatory.

chapter: Disapproval Of Sitting Too Long In The Lavatory
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: طول الجلوس عىل الخالء يورث الباسور.
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Prolonged sitting on the toilet causes hemorrhoids.

chapter: Disapproval Of Sitting Too Long In The Lavatory
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر عليه السالم يقول: طول الجلوس عىل الخالء يورث البواسير.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, say: Prolonged sitting on the toilet causes hemorrhoids.

chapter: Disapproval Of Sitting Too Long In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن آابئه، عن عيل عليهم السالم اقل: طول الجلوس عىل الخالء يورث الباسور.
englishText: From his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them), he said: Prolonged sitting on the toilet causes hemorrhoids.

chapter: Disapproval Of Sitting Too Long In The Lavatory
arabicText: وقيل: إن مواله دخل المخرج، أفطال فيه الجلوس فناداه لقمان: طول الجلوس عىل الحاجة يضجع منه الكبد، ويورث منه الباسور، ويصعد الحرارة إلى الرأس، افجلس هوان، وقم هوان، اقل: فكتب حكمته عىل ابب الحش.
englishText: It was said that his master entered the bathroom and sat there for a long time, so Luqman called out to him: Prolonged sitting for relieving oneself weakens the liver, causes hemorrhoids, and causes heat to rise to the head, so sit gently and rise gently. He said: So he wrote this wisdom on the door of the bathroom.

chapter: Disapproval Of Using A Miswak In The Lavatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا، عن عيل بن سليمان، عن الحسن بن أشيم اقل: أكل اإلشنان يذيب البدن، والتدلك ابلخزف يبيل الجسد، والسواك في الخالء يورث البخر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from Ali bin Sulayman, from Al-Hasan bin Ashyam, he said: "Eating purslane (a herb) melts the body, rubbing with khuzfa (* pumice stone) wears out the body, and using a siwak in the bathroom causes bad breath." Translator: * In the olden days, pumice stone was widely used as a natural exfoliating tool during bathing to remove dead skin cells and soften the skin.

chapter: Disliking Of Urinating On Hard Ground And Preferring To Seek Elevated Places Or Places With Abundant Soil For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: من فقه الرجل أن يراتد موضعا لبوله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: It is from a man's understanding to seek an appropriate place for urinating.

chapter: Disliking Of Urinating On Hard Ground And Preferring To Seek Elevated Places Or Places With Abundant Soil For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أشد الناس توقيا عن البول، كان إذا أراد البول يعمد إلى مكان مرتفع من األرض أو إلى مكان من األمكنة يكون فيه التراب الكثير، كراهية أن ينضح عليه البول.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was the most cautious of people regarding urination. When he wanted to urinate, he would go to an elevated place on the earth or to a place with abundant soil, disliking that urine would splash on him.

chapter: Disliking Of Urinating On Hard Ground And Preferring To Seek Elevated Places Or Places With Abundant Soil For It
arabicText: عن سليمان الجعفري اقل: بت مع الرضا عليه السالم في سفح جبل، فلما كان آخر الليل اقم فتنىح، وصار عىل موضع مرتفع فبال وتوضأ - واقل: من فقه الرجل أن يراتد لموضع بوله - وبسط سراويله، واقم عليه، وصىل صالة الليل.
englishText: From Sulayman Al-Ja'fari who said: I spent the night with Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) at the foot of a mountain. When it was the end of the night, he got up and moved away, and went to an elevated place where he urinated and performed ablution - and said: It is from a man's understanding to seek an appropriate place for urination - and he spread his trousers, stood on it, and performed the night prayer.

chapter: Necessity Of Caution Against Urine
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: ال تستحقرن ابلبول، وال تتهاونن به، الحديث.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, he said: Do not take urination lightly, and do not be negligent (or careless) regarding it.

chapter: Necessity Of Caution Against Urine
arabicText: عن الصادق عن آابئه عليهم السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: أربعة يؤذون أهل النار عىل ما بهم من األذى، يسقون من الحميم والجحيم، ينادون ابلويل والثبور، (أحدهم يجر أمعاءه) (١) - إلى أن اقل - فيقال له: ما ابل األبعد قد آذاان عىل ما بنا من األذى؟ فيقول: إن األبعد كان ال يبالي أين أصاب البول من جسده، الحديث.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Four people will harm the people of Hell, in addition to the harm they are already experiencing. They will be given to drink from scalding water and hellfire. They will cry out in woe and destruction. (One of them will drag his intestines) - until he said - It will be said to him: What is wrong with the most distant one who has harmed us on top of the harm we are already experiencing? He will say: The most distant one did not care where urine touched his body. The hadith.

chapter: Necessity Of Caution Against Urine
arabicText: عن عيل بن أبي طالب عليه السالم اقل: عذاب القبر يكون من النميمة، والبول، وعزب الرجل عن أهله.
englishText: From Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said: The punishment of the grave comes from spreading malicious gossip (namimah), not cleaning oneself properly after urinating, and a man distancing himself from his ahl (*). Translator: * Immediate family members like spouses, children, and parents, as well as extended family members depending on the context.

chapter: Necessity Of Caution Against Urine
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن جل عذاب القبر في البول.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Indeed, most of the punishment in the grave is due to [not being cautious about] urine.

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم أنه اقل: ال تشرب وأنت اقئم، وال تبل في ماء نقيع، وال تطف بقبر، وال تخل في بيت وحدك، وال تمش بنعل واحدة إفن الشيطان أسرع ما يكون إلى العبد إذا كان عىل بعض هذه األحوال، اقل: إنه ما أصاب أحدا شئ عىل هذه الحال فكاد أن يفارقه إال أن يشاء هللا عز وجل.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both) that he said: Do not drink while standing, do not urinate in stagnant water, do not circumambulate a grave, do not stay alone in a house, and do not walk with one sandal, for the devil is quickest to approach the servant when he is in any of these states. He said: No one has been afflicted by anything in these states without nearly being separated from it, unless Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, wills otherwise.

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في - حديث - اقل: قلت: له يبول الرجل في الماء؟ اقل: نعم، ولكن يتخوف عليه من الشيطان.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, in a hadith, he said: I asked him: Can a man urinate in water? He said: Yes, but there is fear for him from Satan.

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: إنه نهى أن يبول الرجل في الماء الجاري إال من ضرورة، واقل: إن للماء أهال.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: He prohibited that a man urinate in flowing water except out of necessity, and he said: Indeed water has inhabitants.

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين، اقل: وقد روي أن البول في الماء الراكد يورث النسيان.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: It has been narrated that urinating in stagnant water causes forgetfulness.

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: عن آابئه عليهم السالم، عن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله - في حديث المناهي ،- اقل: ونهى أن يبول أحد في الماء، الراكد إفنه يكون منه ذهاب العقل.
englishText: From his forefathers, peace be upon them, from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family - in the hadith of prohibitions -, he said: And he forbade anyone from urinating in stagnant water, for it can lead to the loss of reason (aql).

chapter: Disapproval Of Urinating In Flowing And Stagnant Water, And A Collection Of Prohibitions
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال تشرب وأنت اقئم، وال تطف بقبر، وال تبل في ماء نقيع، إفنه من فعل ذلك أفصابه شئ فال يلومن إال نفسه، ومن فعل شيئا من ذلك لم يكد يفارقه إال ما شاء هللا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Do not drink while standing, do not circumambulate a grave, and do not urinate in stagnant water. For whoever does this and is afflicted by something, he should blame none but himself. And whoever does any of this will hardly be free from it except as Allah wills. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what indicates this has preceded in the hadith about relieving oneself on a grave, and what indicates it and denies prohibition in the hadiths about flowing water, and what indicates some of the intended will come.

chapter: Dislike Of Facing The Sun Or Moon With Private Parts During Relieving Oneself
arabicText: عن جعفر، عن أبيه، عن آابئه عليهم السالم اقل: نهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يستقبل الرجل الشمس والقمر بفرجه وهو يبول.
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers peace be upon them, who said: The Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family forbade that a man face the sun and moon with his private parts while urinating.

chapter: Dislike Of Facing The Sun Or Moon With Private Parts During Relieving Oneself
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: ال يبولن أحدكم وفرجه ابد للقمر، يستقبل به.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah peace be upon him who said: The Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family said: None of you should urinate while his private parts are exposed to the moon, facing it.

chapter: Dislike Of Facing The Sun Or Moon With Private Parts During Relieving Oneself
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: وفي خبر آخر: ال تستقبل الهالل، وال تستدبره، يعني في التخيل.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: And in another report: Do not face the crescent moon, nor turn your back to it, meaning while relieving oneself.

chapter: Dislike Of Facing The Sun Or Moon With Private Parts During Relieving Oneself
arabicText: وبإسناده - في حديث المناهي - اقل: ونهى أن يبول الرجل وفرجه ابد للشمس أو القمر.
englishText: And by his chain - in the hadith of prohibitions - he said: And he forbade that a man urinate while his private parts are exposed to the sun or moon.

chapter: Dislike Of Facing The Sun Or Moon With Private Parts During Relieving Oneself
arabicText: محمد بن يعقوب اقل: وروي أيضا: ال تستقبل الشمس، وال القمر.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ya'qub said: And it is also narrated: Do not face the sun, nor the moon.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن البول يصيب الجسد؟ اقل: صب عليه الماء مرتين.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about urine that touches the body? He said: Pour water over it twice.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: اقل الكليني: وروي أنه يجزي أن يغسل بمثله من الماء إذا كان عىل رأس الحشفة، وغيره.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It has been narrated that it is sufficient to wash with an equal amount of water when it is on the tip of the glans and elsewhere.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: اقل: وروى أنه ماء ليس بوسخ، فيحتاج أن يدلك.
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that it is water, not dirt, so it needs to be rubbed.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن البول يصيب الجسد؟ اقل: صب عليه الماء مرتين.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about urine that comes into contact with the body? He said: Pour water over it twice.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته: كم يجزي من الماء في االستنجاء من البول؟ فقال: مثال ما عىل الحشفة من البلل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him: How much water is sufficient for cleansing (istinja) after urination? He said: Approximately the amount of wetness on the glans.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: عن حريز، عن زرارة اقل: كان يستنيج من البول ثالث مرات، ومن الغائط ابلمدر والخرق.
englishText: Hurayz narrated from Zurarah who said: He would cleanse himself from urine three times, and from feces with stones and rags. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The owner of Al-Muntaqa mentioned that the pronoun in "he used to" refers back to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him).

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: يجزي من البول أن يغسله بمثله. اقل الشيخ: يحتمل أن يكون قوله: بمثله، راجعا إلى البول ال إلى ما بقي عىل الحشفة، وذلك أكثر مما اعتبرانه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: It suffices to wash urine with its like. The Shaykh said: It is possible that his saying "with its like" refers to the urine, not to what remains on the glans, and that is more than what we have considered.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: رأيت أاب الحسن الثالث عليه السالم - غير مرة - يبول ويتناول كوزا صغيرا، ويصب الماء عليه من ساعته. اقل الشيخ: قوله: يصب عليه الماء، يدل عىل أن قدر الماء أكثر من مقدار بقية البول ألنه ال ينصب إال مقدار يزيد عىل ذلك. أقول: قد عرفت أن مجرد الفعل ال يدل عىل الوجوب، فيحمل ما زاد عىل المثلين عىل االستحباب.
englishText: I saw Abu al-Hasan the Third, peace be upon him, more than once, urinating and taking a small jug, and pouring water on it immediately. The Shaykh said: His saying "pouring water on it" indicates that the amount of water is more than the remaining urine because it only pours in an amount that exceeds that. I (Hurr Amili) say: You have known that the mere action does not indicate obligation, so what exceeds twice the amount is considered recommended.

chapter: Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It Is Said That At Least What Is On The Glans Must Be Washed, Three Times Is Recommended, Pouring Water Is Sufficient, And Rubbing Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: سألته عن البول يصيب الجسد؟ اقل: صب عليه الماء مرتين، إفنما هو ماء.
englishText: I asked him about urine that touches the body. He said: Pour water over it twice, for it is only water. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And it has been mentioned before that nothing but water is sufficient here, and more evidence on this will be provided. Regarding The Minimum Requirement For Cleaning After Urination, It ...

chapter: No Obligation To Perform Istinja After Sleeping Or Passing Wind, Nor Is It Recommended
arabicText: رأيت أاب الحسن عليه السالم يستيقظ من نومه، يتوضأ وال يستنيج، واقل - كالمتعجب من رجل سماه :- بلغني أنه إذا خرجت منه الريح استنىج.
englishText: I saw Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, wake up from his sleep, perform ablution without performing istinja, and he said - as if amazed about a man he named -: I heard that when he passes wind he performs istinja.

chapter: No Obligation To Perform Istinja After Sleeping Or Passing Wind, Nor Is It Recommended
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الرجل تخرج منه الريح، أعليه أن يستنىج؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about a man from whom wind exits, is it required for him to perform istinja? He said: No.

chapter: If One Of The Two Impurities Is Emitted, It Is Obligatory To Wash Its Exit Only And Not The Other's Exit
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: إذا ابل الرجل ولم يخرج منه شئ غيره، إفنما عليه أن يغسل إحليله وحده، وال يغسل مقعدته، وإن خرج من مقعدته شئ، ولم يبل إفنما عليه أن يغسل المقعدة وحدها وال يغسل اإلحليل.
englishText: Narrated from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, in a hadith, he said: If a man urinates and nothing else comes out of him, he is only required to wash his penis alone, and not wash his anus. And if something comes out of his anus, and he does not urinate, he is only required to wash the anus alone and not wash the penis.

chapter: Obligation In Istinja (Cleansing) Is To Wash The External Part Of The Exit Point, Not The Internal Part
arabicText: سمعت الرضا (عليه السالم) يقول - في االستنجاء :- يغسل ما ظهر منه عىل الشرج، وال يدخل فيه األنملة.
englishText: I heard Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) say - regarding istinja -: One should wash what is apparent of it on the anus, and should not insert the fingertip into it.

chapter: Obligation In Istinja (Cleansing) Is To Wash The External Part Of The Exit Point, Not The Internal Part
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) - في حديث - اقل إنما عليه أن يغسل ما ظهر منها - يعني المقعدة - وليس عليه أن يغسل ابطنها.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: One is only required to wash what appears of it - meaning the anus - and is not required to wash its internal part.

chapter: Obligation In Istinja (Cleansing) Is To Wash The External Part Of The Exit Point, Not The Internal Part
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: سألته عن طهور المرأة في النفاس إذ طهرت وكانت ال تستطيع أن تستنيج ابلماء أنها إن استنجت اعتقرت هل لها رخصة أن تتوضأ من خارج وتنشفه بقطن أو خرقة؟ اقل: نعم لتتقي من داخل بقطن أو بخرقة.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the purification of a woman in postpartum period when she becomes pure but is unable to clean herself with water, as doing so would harm her - is there a concession for her to perform ablution from the outside and dry it with cotton or cloth? He said: Yes, let her protect from inside with cotton or cloth.

chapter: Having The Choice Between Three Unused Stones And Water For Istinja' (Cleaning) After Defecation, And The Recommendation Of Combining Both, And Making The Number Odd If More Is Needed
arabicText: عن زرارة عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن التمسح ابألحجار فقال: كان الحسين بن عيل عليه السالم يمسح بثالثة أحجار.
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about wiping with stones, so he said: Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) used to wipe with three stones.

chapter: Having The Choice Between Three Unused Stones And Water For Istinja' (Cleaning) After Defecation, And The Recommendation Of Combining Both, And Making The Number Odd If More Is Needed
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم أنه اقل: يجزي من الغائط المسح ابألحجار وال يجزي من البول إال الماء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said: Wiping with stones suffices for defecation, but for urine, nothing suffices except water.

chapter: Having The Choice Between Three Unused Stones And Water For Istinja' (Cleaning) After Defecation, And The Recommendation Of Combining Both, And Making The Number Odd If More Is Needed
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: جرت السنة في أثر الغائط بثالثة أحجار أن يمسح العجان، وال يغسله ويجوز أن يمسح رجليه وال يغسلهما.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Sunnah has established regarding the aftermath of defecation to wipe the perineum (*) with three stones, and not wash it, and it is permissible to wipe the feet and not wash them. Translator: * The area between the anus and the scrotum or vulva.

chapter: Having The Choice Between Three Unused Stones And Water For Istinja' (Cleaning) After Defecation, And The Recommendation Of Combining Both, And Making The Number Odd If More Is Needed
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: جرت السنة في االستنجاء بثالثة أحجار أبكار ويتبع ابلماء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Sunnah has established regarding istinja to use three unused stones and follow it with water.

chapter: Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا انقطعت درة البول فصب الماء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When the flow of urine stops, then pour water.

chapter: Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن رجل ابل في موضع ليس فيه ماء فمسح ذكره بحجر وقد عرق ذكره وفخذاه؟ اقل اقل: يغسل ذكره وفخذيه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about a man who urinated in a place where there was no water, so he wiped his penis with a stone, and his penis and thighs had become sweaty? He said: He should wash his penis and thighs.

chapter: Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان بنوا إسرائيل إذا أصاب أحدهم قطرة بول قرضوا لحومهم ابلمقاريض، وقد وسع هللا عليكم أبوسع ما بين السماء واألرض وجعل لكم الماء طهورا افنظروا كيف تكونون.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When any of the Children of Israel was touched by a drop of urine, they would cut their flesh with scissors. But Allah has given you ease as vast as what is between the heaven and earth, and has made water a means of purification for you, so be mindful of how you conduct yourselves.

chapter: Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination
arabicText: اي أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم وأان اقئم عىل رأسه ومعي إداوة، أو اقل: كوز، فلما انقطع شخب البول اقل بيده هكذا إلى فناولته الماء، فتوضأ مكانه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, while I was standing by his head with a water container, or he said: a jug, when the flow of urine stopped, he gestured with his hand like this, so I handed him the water, and he performed ablution in his place.

chapter: Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: الرجل يبول وال يكون عنده الماء فيمسح ذكره ابلحائط اقل: كل شئ اي بس زىك.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man urinates and has no water, so he wipes his penis on the wall. He said: Everything dry is pure. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is carried on taqiyyah because it is the practice of the opponents, or on the permissibility to prevent the spread of impurity, even if purity is not achieved; in fact, it has no proof of it at all, and what proves the intended meaning has been mentioned before, and what proves it will come. Obligation To Limit To Water For Cleaning After Urination

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Wiping Between The Two Outlets
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر، وأبى عبد هللا عليهما السالم اقل: سمعتهما يقوالن: عفى عما بين األليين والحشفة ال يمسح وال يغسل.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both, who said: I heard them both saying: What is between the buttocks and the glans has been pardoned from [washing or wiping]; it is neither to be wiped nor washed.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: نهى النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يطمح الرجل ببوله من السطح، ومن الشئ المرتفع في الهواء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited a man from directing his urine from a rooftop and from elevated places into the air.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل سألته عن الرجل يطيل فيبول وهو اقئم؟ اقل: ال أبس به.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man applying depilatory paste and urinating while standing? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: اقل عليه السالم: البول اقئما من غير علة من الجفاء.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: He (peace be upon him) said: Urinating while standing without a valid reason is from rudeness.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: اقل: ونهى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله أن يطمح الرجل ببوله في الهواء من السطح، أو من الشئ المرتفع.
englishText: He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited a man from directing his urine into the air from a rooftop or from an elevated place.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: اقل: وروى أن من جلس وهو متنور خيف عليه الفتق.
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that whoever sits while having applied depilatory paste risks hernia.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: وفي "الخصال" بإسناده عن عيل عليه السالم - في حديث األربعمائة - اقل: ال يبولن (أحدكم) في سطح في الهواء، وال يبولن في ماء جار، إفن فعل ذلك أفصابه شئ فال يلومن إال نفسها، إفن للماء أهال، وإذا ابل أحدكم فال يطمحن ببوله، وال يستقبل ببوله الريح.
englishText: And in "Al-Khisal" with its chain to Ali (peace be upon him) - in the hadith of four hundred - he said: None of you should urinate on a rooftop into the air, nor in flowing water, for if he does so and something afflicts him, he should blame none but himself, for water has its inhabitants, and when one of you urinates, he should not direct his urine upward, nor should he face the wind with his urine.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: قلت له: أيبول الرجل وهو اقئم؟ اقل: نعم ولكن يتخوف عليه أن يلبس به الشيطان، أي يخبله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I said to him: May a man urinate while standing? He said: Yes, but there is fear that Satan may possess him, meaning make him insane.

chapter: Dislike Of Urinating While Standing Without A Reason Except When Applying Depilatory Paste, And The Dislike Of Directing Urine Upward In The Air From A Height
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: يكره للرجل - أو ينهى الرجل - أن يطمح ببوله من السطح في الهواء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: It is disliked -or forbidden- for a man to urinate from a rooftop into the air.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: اي معشر األنصار، إن هللا قد أحسن عليكم الثناء، فماذا تصنعون؟ اقلوا: نستنيج ابلماء.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: O assembly of Ansar, indeed Allah has praised you well, so what do you do? They said: We clean ourselves with water after relieving ourselves.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: االستنجاء ابلماء البارد يقطع البواسير.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: Cleansing with cold water cuts off hemorrhoids.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: كان الناس يستنجون ابألحجار، أفكل رجل من األنصار طعاما، فالن بطنه، افستنىج ابلماء أفنزل هللا تبارك وتعالى فيه: (إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين، فدعاه رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله فخشي الرجل أن يكون قد نزل فيه أمر يسوؤه فلما دخل اقل له رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: هل عملت في يومك هذا شيئا؟ اقل: نعم اي رسول، هللا أكلت طعاما فالن بطني، افستنجيت ابلماء، فقال له: أبشر، إفن هللا تبارك وتعالى قد أنزل فيك )إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين(، فكنت أنت أول التوابين وأول المتطهرين، ويقال: إن هذا الرجل كان البراء بن معزوب األنصاري.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: People used to clean themselves with stones after defecation. A man from the Ansar ate some food, which caused his stomach to become loose, so he cleaned himself with water. Then Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, revealed regarding him: [And Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves] [Quran, 2:222] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, called him. The man feared that something unpleasant had been revealed about him. When he entered, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to him: Have you done anything today? He said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah, I ate food until I was full, and I cleaned myself with water. He said to him: Rejoice, for Allah the Blessed and Exalted has revealed concerning you "Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves" [Quran, 2:222], and you were the first of those who repent and the first of those who purify themselves. And it is said that this man was Al-Bara ibn Ma'zoob AlAnsari.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في قول هللا عز وجل "إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين" اقل: كان الناس يستنجون ابلكرسف واألحجار، ثم أحدث الوضوء وهو خلق كريم أفمر به رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، وصنعه، أفنزل هللا في كتابه إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding the words of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic "Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves" [Quran, 2:222], he said: People used to clean themselves with cotton and stones, then ablution was introduced and it is a noble practice, so the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, ordered it and performed it, then Allah revealed in His Book: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان الناس يستنجون بثالثة أحجار، ألنهم كانوا أيكلون البسر، فكانوا يبعرون بعرا، أفكل رجل من األنصار الداب، فالن بطنه، افستنىج ابلماء، فبعث إليه النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله، اقل: فجاء الرجل وهو خائف يظن أن يكون قد نزل فيه شئ يسوؤه في استنجائه ابلماء، فقال له: هل عملت في يومك هذا شيئا؟ فقال له: نعم اي رسول هللا، إني وهللا ما حملني عىل االستنجاء ابلماء إال أني أكلت طعاما فالن بطني، فلم تغن عني الحجارة شيئا، افستنجيت ابلماء، فقال له رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: هنيئا لك، إفن هللا عز وجل قد أنزل فيك آية، أفبشر إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين فكنت أول من صنع هذا، وأول التوابين، وأول المتطهرين.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: People used to perform istinja (cleaning themselves after defecation) with three stones, because they used to eat unripe dates, so they would defecate like camels. A man from the Ansar ate gourd, which caused his stomach to become upset, so he performed istinja (cleaning after relieving himself) with water. The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, sent for him. The man came fearfully, thinking something bad had been revealed about him regarding his use of water for istinja. The Prophet asked him: Have you done anything today? He replied: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. By Allah, nothing made me use water for istinja except that I ate food which upset my stomach, and stones were not sufficient for me, so I used water. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to him: Congratulations to you, for Allah the Mighty and Majestic has revealed a verse regarding you, so rejoice for Allah loves those who turn to Him in repentance and loves those who purify themselves [Quran, 2:222]. You were the first to do this, the first of those who turn in repentance, and the first of those who purify themselves.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: جرت في البراء بن معرور األنصاري ثالث من السنن: أما أولهن إفن الناس كانوا يستنجون ابألحجار أفكل البراء بن معرور الداب، فالن بطنه افستنىج ابلماء، أفنزل هللا فيه: "إن هللا يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين" فجرت السنة في االستنجاء ابلماء، فلما حضرته الوافة كان غائبا عن المدينة أفمر أن يحول وجهه إلى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، وأوصى ابلثلث من ماله، فنزل الكتاب ابلقبلة، وجرت السنة ابلثلث.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Three Sunnah practices originated with Al-Bara ibn Ma'rur Al-Ansari. As for the first of them, people used to clean themselves with stones after relieving themselves, but Al-Bara ibn Ma'rur ate squash which caused his stomach to become loose, so he cleaned himself with water. Then Allah revealed concerning it: Truly Allah loves those who turn to Him in repentance and He loves those who purify themselves [Quran, 2:222]. Thus the Sunnah of using water for cleansing after relieving oneself was established. When death approached him while he was away from Medina, he ordered that his face be turned towards the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and he bequeathed one-third of his wealth. Then the Book was revealed regarding the qibla, and the practice of one-third became established as the Sunnah.

chapter: Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency Towards Bowel Movements During Cleansing After Defecation, Its Necessity In Cases Of Contamination, And Choosing Cold Water For Those With Hemorrhoids.
arabicText: الفضل بن الحسن الطبرسي في "مجمع البيان"، في قوله تعالى "وهللا يحب المتطهرين" اقل: قيل: يحبون أن يتطهروا ابلماء من الغائط والبول.
englishText: Al-Fadhl ibn al-Hasan al-Tabarsi in "Majma' al-Bayan", regarding Allah's saying "And Allah loves those who purify themselves" [Quran, 9:108], said: It was said: They loved to purify themselves with water from defecation and urination. Preferring Water Over Stones, Especially For Those With A Tendency ...

chapter: Regarding The Prohibition Of Cleaning Oneself After Defecation With Bone And Dung, And The Permissibility Of Using Clay, Fabric Scraps, Cotton, And The Like  Heading 947 عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن استنجاء الرجل ابلعظم أو البعر، أو العود؟ اقل: أما العظم، والروث، فطعام الجن، وذلك مما اشترطوا عىل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقال: ال يصلح بشئ من ذلك. From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about a man using a bone, dung, or a stick for istinja (cleaning after defecation)? He said: As for the bone and dung, they are food for the jinn, and that is from what they stipulated as a condition upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. So he said: It is not suitable to use any of these things.
arabicText: عن زرارة اقل: كان يستنيج من البول ثالث مرات، ومن الغائط ابلمدر والخرق.
englishText: Zurarah narrated: He would cleanse himself with water from urine three times, and from defecation with stones and rags.

chapter: Regarding The Prohibition Of Cleaning Oneself After Defecation With Bone And Dung, And The Permissibility Of Using Clay, Fabric Scraps, Cotton, And The Like  Heading 947 عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن استنجاء الرجل ابلعظم أو البعر، أو العود؟ اقل: أما العظم، والروث، فطعام الجن، وذلك مما اشترطوا عىل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقال: ال يصلح بشئ من ذلك. He said: As for the bone and dung, they are food for the jinn, and that is from what they stipulated as a condition upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. So he said: It is not suitable to use any of these things.
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر عليه السالم يقول: كان الحسين بن عيل عليه السالم يتمسح من الغائط ابلكرسف، وال يغتسل.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) used to clean himself from feces with cotton, and he would not wash.

chapter: Regarding The Prohibition Of Cleaning Oneself After Defecation With Bone And Dung, And The Permissibility Of Using Clay, Fabric Scraps, Cotton, And The Like  Heading 947 عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن استنجاء الرجل ابلعظم أو البعر، أو العود؟ اقل: أما العظم، والروث، فطعام الجن، وذلك مما اشترطوا عىل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقال: ال يصلح بشئ من ذلك. From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about a man using a bone, dung, or a stick for istinja (cleaning after defecation)? He said: As for the bone and dung, they are food for the jinn, and that is from what they stipulated as a condition upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. So he said: It is not suitable to use any of these things.
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين بن اببويه اقل: إن وفد الجان جاؤوا إلى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقالوا: اي رسول هللا، متعنا، أفعطاهم الروث، والعظم، فلذلك ال ينبغي أن يستنىج بهما.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn bin Babawayh said: The delegation of the Jinn came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and they said: O Messenger of Allah, provide us with provision. So he gave them dung and bones. Therefore, it is not appropriate to use these two things for cleansing after relieving oneself.

chapter: Regarding The Prohibition Of Cleaning Oneself After Defecation With Bone And Dung, And The Permissibility Of Using Clay, Fabric Scraps, Cotton, And The Like  Heading 947 عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن استنجاء الرجل ابلعظم أو البعر، أو العود؟ اقل: أما العظم، والروث، فطعام الجن، وذلك مما اشترطوا عىل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقال: ال يصلح بشئ من ذلك. arabicText: عن الصادق عن آابئه عليهم السالم، عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله - في حديث المناهي - اقل: ونهى أن يستنىج الرجل ابلروث والرمة.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq from his forefathers, peace be upon them, from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family - in the hadith of prohibitions - he said: And he prohibited that a man clean himself after defecation with dung and decayed bones.

chapter: Regarding The Prohibition Of Cleaning Oneself After Defecation With Bone And Dung, And The Permissibility Of Using Clay, Fabric Scraps, Cotton, And The Like  Heading 947 عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن استنجاء الرجل ابلعظم أو البعر، أو العود؟ اقل: أما العظم، والروث، فطعام الجن، وذلك مما اشترطوا عىل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فقال: ال يصلح بشئ من ذلك. He said: As for the bone and dung, they are food for the jinn, and that is from what they stipulated as a condition upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. So he said: It is not suitable to use any of these things.
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن عليه السالم، اقل: قلت له: لالستنجاء حد؟ اقل: ال، يبقى ماثمة.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him: Is there a limit for istinja (cleansing after relieving oneself)? He said: No, one should continue until it is clean. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Some of our scholars have used this to justify that cleaning oneself after using the toilet can be done with any pure body that removes impurity. chapter: Permissibility Of Carrying A Ring Made From Zamzam Stones Or Emeralds When Relieving Oneself, And The Recommendation To Remove It When Cleaning Afterward
arabicText: عن عيل بن الحسي قلت له: ما تقول في الفص يتخذ من أحجار زمزم؟ اقل: ال أبس به، ولكن إذا أراد االستنجاء نزعه.
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Husayn, I said to him: What do you say about a ring made from the stones of Zamzam? He said: There is no harm in it, but when one wants to perform istinja (cleansing after relieving oneself), they should remove it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Kulayni narrated this except that in Al-Kafi it's mentioned as "emerald," and in another version: "Zamzam," as in Al-Faqih and At-Tahdhib, and the latter is more likely correct. The intended meaning of stones from Zamzam is those that are picked up for repair purposes, like debris, so it does not imply that taking stones from the mosque, which is not permitted, as will be discussed later.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sitting For Istinja (Cleaning Private Parts) Like Sitting For Defecation
arabicText: سئل الصادق عليه السالم عن الرجل إذا أراد أن يستنىج، كيف يقعد؟ اقل: كما يقعد للغائط.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about how a man should sit when he wants to perform istinja. He said: Like how he sits for defecation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sitting For Istinja (Cleaning Private Parts) Like Sitting For Defecation
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: قلت له: الرجل يريد أن يستنىج كيف يقعد؟ اقل: كما يقعد للغائط، واقل: إنما عليه أن يغسل ما ظهر منه، وليس عليه أن يغسل ابطنه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, (the narrator) said: I asked him: How should a man sit when he wants to perform istinja? He said: Like how he sits for defecation, and he said: He only needs to wash what is apparent of it, and he does not need to wash its interior.

chapter: Dislike Of A Free Woman Washing Her Husband's Private Parts Except In Case Of Illness, The Permissibility For A Slave Woman Not Married To Him, And The Prohibition Of Others Doing So Absolutely
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: المرأة تغسل فرج زوجها؟ فقال: ولم؟ من سقم؟ قلت: ال، اقل: ما أحب للحرة أن تفعل، أفما األمة فال يضره، اقل: قلت له: أيغتسل الرجل بين يدي أهله؟ فقال: نعم، ما يفضي به أعظم.
englishText: Al-Hasan said, I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should a woman wash her husband's private parts? He said: Why? Due to illness? I said: No. He said: I do not like for a free woman to do this, but for a slave woman it does not harm. I asked him: Can a man perform ghusl (ritual bath) in front of his wife? He said: Yes, what he has exposed to her is greater. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The rest of the intended meaning will come in the section on marriage.

chapter: If Someone Enters The Lavatory And Finds A Piece Of Bread In Dirt, It Is Recommended For Them To Wash It And Eat It After Coming Out
arabicText: دخل أبو جعفر الباقر عليه السالم الخالء فوجد لقمة خبز في القذر، أفخذها، وغسلها، ودفعها إلى مملوك معه، فقال: تكون معك آلكلها إذا خرجت، فلما خرج عليه السالم اقل للمملوك: أين اللقمة؟ فقال: أكلتها اي بن رسول هللا فقال عليه السالم إنها ما استقرت في جوف أحد إال وجبت له الجنة، افذهب، أفنت حر إفني أكره أن أستخدم رجال من أهل الجنة.
englishText: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir, peace be upon him, entered the lavatory and found a morsel of bread in the waste. He took it, washed it, and gave it to a slave who was with him, saying: Keep it with you so I may eat it when I come out. When he came out, peace be upon him, he asked the slave: Where is the morsel? The slave said: I ate it, O son of the Messenger of Allah. He, peace be upon him, said: It has not settled in anyone's stomach except that Paradise became obligatory for him. Go, for you are free, as I dislike to employ a man from the people of Paradise.

chapter: If Someone Enters The Lavatory And Finds A Piece Of Bread In Dirt, It Is Recommended For Them To Wash It And Eat It After Coming Out
arabicText: وفي "عيون األخبار" أبسانيد أتتي في إسباغ الوضوء، عن الرضا، عن آابئه، الحسين بن عيل عليه السالم أنه دخل المستراح فوجد لقمة ملقاة فدفعها إلى غالم له واقل: اي غالم أذكرني بهذه اللقمة إذا خرجت، أفكلها الغالم. فلما خرج الحسين بن عيل عليه السالم اقل: اي غالم، اللقمة؟ اقل: أكلتها اي موالي، اقل: أنت حر لوجه هللا، فقال رجل: أعتقته؟! اقل: نعم، سمعت رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يقول: من وجد لقمة ملقاة، فمسح منها أو غسل منها، ثم أكلها، لم تستقر في جوفه إال أعتقه هللا من النار، ولم أكن ألستعبد رجال أعتقه هللا من النار.
englishText: In Uyun al-Akhbar, with chains that come regarding perfecting ablution, from alRidha, from his fathers, from al-Husayn ibn Ali peace be upon him that he entered the lavatory and found a morsel (of bread) thrown away, so he handed it to his servant and said: O servant, remind me of this morsel when I come out. The servant ate it. When Al-Husain bin Ali, peace be upon him, went out, he said: O boy, where is the morsel? He said: I ate it, my master. He said: You are free for the sake of Allah. A man said: You freed him?! He said: Yes, I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, say: Whoever finds a discarded morsel, then wipes it or washes it, then eats it, it will not settle in his stomach except that Allah will free him from the Fire, and I would not enslave a man whom Allah has freed from the Fire.

chapter: Prohibition Of Using Bread For Istinja, The Ruling On Husayni Soil, And Food.
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول - في - حديث - إن قوما أفرغت عليهم النعمة، وهم أهل الثراثر فعمدوا إلى مخ الحنطة فجعلوه خبزا هجاء، وجعلوا ينجون به صبيانهم حتى اجتمع من ذلك جبل عظيم فمر بهم رجل صالح عىل امرأة وهي تفعل ذلك بصبي لها فقال: ويحكم اتقوا هللا عز وجل ال تغيروا ما بكم من نعمة! فقالت: كأنك تخوفنا ابلجوع أما ما دام ثراثران يجري إفان ال نخاف الجوع. أفسف هللا عز وجل وأضعف لهم الثراثر وحبس عنهم قطر السماء ونبت األرض، اقل: افحتاجوا إلى ذلك الجبل إفنه كان ليقسم بينهم ابلميزان.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, say in a hadith: Some people were showered with blessings, and they were the people of Tharthar. They took the core of wheat and made it into inferior bread, and they used it to clean their children until a great mountain of it accumulated. A righteous man passed by them and saw a woman doing this with her child. He said: Woe to you! Fear Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, do not change the blessings you have! She said: It seems you are frightening us with hunger; as long as our Tharthar flows, we do not fear hunger. So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, became angered and weakened their Tharthar for them and withheld the rain of the sky and the growth of the earth. He said: They became in need of that mountain, and it was distributed between them by scale. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Many narrations have been transmitted about honoring bread, prohibiting its disrespect, using it for istinja (cleansing after relieving oneself), and about seeking blessings from Husayni soil, and the obligation to honor it will come in its place, God willing. These include evidence for the intended point here, and previously mentioned was the prohibition of using bones and dung for istinja because they are the food of jinn, implying by priority the respect for human food as said, though the evidence is weak if not for caution, and God knows best. Section 8 Wudu (Ablution)

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: ال صالة إال بطهور.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, he said: There is no prayer except with purification.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: اي زرارة الوضوء فريضة.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him - in a hadith - he said: O Zurarah, ablution is obligatory.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن الفرض في الصالة، فقال: الوقت، والطهور، والقبلة، والتوجه، والركوع، والسجود، والدعاء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, I asked him about what is obligatory in prayer. He said: The time, purification, facing the qibla, having proper intention, bowing, prostration, and supplication.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: افتتاح الصالة الوضوء، وتحريمها التكبير، وتحليلها التسليم.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: The commencement of prayer is ablution, its sanctification is the takbir (saying Allahu Akbar), and its conclusion is the tasleem (saying As-salamu alaikum).

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الوضوء شطر االيمان.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Ablution is half of faith.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم ال صالة إال بطهور.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: There is no prayer without purification.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: واقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: افتتاح الصالة الوضوء، وتحريمها التكبير، وتحليلها التسليم.
englishText: And Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: The opening of prayer is ablution, its sanctification is saying takbir (saying Allahu Akbar), and its termination is saying tasleem (saying As-salamu alaikum).

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: واقل الصادق (عليه السالم): الصالة ثالثة أثالث: ثلث طهور، وثلث ركوع، وثلث سجود.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Prayer is divided into three parts: one-third is purification, one-third is ruku, and one-third is sujud.

chapter: Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts
arabicText: عن الرضا (عليه السالم) اقل: إنما امر ابلوضوء وبدئ به ألن يكون العبد طاهرا إذا اقم بين يدي الجبار عند مناجاته إايه، مطيعا له فيما أمره، نقيا من األدانس والنجاسة، مع ما فيه من ذهاب الكسل، وطرد النعاس، وتزكية الفؤاد للقيام بين يدي الجبار، اقل: وإنما جوزان الصالة عىل الميت بغير وضوء ألنه ليس فيها ركوع، وال سجود، وإنما يجب الوضوء في الصالة التي فيها ركوع وسجود.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The command of ablution and starting with it was made so that the servant would be pure when standing before the Almighty during his intimate conversation with Him, obedient to Him in what He commanded, clean from filth and impurity, along with its benefits of removing laziness, dispelling drowsiness, and purifying the heart for standing before the Almighty. He said: And we permitted prayer over the deceased without ablution because it has no ruku or sujud, as ablution is only obligatory in prayers that contain ruku and sujud. Its Obligation For Prayer And Similar Acts

chapter: Prohibition Of Entering Prayer Without Purification Even In Taqiyyah And Its Invalidity Without It
arabicText: لجعفر بن محمد عليهما السالم: جعلت فداك، إني أمر بقوم انصبية وقد أقيمت لهم الصالة، وأان عىل غير وضوء، إفن لم أدخل معهم في الصالة اقلوا ما شاؤوا أن يقولوا، أأفصيل معهم ثم أتوضأ إذا انصرفت، واصيل؟ فقال جعفر بن محمد عليه السالم: سبحان هللا، أفما يخاف من يصيل من غير وضوء أن أتخذه األرض خسفا؟!.
englishText: Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, was asked: May I be sacrificed for you, I pass by a group of hostile people (Nawasib) when their prayer is being established, and I do not have ablution. If I do not join them in prayer, they will say whatever they wish to say. Should I pray with them and then perform ablution when I leave, and pray again? Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: Glory to Allah! Does not one who prays without ablution fear that the earth might swallow him?

chapter: Prohibition Of Entering Prayer Without Purification Even In Taqiyyah And Its Invalidity Without It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: اقعد رجل من األحبار في قبره فقيل له: إان جالدوك مأة جلدة من عذاب هللا عز وجل، فقال: ال أطيقها، فلم يزالوا به حتى انتهوا إلى جلدة واحدة (فقال: ال أطيقها)، فقالوا: ليس منها بد، فقال: فيما تجلدونيها؟ اقلوا: نجلدك أنك صليت يوما بغير وضوء، ومررت عىل ضعيف فلم تنصره، فجلدوه جلدة من عذاب هللا افمتأل قبره انرا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: A Jewish scholar (rabbi) was made to sit in his grave and was told: We will give you one hundred lashes from Allah's punishment. He said: I cannot bear it. They kept reducing it until they reached one lash. He said: I cannot bear it. They said: There is no escape from it. He asked: For what are you lashing me? They said: We are lashing you because one day you prayed without ablution, and you passed by a weak person and did not help him. So they gave him one lash from Allah's punishment, and his grave became filled with fire.

chapter: Prohibition Of Entering Prayer Without Purification Even In Taqiyyah And Its Invalidity Without It
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم، ال صالة إال بطهور.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: There is no prayer except with purification.

chapter: Prohibition Of Entering Prayer Without Purification Even In Taqiyyah And Its Invalidity Without It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: ثمانية ال يقبل هللا منهم صالة، وعد منهم اترك الوضوء.
englishText: From Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: There are eight from whom Allah does not accept prayer, and he counted among them one who abandons ablution. Prohibition Of Entering Prayer Without Purification Even In Taqiyya...

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل توضأ ونسي أن يمسح رأسه حتى اقم في صالته؟ اقل: ينصرف، ويمسح رأسه، ثم يعيد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: I asked him about a man who performed ablution and forgot to wipe his head until he stood in his prayer? He said: He should leave, wipe his head, then repeat it.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم رجل توضأ فنسي أن يمسح عىل رأسه حتى اقم في الصالة؟ اقل: فلينصرف، فليمسح عىل رأسه، وليعد الصالة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about a man who performed ablution and forgot to wipe his head until he stood in prayer? He said: He should leave, wipe his head, and repeat the prayer.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من نسي مسح رأسه، أو قدميه، أو شيئا من الوضوء الذي ذكره هللا تعالى في القرآن كان عليه إعادة الوضوء والصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Whoever forgets to wipe his head, or feet, or anything from the ablution that Allah the Exalted has mentioned in the Quran, must repeat the ablution and prayer.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن عيل بن مهزاير في حديث - أن الرجل إذا كان ثوبه نجسا لم يعد الصالة، إال ما كان في وقت، وإذا كان جنبا، أو عىل غير وضوء أعاد. الصلوات المكتوابت اللواتي افتته، ألن الثوب خالف الجسد افعمل عىل ذلك إنشاء هللا تعالى.
englishText: From Ali bin Mahziyar in a hadith - that if a man's clothes were impure, he does not repeat the prayer except what was within its time, but if he was in a state of major ritual impurity or without ablution, he repeats all the missed obligatory prayers, because clothes are different from the body, so act upon this if Allah the Exalted wills.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن رجل توضأ، ونسي أن يمسح رأسه حتى اقم في الصالة؟ اقل: من نسي مسح رأسه، أو شيئا من الوضوء الذي ذكره هللا تعالى في القرآن أعاد الصالة.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about a man who performed ablution and forgot to wipe his head until he stood for prayer? He said: Whoever forgets to wipe his head, or anything from the ablution that Allah the Exalted has mentioned in the Quran, must repeat the prayer.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا ذكرت - وأنت في صالتك - أنك قد تركت شيئا من وضوئك المفروض عليك افنصرف، أفتم الذي نسيته من وضوئك، وأعد صالتك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: If you remember - while you are in prayer - that you have left out something from your obligatory ablution, then leave, complete what you forgot from your ablution, and repeat your prayer.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، في رجل توضأ فنسي أن يمسح عىل رأسه حتى اقم في الصالة، اقل: فلينصرف فليمسح برأسه، وليعد الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who performed ablution but forgot to wipe his head until he stood in prayer, he said: He should leave, wipe his head, and repeat the prayer.

chapter: Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of It, Even If Due To Forgetfulness, Until After Praying And The Obligation Of Making It Up After The Prayer Time Has Passed
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم، أنه اقل: ال تعاد الصالة إال من خمسة: الطهور، والوقت، والقبلة، والركوع، والسجود.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, that he said: Prayer is not repeated except for five things: purification, time, direction of prayer (qibla), ruku, and sujud. Obligation To Repeat Prayer For One Who Omits Ablution Or Part Of I...

chapter: Obligation Of Purification Upon The Entry Of Prayer Time And The Permissibility Of Performing It Before, Rather It Is Recommended
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: إذا دخل الوقت وجب الطهور والصالة، وال صالة إال بطهور.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When the time enters, purification and prayer become obligatory, and there is no prayer without purification.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification Upon The Entry Of Prayer Time And The Permissibility Of Performing It Before, Rather It Is Recommended
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: لكل صالة وقتان، وأول الوقت أفضلهما.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: For every prayer there are two times, and the first of the two times is better.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification Upon The Entry Of Prayer Time And The Permissibility Of Performing It Before, Rather It Is Recommended
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: أحب الوقت إلى هللا عز وجل أوله حين يدخل وقت الصالة، فصل الفريضة.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The most beloved time to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is its beginning when the prayer time enters, so perform the obligatory prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification Upon The Entry Of Prayer Time And The Permissibility Of Performing It Before, Rather It Is Recommended
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، أخبرني عن أفضل المواقيت في صالة الفجر؟ فقال: مع طلوع الفجر - إلى أن اقل - إفذا صىل العبد صالة الصبح مع طلوع الفجر أثبتت له مرتين: تثبته مالئكة الليل، ومالئكة النهار.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: Tell me about the best timing for the Fajr prayer? He said: With the break of dawn - until he said - When a servant prays the morning prayer at the break of dawn, it is recorded for him twice: it is recorded by the angels of the night and the angels of the day.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification Upon The Entry Of Prayer Time And The Permissibility Of Performing It Before, Rather It Is Recommended
arabicText: محمد بن ميك الشهيد في (الذكرى) اقل: روى: ما وقر الصالة من أخر الطهارة لها حتى يدخل وقتها.
englishText: Muhammad bin Makki Al-Shaheed reported in (Al-Dhikra): One has not respected the prayer who delays the purification for it until its time has entered.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification For The Mandatory Tawaaf, And Its Recommendation For The Voluntary Tawaaf And The Rest Of The Hajj Rituals
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال أبس أن يقضى المناسك كلها عىل غير وضوء إال الطواف، إفن فيه صالة، والوضوء أفضل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: There is no harm in performing all the rituals without ablution except for the tawaf, for it includes prayer, and ablution is preferable.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having Ablution When Seeking Needs And The Dislike Of Abandoning It When Pursuing Them
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل سمعته يقول: من طلب حاجة وهو عىل غير وضوء فلم تقض، فال يلومن إال نفسه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: Whoever seeks a need while not having ablution and it is not fulfilled, then he should blame none but himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having Ablution When Seeking Needs And The Dislike Of Abandoning It When Pursuing Them
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: إني ألعجب ممن أيخذ في حاجة وهو عىل وضوء، كيف ال تقضى حاجته.
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: I am amazed at someone who pursues a need while having ablution, how his need would not be fulfilled.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Ablution As Long As It Is Not Invalidated
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم: يصيل الرجل بوضوء واحد صالة الليل والنهار كلها؟ اقل: نعم، ما لم يحدث، قلت: فيصيل بتيمم واحد صالة الليل والنهار؟ اقل: نعم، كلها ما لم يحدث، أو يصب ماءا.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: Can a man pray with one ablution all prayers of night and day? He said: Yes, as long as he does not break his ablution. I said: Can he pray with one dry ablution (tayammum) the prayers of night and day? He said: Yes, all of them as long as he does not break his ablution or find water. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This statement suggests that in discussions regarding tayammum, there is evidence supporting this view, as well as in discussions regarding the specific acts that nullify ablution and others that have been mentioned and will be mentioned, indicating this point.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: اقل أبو الحسن موسى عليه السالم: من توضأ للمغرب كان وضوؤه ذلك كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه في ليلته إال الكبائر.
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him, said: Whoever performs ablution for Maghrib prayer, that ablution becomes an expiation for his past sins during his night except for the major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: كنت عند أبي الحسن عليه السالم فصىل، الظهر والعصر بين يدي وجلست عنده حتى حضرت المغرب، فدعا بوضوء، فتوضأ للصالة ثم اقل لي: توض، فقلت: جعلت فداك، أان عىل وضوء، فقال. وإن كنت عىل وضوء، إن من توضأ للمغرب كان وضوؤه ذلك كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه في يومه إال الكبائر، ومن توضأ للصبح كان وضوؤه ذلك كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه في ليلته إال الكبائر.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him: I was with Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, when he prayed Dhuhr and Asr prayers before me, and I sat with him until Maghrib time came. He called for water for ablution and performed ablution for prayer, then said to me: Perform ablution. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, I already have ablution. He said: Even if you have ablution. Indeed whoever performs ablution for Maghrib prayer, that ablution becomes an expiation for his past sins during his day except for the major sins, and whoever performs ablution for Fajr prayer, that ablution becomes an expiation for his past sins during his night except for the major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الطهر عىل الطهر عشر حسنات.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Performing ablution while already in a state of purity brings ten good deeds.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: اقل أبو الحسن موسى عليه السالم: من توضأ للمغرب كان وضوؤه ذلك كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه في نهاره، ما خال الكبائر، ومن توضأ لصالة الصبح كان وضوؤه ذلك كفارة لما مضى من ذنوبه في ليلته ما خال الكبائر.
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) said: Whoever performs ablution for the Maghrib prayer, that ablution will be an expiation for the sins committed during his day, except for the major sins. And whoever performs ablution for the Fajr prayer, that ablution will be an expiation for the sins committed during his night, except for the major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: ورواه في (المقنع) مرسال نحوه، وترك حكم الصبح.
englishText: And it was narrated in (Al-Muqni') in a mursal form similarly, but without mentioning the ruling about the Fajr prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: عن الرضا عليه السالم اقل: تجديد الوضوء لصالة العشاء يمحو "ال وهللا" و "بىل وهللا".
englishText: From Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, who said: Renewing ablution for the Isha prayer erases saying "No by Allah" and "Yes by Allah."

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من جدد وضوؤه لغير حدث جدد هللا توبته من غير استغفار.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Whoever renews their ablution without having broken it, Allah renews their repentance without seeking forgiveness.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: وزاد وفي حديث آخر: الوضوء عىل الوضوء نور عىل نور.
englishText: And in another hadith it adds: Ablution upon ablution is light upon light.

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: اقل: وكان النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله يجدد الوضوء لكل فريضة، وكل صالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, would renew his ablution for every obligatory prayer and every prayer. Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Ever...

chapter: Recommendation Of Renewing Ablution Without Having Lost It For Every Prayer, Especially Maghrib, Isha, And Fajr
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: الوضوء بعد الطهور عشر حسنات، فتطهروا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: Performing ablution after being in a state of purity earns ten good deeds, so perform ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sleeping In A State Of Ritual Purity Even If By Tayammum
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من تطهر ثم آوى إلى فراشه ابت وفراشه كمسجده.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever purifies himself then retires to his bed, spends the night while his bed is like his place of prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sleeping In A State Of Ritual Purity Even If By Tayammum
arabicText: عن الصادق عليه السالم اقل: من تطهر ثم آوى إلى فراشه ابت وفراشه كمسجده، إفن ذكر أنه ليس عىل وضوء، فتيمم من داثره كائنا ما كان، لم يزل في صالة ما ذكر هللا.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever purifies himself then retires to his bed, spends the night while his bed is like his place of prayer. If he remembers that he is not in a state of ablution, he can perform tayammum with his blanket whatever it may be, and he remains in prayer as long as he remembers Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sleeping In A State Of Ritual Purity Even If By Tayammum
arabicText: عن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل: من ابت عىل طهر فكأنما أحيى الليل.
englishText: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Whoever sleeps in a state of purity, it is as if he spent the night in worship.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sleeping In A State Of Ritual Purity Even If By Tayammum
arabicText: عن أمير المؤمنين عليهم السالم، اقل: ال ينام المسلم وهو جنب، وال ينام إال عىل طهور، إفن لم يجد الماء فليتيمم ابلصعيد إفن روح المؤمن تروح إلى هللا عز وجل، فيلقاها، ويبارك عليها، إفن كان أجلها قد حضر جعلها في مكنون رحمته، وإن لم يكن أجلها قد حضر بعث بها مع أمنائه من المالئكة، فيردها في جسده.
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said: A Muslim should not sleep while in a state of major ritual impurity, and should only sleep in a state of purity. If he cannot find water, he should perform tayammum with clean earth, for the soul of a believer ascends to Allah the Mighty and Majestic, who meets it and blesses it. If its appointed time has come, He places it in the hidden treasure of His mercy, and if its appointed time has not come, He sends it back with His trusted angels who return it to its body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم، اقل: إذا دخلت المسجد وأنت تريد أن تجلس، فال تدخله إال طاهرا.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When you enter the mosque intending to sit, do not enter it except in a state of purity.

chapter: Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques
arabicText: عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد عليه السالم أنه اقل: عليكم بإتيان المساجد إفنها بيوت هللا في األرض من أاتها متطهرا طهره هللا من ذنوبه، وكتب من زواره.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him), he said: You must attend the mosques for they are Allah's houses on earth. Whoever comes to them in a state of purity, Allah will purify him from his sins and record him among its visitors.

chapter: Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: أال أدلكم عىل شئ يكفر هللا به الخطااي، ويزيد في الحسنات؟ قيل: بىل اي رسول هللا اقل: إسباغ الوضوء عىل المكاره، وكثرة الخطى إلى هذه المساجد، وانتظار الصالة بعد الصالة، وما من أحد يخرج من بيته متطهرا، فيصيل الصالة في الجماعة مع المسلمين، ثم يقعد ينتظر الصالة األخرى إال والمالئكة تقول: اللهم اغفر له اللهم ارحمه.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Shall I not guide you to something by which Allah erases sins and increases good deeds? They said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said: Performing complete ablution despite difficulties, taking many steps to these mosques, and waiting for prayer after prayer. When someone leaves his house in a state of purity, performs prayer in congregation with Muslims, then sits waiting for the next prayer, the angels say: O Allah, forgive him, O Allah, have mercy on him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: مكتوب في التوراة، إن بيوتي في األرض المساجد فطوبى لعبد تطهر في بيته ثم زارني في بيتي، أال أن عىل المزور كرامة الزائر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: It is written in the Torah that my houses on earth are the mosques, so glad tidings to a servant who purifies himself in his house then visits Me in My house. Indeed, it is upon the one being visited to honor the visitor.

chapter: Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques
arabicText: وفي (العلل) عن أبيه، عن سعد، عن محمد بن الحسين، مثله، إال إنه اقل: وحق عىل المزور أن يكرم الزائر.
englishText: And in (Al-Ilal) from his father, from Sa'd, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn, similar to it, except he said: And it is a right upon the one being visited to honor the visitor. Recommendation Of Purification For Entering Mosques

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution Before Sleep In The State Of Major Ritual Impurity, After Minor Ritual Impurity, Before Prayer, After Ablution, And Maintaining A State Of Ritual Purity
arabicText: سئل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل، أينبغي له أن ينام وهو جنب؟ فقال: يكره ذلك حتى يتوضأ.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man, should he sleep while in a state of major ritual impurity? He said: It is disliked until he performs ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution Before Sleep In The State Of Major Ritual Impurity, After Minor Ritual Impurity, Before Prayer, After Ablution, And Maintaining A State Of Ritual Purity
arabicText: اقل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: يقول هللا تعالى: من أحدث ولم يتوضأ فقد جفاني، ومن أحدث وتوضأ، ولم يصل ركعتين، فقد جفاني، ومن أحدث وتوضأ، وصىل ركعتين، ودعاني ولم أجبه فيما سألني من أمر دينه ودنياه، فقد جفوته، ولست برب جاف.
englishText: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Allah the Most High says: Whoever experiences ritual impurity and does not perform ablution has turned away from (shunned) Me, and whoever experiences ritual impurity and performs ablution but does not pray two rak'ahs has turned away from Me, and whoever experiences ritual impurity and performs ablution and prays two rak'ahs and supplicates to Me but I do not answer what he asks regarding his religious and worldly affairs, then I have turned away from him - and I am not a Lord who turns away.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution Before Sleep In The State Of Major Ritual Impurity, After Minor Ritual Impurity, Before Prayer, After Ablution, And Maintaining A State Of Ritual Purity
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: اي أنس، أكثر من الطهور يزيد هللا في عمرك، وإن استطعت أن تكون ابلليل والنهار عىل طهارة اففعل، إفنك تكون إذا مت عىل طهارة مت شهيدا.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Anas, increase in purification and Allah will increase your lifespan, and if you can maintain ritual purity during the night and day then do so, for if you die while in a state of ritual purity, you will die as a martyr.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Touching Quranic Script And Copying It, And The Impermissibility Of A Person In A State Of Minor Or Major Ritual Impurity Touching Quranic Script
arabicText: عن أبي بصير اقل: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عمن قرء في المصحف وهو عىل غير وضوء؟ اقل: ال أبس، وال يمس الكتاب.
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about one who reads the Quran without ablution? He said: There is no problem, but he should not touch the script.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Touching Quranic Script And Copying It, And The Impermissibility Of A Person In A State Of Minor Or Major Ritual Impurity Touching Quranic Script
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كان إسماعيل بن أبي عبد هللا عنده فقال: اي بنى، إقرء المصحف، فقال: إني لست وضوء، فقال: ال تمس الكتابة، ومس الورق إفقرأه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Isma'il ibn Abu Abdullah was with him, and he said: O my son, read the Quran. He replied: I don't have ablution. He said: Don't touch the script, but touch the paper and read it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Touching Quranic Script And Copying It, And The Impermissibility Of A Person In A State Of Minor Or Major Ritual Impurity Touching Quranic Script
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن عليه السالم اقل: المصحف ال تمسه عىل غير طهر، وال جنبا، وال تمس خيطه وال تعلقه، إن هللا تعالى يقول: "ال يمسه إال المطهرون."
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, who said: Do not touch the Quran (Mushaf) without being in a state of purity, nor while in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah), and do not touch its binding (thread) nor hang it. Indeed Allah the Most High says: "None touch it except the purified" [Quran, 56:79]. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh and others have held that it is disliked (karaaha) to touch something other than the writing of the Quran without wudu.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Touching Quranic Script And Copying It, And The Impermissibility Of A Person In A State Of Minor Or Major Ritual Impurity Touching Quranic Script
arabicText: وبإسناده عن عيل بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم أنه سأله عن الرجل أيحل له أن يكتب القرآن في األلواح، والصحيفة وهو عىل غير وضوء؟ اقل: ال.
