englishText: And by his chain from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he asked him about whether it is permissible for a man to write the Quran on tablets and pages while not having ablution? He said: No. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is interpreted as recommending ablution or as implying the need to touch some of the words during writing, or it could be related to taqiyyah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Touching Quranic Script And Copying It, And The Impermissibility Of A Person In A State Of Minor Or Major Ritual Impurity Touching Quranic Script
arabicText: عن محمد بن عيل الباقر عليه السالم في قوله: "ال يمسه اال المطهرون"، اقل: من األحداث والجناابت، واقل: ال يجوز للجنب، والحائض، والمحدث، مس المصحف.
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ali Al-Baqir, peace be upon him, regarding His saying: "None touch it except the purified" [Quran, 56:79], he said: From minor and major impurities, and he said: It is not permissible for one who is in a state of major ritual impurity (junub), menstruating woman, and one who has lost their ritual purity (wudu) to touch the Quran.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Intercourse With A Pregnant Woman, Returning To Intercourse Even If Repeated, And For One Who Had Intercourse With A Slave Girl And Wants To Have Intercourse With Another
arabicText: عن أبي سعيد الخدري - في وصية النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله لعيل عليه السالم اقل: اي عيل إذا حملت امرأتك فال تجامعها إال وأنت عىل وضوء إفنه إن قضى بينكما ولد يكون أعمى القلب، بخيل اليد.
englishText: From Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri - regarding the Prophet's peace be upon him and his family advice to Ali peace be upon him, he said: O Ali, when your wife becomes pregnant, do not have intercourse with her unless you have performed ablution, for if a child is decreed between you, it would be blind of heart and stingy of hand (miserly).

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For Intercourse With A Pregnant Woman, Returning To Intercourse Even If Repeated, And For One Who Had Intercourse With A Slave Girl And Wants To Have Intercourse With Another
arabicText: فالن بن محرز بلغنا أن أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم كان إذا أراد أن يعاود أهله للجماع توضأ وضوء الصالة، أفحب أن تسأل أاب الحسن الثاني عليه السالم عن ذلك. اقل الوشاء: فدخلت عليه افبتدأني من غير أن أسأله فقال: كان أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم إذا جامع وأراد أن يعاود توضأ وضوء الصالة، وإذا أراد أيضا توضأ للصالة.
englishText: From Ibn Mahraz: We were informed that Abu Abdullah peace be upon him would perform ablution like the ablution for prayer when he wanted to return to his wife for intercourse, so I would like you to ask Abu Al-Hasan the Second peace be upon him about that. Al-Washaa said: I went to see him and before I could ask, he initiated saying: Abu Abdullah peace be upon him would perform ablution like the ablution for prayer when he had intercourse and wanted to return to it, and when he wanted to do it again he would perform ablution for prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution For A Menstruating Woman At The Time Of Each Prayer And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Her Prayer
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا كانت المرأة طامثا فال تحل لها الصالة، وعليها أن تتوضأ وضوء الصالة عند وقت كل صالة، ثم تقعد في موضع طاهر فتذكر هللا عز وجل، وتسبحه، وتهلله، وتحمده، كمقدار صالتها، ثم تفرغ لحاجتها.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When a woman is menstruating, prayer is not permissible for her. However, she should perform ablution as for prayer at the time of each prayer, then sit in a clean place and remember Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, glorify Him, declare His oneness, and praise Him, for the duration of her prayer. Then she may attend to her needs.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: إن أبي كان يقول: إن للوضوء حدا، من تعداه لم يوجر، وكان أبي يقول: إنما يتلدد، فقال له رجل: وما حده؟ اقل: تغسل وجهك ويدك، وتمسح رأسك ورجليك.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, saying: Indeed my father used to say: Wudu has a limit, whoever exceeds it will not be rewarded, and my father used to say: One only wastes water (when they exceed). A man asked him: And what is its limit? He said: You wash your face and your hands, and you wipe your head and your feet.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: أال أحيك لكم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ فقلنا: بىل، فدعا بقعب فيه شئ من ماء فوضعه بين يديه، ثم حسر عن ذراعيه ثم غمس فيه كفه اليمنى، ثم اقل: هكذا إذا كانت الكف طاهرة، ثم غرف مألها ماء، فوضعها عىل جبهته، ثم اقل: بسم هللا، وسدله عىل أطراف لحيته، ثم أمر يده عىل وجهه وظاهر جبهته مرة واحدة. ثم غمس يده اليسرى، فغرف بها مألها ثم وضعه عىل مرفقه اليمنى أفمر كفه عىل ساعده حتى جرى الماء عىل أطراف أصابعه، ثم غرف بيمينه مألها فوضعه عىل مرفقه اليسرى أفمر كفه عىل ساعده حتى جرى الماء عىل أطراف أصابعه، ومسح مقدم رأسه، وظهر قدميه، ببلة يساره، وبقية بلة يمناه. واقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: إن هللا وتر، يحب الوتر، فقد يجزيك من الوضوء ثالث غرافت: واحدة للوجه، واثنتان للذراعين، وتمسح ببلة يمناك انصيتك، وما بقي من بلة يمينك ظهر قدمك اليمنى، وتمسح ببلة يسارك ظهر قدمك اليسرى. اقل زرارة: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: سأل رجل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم عن وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فحىك له مثل ذلك. ورواه الصدوق إال أنه اقل: ومسح عىل مقدم رأسه وظهر قدميه ببلة بقية مائه، ولم يزد عىل ذلك.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Shall I describe to you the ablution of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family? We said: Yes. So he called for a bowl containing some water and placed it before him, Then he rolled up his sleeves, then dipped his right palm in it, then said: This is how it should be done when the palm is clean, then he scooped a handful of water and placed it on his forehead, then said: Bismillah, and let it flow to the edges of his beard, then he passed his hand over his face and the outer part of his forehead once. Then he immersed his left hand, scooped a handful of water with it, then placed it on his right elbow and passed his palm over his forearm until the water flowed to his fingertips. Then he scooped a handful with his right hand and placed it on his left elbow, passing his palm over his forearm until the water flowed to his fingertips. He wiped the front of his head and the top of his feet with the moisture remaining on his left hand and the rest of the moisture on his right hand. Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Indeed Allah is One (Witr) and loves the odd numbers. Three scoops of water are sufficient for ablution: one for the face, two for the forearms, and you wipe your forehead with the wetness of your right hand, and with what remains of wetness on your right hand you wipe the top of your right foot, and with the wetness of your left hand you wipe the top of your left foot. Zurarah said: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: A man asked Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, about the ablution of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and he described it to him like that. And Al-Saduq narrated it, except that he said: And he wiped the front of his head and the top of his feet with the remaining moisture of his water, and did not add more than that.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن زرارة وبكير أنهما سأال أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فدعا بطشت أو تور فيه ماء، فغمس يده اليمنى، فغرف بها غرفة، فصبها عىل وجهه فغسل بها وجهه، ثم غمس كفه اليسرى فغرف بها غرفة أففرغ عىل ذراعه اليمنى، فغسل بها ذراعه من المرفق إلى الكف ال يردها إلى المرفق، ثم غمس كفه اليمنى أففرغ بها عىل ذراعه اليسرى من المرفق وصنع بها مثل ما صنع ابليمنى، ثم مسح رأسه وقدميه ببلل كفه، لم يحدث لهما ماء جديدا، ثم اقل: وال يدخل أصابعه تحت الشراك، اقل ثم اقل: إن هللا تعالى يقول: (اي أيها الذين آمنوا إذ أقمتم إلى الصالة افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم) فليس له أن يدع شيئا من وجهه إال غسله، وأمر بغسل اليدين إلى المرفقين، فليس له ان يدع من يديه إلى المرفقين شيئا إال غسله، الن هللا تعالى يقول: (افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم إلى المرافق). ثم اقل: "وامسحوا برؤوسكم وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين" إفذا مسح بشئ من رأسه، أو بشئ من قدميه ما بين الكعبين إلى أطراف األصابع، فقد أجزأه. فقلنا أين الكعبان؟ اقل: هاهنا، يعنى المفصل دون عظم الساق، فقلنا: هذا ما هو؟ فقال: هذا من عظم، الساق والكعب أسفل من ذلك. فقلنا: أصلحك هللا افلغرفة الواحدة تجزي للوجه وغرفة للذراع؟ اقل: نعم، إذا ابلغت فيها والثنتان أتتيان عىل ذلك كله. أقول: المراد من الثنتين: غرفة الوجه وغرفة الذراع، والالم للعهد الذكري، وال أقل من االحتمال، فال داللة فيه عىل استحباب التثنية.
englishText: From Zurārah and Bukayr, they both asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about the ablution of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. He called for a basin or a bowl containing water. He then dipped his right hand, scooped up a handful of water, and poured it over his face, washing his face with it. Then he dipped his left palm and scooped with it, pouring it over his right forearm. He washed his forearm from the elbow to the palm without returning to the elbow. Then he dipped his right palm and poured it over his left forearm from the elbow, doing with it as he had done with the right. Then he wiped his head and his feet with the wetness remaining on his hands, without introducing new water for them. Then he said: And he should not put his fingers under the strap. Then he said: Indeed Allah the Exalted says: "O you who believe, when you rise to prayer, wash your faces and your hands" [Quran, 5:6], so he must not leave any part of his face unwashed, and He commanded washing the hands up to the elbows, so he must not leave any part of his hands up to the elbows unwashed, because Allah the Exalted says: "wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows" [Quran, 5:6]. Then he said: "And wipe your heads and feet up to the ankles" [Quran, 5:6]. So if one wipes any part of his head, or any part of his feet between the ankles to the tips of the toes, it suffices him. We asked: Where are the ankles? He said: Here, meaning the joint below the shin bone. We said: What is this? He said: This is from the shin bone, and the ankle is below that. We said: May Allah preserve you! Is one scoop sufficient for the face and one scoop for the forearm? He said: Yes, if you do it thoroughly, and "the two" (*) scoops cover all of that. * I (Hurr Amili) say: What is meant by "the two" is washing the face once and washing the forearm once, and the definite article is for previously mentioned reference, and there is at least a possibility, so there is no indication in it for the recommendation of doing it twice. Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: أال أحىك لكم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ أفخذ بكفه اليمنى كفا من ماء، فغسل به وجهه، ثم أخذ بيده اليسرى كفا، فغسل به يده اليمنى ثم أخذ بيده اليمنى كفا من ماء، فغسل به يده اليسرى، ثم مسح بفضل يديه رأسه ورجليه.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Shall I not tell you about the wudu of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)? He took a handful of water with his right palm and washed his face with it, then he took a handful with his left hand and washed his right hand with it, then he took a handful of water with his right hand and washed his left hand with it, then he wiped his head and feet with the remaining moisture from his hands.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث طويل - أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل: لما أسري بي إلى السماء أوىح هللا إلي: اي محمد، أدن من صاد افغسل مساجدك وطهرها، وصل لربك. فدان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله من صاد وهو ماء يسيل من ساق العرش األيمن، فتلقى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله الماء بيده اليمنى، فمن أجل ذلك صار الوضوء ابليمين، ثم أوىح هللا إليه أن اغسل وجهك، إفنك تنظر إلى عظمتي، ثم اغسل ذراعيك اليمنى واليسرى إفنك تلقى بيديك كالمي، ثم امسح رأسك بفضل ما بقي في يدك من الماء، ورجليك إلى كعبيك إفني أابرك عليك وأوطئك موطئا لم يطأه أحد غيرك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him - in a long hadith - that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: When I was taken on the night journey to heaven, Allah revealed to me: O Muhammad, approach Saad (reference to a place), wash your places of prostration and purify them, and pray to your Lord. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, approached Saad, which is water flowing from the right leg of the Throne. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, received the water with his right hand. For this reason, ablution is performed with the right hand. Then Allah revealed to him: Wash your face for you will look upon My greatness, then wash your right and left forearms for you will receive My words with your hands, then wipe your head with the remaining water in your hands, and your feet up to your ankles for I will bless you and make you step in a place where no one else has stepped.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن زرارة اقل: حىك لنا أبو جعفر عليه السالم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فدعا بقدح، أفخذ كفا من ماء أفسد له عىل وجهه، ثم مسح وجهه من الجانبين جميعا، ثم أعاد يده اليسرى في اإلانء أفسد لها عىل يده اليمنى، ثم مسح جوانبها، ثم أعاد اليمنى في اإلانء فصبها عىل اليسرى، ثم صنع بها كما صنع ابليمنى، ثم مسح بما بقي في يده ورأسه ورجليه ولم يعدهما في اإلانء.
englishText: Zurarah said: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, described to us the ablution of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. He called for a bowl, then took a handful of water and poured it over his face, then wiped his face from both sides. Then he returned his left hand to the vessel and poured water over his right hand, then wiped its sides. Then he returned his right hand to the vessel and poured it over his left hand, then did with it as he did with the right hand. Then he wiped with what remained on his hand his head and feet, and did not return them to the vessel.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: أيخذ أحدكم الراحة من الدهن، فيمأل بها جسده والماء أوسع أال أحيك لكم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ قلت: بىل، اقل: أفدخل يده في اإلانء ولم يغسل يده، أفخذ كفا من ماء، فصبه عىل وجهه، ثم مسح جانبيه حتى مسحه كله، ثم أخذ كفا آخر بيمينه فصبه عىل يساره، ثم غسل به ذراعه األيمن، ثم أخذ كفا آخر فغسل به ذراعه األيسر، ثم مسح رأسه ورجليه بما بقي في يديه.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: One of you takes a handful of oil and covers his entire body with it, while water is more plentiful. Shall I not tell you about the ablution of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family? I said: Yes. He said: He put his hand in the vessel without washing it, then took a handful of water and poured it on his face. Then he wiped both sides until he wiped his entire face. Then he took another handful with his right hand and poured it on his left hand, then washed his right forearm with it. Then he took another handful and washed his left forearm with it. Then he wiped his head and feet with what remained on his hands.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وضأت أاب جعفر عليه السالم بجمع، وقد ابل، فناولته ماء افستنىج ثم صببت عليه كفا فغسل به وجهه وكفا غسل به ذراعه األيمن وكفا غسل به ذراعه األيسر، ثم مسح بفضله الندى رأسه ورجليه.
englishText: I performed ablution for Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, at Jam' (Muzdalifah), after he had urinated. I handed him water, and he cleaned his private parts. Then I poured a handful of water, with which he washed his face, and another handful with which he washed his right forearm, and another handful with which he washed his left forearm. Then, with the remaining moisture, he wiped his head and feet. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It was also narrated in two other places similarly, in text and chain, except it was said: "then he took a handful" instead of "then I poured a handful over him." Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: أال أحيك لكم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله ثم أخذ كفا من ماء فصبها عىل وجهه، ثم أخذ كفا فصبها عىل ذراعه، ثم أخذ كفا آخر فصبها عىل ذراعه األخرى، مسح رأسه وقدميه، ثم وضع يده عىل ظهر القدم، ثم اقل: هذا هو الكعب، اقل: وأومأ بيده إلى أسفل العرقوب، ثم اقل: إن هذا هو الظنبوب.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Shall I describe to you the wudu of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)? Then he took a handful of water and poured it on his face, then took a handful and poured it on his forearm, then took another handful and poured it on his other forearm, wiped his head and his feet, then placed his hand on the top of the foot, then said: This is the ankle. He said: And he gestured with his hand to the lower part of the tendon, then said: This is the shin bone.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: حىك لنا أبو جعفر عليه السالم وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، فدعا بقدح من ماء، أفدخل يده اليمنى أفخذ كفا من ماء أفسدلها عىل وجهه من أعىل الوجه ثم مسح بيده الجانبين جميعا، ثم أعاد اليسرى في االانء أفسدلها عىل اليمنى، ثم مسح جوانبها ثم أعاد اليمنى في اإلانء، ثم صبها عىل اليسرى فصنع بها كما صنع ابليمنى، ثم مسح ببلة ما بقي في يديه رأسه ورجليه، ولم يعدهما في اإلانء.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, related to us the wudu of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. He called for a vessel of water, then inserted his right hand and took a handful of water. He poured it over his face from the top of the face, then wiped both sides with his hand. Then he returned his left hand to the vessel and poured water over the right arm, then wiped its sides. Then he returned his right hand to the vessel and poured water over the left arm, doing the same as he did with the right arm. Then with the remaining moisture on his hands, he wiped his head and feet, without returning them to the vessel.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن بكير وزرارة ابني أعين إنهما سأال أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ فدعا بطشت أو بتور، فيه ماء فغسل كفيه، ثم غمس كفه اليمنى في التور فغسل وجهه بها واستعان بيده اليسرى بكفه عىل غسل وجهه، ثم غمس كفه اليمنى في الماء، افغترف بها من الماء، فغسل يده اليمنى من المرفق إلى األصابع ال يرد الماء إلى المرفقين، ثم غمس كفه اليمنى في الماء افغترف بها من الماء، أففرغه عىل يده اليسرى من المرفق إلى الكف، ال يرد الماء إلى المرفق كما صنع ابليمنى، ثم مسح رأسه وقدميه إلى الكعبين بفضل كفيه لم يجدد ماءا.
englishText: Bukair and Zurarah, sons of A'yan, narrated that they asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the wudu of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So he called for a basin or a container with water. He washed his palms, then dipped his right palm in the container and washed his face with it, using his left hand to assist in washing his face. Then he dipped his right palm in the water, scooped water with it, and washed his right arm from the elbow to the fingers without returning the water to the elbows. Then he dipped his right palm in the water and scooped water with it, then poured it over his left hand from the elbow to the palm, not returning the water to the elbow as he did with the right hand. Then he wiped his head and feet up to the ankles with the remaining water on his palms, without renewing the water.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: سمعت أاب جعفر عليه السالم يحدث الناس بمكة في حديث أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل للثقفي قبل أن يسأله: أما أنك جئت أن تسألني عن وضوئك، وصالتك، ومالك فيهما؟ افعلم أنك إذا ضربت يدك في الماء وقلت: بسم هللا الرحمن الرحيم تناثرت الذنوب التي اكتسبتها يداك. إفذا غسلت وجهك تناثرت الذنوب التي اكتسبتها عيناك بنظرهما، وفوك بلفظه، إفذا غسلت ذراعيك تناثرت الذنوب عن يمينك وشمالك إفذا مسحت رأسك وقدميك تناثرت الذنوب التي مشيت إليها عىل قدميك، فهذا لك في وضوئك. إفذا أقمت إلى الصالة وتوجهت وقرأت أم الكتاب، وما تيسر لك من السور ثم ركعت أفتممت ركوعها، وسجودها، وتشهدت، وسلمت، غفر لك كل ذنب فيما بينك وبين الصالة التي قدمتها إلى الصالة المؤخرة، فهذا لك في صالتك.
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, narrating to people in Makkah in a hadith that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to the Thaqafi before he asked him: "As for you, you have come to ask me about your ablution, your prayer, and what you have in them? Know that when you strike your hand in the water and say: 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' the sins that your hands have committed will be scattered." When you wash your face, the sins that your eyes have committed through looking and your mouth through speaking fall away. When you wash your forearms, the sins from your right and left fall away. When you wipe your head and feet, the sins that you walked towards with your feet fall away. This is for you in your ablution. When you stand for prayer, face the qibla and recite the Opening of the Book (AlFatihah) and whatever is easy for you from the Quran, then bow completing your bowing and prostration, then recite the tashahhud and give the salam, every sin between you and the previous prayer up to this recent prayer will be forgiven. This is for you in your prayer. Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وفي "عيون األخبار" وفي "كتاب العلل" ابإلسناد اآلتي عن الفضل بن شاذان، عن الرضا عليه السالم "حديث العلل": إنما وجب الوضوء عىل الوجه واليدين ومسح الرأس والرجلين ألن العبد إذا اقم بين يدي الجبار إفنما ينكشف من جوارحه، ويظهر ما وجب فيه الوضوء، وذلك أنه بوجهه (يستقبل و) يسجد ويخضع، وبيده يسأل، ويرغب ويرهب، ويتبتل و، وبرأسه يستقبله في ركوعه وسجوده، وبرجليه يقوم ويقعد. وإنما وجب الغسل عىل الوجه واليدين، والمسح عىل الرأس والرجلين، ولم يجعل غسال كله وال مسحا كله لعلل شتى: منها أن العبادة العظمى إنما هي الركوع والسجود، وإنما يكون الركوع والسجود ابلوجه واليدين، ال ابلرأس والرجلين. ومنها: أن الخلق ال يطيقون في كل وقت غسل الرأس والرجلين، ويشتد ذلك عليهم في البرد والسفر والمرض و الليل والنهار، وغسل الوجه واليدين أخف من غسل الرأس والرجلين، وإنما وضعت الفرائض عىل قدر أقل الناس طاقة من أهل الصحة، ثم عم فيها القوي والضعيف. ومنها أن الرأس والرجلين ليس هما في كل وقت أبداين وظاهران، كالوجه واليدين، لموضع العمامة والخفين وغير ذلك.
englishText: In "Uyun al-Akhbar" and in "Kitab al-'Ilal" with the following chain of narration from Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, "Hadith of Reasons": The obligation of ablution on the face, hands, wiping the head and feet is because when the servant stands before the Almighty, only those parts of his body are uncovered and visible for which ablution is required. This is because with his face he (faces and) prostrates and submits, with his hand he asks, desires, fears, and devotes himself, with his head he faces Him in his bowing and prostration, and with his feet he stands and sits. The washing of the face and hands, and the wiping of the head and feet, were made obligatory, and it was not made all washing or all wiping, for various reasons: among them is that the greatest act of worship is bowing and prostration, and bowing and prostration are performed with the face and hands, not with the head and feet. Among them: that people cannot always manage to wash the head and feet, and it becomes difficult for them in cold weather, during travel, in illness, and at night and day. Washing the face and hands is easier than washing the head and feet. The obligations were set according to the capability of the least able among the healthy people, then they were generalized to include the strong and the weak. Among these is that the head and feet are not always exposed and apparent like the face and hands, due to the placement of the turban and leather socks and other such items.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن الفضل بن شاذان، عن الرضا عليه السالم أنه كتب إلى المأمون، أن محض االسالم شهادة أن أال إله إال هللا - إلى أن اقل - ثم الوضوء كما أمر هللا في كتابه غسل الوجه واليدين إلى المرفقين ومسح الرأس والرجلين مرة واحدة.
englishText: From Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, that he wrote to AlMa'mun: The essence of Islam is the testimony that there is no god but Allah - until he said - then the ablution as Allah commanded in His Book: washing the face and hands up to the elbows, and wiping the head and feet once.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن محمد بن سنان، عن الرضا عليه السالم في جواب مسائله :- وعلة الوضوء التي من أجلها وجب غسل الوجه والذراعين ومسح الرأس والرجلين فلقيامه بين يدي هللا عز وجل، واستقباله إايه بجوارحه الظاهر، ومالاقته بها الكرام الكاتبين، فيغسل الوجه للسجود والخضوع، ويغسل اليدين ليقلبهما، ويرغب بهما ويرهب ويتبتل، ومسح الرأس والقدمين ألنهما ظاهران مكشوافن يستقبل بهما في كل حاالته وليس فيهما من الخضوع والتبتل ما في الوجه والذراعين.
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) in response to his questions: The reason for ablution, for which washing the face and forearms, and wiping the head and feet became obligatory, is for standing before Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and facing Him with one's visible limbs, and meeting the noble recording angels with them. He washes the face for prostration and submission, and washes the hands to turn them in supplication, seeking what is desired and fearing what is dreaded and dedicating oneself to worship, and wipes the head and feet because they are apparent and uncovered, facing with them in all conditions, and they do not involve the submission and dedication that is in the face and forearms.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وفي "العلل" بإسناده اقل: جاء نفر من اليهود إلى رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله فسألوه عن مسائل وكان فيما سألوه: أخبران اي محمد، ألي علة توضأ هذه الجوارح األربع وهي أنظف المواضع في الجسد؟ فقال النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: لما أن وسوس الشيطان إلى آدم عليه السالم دان من الشجرة فنظر إليها فذهب ماء وجهه، ثم اقم ومشى إليها وهي أول قدم مشت إلى الخطيئة، ثم تناول بيده منها ما عليها وأكل فتطاير الحيل والحلل عن جسده فوضع آدم يده عىل أم رأسه وبىك، فلما اتب هللا عليه فرض (هللا) عليه وعىل ذريته تطهير هذه الجوارح األربع (أفمره هللا عز وجل) بغسل الوجه لما نظر إلى الشجرة وأمره بغسل اليدين إلى المرفقين لما تناول بهما، وأمره بمسح الرأس لما وضع يده عىل أم رأسه وأمره بمسح القدمين لما مشى بهما إلى الخطيئة.
englishText: In "Al-'Ilal" with its chain of narration: A group of Jews came to the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family and asked him questions, and among what they asked was: Tell us O Muhammad, for what reason do you perform ablution on these four limbs while they are the cleanest parts of the body? Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: When Satan whispered to Adam, peace be upon him, he approached the tree and looked at it, then his dignity departed. Then he stood and walked to it, and this was the first step that walked toward error [khatee'ah]. Then he took with his hand what was on it and ate, causing the ornaments and garments to fly off his body. Then Adam placed his hand on his head and wept. When Allah accepted his repentance, Allah made it obligatory upon him and his offspring to purify these four limbs. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, commanded him to wash the face because he looked at the tree, and commanded him to wash the hands up to the elbows because he took with them, and commanded him to wipe the head because he placed his hand on the crown of his head, and commanded him to wipe the feet because he walked with them towards the error [khatee'ah].

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ورواه في "المجالس" ابإلسناد المشار إليه وزاد: اقل: ثم سن عىل أمتي المضمضة لينقي القلب من الحرام، واالستنشاق لتحرم عليه رائحة النار ونتنها، اقل (اليهودي: صدقت) اي محمد، فما جزاء عاملها؟ فقال النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: أول ما يمس الماء يتباعد عنه الشيطان، إفذا تمضمض نور هللا قلبه ولسانه ابلحكمة، وإذا استنشق آمنه هللا من النار ورزقه رائحة الجنة، وإذا غسل وجهه بيض هللا وجهه يوم تبيض وجوه وتسود وجوه، إفذا غسل ساعديه حرم هللا عليه أغالل، النار، وإذا مسح رأسه مسح هللا عنه سيئاته، وإذا مسح قدميه أجازه عىل الصراط يوم تزل فيه األقدام.
englishText: And he narrated it in "Al-Majalis" with the aforementioned chain of narrators and added: He said: Then He prescribed for my nation the rinsing of the mouth to purify the heart from the forbidden, and the sniffing of water into the nose to forbid upon it the smell of Hellfire and its stench. The Jew said: You have spoken the truth, O Muhammad, so what is the reward for the one who does this? The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: When water first touches [a person], Satan distances himself from it. When one rinses the mouth, Allah illuminates his heart and tongue with wisdom. When one rinses the nose, Allah protects him from the fire and grants him the fragrance of Paradise. When one washes the face, Allah will brighten his face on the day when some faces will be brightened and others darkened [Quran, 3:106]. When one washes the forearms, Allah forbids the chains of fire upon them. When one wipes the head, Allah wipes away his sins. When one wipes the feet, Allah will help him cross the bridge [to Paradise] on the Day when feet will slip.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وفي "الخصال" بإسناده عن األعمش، عن جعفر بن محمد عليه السالم اقل: هذه شرايع الدين لمن أراد أن يتمسك بها، وأراد هللا هداه: إسباغ الوضوء كما أمر هللا في كتابه الناطق، غسل الوجه واليدين إلى المرفقين، ومسح الرأس والقدمين إلى الكعبين مرة مرة، ومراتن جائز، وال ينقض الوضوء إال: البول، والريح، والنوم، والغائط، والجنابة، ومن مسح عىل الخفين فقد خالف هللا ورسوله وكتابه، ووضوؤه لم يتم، وصالته غير مجزية.
englishText: In "Al-Khisal" with his chain of narration from Al-A'mash, from Ja'far bin Muhammad, peace be upon him, who said: These are the laws of religion for whoever wants to hold firmly to them, and for whom Allah wants to guide: Performing ablution completely as Allah commanded in His speaking Book - washing the face and hands up to the elbows, wiping the head and feet up to the ankles once, and twice is permissible. And nothing invalidates ablution except: urine, passing wind, sleep, defecation, and sexual impurity. And whoever wipes over leather socks (khuff) has opposed Allah, His Messenger, and His Book, and his ablution is incomplete, and his prayer is not sufficient.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم - في عهده إلى محمد بن أبي بكر - لما واله مصر - إلى أن اقل: - وانظر إلى الوضوء إفنه من تمام الصالة، تمضمض ثالث مرات، واستنشق ثالاث، واغسل وجهك، ثم يدك اليمنى، ثم اليسرى، ثم امسح رأسك ورجليك إفني رأيت رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يصنع ذلك، واعلم أن الوضوء نصف اإليمان.
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him - in his covenant to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr - when he appointed him governor of Egypt - until he said: And look to the ablution, for it is part of the completion of prayer. Rinse your mouth three times, sniff water into your nose three times, wash your face, then your right hand, then your left hand, then wipe your head and feet, for I have seen the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, do so. And know that ablution is half of faith.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: الحسن بن عيل العسكري عليه السالم في "تفسيره": عن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل: مفتاح الصالة الطهور، وتحريمها التكبير، وتحليلها التسليم، وال يقبل هللا صالة بغير طهور، وال صدقة من غلول. وإن أعظم طهور الصالة الذي ال يقبل هللا الصالة إال به، وال شيئا من الطاعات مع فقده، مواالة محمد صىل هللا عليه وآله ألنه سيد المرسلين، ومواالة عيل عليه السالم ألنه سيد الوصيين، ومواالة أوليائهما ومعاداة أعدائهما.
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Ali al-Askari, peace be upon him, in "his Tafsir": from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, who said: The key to prayer is purification, Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings its prohibition (sanctification) is the takbir, and its conclusion is the tasleem. Allah does not accept prayer without purification, nor sadaqah from embezzlement. And indeed, the greatest purification for prayer, without which Allah does not accept prayer or any act of obedience in its absence, is allegiance (*) to Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, for he is the master of the messengers, and allegiance to Ali, peace be upon him, for he is the master of the trustees, and allegiance to their allies and enmity towards their enemies. Translator: *The word mawalat is related to wali and wilayah and carries the meanings of guardianship, closeness, friendship, loyalty, and alliance.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: واقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: إن العبد إذا توضأ فغسل وجهه تناثرت ذنوب وجهه، وإذا غسل يديه إلى المرفقين تناثرت عنه ذنوب يديه، وإذا مسح برأسه تناثرت عنه ذنوب رأسه، وإذا مسح رجليه، أو غسلهما للتقية تناثرت عنه ذنوب رجليه، وإن اقل في أول وضوئه: بسم هللا الرحمن الرحيم، طهرت أعضاؤه كلها من الذنوب، وإن اقل في آخر وضوئه أو م ّحم ًدا َيك ْ ، وأشَه ُد ّ أن ُ ُوب إلَ َك ُ وأت ُ ِ َ له ْ إال أن َت ْ ، أسَت ْغِفر ِ َح ْم ِد َك ْ ، أشَه ُد َّ أن ال إ َّم وب ُه ْ َحانَ َك اللّ ُ غسله من الجنابة: سب ِص ُ ياؤه، تحاتت عنه ذنوبه ْ َ أو َ فاؤك و ِل ِياءِه ُ خلَ ْ َ َّ أن أو َك، و ُّ ِبي َ ْع َد نَ َخِل َيفُت َك ب َ َك و ُ ِلي َ ًا و ْ أشَه ُد ّ أن َ عِلي َ َك، و ُ َ ُسول َر ُ عبد َك و كما تتحات أوراق الشجر، وخلق هللا بعدد كل قطرة من قطرات وضوئه أو غسله ملكا يسبح هللا، ويقدسه، ويهلله، ويكبره، ويصيل عىل محمد وآله الطيبين، وثواب ذلك لهذا المتوضي، ثم أيمر هللا بوضوئه وغسله فيختم عليه بخاتم من خواتيم رب العزة، الحديث وهو طويل يشتمل عىل ثواب عظيم جدا.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: When a servant performs ablution and washes his face, the sins of his face fall away. When he washes his hands up to the elbows, the sins of his hands fall away. When he wipes his head, the sins of his head fall away. And when he wipes his feet, or washes them out of taqiyyah, the sins of his feet fall away. And if he says at the beginning of his ablution 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim (In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful)', all his limbs are purified from sins. And if he says at the end of his ablution or his bath from major impurity (ghusl janaba): 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk, wa ash-hadu anna Alian waliyuka wa khalifatuka ba'da nabiyyika, wa anna awliya'ahu khulafa'uka wa awsiya'uhu' (*), his sins fall away as leaves fall from a tree, And Allah creates for every drop of his ablution or ritual washing an angel that glorifies Allah, sanctifies Him, proclaims His oneness, exalts Him, and sends blessings upon Muhammad and his pure family. The reward for this is for the one performing ablution. Then Allah commands that his ablution and ritual washing be sealed with a seal from the seals of the Lord of Might. [This is part of] a long hadith that includes immense rewards. Translator: * "Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. I bear witness that there is no deity but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance. And I bear witness that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger. And I bear witness that Ali is Your wali (guardian) and Your successor after Your prophet, and that his awliya (guardians) are Your successors and Your appointed ones."

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: قلت ألبي الحسن موسى عليه السالم: كيف أتوضأ للصالة؟ فقال: ال تعمق في الوضوء، وال تلطم وجهك ابلماء لطما، ولكن اغسله من أعىل وجهك إلى أسفله ابلماء مسحا، وكذلك افمسح الماء عىل ذراعيك ورأسك، وقدميك.
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him: How should I perform ablution for prayer? He said: Do not be excessive in ablution, and do not slap water on your face forcefully, but wash it from the top of your face to the bottom with water by wiping (gently), and likewise wipe water on your forearms, your head, and your feet.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن الصادق عن آابئه، عن أمير المؤمنين عليهم السالم - في حديث - اقل: والمحكم من القرآن مما أتويله في تنزيله مثل قوله تعالى: "اي أيها الذين آمنوا إذا قمتم إلى الصالة افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم إلى المرافق، وامسحوا برؤوسكم وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين" وهذا من المحكم الذي أتويله في تنزيله ال يحتاج أتويله أكثر من التنزيل. ثم اقل: وأما حدود الوضوء: فغسل الوجه واليدين، ومسح الرأس والرجلين وما يتعلق بها ويتصل، سنة واجبة عىل من عرفها وقدر عىل فعلها.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq from his forefathers, from Amir al-Mu'minin peace be upon them - in a hadith - he said: And from the clear verses of the Quran whose interpretation is in its revelation is like the saying of the Most High: "O you who believe! When you rise to prayer, wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows, and wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles" [Quran, 5:6] This is from the unequivocal text whose interpretation is in its revelation, and its interpretation does not need more than the revelation. Then he said: As for the limits of ablution: washing the face and hands, wiping the head and feet, and what is related to them and connected, is an obligatory sunnah upon whoever knows it and is capable Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings of performing it.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عيل بن عيسى بن أبي الفتح األربيل في كتاب (كشف الغمة): اقل: ذكر عيل بن إبراهيم بن هاشم - وهو من أجل رواة أصحابنا - في كتابه، عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله، وذكر حديثا في ابتداء النبوة يقول فيه: فنزل عليه جبرئيل وأنزل عليه ماء من السماء فقال له: اي محمد قم توضأ للصالة، فعلمه جبرئيل الوضوء عىل الوجه واليدين من المرفق، ومسح الرأس والرجلين إلى الكعبين.
englishText: Ali ibn Isa ibn Abi al-Fath al-Arbili reported in his book (Kashf al-Ghummah): He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim - who is one of the most esteemed narrators among our companions - mentioned in his book, from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, and he narrated a hadith about the beginning of prophethood in which he says: Gabriel descended upon him and brought down water from the sky, then said to him: O Muhammad, rise and perform ablution for prayer. So Gabriel taught him ablution: washing the face and hands up to the elbows, and wiping the head and feet up to the ankles.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى بن جعفر عن أبيه، عليهما السالم، أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل لعيل وخديجة - لما أسلما :- إن جبرئيل عندي يدعو كما إلى بيعة االسالم، ويقول لكما: إن لالسالم شروطا: أن تقوال: نشهد أن ال إله إال هللا - إلى أن اقل: - وإسباغ الوضوء عىل المكاره، الوجه واليدين، والذراعين ومسح الرأس ومسح الرجلين إلى الكعبين، وغسل الجنابة في الحر والبرد، وإاقم الصالة، وأخذ الزكاة من حلها ووضعها في وجهها، وصوم شهر رمضان، والجهاد في سبيل هللا، والوقوف عند الشبهة إلى اإلمام إفنه ال شبهة عنده.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far from his father, peace be upon them both, that the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family said to Ali and Khadijah - when they embraced Islam: Gabriel is with me calling you both to pledge allegiance to Islam, and he says to you both: Islam has conditions: that you say: We bear witness that there is no god but Allah - until he said - And performing ablution properly despite difficulties, the face and hands and forearms and wiping the head and wiping the feet to the ankles, and performing the ritual bath after sexual impurity in heat and cold, and establishing prayer, and taking zakat from lawful sources and spending it in its rightful places, and fasting the month of Ramadan, and striving in the way of Allah, and stopping at matters of doubt by referring to the Imam for he has no doubt.

chapter: Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وعنه، عن موسى بن جعفر، عن أبيه عليهما السالم، أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل للمقداد، وسلما وأبي ذر: أتعرفون شرائع اإلسالم؟ اقلوا: نعرف ما عرفنا هللا ورسوله، فقال: هي أكثر من أن تحصى: أشهدوني عىل أنفسكم بشهادة أن ال إله إال هللا - إلى أن اقل - وأن القبلة قبلتي شطر المسجد الحرام لكم قبلة، وأن عيل بن أبي طالب وصي محمد صىل هللا عليه وآله وأمير المؤمنين، وأن مودة أهل بيته مفروضة واجبة، مع إاقم الصالة، وإيتاء الزكاة، والخمس، وحج البيت، والجهاد في سبيل هللا، وصوم شهر رمضان، وغسل الجنابة، والوضوء الكامل عىل الوجه واليدين والذراعين إلى المرافق والمسح عىل الرأس، والقدمين إلى الكعبين، ال عىل خف، وال عىل خمار، وال عىل عمامة، - إلى أن اقل - فهذه شروط اإلسالم، وقد بقي أكثر.
englishText: And from him, from Musa bin Ja'far, from his father peace be upon them both, that the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family said to Al-Miqdad, Salman and Abu Dharr: Do you know the laws of Islam? They said: We know what Allah and His Messenger have taught us. He said: They are too many to count: Bear witness upon yourselves with the testimony that there is no god but Allah - until he said - and that the qibla is my qibla towards the Masjid al-Haram (Sacred Mosque) which is a qibla for you, and that Ali ibn Abi Talib is the successor of Muhammad peace be upon him and his family and Amir alMu'minin, and that mawaddah (love) for his Ahl al-Bayt is obligatory and mandatory. With establishing prayer, giving zakat, (paying) the fifth (khums), pilgrimage to the House (Hajj), striving in the path of Allah, fasting the month of Ramadan, and performing the ritual bath after sexual impurity. Complete ablution includes washing the face, hands, and forearms up to the elbows, wiping the head, and washing the feet up to the ankles, not over leather socks, nor over a head covering, nor over a turban. - He then said - These are the conditions of Islam, and much more remains. Method Of Ablution And A Collection Of Its Rulings

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting The Transmitted Supplications When Looking At Water, During Istinja, Rinsing The Mouth, Sniffing Water Into The Nose, Washing The Limbs, And The Permissibility Of Asking Someone Else To Bring Water For Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: بينا أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم ذات يوم جالس مع محمد بن الحنفية إذ اقل له: اي محمد ايتني بإانء من ماء أتوضأ للصالة، أفاته محمد ابلماء أفكفاه فصبه بيده (اليسرى عىل يده اليمنى)، ثم اقل: بسم هللا وابهلل، والحمد هلل الذي جعل الماء طهور ولم يجعله نجسا. ثم استنىج فقال: اللهم حصن فريج وأعفه، واستر عورتي، وحرمني عىل النار. ثم تمضمض فقال: اللهم لقني حجتي يوم ألقاك وأطلق لساني بذكراك. ثم استنشق فقال: اللهم ال تحرم عىل ريح الجنة، واجعلني ممن يشم ريحها وروحها وطيبها. ثم غسل وجهه فقال: اللهم بيض وجهي يوم تسود فيه الوجوه، وال تسود وجهي يوم تبيض الوجوه، ثم غسل يده اليمنى فقال: اللهم أعطني كتابي بيميني، والخلد في الجنان بيساري، وحاسبني حسااب يسيرا، ثم غسل يده اليسرى فقال: اللهم ال تعطني كتابي بشمالي وال تجعلها مغلولة إلى عنقي، وأعوذ بك من مقطعات النيران، ثم مسح رأسه فقال: اللهم غشني برحمتك وبركاتك وعفوك، ثم مسح رجليه فقال: اللهم ثبتني عىل الصراط يوم تزل فيه األقدام واجعل سعيي فيما يرضيك عني، ثم رفع رأسه فنظر إلى محمد فقال: اي محمد، من توضأ مثل وضوئي، واقل مثل قولي خلق هللا له من كل قطرة ملكا يقدسه، ويسبحه، ويكبره، فيكتب هللا له ثوب ذلك إلى يوم القيامة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: One day while Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was sitting with Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah, he said to him: O Muhammad, bring me a vessel of water so I may perform ablution for prayer. Muhammad brought him water and he (Amir al-Mu'minin) poured it, pouring it with his (left hand onto his right hand), then said: "In the name of Allah and by Allah, and praise be to Allah who made water pure and did not make it impure." Then he performed istinja (cleaning private parts) and said: "O Allah, protect my private parts and keep them chaste, conceal my nakedness, and forbid me upon the Fire." He then rinsed his mouth and said: "O Allah, grant me my argument (hujjati) on the day I meet You and loosen my tongue with Your remembrance." Then he inhaled water (during ablution) and said: "O Allah, do not forbid upon me the fragrance of Paradise, and make me among those who smell its fragrance, its breeze and its perfume." Then he washed his face and said: "O Allah, whiten my face on the day when faces become black, and do not blacken my face on the day when faces become white." Then he washed his right hand and said: "O Allah, give me my book in my right hand, and eternity in Paradise in my left hand, and give me an easy reckoning." Then he washed his left hand and said: "O Allah, do not give me my book in my left hand and do not make it bound to my neck, and I seek refuge in You from the fragments of the Fire." Then he wiped over his head and said: "O Allah, cover me with Your mercy, Your blessings, and Your pardon." Then he wiped his feet and said: "O Allah, keep me firm on the path on the day when feet will slip, and make my efforts in what pleases You with me." Then he raised his head and looked at Muhammad and said: "O Muhammad, whoever performs ablution like my ablution, and says like my saying, Allah creates for him from every drop an angel that sanctifies Him, praises Him, and exalts Him, and Allah writes for him the reward of that until the Day of Resurrection."

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting The Transmitted Supplications When Looking At Water, During Istinja, Rinsing The Mouth, Sniffing Water Into The Nose, Washing The Limbs, And The Permissibility Of Asking Someone Else To Bring Water For Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، أنه اقل له: ضع لي ماء أتوضأ.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, that he said to him: Prepare water for me to perform ablution. Recommendation Of Reciting The Transmitted Supplications When Looki...

chapter: Limit Of The Face That Must Be Washed, And The Nonobligation Of Washing The Temples
arabicText: عن زرارة بن أعين، أنه اقل ألبى جعفر الباقر عليه السالم: أخبرني عن حد الوجه الذي ينبغي أن يوضأ الذي اقل هللا عزو جل؟ فقال: الوجه الذي اقل هللا وأمر هللا عز وجل بغسله، الذي ال ينبغي ألحد أن يزيد عليه، وال ينقص منه، إن زاد عليه لم يوجر، وإن نقص منه أثم: ما دارت عليه الوسطى واإلبهام من قصاص شعر الرأس إلى الذقن، وما جرت عليه اإلصبعان من الوجه مستديرا فهو من الوجه، وما سوى ذلك فليس من الوجه، فقال له: الصدغ من الوجه؟ فقال: ال.
englishText: From Zurarah ibn A'yan, that he said to Abu Ja'far al-Baqir, peace be upon him: Tell me about the boundary of the face that should be washed which Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, mentioned? He said: The face that Allah mentioned and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, commanded to wash is that which no one should exceed nor reduce from. If one exceeds it, they will not be rewarded, and if one reduces from it, they will sin: It is what the middle finger and thumb encompass from the hairline to the chin, and what the two fingers cover when moved in a circular motion on the face is considered part of the face, and whatever is beyond that is not from the face. He asked him: Is the temple part of the face? He said: No.

chapter: Limit Of The Face That Must Be Washed, And The Nonobligation Of Washing The Temples
arabicText: كتبت إلى الرضا عليه السالم أسأله عن حد الوجه فكتب: من أول الشعر إلى آخر الوجه، وكذلك الجبينين.
englishText: I wrote to Al-Ridha peace be upon him asking him about the boundary of the face, so he wrote: From the beginning of the hair to the end of the face, and likewise the two temples.

chapter: It Is Not Obligatory To Wash The Ears With The Face Nor To Wipe Them With The Head.
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: األذانن ليسا من الوجه وال من الرأس.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: The ears are neither part of the face nor part of the head.

chapter: It Is Not Obligatory To Wash The Ears With The Face Nor To Wipe Them With The Head.
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم قلت: إن أانسا يقولون: إن بطن األذنين من الوجه وظهر هما من الرأس؟ فقال: ليس عليهما غسل وال مسح.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, saying: Some people say that the inside of the ears is part of the face, and the outside of them is part of the head? He said: Neither washing nor wiping is required for them.

chapter: It Is Not Obligatory To Wash The Ears With The Face Nor To Wipe Them With The Head.
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم األذانن من الرأس؟ اقل: نعم، قلت إفذا مسحت رأسي مسحت اذني؟ اقل: نعم كأني أنظر إلى أبي وفي عنقه عكنة وكان يحفي رأسه إذا جزه كأني أنظر والماء ينحدر عىل عنقه. اقل الشيخ: هذا محمول عىل التقية ألنه موافق للعامة ومناف لظاهر القرآن. وحمله صاحب المنتقى أيضا عىل التقية. أقول: وال تصريح فيه ابلوضوء فلعل السؤال عن الغسل والمراد ابلمسح إمرار اليد عىل الجسد بعد صب الماء، بقرينة قوله، والماء ينحدر عىل عنقه. ويحتمل كون السؤال عن مسح الرأس المستحب بعد الحلق، بقرينة قوله: وكان يحفي رأسه إذا جزه، وهللا أعلم.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, "Are the ears part of the head?" He said: Yes. I said: "So when I wipe my head, should I wipe my ears?" He said: Yes. It is as if I can see my father with a fold in his neck, and when he would cut his hair, he would cut it very short. It is as if I can see the water flowing down his neck. The Shaykh said: This is interpreted as taqiyyah because it agrees with the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims) and contradicts the apparent meaning of the Quran. The author of Al-Muntaqa also interpreted it as taqiyyah. I (Hurr Amili) say: There is no explicit mention of ablution in it, so perhaps the question is about bathing, and what is meant by wiping is passing the hand over the body after pouring water, as indicated by his saying, "and the water flows down his neck." It is also possible that the question is about the recommended wiping of the head after shaving, as indicated by his saying: "he would cut it very short," and Allah knows best.

chapter: Obligation To Begin Washing The Face From Its Top And The Hands From The Elbows
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن قوله تعالى "افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم إلى المرافق" فقلت: هكذا؟ ومسحت من ظهر كفي إلى المرفق، فقال: ليس هكذا تنزيلها إنما هي: "افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم من المرافق" ثم أمر يده من مرفقه إلى أصابعه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about Allah's saying Your faces and your hands up to the elbows [Quran, 5:6], so I said: Like this? And I wiped from the back of my palm to the elbow. He said: This is not how it was revealed. Rather it is: Wash your faces and your hands from the elbows. Then he moved his hand from his elbow to his fingers. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And the Sheikh narrated with his chain from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub. I say: The Sheikh interprets this to mean that this reading is a permissible interpretation of the verse, and it's possible that the intended meaning of revelation is interpretation, carrying, and allegory. Thus, the essence is that "to" in the verse means "from," as it is said: The Sheikh descended the hadith to such, and it can be interpreted as such. Then, the hadiths on the method of ablution and others that have passed and are to come, indicate the required understanding, and "to" in the verse means either "from" or "with," as the Sheikh said, and he provided evidence for it, or to clarify the limit of what should be washed, not the washing itself because it's closer to it, in addition to the consensus of the rightful group upon it and the multitude of texts supporting it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reversing In Wiping
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال أبس بمسح الوضوء مقبال ومدبرا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: There is no harm in wiping [during ablution] from front to back or from back to front.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reversing In Wiping
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال أبس بمسح القدمين مقبال ومدبرا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: There is no harm in wiping the feet forwards and backwards.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reversing In Wiping
arabicText: أخبرني من رأى أاب الحسن عليه السالم بمنى يمسح ظهر قدميه من أعىل القدم إلى الكعب، ومن الكعب إلى أعىل القدم، ويقول: األمر في مسح الرجلين موسع: من شاء مسح مقبال، ومن شاء مسح مدبرا، إفنه من األمر الموسع إن شاء هللا.
englishText: I was informed by one who saw Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, at Mina wiping the top of his feet from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle to the top of the foot, and he said: The matter regarding wiping the feet is flexible: whoever wishes may wipe forward, and whoever wishes may wipe backward, for it is from the flexible matters, insha'Allah.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: قلت له: الرجل ينسى مسح رأسه وهو في الصالة؟ اقل: إن كان في لحيته بلل فليمسح به، قلت: إفن لم يكن له لحية؟ اقل: يمسح من حاجبيه أو أشفار عينيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I said to him: What about a man who forgets to wipe his head while he is in prayer? He said: If there is moisture in his beard, he should wipe with it. I said: What if he does not have a beard? He said: He should wipe from his eyebrows or his eyelashes.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا ذكر وأنت في صالتك أنك قد تركت شيئا من وضوئك - إلى أن اقل - ويكفيك من مسح رأسك أن أتخذ من لحيتك بللها، إذا نسيت أن تمسح رأسك، فتمسح به مقدم رأسك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If you remember while you are in your prayer that you have left something from your ablution - until he said - and it suffices you for wiping your head to take moisture from your beard, if you forgot to wipe your head, and wipe the front of your head with it.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل ينسى مسح رأسه حتى دخل في الصالة، اقل: إن كان في لحيته بلل بقدر ما يمسح رأسه ورجليه فليفعل ذلك، وليصل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who forgets to wipe his head until he has entered the prayer, he said: If there remains moisture in his beard sufficient to wipe his head and feet, then let him do that and continue his prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن مسح الرأس قلت: أمسح (بما عىل يدي). من الندى رأسي؟ اقل: ال بل تضع يدك في الماء، ثم تمسح.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about wiping the head. I said: Should I wipe my head with the moisture on my hand? He said: No, rather put your hand in the water, then wipe. Shaykh Hurr Amili: His face comes [next].

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم: أيجزي الرجل أن يمسح قدميه بفضل رأسه؟ فقال برأسه ال، فقلت: أبماء جديد؟ فقال برأسه: نعم.
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan, peace be upon him: Is it sufficient for a man to wipe his feet with the remaining moisture from wiping his head? He gestured with his head no. So I asked: With fresh water? He gestured with his head yes. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: "Both narrations (1060 and 1061) are carried on the basis of taqiyyah because they conform to the doctrine of many of the A'ammah (general muslims)." I say: "And the contextual evidence in the second [narration] attests to that."

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: سألت جعفر بن محمد عليه السالم: أمسح رأسي ببلل يدي؟ اقل: خذ لرأسك ماءا جديدا.
englishText: I asked Ja'far bin Muhammad, peace be upon him: Should I wipe my head with the wetness of my hand? He said: Take fresh water for your head. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: "The reason for this also involves taqiyyah, because its narrators are among the A'ammah (general muslims) and the Zaidis."

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من نسي مسح رأسه، ثم ذكر أنه لم يمسح رأسه، إفن كان في لحيته بلل فليأخذ منه، وليمسح رأسه، وإن لم يكن في لحيته بلل فلينصرف وليعد الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: Whoever forgets to wipe his head, then remembers that he did not wipe his head, if there is wetness in his beard he should take from it and wipe his head, and if there is no wetness in his beard he should leave and repeat the ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: إن نسيت مسح رأسك افمسح عليه وعىل رجليك من بلة وضوئك، إفن لم يكن بقي في يدك من نداوة وضوئك شئ فخذ ما بقي منه في لحيتك، وامسح به رأسك ورجليك، وإن لم يكن لك لحية فخذ من حاجبيك، وأشفار عينيك، وامسح به رأسك ورجليك، وإن لم يبق من بلة وضوئك شئ أعدت الوضوء.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: If you forget to wipe your head, then wipe it and your feet with the wetness of your ablution. If no wetness remains on your hand from your ablution, take what remains of it in your beard and wipe your head and feet with it. If you do not have a beard, take from your eyebrows and eyelashes and wipe your head and feet with it. If no wetness remains from your ablution, repeat the ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows, Or Eyelashes If One's Hands Have Dried, And The Impermissibility Of Using New Water For It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، في رجل نسي مسح رأسه، اقل: فليمسح، اقل: لم يذكره حتى دخل في الصالة؟ اقل: فليمسح رأسه من بلل لحيته.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding a man who forgot to wipe his head, he said: He should wipe it. It was asked: What if he did not remember until he had entered the prayer? He said: He should wipe his head using the moisture from his beard. Obligation Of Taking Moisture For Wiping From One's Beard, Eyebrows...

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: مسح الرأس عىل مقدمه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: Wiping of the head is on its front part.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إمسح الرأس عىل مقدمه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: Wipe the head on its front part.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم في الرجل يتوضأ وعليه العمامة، اقل: يرفع العمامة بقدر ما يدخل أصبعه فيمسح عىل مقدم رأسه.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) regarding a man who performs ablution while wearing a turban, he said: He should lift the turban enough to insert his finger and wipe the front of his head.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن الرجل يمسح رأسه من خلفه، وعليه عمامة، أبصبعه أيجزيه ذلك؟ فقال: نعم.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who wipes his head from behind while wearing a turban with his finger, is that sufficient? He said: Yes. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: "It is not prohibited for him to insert his finger from behind and wipe over the forefront."

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن المسح عىل الرأس؟ فقال: كأني أنظر إلى عكنة في قفا أبي يمر عليها يده، وسألته عن الوضوء بمسح الرأس مقدمه ومؤخره؟ فقال: كأني أنظر إلى عكنة في رقبة أبي يمسح عليها.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about wiping the head? He said: It is as if I am looking at a fold of skin on my father's nape as he passes his hand over it. And I asked him about ablution with wiping the front and back of the head? He said: It is as if I am looking at a fold of skin on my father's neck as he wipes over it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets this as taqiyyah, and so is the case with what preceded it because it is the practice of some of the a'ammah (general muslims).

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: امسح الرأس عىل مقدمه ومؤخره.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: Wipe the front and back of the head. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets this as taqiyyah, and there were two opinions previously mentioned similar to this, in the narration about wiping the ears.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا فرغ أحدكم عن وضوئه فليأخذ كفا من ماء فليمسح به قفاه يكون ذلك فكاك رقبته من النار.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When one of you completes his ablution, let him take a handful of water and wipe the back of his neck (nape) with it, for that will be his liberation from the Fire. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This too conforms to taqiyyah, and it could be an act separate from ablution, done after completing it; indeed, this appears to be its apparent meaning. Obligation Of Wiping The Front Part Of The Head

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم: أال تخبرني من أين علمت وقلت، أن المسح ببعض الرأس وبعض الرجلين؟ فضحك فقال: اي زرارة اقله رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، ونزل به الكتاب من هللا عز وجل، الن هللا عز وجل اقل "افغسلوا وجوهكم" فعرفنا أن الوجه كله ينبغي أن يغسل. ثم اقل: "وأيديكم إلى المرافق" فوصل اليدين إلى المرفقين ابلوجه فعرفنا أنه ينبغي لهما أن يغسال إلى المرفقين، ثم فصل بين الكالم فقال: "وامسحوا برؤوسكم" فعرفنا حين اقل: "برؤوسكم" أن المسح ببعض الرأس لمكان الباء، ثم وصل الرجلين ابلرأس كما وصل اليدين ابلوجه فقال: "وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين" فعرفنا حين وصلهما ابلرأس أن المسح عىل بعضهما, ثم فسر ذلك رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله للناس فضيعوه.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Would you tell me how you knew and said that wiping part of the head and part of the feet is sufficient? He laughed and said: O Zurarah, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said it, and the Book came down with it from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, because Allah said "wash your faces" [Quran, 5:6] so we knew that the entire face must be washed. Then He said "and your hands up to the elbows" [Quran, 5:6] connecting the hands to the elbows with the face, so we knew that they must be washed up to the elbows. Then He separated between the words and said "and wipe your heads" [Quran, 5:6] so we knew when He said "your heads" that wiping part of the head is sufficient due to the presence of 'bi' (with/of). Then He connected the feet with the head as He connected the hands with the face and said "and your feet up to the ankles" [Quran, 5:6] so we knew when He connected them with the head that wiping part of them is sufficient. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) explained that to the people but they lost it.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن موسى عليه السالم قلت: جعلت فداك يكون خف الرجل مخراق فيدخل يده فيمسح ظهر قدمه، أيجزيه ذلك؟ اقل: نعم.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), I said: May I be sacrificed for you, if a person's leather sock (khuf) has a hole and he puts his hand through it to wipe the top of his foot, is that sufficient? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: توضأ عيل عليه السالم فغسل وجهه وذراعيه ثم مسح عىل رأسه وعىل نعليه ولم يدخل يده تحت الشراك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) performed ablution by washing his face and forearms, then wiped over his head and his sandals, and did not insert his hand under the straps.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم أنه اقل في المسح: تمسح عىل النعلين وال تدخل يدك تحت الشراك، وإذا مسحت بشئ من رأسك، أو بشئ من قدميك ما بين كعبيك إلى أطراف األصابع فقد أجزأك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said regarding wiping: Wipe over the sandals and do not insert your hand under the straps, and if you wipe any part of your head, or any part of your feet between your ankles to the tips of your toes, it is sufficient.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال تمسح المرأة ابلرأس كما يمسح الرجال إنما المرأة إذا أصبحت مسحت رأسها تضع الخمار عنها، وإذا كان الظهر والعصر والمغرب والعشاء تمسح بناصيتها.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman does not wipe her head as men do. Rather, when a woman performs ablution for the Fajr prayer, she removes her head covering and wipes her head, and for the Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha prayers, she wipes her forehead. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets this as taqiyyah.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، اقل: إذا توضأت افمسح قدميك ظاهرهما وابطنهما ثم اقل: هكذا فوضع يده عىل الكعب وضرب األخرى عىل ابطن قدميه، ثم مسحهما إلى األصابع.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When you perform ablution, wipe your feet - their top and bottom. Then he said: Like this - and he placed his hand on the ankle and struck the other on the bottom of his feet, then wiped them to the toes. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted this as taqiyyah. Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And No...

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في مسح القدمين ومسح الرأس فقال: مسح الرأس واحدة من مقدم الرأس ومؤخره، ومسح القدمين ظاهرهما وابطنهما.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding wiping the feet and wiping the head, he said: Wiping the head is done once from the front of the head to its back, and wiping the feet is done on their top (ankle) and bottom (toes). Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted this as taqiyyah, like the one before it. He said: "Because they conform to the doctrine of some of the general populace who view wiping and say it encompasses the entire foot, which is contrary to the truth as we have explained."

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: مسح أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم عىل النعلين ولم يستبطن الشراكين.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, wiped over the sandals and did not wipe underneath the straps.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The Entire Face And Hands In Ablution, And Non-obligation Of Wiping The Entire Head And Width Of Feet, And That The Obligation Is To Wipe The Top Of The Foot
arabicText: اقل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم: لوال أني رأيت رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يمسح ظاهر قدميه لظننت أن ابطنهما أولى ابلمسح من ظاهرهما.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: Had I not seen the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, wiping the top of his feet, I would have thought that wiping the bottom of the feet was more appropriate than wiping their top.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم في الرجل يتوضأ وعليه العمامة اقل: يرفع العمامة بقدر ما يدخل أصبعه فيمسح عىل مقدم رأسه.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) regarding a man who performs ablution while wearing a turban, he said: He should lift the turban enough to insert his finger and wipe the front part of his head.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: رجل توضأ وهو معتم فثقل عليه نزع العمامة لمكان البرد؟ فقال: ليدخل أصبعه.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him: A man performed ablution while wearing a turban, and it was difficult for him to remove the turban due to the cold? He said: Let him insert his finger.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: المرأة يجزيها من مسح الرأس أن تمسح مقدمه قدر ثالث أصابع، وال تلقى عنها خمارها.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: For a woman, it suffices to wipe the front part of her head, an area equivalent to three fingers' width, for the ritual ablution, and she does not need to remove her headcover.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: سألته عن المسح عىل القدمين كيف هو؟ فوضع كفه عىل األصابع فمسحها إلى الكعبين إلى ظاهر القدم، فقلت: جعلت فداك، لو أن رجال اقل أبصبعين من أصابعه هكذا؟ فقال ال، إال بكفه كلها.
englishText: I asked him about wiping over the feet, how is it done? He placed his palm on the toes and wiped them up to the ankles on the top of the foot. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, what if a man were to do it with two of his fingers like this? He said: No, only with his entire palm.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم، اقل: يجزي من المسح عىل الرأس موضع ثالث أصابع، وكذلك الرجل.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, he said: It suffices to wipe an area equivalent to three fingers on the head, and likewise for the foot.

chapter: Least Amount That Suffices In Wiping
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم أن عليا عليه السالم مسح عىل النعلين ولم يستبطن الشراكين.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, that Ali, peace be upon him, wiped over the sandals and did not wipe the inside of the straps. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets this [to apply] to the Arabian footwear because they do not prevent water from reaching the feet to the extent required for wiping.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث ،- اقل: وذكر المسح فقال: امسح عىل مقدم رأسك، وامسح عىل القدمين وابدأ ابلشق األيمن.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: And he mentioned wiping and said: Wipe the front of your head, and wipe your feet, and begin with the right side.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إنه أيتي عىل الرجل ستون وسبعون سنة ما قبل هللا منه صالة، قلت: كيف ذاك؟ اقل: ألنه يغسل من امر هللا بمسحه.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Sixty or seventy years may pass over a person while Allah does not accept any of his prayers. I asked: How is that? He said: Because he washes what Allah commanded to be wiped.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم اقل: سألته عن المسح عىل الرجلين؟ فقال: ال أبس.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both), he said: I asked him about wiping the feet? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن المسح عىل الرجلين؟ فقال: هو الذي نزل به جبرئيل.
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about wiping the feet? He said: This is what Gabriel brought down.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: وروي عن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم وابن عباس، عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أنه توضأ ومسح عىل قدميه ونعليه.
englishText: It is narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) and Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he performed ablution and wiped over his feet and his sandals.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: ورووا أيضا عن ابن عباس أنه وصف وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله فمسح عىل رجليه.
englishText: They also narrated from Ibn Abbas that he described the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and he wiped over his feet.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: وروي عنه أنه اقل: إن في كتاب هللا المسح، وأيبى الناس إال الغسل.
englishText: It is narrated from him that he said: In the Book of Allah it is wiping, but people refuse except washing.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: وقد روي مثل هذا عن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم وأنه اقل: ما القرآن إال ابلمسح.
englishText: It has been narrated similarly from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: The Quran only mentions wiping.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: اقل: وروي عن ابن عباس أنه اقل: غسلتان ومسحتان.
englishText: It has been narrated from Ibn Abbas that he said: Two washings and two wipings.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا، عن حماد، عن محمد بن النعمان، عن غالب بن الهذيل اقل: سألت أاب جعفر عليه السالم عن قول هللا عز وجل: "وامسحوا برؤوسكم وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين" عىل الخفض هي أم عىل النصب؟ اقل: بل هي عىل الخفض.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from Hammad, from Muhammad bin Nu'man, from Ghalib bin al-Hudhail who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: "and wipe your heads and your feet to the ankles" [5:6] - is it in the genitive case or accusative case? He said: Rather, it is in the genitive case. Translator: Refers to the different grammatical cases of nouns in the grammar of the Arabic language.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الرضا عليه السالم في وضوء الفريضة في كتاب هللا تعالى: المسح، والغسل في الوضوء للتنظيف.
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) regarding the obligatory ablution in the Book of Allah the Exalted: The wiping, and the washing in ablution is for cleanliness.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن زرارة، اقل: اقل لي: لو أنك توضأت فجعلت مسح الرجلين غسال، ثم أضمرت أن ذلك من المفروض لم يكن ذلك بوضوء، ثم اقل: ابدأ ابلمسح عىل الرجلين إفن بدا لك غسل فغسلته افمسح بعده، ليكون آخر ذلك المفروض.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: He said to me: If you perform ablution and make the wiping of the feet into washing, then believe that this is from what is obligatory, this would not be a valid ablution. Then he said: Begin with wiping on the feet, then if you wish to wash them and wash them, then wipe after it, so that the last of it is what is obligatory.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: كتبت إلى أبي الحسن عليه السالم أسأله عن المسح عىل القدمين، فقال: الوضوء ابلمسح وال يجب فيه إال ذاك ومن غسل فال أبس.
englishText: I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan peace be upon him asking him about wiping over the feet, and he said: The ablution is with wiping and nothing else is obligatory in it, and if one washes there is no harm. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as cleansing as mentioned before, and it could be interpreted as taqiyyah, for among them are those who said there is a choice.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يتوضأ الوضوء كله إال رجليه، ثم يخوض بهما الماء خوضا، اقل: أجزأه ذلك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who performs the entire ablution except for his feet, then submerges them in water, he said: That suffices him. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: "This is interpreted in the context of taqiyyah, not choice."

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: عن عيل عليه السالم اقل: جلست أتوضأ أفقبل رسول هللا حين ابتدأت في الوضوء فقال لي: تمضمض واستنشق واستن، ثم غسلت وجهي ثالاث فقال: قد يجزيك من ذلك المراتن، اقل: فغسلت ذراعي ومسحت برأسي مرتين فقال: قد يجزيك من ذلك المرة، وغسلت قدمي اقل: فقال لي: اي عيل خلل بين األصابع تخلل ابلنار. اقل الشيخ: هذا هو موافق للعامة وقد ورد مورد التقية ورواته كلهم عامة وزيدية، والمعلوم من مذاهب أئمتنا عليهم السالم القول ابلمسح. أقول: وقد تواتر ذلك كما في أحاديث كيفية الوضوء وغيرها، وهذا يحتمل النسخ ويكون نقله للتقية، ويحتمل كون الغسل للتنظيف ال من الوضوء.
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: I sat to perform ablution when the Messenger of Allah came when I began the ablution and said to me: Rinse your Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In... mouth, inhale water in your nose and clean your teeth, then I washed my face three times and he said: Two times suffices you from that. He said: So I washed my forearms and wiped my head twice and he said: Once suffices you from that, and I washed my feet. He said to me: O Ali, put water between the fingers lest fire come between them. The Shaykh said: This conforms with the a'ammah (general muslims) and has come in the context of taqiyyah and all its narrators are from the general public and Zaydis, and what is known from the school of our Imams (peace be upon them) is the ruling of wiping. I (Hurr Amili) say: This has been reported frequently as in the hadiths about how to perform ablution and others, and this possibly indicates abrogation and its narration was for taqiyyah, and possibly the washing was for cleanliness not as part of ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping The Feet And The Invalidity Of Washing Them In Ablution
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: إن الرجل ليعبد هللا أربعين سنة، وما يطيعه في الوضوء، ألنه يغسل ما أمر هللا بمسحه.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, who said: Indeed, a man may worship Allah for forty years while not obeying Him in wudu, because he washes what Allah commanded to be wiped.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل، إفذا توضأت فقل: أشهد أن ال إله إال هللا، اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين، والحمد هلل رب العالمين.
