englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: When you perform ablution, say: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves. And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: إذا وضعت يدك في الماء فقل: بسم هللا وابهلل اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين، إفذا فرغت فقل: الحمد هلل رب العالمين.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When you put your hand in water, say: "In the name of Allah and by Allah. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves." When you finish, say: "Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا اقل: من ذكر اسم هللا عىل وضوئه فكأنما اغتسل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, he said: Whoever mentions Allah's name during ablution, it is as if he performed a ritual bath.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: اقل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: اي أاب محمد من توضأ فذكر اسم هللا طهر جميع جسده، ومن لم يسم لم يطهر من جسده إال ما اصابه الماء.
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: O Abu Muhammad, whoever performs ablution and mentions Allah's name purifies his entire body, and whoever does not mention His name only purifies what the water touches.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا سميت في الوضوء طهر جسدك كله، وإذا لم تسم لم يطهر من جسدك إال ما مر عليه الماء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When you say bismillah during ablution, your entire body is purified, and when you don't say it, only what the water passes over is purified.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: وبهذا اإلسناد، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن رجال توضأ وصىل فقال له رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: أعد وضوءك وصالتك، ففعل فتوضأ وصىل، فقال له النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أعد وضوءك وصالتك، ففعل فتوضأ وصىل فقال له النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: أعد وضوءك وصالتك، أفتى أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم فشكا ذلك إليه فقال له: هل سميت حيث توضأت؟ اقل، ال اقل: سم عىل وضوئك فسمى وتوضأ وصىل أفتى النبي (صىل هللا عليه وآله) فلم أيمره ان يعيد.
englishText: With this chain of narration, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: A man performed ablution and prayed, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) told him: "Repeat your ablution and prayer." He did so, performed ablution and prayed, but the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) told him: "Repeat your ablution and prayer." He did so, performed ablution and prayed, but the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) told him: "Repeat your ablution and prayer." So he went to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) and complained about this to him. He asked him: "Did you say bismillah when you performed ablution?" He said: "No." He said: "Say bismillah during your ablution." So he said bismillah, performed ablution, and prayed. Then he went to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who did not order him to repeat. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted the mentioning here as the intention, as previously mentioned and what is to come, which indicates denying the obligation of mentioning [the name of Allah], and it can be interpreted that the repetition is recommended, and it's possible that it was abrogated.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: كان أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم إذا توضأ اقل: بسم هللا وابهلل وخير األسماء هلل، وأكبر األسماء هلل، واقهر لمن في السماء واقهر لمن في األرض هللا الحمد هلل الذي جعل من الماء كل شئ يح، وأحيى قلبي اباليمان، اللهم تب عيل وطهرني، واقض لي ابلحسنى، وأرني كل الذي أحب، وافتح لي ابلخيرات من عندك اي سميع الدعاء.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) would say when performing ablution: "In the name of Allah and by Allah, the best names belong to Allah, and the greatest names belong to Allah, the Subduer of those in the heavens and the Subduer of those on earth. Allah, praise be to Allah who made from water every living thing (Quran 21:30) and revived my heart with faith. O Allah, accept my repentance and purify me, and decree for me what is best, and show me all that I love, and open for me the gates of goodness from You, O Hearer of supplication."

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: اقل: وروي أن من توضأ فذكر اسم هللا طهر جميع جسده، وكان الوضوء إلى الوضوء كفارة لما بينهما من الذنوب، ومن لم يسم لم يطهر من جسده إال ما أصابه الماء.
englishText: He said: It is narrated that whoever performs ablution and mentions the name of Allah, his entire body becomes purified, and ablution after ablution becomes an expiation for sins committed between them, and whoever does not mention His name, only the parts touched by water become purified from his body.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من ذكر اسم هللا عىل وضوئه فكأنما اغتسل.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever mentions Allah's name during their ablution, it is as if they performed a full bath (ghusl).

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: وفي (الخصال) بإسناده اآلتي عن عيل عليه السالم - في حديث األربعمائة - اقل: ال يتوضأ الرجل حتى يسمي يقول قبل أن يمس الماء: بسم هللا وابهلل اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين، إفذا فرغ من طهوره اقل: أشهد أن ال إله إال هللا وحده ال شريك له، وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله صىل هللا عليه وآله، فعندها يستحق المغفرة.
englishText: In (Al-Khisal), with its forthcoming chain of narrators from Ali (peace be upon him) - in the hadith of the four hundred - he said: A man should not perform ablution until he mentions Allah's name, saying before touching the water: "In the name of Allah and by Allah, O Allah make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves." When he finishes his purification, he should say: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger (peace be upon him and his family)," and at this point he becomes deserving of forgiveness.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن محمد بن جعفر عن أبيه عليه السالم اقل: من ذكر اسم هللا عىل وضوئه طهر جسده كله ومن لم يذكر اسم هللا عىل وضوئه طهر من جسده ما أصابه الماء.
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ja'far from his father (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed S... mentions Allah's name during their ablution, their entire body becomes pure, and whoever does not mention Allah's name during their ablution, only the parts touched by water become pure.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا توضأ أحدكم ولم يسم كان للشيطان في وضوئه شرك، وإن أكل، أو شرب، أو لبس، وكل شئ صنعه ينبغي له ان يسمي عليه إفن لم يفعل كان للشيطان فيه شرك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When one of you performs ablution and does not say bismillah (mention Allah's name), Satan has a share in his ablution, and if he eats, or drinks, or dresses, and everything he does, he should mention Allah's name upon it, for if he does not do so, Satan has a share in it.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Saying Bismillah And Prescribed Supplications During Ablution, And Saying Bismillah During Eating, Drinking, Dressing, And Every Action
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل إذا توضأ أحدكم، أو اكل، أو شرب أو لبس لباسا ينبغي له أن يسمي عليه، إفن لم يفعل كان للشيطان فيه شرك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When one of you performs ablution, or eats, or drinks, or wears clothing, he should say Bismillah upon it. If he does not do so, Satan will have a share in it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Before Putting Them In The Vessel: Once After Urination And Sleep, Twice After Defecation, And Thrice After Major Ritual Impurity (Janabah)
arabicText: عن عبيد هللا بن عيل الحلبي اقل: سألته عن الوضوء كم يفرغ الرجل عىل يده اليمنى قبل أن يدخلها في اإلانء؟ اقل: واحدة من حدث البول، واثنتان من حدث الغائط، وثالث من الجنابة.
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi who said: I asked him about ablution, how many times should a man pour water on his right hand before putting it in the vessel? He said: Once after urinating, twice after defecation, and thrice after major ritual impurity (janabah).

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Before Putting Them In The Vessel: Once After Urination And Sleep, Twice After Defecation, And Thrice After Major Ritual Impurity (Janabah)
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: يغسل الرجل يده من النوم مرة ومن الغائط والبول مرتين، ومن الجنابة ثالاث.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A man should wash his hand once after sleep, twice after defecation and urination, and thrice after major ritual impurity (janabah). Shaykh Hurr Amili: Considering twice for urination is based on preference, or in the case of defecation and urination occurring together, as is apparent from the conjunction, indicating overlap.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Before Putting Them In The Vessel: Once After Urination And Sleep, Twice After Defecation, And Thrice After Major Ritual Impurity (Janabah)
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل يبول ولم يمس يده اليمنى شئ أيدخلها في وضوئه قبل أن يغسلها؟ اقل: ال، حتى يغسلها. ، قلت: إفنه استيقظ من نومه ولم يبل، أيدخل يده في وضوئه قبل أن يغسلها؟ اقل: ال، ألنه ال يدرى حيث ابتت يده، فليغسلها.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who urinates and his right hand hasn't touched anything, can he put it in his ablution water before washing it? He said: No, not until he washes it. I said: What if he wakes up from sleep and hasn't urinated, can he put his hand in his ablution water before washing it? He said: No, because he doesn't know where his hand was during the night, so he should wash it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interprets it as recommended rather than obligatory, as will be explained.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Before Putting Them In The Vessel: Once After Urination And Sleep, Twice After Defecation, And Thrice After Major Ritual Impurity (Janabah)
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: اغسل يدك من البول مرة، ومن الغائط مرتين. ومن الجنابة ثالاث.
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Wash your hand once after urination, twice after defecation, and thrice after major ritual impurity (janabah).

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Before Putting Them In The Vessel: Once After Urination And Sleep, Twice After Defecation, And Thrice After Major Ritual Impurity (Janabah)
arabicText: اقل: واقل عليه السالم: اغسل يدك من النوم مرة.
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Wash your hand once after (waking up from) sleep.

chapter: Permissibility Of Putting Hands In A Container Before The Recommended Washing
arabicText: سألته عن الرجل يبول وال تمس يده اليمنى شيئا أيغمسها في الماء؟ اقل: نعم، وإن كان جنبا.
englishText: I asked him about a man who urinates without his right hand touching anything - can he immerse it in water? He said: Yes, even if he is in the state of ritual impurity (janabah).

chapter: Permissibility Of Putting Hands In A Container Before The Recommended Washing
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا أصاب الرجل جنابة أفدخل يده في اإلانء فال أبس إن لم يكن أصاب يده شئ من المني.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: When a man becomes in a state of major ritual impurity and puts his hand in a vessel, there is no harm if his hand has not been touched by any semen.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: المضمضة واالستنشاق مما سن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are from what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established as Sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: سألته عنهما؟ اقل: هما من السنة إفن نسيتهما لم يكن عليك إعادة.
englishText: I asked him about them both? He said: They are from the Sunnah, and if you forget them, you don't have to repeat [the ablution].

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عمن توضأ ونسي المضمضة واالستنشاق، ثم ذكر بعد ما دخل في صالته؟ اقل: ال أبس.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about someone who performed ablution and forgot rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose, then remembered after entering his prayer? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عنهما؟، فقال: هما من الوضوء إفن نسيتهما فال تعد.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about them both? He said: They are part of ablution, but if you forget them, do not repeat [the ablution].

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: المضمضة واالستنشاق ليسا من الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are not part of ablution. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it to mean that they are not among its obligations but from its Sunnah, as previously mentioned.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: ليس المضمضة واالستنشاق فريضة وال سنة، إنما عليك أن تغسل ما ظهر.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are neither obligatory nor Sunnah, rather you only have to wash what is apparent. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said, meaning they are not from the Sunnah that cannot be abandoned. I say: What he meant by Sunnah is what its obligation is known through the Sunnah, and this is a meaning where the term Sunnah is used in the hadiths. It's possible that the hadith of Abu Basir was stated in the form of taqiyyah, and that they are recommended acts outside of ablution though recommended by him, as it will come to be mentioned that they are from the Hanafi Sunnahs. And what proves their recommendation in the manner of performing ablution has been mentioned in several hadiths.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: اقل الفقيه العسكري عليه السالم: ليس في الغسل وال في الوضوء مضمضة وال استنشاق.
englishText: The Faqih Al-Askari (peace be upon him) said: There is neither rinsing the mouth nor sniffing water into the nose in ritual bath (ghusl) or ablution (wudu).

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن المضمضة واالستنشاق، أمن الوضوء هي؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about rinsing the mouth and nose, are they part of the ablution? He said: No.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن المضمضة واالستنشاق؟ اقل: ليس عليك مضمضة وال استنشاق، ألنهما من الجوف.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose? He said: Neither rinsing the mouth nor sniffing water into the nose is required of you, because they are from the inside.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي بكر الحضرمي، عن أبي عبدهللا ( عليه السالم ) اقل: ليس عليك مضمضة وال استنشاق، ألنهما من الجوف.
englishText: From Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: You are not required to do mouth rinsing nor nasal rinsing, because they are from the Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water ... interior.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين في (ثواب األعمال) عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله اقل: ليبالغ أحدكم في المضمضة واالستنشاق، إفنه غفران لكم ومنفرة للشيطان.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn in (Thawab Al-A'mal) from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Let one of you be thorough in rinsing the mouth and nose, for it is forgiveness for you and drives away Satan.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر وأبي عبد هللا عليهما السالم، أنهما اقال: المضمضة واالستنشاق ليسا من الوضوء ألنهما من الجوف.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both, they said: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are not part of wudu because they are from the inner body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: وفي (الخصال) بإسناده، عن عيل عليه السالم - في حديث األربعمائة - اقل: والمضمضة واالستنشاق سنة وطهور للفم واألنف، والسعوط مصححة للرأس، وتنقية للبدن وساير أوجاع الرأس.
englishText: In Al-Khisal, with his chain of narration, from Ali peace be upon him - in the hadith of the four hundred - he said: Rinsing the mouth and nose is a sunnah and purification for the mouth and nose, and nasal medication is healing for the head, cleansing for the body and other head pains.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth Three Times And Sniffing Water Into The Nose Three Times Before Ablution, And Their Non-Obligation
arabicText: عن عيل بن جعفر عن أخيه موسى عليه السالم، أنه سأله عن المضمضة واالستنشاق، اقل: ليس بواجب وإن تركهما لم يعد لهما صالة.
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far from his brother Musa (peace be upon him), that he asked him about rinsing the mouth and nose, he said: It is not obligatory and if one leaves them out, they need not repeat the prayer for them. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Perhaps the emphasis on denial aims to refute the general populace who persistently practice them, and among them are those who argue for their obligatory nature, as mentioned by some of our scholars. And there will come what proves the recommendation of rinsing and sniffing in the use of miswak. And Allah knows best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Lightly Splashing Water On The Face During Ablution And The Dislike Of Excessive Striking And Going To Extremes In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا توضأ الرجل فليصفق وجهه ابلماء، إفنه إن كان انعسا فزع واستيقظ، وإن كان البرد فزع ولم يجد البرد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: When a person performs ablution, he should splash his face with water, for if he is drowsy he will be startled and wake up, and if it is cold he will be startled and will not feel the cold.

chapter: Recommendation Of Lightly Splashing Water On The Face During Ablution And The Dislike Of Excessive Striking And Going To Extremes In Ablution
arabicText: عن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: ال تضربوا وجوهكم ابلماء إذا توضأتم ولكن شنوا الماء شنا.
englishText: From Ja'far, peace be upon him, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Do not strike your faces with water when you perform ablution, but rather sprinkle the water gently. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is subject to abrogation, and the interpretation that negates obligation, or prohibits excessive striking and extravagance.

chapter: Recommendation Of Lightly Splashing Water On The Face During Ablution And The Dislike Of Excessive Striking And Going To Extremes In Ablution
arabicText: قلت ألبي الحسن موسى عليه السالم: كيف أتوضأ للصالة؟ فقال: ال تعمق في الوضوء، وال تلطم وجهك ابلماء لطما.
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him: How should I perform ablution for prayer? He said: Do not be excessive in ablution, and do not slap water on your face forcefully.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: الوضوء واحد، ووصف الكعب في ظهر القدم. ورواه الكليني عن الحسين بن سعيد، مثله، إال أنه اقل: واحدة واحدة، وكذا في إحدى روايتي الشيخ.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, he said: The ablution is one (wash), and he described the ankle as being on the top of the foot. And it was narrated by Al-Kulayni from Al-Husayn bin Sa'id, similar to it, except that he said: "wahidah, wahidah" (one, one), and likewise in one of the two narrations of the Shaykh.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: إن هللا وتر يحب الوتر، فقد يجزيك من الوضوء ثالث غرافت: واحدة للوجه، واثنتان للذراعين، وتمسح ببلة يمناك انصيتك، وما بقي من بلة يمناك ظهر قدمك اليمنى، وتمسح ببلة يسراك ظهر قدمك اليسرى.
englishText: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: Indeed Allah is odd and loves the odd numbers. For wudu, three scoops of water are sufficient for you: one for the face, and two for the forearms, and you wipe your forehead with the moisture of your right hand, and with what remains of moisture on your right hand wipe the top of your right foot, and with the moisture of your left hand wipe the top of your left foot.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الوضوء واحدة فرض، واثنتان ال يؤجر، والثالث بدعة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, he said: One wash in ablution is obligatory, doing it twice brings no reward, and doing it thrice is an innovation.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من لم يستيقن أن واحدة من الوضوء تجزيه لم يؤجر عىل الثنتين.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Whoever is not certain that one (wash) in wudu is sufficient will not be rewarded for doing two.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الوضوء مثنى مثنى، من زاد لم يؤجر عليه، وحىك لنا وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله فغسل وجهه مرة واحدة، وذراعيه مرة واحدة، ومسح رأسه بفضل وضوئه ورجليه. أقول: وقوله: مثنى مثنى، ينبغي حمله عىل أن المراد غسالن ومسحان، والقرينة هنا ظاهرة، أو عىل التجديد، أو عىل الجواز ال االستحباب، أو عىل التقية.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Ablution is mathna, mathna (twice twice) (*), whoever does more will not be rewarded for it, and he narrated to us the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he washed his face once, and his forearms once, and wiped his head with the remaining moisture of his ablution and his feet. (*) I (Hurr Amili) say: And his saying "mathna, mathna," should be interpreted as meaning two washes and two wipes, and the evidence here is clear, or it refers to renewal, or permissibility not recommendation, or it is based on taqiyyah.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الوضوء للصالة؟ فقال: مرة مرة هو.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ablution for prayer. He said: It is marrah, marrah (one time, one time).

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الوضوء؟ فقال: ما كان وضوء عيل عليه السالم إال مرة مرة.
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, was asked about ablution, and he said: The ablution of Ali, peace be upon him, was only marrah, marrah (one time, one time) (*). Translator: * The phrase "illa marrah marrah" emphasizes that an action should be done only once, with "marrah" meaning "time" or "instance." The repetition of the word "marrah" with "illa" (except) serves as an emphasis on singularity or doing something just one time.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن حماد بن عثمان، اقل: كنت اقعدا عند أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم فدعا بماء فمأل به كفه، فعم به وجهه، ثم مأل كفه فعم به يده اليمنى، ثم مأل كفه فعم به يده اليسرى، ثم مسح عىل رأسه ورجليه، واقل هذا وضوء من لم يحدث حداث، يعني به التعدي في الوضوء.
englishText: From Hammad bin Uthman who said: I was sitting with Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, when he called for water. He filled his palm with it and covered his face with it completely. Then he filled his (left) palm and covered his right hand with it completely. Then he filled his (right) palm and covered his left hand with it completely. Then he wiped his head and his feet, and said: This is the ablution of one Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second ... who has not invalidated his ablution, meaning by this not exceeding in ablution.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: واقل الكليني: وروي في رجل كان معه من الماء مقدار كف، وحضرت الصالة، فقال: يقسمه أثالاث: ثلث للوجه، وثلث لليد اليمنى، وثلث لليسرى ويمسح ابلبلة رأسه ورجليه.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It is narrated regarding a man who had with him an amount of water equal to a handful, and the prayer time came, so he said: He should divide it into thirds: one third for the face, one third for the right hand, and one third for the left hand, and he should wipe his head and feet with the remaining moisture.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: وهللا ما كان وضوء رسول هللا إال مرة مرة.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: By Allah, the wudu of the Messenger of Allah was nothing but marrah, marrah (one time, one time) (*). Translator: * The repetitive structure of the expression "marrah, marrah" is a linguistic feature in Arabic that indicates distribution - meaning each part or step of the wudu was done once. It's more specific than just saying marrah wahidah (once) because it emphasizes that each individual component of the ablution was performed one time. The best translation would be "once for each part" or "one time for each step" in the context of wudu.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل: وتوضأ النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله مرة مرة فقال: هذا وضوء ال يقبل هللا الصالة إال به.
englishText: And the Prophet, peace be upon him, performed wudu marrah, marrah (one time, one time) (*) and said: This is the ablution without which Allah does not accept prayer. Translator: * Refer to comment on Hadith 1150.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل: وقد روي أن الوضوء حد من حدود هللا ليعلم هللا من يطيعه ومن يعصيه، وأن المؤمن ال ينجسه شئ، وإنما يكفيه مثل الدهن.
englishText: It is narrated that ablution is one of Allah's limits to know who obeys Him and who disobeys Him, and that nothing makes a believer impure, and only a small amount like oil suffices him (*). Translator: * Oil, in general, is used sparingly and likewise very little water for wudu suffices for the believer.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: واقل الصادق عليه السالم: من تعدى في وضوئه كان كناقضه.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Whoever exceeds the limits in their ablution is like one who has invalidated it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: واقل الصادق عليه السالم: من توضأ مرتين لم يؤجر. اقل الصدوق: يعني أنه أتى بغير الذي امر به، ووعد عليه األجر فال يستحق األجر.
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Whoever performs ablution twice will not be rewarded. Al-Saduq said: This means he did other than what was commanded and promised reward for, so he does not deserve the reward.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: فرض هللا الوضوء واحدة واحدة ووضع رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله للناس اثنتين اثنتين؟! اقل الصدوق: اإلسناد منقطع، وهذا عىل اإلنكار ال اإلخبار، كأنه اقل: حد هللا حدا فتجاوزه رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله وتعداه، وقد اقل هللا: "ومن يتعد حدود هللا فقد ظلم نفسه"؟!
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: [So] Allah prescribed/ordained the wudu wahidah, wahidah (once, once), and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, established for the people ithnatayn, ithnatayn (twice, twice)?!! Al-Saduq said: The chain of transmission is disconnected, and this is in the form of denial, not information, as if he said: Allah set a limit, so did the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, exceed and transgress it? While Allah has said "And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself" [Quran,

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن عمرو بن أبي المقدام اقل: حدثني من سمع أاب عبدهللا يقول: إني ألعجب ممن يرغب أن يتوضأ اثنتين اثنتين، وقد توضأ رسول هللا ( صىل هللا عليه وآله ) اثنتين اثنتين.
englishText: From Amr bin Abi Al-Miqdam who said: Someone who heard Abu Abdullah narrated to me saying: I am amazed by one who dislikes performing ablution ithnatayn, ithnatayn (twice, twice) (*), while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed ablution ithnatayn, ithnatayn (*). Translator: * Based on the comment of Shaykh Hurr Amili in the next hadith (1157), twice twice here means "renewal" of wudu for every obligatory prayer. Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second ...

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: والنبي صىل هللا عليه وآله كان يجدد الوضوء لكل فريضة وكل صالة. فمعنى الحديث إني ألعجب ممن يرغب عن تجديد الوضوء وقد جدده النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله.
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to renew his ablution for every obligatory prayer and every prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: So the meaning of [the previous] hadith (1156) is: I am amazed by one who dislikes renewing ablution when the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) renewed it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل: وروي من زاد عىل مرتين لم يؤجر.
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that whoever exceeds twice (*) will not be rewarded. Translator: * Also refer to Hadith 1156, 1157 and 1170.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: وكذلك ما روي أن مرتين أفضل.
englishText: And likewise what is narrated that twice (*) is better. Translator: * Also refer to Hadith 1156, 1157 and 1170.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: وكذلك ما روي في مرتين أنه إسباغ.
englishText: And likewise what is narrated about twice (*) being thorough. Translator: * Also refer to Hadith 1156, 1157 and 1170.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: وفي "الخصال"، أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله توضأ مرة مرة.
englishText: And in "Al-Khisal," the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed ablution marrah, marrah (one time, one time).

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن الفضل بن شاذان، عن الرضا عليه السالم، أنه كتب إلى المأمون: محض اإلسالم شهادة أن ال إله إال هللا - إلى أن اقل - ثم الوضوء كما أمر هللا في كتابه: غسل الوجه واليدين إلى المرفقين، ومسح الرأس والرجلين مرة واحدة.
englishText: From Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), that he wrote to AlMa'mun: The pure essence of Islam is the testimony that there is no deity except Allah - until he said - then ablution as Allah commanded in His Book: washing the face and hands to the elbows, and wiping the head and feet once.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن الرضا عليه السالم، مثله، إال أنه اقل فيه: إن الوضوء مرة فريضة، واثنتان إسباغ.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), similar to it, except that he said in it: Performing ablution once is obligatory, and twice (*) is thorough. Translator: * Also refer to Hadith 1156, 1157 and 1170.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من تعدى في الوضوء كان كناقصه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever exceeds in wudu is like one who performs it deficiently.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم، إن أهل الكوفة يروون، عن عيل عليه السالم أنه ابل حتى رغا، ثم توضأ ثم مسح عىل نعليه، ثم اقل: هذا وضوء من لم يحدث. فقال: نعم، قد فعل ذلك، قلت: أفي حدث أحدث من البول؟ فقال: إنما يعني بذلك التعدي في الوضوء، أ يزيد عىل حد الوضوء.
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: The people of Kufa narrate from Ali, peace be upon him, that he urinated until he finished, then performed wudu and wiped over his sandals, then said: This is the wudu of one who has not invalidated it. He (Abu Ja'far) said: Yes, he did that. I said: What invalidation is greater than urination? He said: He only meant by that exceeding the bounds in wudu, or adding beyond the limits of wudu.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: اقل الكليني - بعد الحديث السابق: "ما كان وضوء عيل عليه السالم إال مرة مرة": هذا دليل عىل أن الوضوء إنما هو مرة مرة، ألنه عليه السالم كان إذا ورد عليه أمران كالهما هلل طاعة أخذ أبحوطهما، وأشدهما عىل بدنه، إنتهى.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said - after the previous hadith "Ali's (peace be upon him) wudu was only marrah, marrah (one time, one time)": This is evidence that wudu is only marrah, marrah (one time, one time), because when he (peace be upon him) was presented with two matters, both being obedience to Allah, he would choose the more precautionary and harder one on his body. Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second ...

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن ابن أبي يعفور، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الوضوء اقل: اعلم أن الفضل في واحدة، ومن زاد عىل اثنتين لم يؤجر.
englishText: From Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding ablution, he said: Know that the virtue is in doing it once, and whoever exceeds twice (*) will not be rewarded. Translator: * Also refer to Hadith 1156, 1157 and 1170.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن الوضوء؟ فقال: مثنى مثنى.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about ablution? He said: Mathna, mathna (twice twice) (*). Translator: * Refer to Shaykh Hurr Amili's comment in Hadith 1145.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: الوضوء مثنى مثنى. أقول: تقدم أتويل مثله. واقل صاحب المنتقى: ما دل عليه الخبران يخالف ما مر في حكاية وضوء رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله، وقد حمله الشيخ عىل استحباب تثنية الغسل وهو ال يدفع المخالفة عند التحقيق، والمتجه حمله عىل التقية، ألن العامة تنكر الوحدة، وتروى في أخبارهم التثنية، ويحتمل أن يراد تثنية الغرفة عىل طريق نفي البأس ال إثبات المزية إنتهى.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Wudu is mathna, mathna (twice twice) (*). I (Hurr Amili) say: A similar interpretation has preceded. And the author of AlMuntaqa said: What these two reports indicate contradicts what was previously mentioned regarding the description of the ablution of the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family. The Shaykh interpreted it as a recommendation for washing twice, but this does not truly resolve the contradiction upon investigation. The correct approach is to interpret it as taqiyyah, because the Aammah (general nonShia muslims) reject single washing and narrate double washing in their reports. It is also possible that the intended meaning is taking two handfuls of water in a way that indicates permissibility rather than establishing preference. End. Translator: * Also refer to Shaykh Hurr Amili's comment in Hadith 1145.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second And Third
arabicText: واقل الكليني: والذي جاء عنهم أن الوضوء مراتن هو أنه لم يقنعه مرة واستزاده فقال: مراتن، ثم اقل: ومن زاد عىل مرتين لم يؤجر، وهو أقصى غاية الحد في الوضوء الذي من تجاوزه أثم، ولم يكن له وضوء، وكان كمن صىل للظهر خمس ركعات، ولو لم يطلق عليه السالم في المرتين لكان سبيلهما سبيل الثالث إنتهى.
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: What has been reported from them regarding wudu being performed twice is that one was not satisfied with once and asked for more, so he said: twice. Then he said: Whoever exceeds twice will not be rewarded, and this is the ultimate limit in ablution which if transgressed becomes sinful, and his wudu would not be valid, and he would be like someone who prays five rak'ahs for Dhuhr prayer. If he (peace be upon him) had not permitted the two times, their ruling would have been the same as three times. End. Translator: Based on the hadiths on wudu and their context, there appears to be some variation in opinions regarding washing once or twice within Shia scholarship. Multiple hadiths explicitly state that washing once is the original divine obligation and several hadiths warn against exceeding limits. There are some seemingly contradictory hadiths mentioning "twice", however, Shaykh Kulayni, Saduq and Hurr Amili have provided explanations for these apparent contradictions and they can be understood as permissible but not preferred or recommended. They also may be based on taqiyyah or they refer to renewal of wudu, not repetition within one wudu. The strongest evidence in our body of hadith supports washing once as the basic requirement and preferred method as it is explicitly stated as the Prophet's practice and multiple Imams demonstrated it personally. Whereas washing twice is permissible but not superior and should not be considered more rewarding given that there is no clear indication that the Prophet or Imams ever practiced it. Sufficiency Of One Scoop In Ablution, And The Ruling On The Second ...

chapter: Permissibility of Performing Ablution Thrice For Taqiyyah, Rather its Obligation, as well as Washing Feet and Other Things, Specifically in Times of Fear
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الوضوء؟ فقال لي: توضأ ثالاث ثالاث، ثم اقل لي: أليس تشهد بغداد وعساكرهم؟ قلت: بىل، اقل: فكنت يوما أتوضأ في دار المهدي، فرآني بعضهم وأان ال أعلم به فقال: كذب من زعم أنك فألني وأنت تتوضأ هذا الوضوء، اقل: فقلت لهذا وهللا أمرني.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about wudu? He said to me: Perform wudu three times three times. Then he said to me: Do you not visit Baghdad and their military camps? I said: Yes. He said: One day I was performing wudu in Al-Mahdi's house, and one of them saw me while I was unaware of his presence, and he said: Whoever claims that you are a deviant has lied, while you perform wudu in this manner. He said: So I said: By Allah, this is what I was commanded to do.

chapter: Permissibility of Performing Ablution Thrice For Taqiyyah, Rather its Obligation, as well as Washing Feet and Other Things, Specifically in Times of Fear
arabicText: دخلت عىل أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم فقلت له: جعلت فداك كم عدة الطهارة؟ فقال: ما أوجبه هللا فواحدة، وأضاف إليها رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله واحدة لضعف الناس، ومن توضأ ثالاث ثالاث فال صالة له، أان معه في ذا حتى جاءه داود بن زربي فسأله عن عدة الطهارة؟ فقال له: ثالاث ثالاث، من نقص عنه فال صالة له، افرتعدت فرائصي وكاد، أن يدخلني الشيطان، أفبصر أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم إلي وقد تغير لوني، فقال: أسكن اي داود، هذا هو الكفر، أو ضرب األعناق، فخرجنا من عنده وكان ابن زربي إلى جوار بستان أبي جعفر المنصور، وكان قد القي إلى أبي جعفر أمر داود بن زربي، وأنه رافضي يختلف إلى جعفر بن محمد فقال أبو جعفر المنصور: إني مطلع إلى طهارته، إفن هو توضأ وضوء جعفر بن محمد - إفني ألعرف طهارته - حققت عليه القول وقتلته، افطلع وداود يتهيأ للصالة من حيث ال يراه، أفسبغ داود بن زربي الوضوء ثالاث ثالاث كما أمره أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم فما تم وضوءه حتى بعث إليه أبو جعفر المنصور فدعاه، فقال داود: فلما أن دخلت عليه رحب بي واقل: اي داود، قيل فيك شئ ابطل، وما أنت كذلك اقل، قد اطلعت عىل طهارتك وليس طهارتك طهارة الرافضة، افجعلني في حل، وأمر له بمائة ألف درهم، فقال داود الرقي: التقيت أان وداود بن زربي عند أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم، فقال له داود بن زربي: جعلت فداك، حقنت دماؤان في دار الدنيا، ونرجو أن ندخل بيمنك وبركتك الجنة، فقال أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: فعل هللا ذلك بك وبإخوانك من جميع المؤمنين، فقال أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم لداود بن زربي: حدث داود الرقي بما مر عليكم حتى تسكن روعته، فقال: فحدثته ابألمر كله، فقال أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: لهذا أفتيته ألنه كان أشرف عىل القتل من يد هذا العدو، ثم اقل: اي داود بن زربي توضأ مثنى، مثنى وال تزدن عليه إفنك إن زدت عليه فال صالة لك.
englishText: I went to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, how many times should one perform ablution? He said: What Allah has made obligatory is once, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) added one more due to people's weakness, and whoever performs ablution three times has no prayer. I was with him until Dawud bin Zarbi came and asked him about the number of times for ablution. He said to him: Three times three, whoever does less than that has no prayer. I started trembling and Satan almost entered me. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) looked at me and saw my color had changed, so he said: Be calm, O Dawud, this is either disbelief or beheading. We left him, and Ibn Zarbi was near Abu Ja'far alMansur's garden. It had been reported to Abu Ja'far that Dawud bin Zarbi was a Rafidi who frequented Ja'far bin Muhammad. Abu Ja'far al-Mansur said: I will observe his ablution, and if he performs ablution like Ja'far bin Muhammad - for I know his ablution - I will confirm the accusation and kill him. He observed while Dawud was preparing for prayer from where he couldn't see him. Dawud bin Zarbi performed complete ablution three times each as Abu Abdullah had instructed him. Before he finished his ablution, Abu Ja'far al-Mansur sent for him and called him. Dawud said: When I entered upon him, he welcomed me and said: O Dawud, something false was said about you, and you are not like that. I have observed your ablution, and your ablution is not the ablution of the Rafida. Consider me absolved, and he ordered a hundred thousand dirhams for him. Dawud al-Raqqi said: Dawud bin Zarbi and I met with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and Dawud bin Zarbi said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, our blood was saved in this worldly life, and we hope to enter Paradise through your blessing and grace. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: May Allah do that for you and your believing brothers. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to Dawud bin Zarbi: Tell Dawud al-Raqqi what happened to you to calm his fear. So he told me the whole matter. Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: This is why I gave him that fatwa, because he was about to be killed by this enemy. Then he said: O Dawud bin Zarbi, perform ablution mathna, mathna (twice, twice) (*), and do not exceed that, for if you exceed it, you will have no prayer. Translator: * Refer to Hadith 1145. chapter: Permissibility of Performing Ablution Thrice For Taqiyyah, Rather its Obligation, as well as Washing Feet and Other Things, Specifically in Times of Fear
arabicText: عن محمد بن الفضل أن عيل بن يقطين كتب إلى أبي الحسن موسى عليه السالم يسأله عن الوضوء؟ فكتب إليه أبو الحسن عليه السالم: فهمت ما ذكرت من االختالف في الوضوء، والذي آمرك به في ذلك أن تمضمض ثالاث، وتستنشق ثالاث، وتغسل وجهك ثالاث، وتخلل شعر لحيتك وتغسل يديك إلى المرفقين ثالاث، وتمسح رأسك كله، وتمسح ظاهر اذنيك وابطنهما، وتغسل رجليك إلى الكعبين ثالاث، وال تخالف ذلك إلى غيره. فلما وصل الكتاب إلى عيل بن يقطين تعجب مما رسم له أبو الحسن عليه السالم فيه مما جميع العصابة عىل خالفه ثم اقل: موالي أعلم بما اقل، وأان أمتثل أمره فكان يعمل في وضوئه عىل هذا الحد ويخالف ما عليه جميع الشيعة امتثاال ألمر أبي الحسن عليه السالم. وسعى بعيل بن يقطين إلى الرشيد، وقيل: إنه رافضي افمتحنه الرشيد من حيث ال يشعر، فلما نظر إلى وضوئه انداه كذب اي عيل بن يقطين! من زعم أنك من الرافضة. وصلحت حاله عنده، وورد عليه كتاب أبي الحسن عليه السالم ابتدأ من اآلن اي عيل بن يقطين وتوضأ كما أمرك هللا تعالى اغسل وجهك مرة فريضة، وأخرى إسباغا، واغسل يديك من المرفقين كذلك وامسح بمقدم رأسك وظاهر قدميك من فضل نداوة وضوئك فقد زال ما كنا نخاف منه عليك والسالم.
englishText: From Muhammad ibn al-Fadhl that Ali ibn Yaqtin wrote to Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) asking about ablution. Abu al-Hasan wrote back to him: I understand what you mentioned about the differences in ablution. What I command you in this matter is to rinse your mouth three times, sniff water into your nose three times, wash your face three times, run your fingers through your beard hair, wash your hands up to the elbows three times, wipe your entire head, wipe the outside and inside of your ears, and wash your feet to the ankles three times. Do not deviate from this to anything else. When the letter reached Ali ibn Yaqtin, he was surprised at what Abu al-Hasan had prescribed for him, as it differed from what all the group (Shia) practiced. Then he said: My master knows best what he says, and I will follow his command. So he performed his ablution according to these instructions, differing from all Shia in compliance with Abu al-Hasan's command. Someone informed al-Rashid about Ali ibn Yaqtin, saying he was a Rafidi (Shia). AlRashid tested him without his knowledge. When he observed his ablution, he called out: They lied, O Ali ibn Yaqtin! Whoever claimed you are from the Rafida. His status improved with al-Rashid, and then a letter came from Abu al-Hasan saying: From now on, O Ali ibn Yaqtin, perform ablution as Allah the Almighty commanded you - wash your face once as obligation and once for completion, similarly wash your hands from the elbows, wipe the front of your head and the top of your feet with the remaining moisture from your ablution, for what we feared for you has passed. Peace.

chapter: Permissibility of Performing Ablution Thrice For Taqiyyah, Rather its Obligation, as well as Washing Feet and Other Things, Specifically in Times of Fear
arabicText: عن عثمان بن زايد أنه دخل عىل أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم فقال له رجل: إني سألت أابك عن الوضوء، فقال: مرة مرة، فما تقول: أنت؟ فقال: إنك لن تسألني عن هذه المسألة إال وأنت ترى أني أخالف أبي توضأ ثالاث ووخلل أصابعك. أقول: وأحاديث التقية كثيرة أتتي في محلها إنشاء هللا وهي دالة بعمومها وإطالقها عىل وجوب التقية في الوضوء بقدر الضرورة.
englishText: From Uthman bin Ziyad that he entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and a man said to him: I asked your father about ablution, and he said: Once, once. So what do you say? He said: You would not ask me about this matter unless you think I disagree with my father. Perform ablution thrice and interlace your fingers. I (Hurr Amili) say: There are many hadiths about taqiyyah that will come in their place, insha'Allah, and they indicate in their generality and absoluteness the obligation of taqiyyah in ablution to the extent of necessity. Permissibility of Performing Ablution Thrice For Taqiyyah, Rather i...

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: اتبع وضوءك بعضه بعضا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Follow your ablution parts one after another.

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا توضأت بعض وضوئك وعرضت لك حاجة حتى يبس وضوءك أفعد وضوءك إفن الوضوء ال يبعض.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you perform part of your ablution and a need arises until your ablution dries, then repeat your ablution, for ablution cannot be done in parts (divided).

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم ربما توضأت فنفد الماء فدعوت الجارية أفبطأت عيل ابلماء، فيجف وضوئي فقال أعد.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Sometimes I perform ablution and the water runs out, so I call the maid and she delays bringing me water, and my ablution dries. He said: Repeat it.

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: عن حريز، في الوضوء يجف، اقل: قلت: إفن جف األول قبل أن أغسل الذي يليه؟ اقل: جف أو لم يجف اغسل ما بقي، قلت: وكذلك غسل الجنابة؟ اقل: هو بتلك المنزلة، وابدأ ابلرأس ثم أفض عىل سائر جسدك، قلت: وإن كان بعص يوم؟، اقل: نعم. اقل الشيخ: الوجه في هذا الخبر أنه إذا لم يقطع وضوئه وإنما تجففه الريح الشديدة أو الحر العظيم، وإنما تجب عليه اإلعادة في تفريق الوضوء مع اعتدال الوقت والهواء، اقل: ويحتمل أن يكون ورد مورد التقية ألن ذلك مذهب كثير من العامة.
englishText: From Hareez, regarding ablution drying, he said: I asked: What if the first part dries before I wash the next part? He said: Whether it dries or not, wash what remains. I asked: And is it the same for ritual bath after sexual impurity? He said: It is of the same status, and begin with the head then pour over the rest of your body. I asked: Even if it's part of a day? He said: Yes. The Shaykh said: The interpretation of this report is that if one doesn't interrupt their ablution but it dries due to strong wind or intense heat; the repetition is only required when separating ablution parts in moderate weather and time. He said: It's possible this was said out of taqiyyah as this is the belief of many of the Aammah (Sunni) people.

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: اقل الصادق عليه السالم: إن نسيت مسح رأسك افمسح عليه وعىل رجليك من بلة وضوئك - إلى أن اقل - إفن لم يبق من بلة وضوئك شئ أعدت الوضوء.
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: If you forget to wipe your head, then wipe it and your feet with the remaining moisture from your ablution - until he said - if no moisture remains from your ablution, repeat the ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Drying Of Previously Washed Limbs Due To Delay
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن رجل نسي من الوضوء الذراع والرأس؟، اقل: يعيد الوضوء إن الوضوء يتبع بعضه بعضا.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot the forearm and head in ablution? He said: He should repeat the ablution for ablution parts follow one another. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It appears that it is specified for the situation of drying, as mentioned before, and it is possible that by continuity, sequence is meant, as will come, God willing. Obligation Of Continuity In Ablution And Its Invalidity With The Dr...

chapter: Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibility Of Wiping The Feet Together
arabicText: اقل أبو جعفر عليه السالم: اتبع بين الوضوء كما اقل هللا عز وجل، ابدأ الوجه ثم ابليدين ثم امسح الرأس والرجلين، وال تقدمن شيئا بين يدي شئ تخالف ما أمرت به، افن غسلت الذراع قبل الوجه افبدأ ابلوجه، وأعد عىل الذراع، وإن مسحت الرجل قبل الرأس افمسح عىل الرأس قبل الرجل، ثم أعد عىل الرجل، إبدأ بما بدأ هللا عز وجل به.
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Perform ablution in sequence as Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has said. Begin with the face, then the hands, then wipe the head and feet, and do not put anything ahead of another thing in opposition to what you have been commanded. If you wash the forearm before the face, then start with the face and repeat the forearm. If you wipe the foot before the head, then wipe the head before the foot, then repeat the foot. Begin with what Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, began with.

chapter: Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibility Of Wiping The Feet Together
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث - اقل: إمسح عىل القدمين وابدأ ابلشق األيمن.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith - he said: Wipe over the feet and begin with the right side.

chapter: Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibility Of Wiping The Feet Together
arabicText: أن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله كان إذا توضأ بدأ بميامنه.
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would begin with his right side when performing ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibility Of Wiping The Feet Together
arabicText: وكان كاتب أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم - أنه كان يقول إذا توضأ أحدكم للصالة فليبدء ابليمين قبل الشمال من جسده، وذكر الكتاب.
englishText: The scribe of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) - that he would say when one of you performs ablution for prayer, he should begin with the right before the left of his body, and the book mentioned.

chapter: Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibility Of Wiping The Feet Together
arabicText: الطبرسي في (اإلحتجاج)، عن محمد بن عبد هللا، عن صاحب الزمان عليه السالم، أنه كتب إليه يسأله عن المسح عىل الرجلين أبيهما يبدأ ابليمين، أو يمسح عليهما جميعا معا؟ أفجاب عليه السالم يمسح عليهما (جميعا) معا إفن بدأ بإحداهما قبل األخرى فال يبدأ إال ابليمين.
englishText: Al-Tabarsi in (Al-Ihtijaj), from Muhammad bin Abdullah, from the Master of Time (Sahib al-Zaman) peace be upon him, that he wrote to him asking about wiping the feet, which one to start with, the right, or to wipe both together? He peace be upon him responded: Wipe them both together, but if starting with one before the other, then only start with the right. Obligation Of Following The Sequence In Ablution And The Permissibi...

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: سئل أحدهما عليهما السالم عن رجل بدأ بيده قبل وجهه وبرجليه قبل يديه؟، اقل: يبدأ بما بدأ هللا به وليعد ما (كان).
englishText: One of them (peace be upon them) was asked about a man who started with his hands before his face and his feet before his hands? He said: He should start with what Allah started with and repeat what was (done).

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يتوضأ فيبدأ ابلشمال قبل اليمين، اقل: يغسل اليمين ويعيد اليسار.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who performs ablution and starts with the left before the right, he said: He should wash the right and repeat the left.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عمن نسي أن يمسح رأسه حتى اقم في الصالة؟، اقل: ينصرف ويمسح رأسه ورجليه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about someone who forgot to wipe his head until he stood for prayer? He said: He should turn away and wipe his head and feet.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل ينسى مسح رأسه حتى يدخل في الصالة، اقل: إن كان في لحيته بلل بقدر ما يمسح رأسه ورجليه فليفعل ذلك وليصل، اقل: وإن نسي شيئا من الوضوء المفروض فعليه أن يبدء بما نسي ويعيد ما بقي. تمام الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who forgets to wipe his head until he enters prayer, he said: If there is enough moisture in his beard to wipe his head and feet, he should do that and pray. He said: And if he forgets anything from the obligatory ablution, he must start with what he forgot and repeat what remains to complete the ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: من نسي مسح رأسه أو قدميه، أو شيئا من الوضوء الذي ذكره هللا تعالى في القرآن كان عليه إعادة الوضوء والصالة. أقول: هذا مخصوص بصورة الجفاف لما مر.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever forgets to wipe his head or feet, or anything from the ablution that Allah the Exalted mentioned in the Quran, must repeat the ablution and prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is specific to the case of drying as previously mentioned.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم - في حديث تقديم السعي عىل الطواف - اقل: أال ترى أنك إذا غسلت شمالك قبل يمينك كان عليك أن تعيد عىل شمالك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) - in a hadith about performing Sa'i before tawaf - he said: Don't you see that if you wash your left before your right, you must repeat over your left.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن عيل بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل توضأ ونسي غسل يساره، فقال: يغسل يساره وحدها، وال يعيد وضوء شئ غيرها. اقل الشيخ: معناه ال يعيد شيئا مما تقدم قبل غسل يساره، وإنما يجب عليه إتمام ما ييل هذا العضو. أقول: ويمكن حمله عىل التقية لموافقته للعامة ويؤيد قول الشيخ: أن الوضوء يطلق عىل غسل العضو كثيرا وال يطلق عىل مجرد المسح.
englishText: From Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who performed ablution and forgot to wash his left side, he said: He should wash his left side alone, and not repeat ablution of anything else. The Shaykh said: It means he doesn't repeat anything that preceded washing his left side, and he must only complete what follows this limb. I (Hurr Amili) say: It can be interpreted as taqiyyah due to its agreement with the general public, and the Shaykh's statement is supported by the fact that wudu is often used to refer to washing the limb and is not used for mere wiping. chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن نسيت غسل وجهك فغسلت ذراعيك قبل وجهك أفعد غسل وجهك، ثم اغسل ذراعيك بعد الوجه، إفن بدأت بذراعك األيسر قبل األيمن أفعد عىل غسل األيمن ثم اغسل اليسار، وإن نسيت مسح رأسك حتى تغسل رجليك أفمسح رأسك ثم اغسل رجليك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you forget to wash your face and wash your forearms before your face, then repeat washing your face, then wash your forearms after the face. If you start with your left forearm before the right, then repeat washing the right then wash the left. And if you forget to wipe your head until you wash your feet, then wipe your head then wash your feet. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Washing the feet is interpreted as taqiyyah as previously mentioned.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا نسي الرجل أن يغسل يمينه فغسل شماله ومسح رأسه ورجليه فذكر بعد ذلك غسل يمينه وشماله ومسح رأسه ورجليه وإن كان إنما نسي شماله فليغسل الشمال وال يعيد عىل ما كان توضأ واقل: اتبع وضوءك بعضه بعضا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man forgets to wash his right hand and washes his left and wipes his head and feet, then remembers afterward, he should wash his right and left and wipe his head and feet. And if he only forgot his left, then he should wash the left and not repeat what he had performed of the ablution. And he said: Follow your ablution parts one after another.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: روي في حديث آخر فيمن بدأ بغسل يساره قبل يمينه أنه يعيد عىل يمينه، ثم يعيد عىل يساره.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: It is narrated in another hadith regarding one who starts washing his left before his right that he should repeat on his right, then repeat on his left.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: اقل: وقد روي أنه يعيد عىل يساره.
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that he repeats on his left. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The first (1195) is applied to one who has not washed the right, and the second (1196) to one who has washed it.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: اقل: واقل الصادق عليه السالم، إن نسيت مسح رأسك افمسح عليه وعىل رجليك من بلة وضوئك.
englishText: He said: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: If you forget to wipe your head, then wipe it and your feet with the remaining wetness of your ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم، عن رجل بدأ ابلمروة قبل الصفا، اقل: يعيد أال ترى أنه لو بدأ بشماله قبل يمينه في الوضوء أراد أن يعيد الوضوء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who started with Marwa before Safa, he said: He should repeat. Don't you see that if he started with his left before his right in ablution, he would need to repeat the ablution.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا بدأت بيسارك قبل يمينك ومسحت رأسك ورجليك، ثم استيقنت بعد أنك بدأت بها غسلت يسارك ثم مسحت رأسك ورجليك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you start with your left before your right and wipe your head and feet, then become certain afterward that you started with it, wash your left then wipe your head and feet.

chapter: Obligation Of Repeating (Wudu) To Achieve Proper Sequence For One Who Violates It Intentionally Or Forgetfully And Remembers Before The Ablution Dries
arabicText: عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم، اقل: سألته عن رجل توضأ فغسل يساره قبل يمينه كيف يصنع؟ اقل: يعيد الوضوء من حيث أخطأ، يغسل يمينه ثم يساره ثم يمسح رأسه ورجليه.
englishText: From his brother Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a man who performed ablution and washed his left hand before his right hand, what should he do? He said: He should repeat the ablution from where he made the mistake - he should wash his right hand, then his left hand, then wipe his head and feet. chapter: If Rain Falls On The Parts Of Wudu, It Suffices When He Washes His Face And Hands And Wipes His Head And Feet
arabicText: عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الرجل ال يكون عىل وضوء فيصيبه المطر حتى يبتل رأسه ولحيته وجسده ويداه ورجاله هل يجزيه ذلك من الوضوء؟ اقل: إن غسله إفن ذلك يجزيه.
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a man who is not in a state of ablution, then rain falls on him until his head, beard, body, hands, and feet become wet - would this suffice for ablution? He said: If it washes him then that suffices. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And Al-Humayri narrated in "Qurb Al-Isnad" with the previous chain similarly, except that he said: until he washes his beard.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping Directly On The Scalp Or Hair And The Impermissibility Of Wiping Over Barriers Such As Henna, Medicine, Turban, And Head Cover Except In Cases Of Necessity
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الذي يخضب رأسه ابلحناء ثم يبد وله في الوضوء، اقل: ال يجوز حتى يصيب بشرة رأسه ابلماء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding one who dyes his head with henna and then wants to perform ablution, he said: It is not permissible until the water touches the skin of his head.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping Directly On The Scalp Or Hair And The Impermissibility Of Wiping Over Barriers Such As Henna, Medicine, Turban, And Head Cover Except In Cases Of Necessity
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن الدواء إذا كان عىل يدي الرجل أيجزيه أن يمسح عىل طال الدواء؟ فقال: نعم، يجزيه أن يمسح عليه.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about medicine when it is on a man's hands, is it sufficient for him to wipe over the coating of medicine? He said: Yes, it is sufficient for him to wipe over it.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping Directly On The Scalp Or Hair And The Impermissibility Of Wiping Over Barriers Such As Henna, Medicine, Turban, And Head Cover Except In Cases Of Necessity
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل يخضب رأسه ابلحناء ثم يبدو له في الوضوء اقل: يمسح فوق الحناء.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who dyes his head with henna and then wants to perform ablution. He said: He should wipe over the henna.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping Directly On The Scalp Or Hair And The Impermissibility Of Wiping Over Barriers Such As Henna, Medicine, Turban, And Head Cover Except In Cases Of Necessity
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل يحلق رأسه ثم يطليه ابلحناء ثم يتوضأ للصالة، فقال: ال أبس أبن يمسح رأسه والحناء عليه. أقول: هذا محمول عىل حصول الضرر بكشفه كما ذكره صاحب المنتقى وغيره وكذا الدواء ويمكن الحمل عىل إرادة لون الحناء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who shaves his head then applies henna to it, then performs ablution for prayer. He said: There is no problem in wiping his head while the henna is on it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as applying to cases where removing it would cause harm, as mentioned by the author of Al-Muntaqa and others, and the same applies to medicine. It can also be interpreted as referring to when only the color of henna remains.

chapter: Obligation Of Wiping Directly On The Scalp Or Hair And The Impermissibility Of Wiping Over Barriers Such As Henna, Medicine, Turban, And Head Cover Except In Cases Of Necessity
arabicText: سألته، عن المرأة هل يصلح لها أن تمسح عىل الخمار؟ اقل: ال يصلح حتى تمسح عىل رأسها.
englishText: I asked him about a woman, is it permissible for her to wipe over the head cover (khimar)? He said: It is not permissible until she wipes directly on her head.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن زرارة، اقل: قلت له: في مسح الخفين تقية، فقال: ثالثة ال أتقي فيهن أحدا: شرب المسكر، ومسح الخفين، ومتعة الحج. ، اقل زرارة: ولم بقل الواجب عليكم أن ال تتقوا فيهن أحدا.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked him about wiping over leather socks (khuffayn) as taqiyyah. He said: There are three things in which I do not practice taqiyyah with anyone: drinking intoxicants, wiping over leather socks, and Mut'ah of Hajj. Zurarah said: He did not say it is obligatory upon you not to practice taqiyyah in these.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن المريض هل له رخصة في المسح؟ فقال: ال. أقول: هذا محمول عىل إمكان مسح القدمين ولو بمشقة فال يجوز العدول إلى مسح الخفين لما أيتي.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about whether the sick person has a concession regarding wiping? He said: No. I (Hurr Amili) say: This applies when wiping the feet is possible even with difficulty, so it is not permissible to switch to wiping over leather socks as will be explained.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: خطب أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم فقال: قد عملت الوالة قبيل أعمال خالفوا فيها رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله متعمدين لخالفه، ولو حملت الناس عىل تركها لتفرق عني جندي، أرأيتم لو أمرت بمقام إبراهيم فرددته إلى الموضع الذي كان فيه إلى أن اقل: وحرمت المسح عىل الخفين، وحددت عىل النبيذ، وأمرت بإحالل المتعتين، وأمرت ابلتكبير عىل الجنائز خمس تكبيرات، وألزمت الناس الجهر بسم هللا الرحمان الرحيم (إلى أن اقل:) إذا لتفرقوا عني.
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) gave a sermon saying: The rulers before me have done acts in which they deliberately opposed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). If I were to compel people to abandon these acts, my army would disperse from me. Consider if I were to order that Ibrahim's Station (Maqam-e-Ibrahim) be returned to the position where it was... and if I were to prohibit wiping over leather socks (khuffayn), and establish prescribed punishment for drinking nabidh (fermented drink), and order the permissibility of the two mut'ahs (temporary marriage and hajj tamattu'), and command five takbirs in funeral prayers, and require people to recite "Bismillah al-Rahman al-Raheem" aloud (in salat)... (then he said:) they would disperse from me.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن الصادق عليه السالم في حديث - اقل: قلت له ما تقول: في المسح عىل الخفين فتبسم، ثم اقل: إذا كان يوم القيامة ورد هللا كل شئ إلى شيئه ورد الجلد إلى الغنم فترى أصحاب المسح أين يذهب وضوؤهم؟!.
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in a hadith - I said to him: What do you say about wiping over leather socks (khuffayn)? He smiled then said: When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah will return everything to its origin and return the leather to the sheep (*), so where do you think the ablution of those who wipe over leather socks will go?! Translator: * In those days, the socks were made from sheep leather.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن أبي الورد، اقل: قلت ألبي جعفر عليه السالم، إن أاب ظبيان حدثني أنه رأى عليا عليه السالم أراق الماء ثم مسح عىل الخفين فقال: كذب أبو ظبيان أما بلغك قول عيل عليه السالم: فيكم سبق الكتاب الخفين، فقلت: فهل فيهما رخصة؟ فقال: ال، إال من عدو تتقيه، أو ثلج تخاف عىل رجليك.
englishText: From Abu al-Ward who said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that Abu Zibyan told me he saw Ali (peace be upon him) pour water then wipe over leather socks. He said: Abu Zibyan lied. Haven't you heard Ali's (peace be upon him) saying: The Book (Quran) preceded (*) the leather socks? I asked: Is there any concession regarding them? He said: No, except from an enemy you fear or snow you fear will harm your feet. Translator: * The revelation of the verse in Al-Ma'idah has overridden/superseded the ruling and wiping over the khuffayn is no longer allowed.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سمعته يقول: جمع عمر بن الخطاب أصحاب النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله وفيهم عيل عليه السالم فقال: ما تقولون في المسح عىل الخفين؟ فقام المغيرة بن شعبة: فقال: رأيت رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يمسح عىل الخفين فقال عيل عليه السالم: قبل المائدة أو بعدها، فقال: ال أدري، فقال عيل عليه السالم: سبق الكتاب الخفين، إنما أنزلت المائدة قبل أن يقبض بشهرين أو ثالثة.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him say: Umar ibn al-Khattab gathered the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) including Ali (peace be upon him) and said: What do you say about wiping over leather socks (khuffayn)? Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah stood and said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) wipe over leather socks. Ali (peace be upon him) said: Was this before or after (the revelation of surah) al-Ma'idah? He said: I don't know. Ali (peace be upon him) said: The Book preceded the leather socks. Indeed, alMa'idah was revealed two or three months before his death.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن المسح عىل الخفين، فقال: ال تمسح، واقل: إن جدي اقل: سبق الكتاب الخفين.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about wiping over leather socks. He said: Do not wipe, and said: My grandfather said: The Book (Quran) preceded the leather socks.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم أنه سئل عن المسح عىل الخفين وعىل العمامة اقل: ال تمسح عليهما.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he was asked about wiping over leather socks (khuffayn) and turban, he said: Do not wipe over them.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: سألت عن المسح عىل الخفين والعمامة فقال: سبق الكتاب الخفين، واقل: ال تمسح عىل خف.
englishText: I asked about wiping over leather socks and turban, so he said: The Book (Quran) preceded the leather socks (khuffayn), and he said: Do not wipe over leather socks.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: دخلت عىل أبي جعفر عليه السالم فسألته عن أشياء (إلى أن اقل) فقلت له: ما تقول في المسح عىل الخفين؟ فقال: كان عمر يراه ثالاث للمسافر، ويوما وليلة للمقيم، وكان أبي ال يراه في سفر وال حضر، فلما خرجت من عنده فقمت عىل عتبة الباب فقال لي: أقبل، أفقبلت عليه، فقال: إن القوم كانوا يقولون برأيهم فيخطئون ويصيبون وكان أبي ال يقول برأيه.
englishText: I entered upon Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and asked him about things (until he said) so I said to him: What do you say about wiping over leather socks (khuffayn)? He said: Umar considered it valid for three days for the traveler, and one day and night for the resident, but my father did not consider it valid in travel or residence. When I left him and stood at the doorstep, he called me back, so I returned to him. He said: The people used to speak with their opinion, sometimes they were wrong and sometimes right, but my father never spoke from his opinion.
