chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم، أن عليا عليه السالم مسح عىل النعلين ولم يستبطن الشراكين. اقل الشيخ: يعني إذا كاان عربيين إفنهما ال يمنعان من وصول الماء إلى الرجل بقدر ما يجب عليه المسح. أقول: ذكر الشراكين يدل عىل ذلك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), that Ali (peace be upon him) wiped over sandals and did not wipe under the straps. The Shaykh said: This means if they were Arabian sandals as they do not prevent water from reaching the foot in the amount required for wiping. I (Hurr Amili) say: The mention of the straps indicates this.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم اقلت: سمعته يقول: إان أهل بيت ال نمسح عىل الخفين، فمن كان من شيعتنا فليقتد بنا وليستن بسنتنا.
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), she said: I heard him saying: We, the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House), do not wipe over leather socks (khuffayn), so whoever is from our Shia (followers) should follow us and adopt our practice.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: اقل وروي أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله توضأ ثم مسح عىل نعليه فقال له المغيرة أنسيت اي رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله؟ فقال له: بل أنت نسيت هكذا أمرني ربي.
englishText: It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed ablution then wiped over his sandals, so Al-Mughirah said to him: Have you forgotten, O Messenger of Allah? He replied: Rather, you have forgotten, this is how my Lord commanded me. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The explanation for similar cases has preceded, and it is understood from what passed that this is abrogated by the ablution verse in Surah Al-Ma'idah, assuming the sandals were not Arabian.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله أنه اقل: أشد الناس حسرة يوم القيامة من رأى وضوءه عىل جلد غيره.
englishText: From the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: The people with the most regret on the Day of Resurrection are those who saw their ablution on someone else's skin.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: اقل: ولم يعرف للنبي صىل هللا عليه وآله خف إال خفا أهداه له النجاشي، وكان موضع ظهر القدمين منه مشقواق فمسح النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله عىل رجليه وعليه خفاه، فقال الناس: إنه مسح عىل خفيه عىل أن الحديث في ذلك غير صحيح اإلسناد.
englishText: He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was not known to have leather socks (khuffayn) except ones gifted to him by Al-Najashi, and the top part of the feet area was split, so the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) wiped over his feet while wearing his leather socks. People said he wiped over his leather socks, though the hadith about this has an incorrect chain of narration.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: اقل: وسئل موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم عن الرجل يكون خفه مخراق فيدخل يده ويمسح ظهر قدميه أيجزيه؟ فقال: نعم.
englishText: Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about a man whose leather sock has a hole, and he inserts his hand and wipes the top of his feet, is it sufficient? He said: Yes.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: عن الرضا عليه السالم أنه كتب إلى المأمون: ثم الوضوء كما أمر هللا إلى أن اقل: ومن مسح عىل - الخفين فقد خالف هللا ورسوله وترك فريضته وكتابه.
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) that he wrote to Al-Ma'mun: Then the ablution is as Allah commanded... until he said: And whoever wipes over the leather socks (khuffayn) has opposed Allah and His Messenger and abandoned His obligation and His Book.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: وفي (الخصال) بإسناده عن عيل عليه السالم في حديث األربعمائة اقل: ليس في شرب المسكر، والمسح عىل الخفين تقية.
englishText: In (Al-Khisal), with its chain of narrators from Ali (peace be upon him) in the hadith of the four hundred, he said: There is no taqiyyah in drinking intoxicants and wiping over leather socks (khuffayn). Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is considered on the basis that washing the feet prevents harm.

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: سألت جعفر بن محمد عليه السالم عن المسح عىل الخفين، فقال: ال تمسح وال تصل خلف من يمسح.
englishText: I asked Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) about wiping over leather socks, and he said: Do not wipe and do not pray behind one who wipes. Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Sever...

chapter: Prohibition Of Wiping Over Leather Socks (Khuffayn) Except In Severe Necessity Or Great Taqiyyah
arabicText: سألت أاب إسحق، عن المسح يعني المسح عىل الخفين فقال: أدركت الناس يمسحون حتى لقيت رجال من بني هاشم لم أر مثله قط يقال له: محمد ابن عيل بن الحسين عليه السالم فسألته عن المسح فنهاني عنه، واقل: لم يكن عيل أمير المؤمنين عليه السالم يمسح عىل الخفين. وكان يقول: سبق الكتاب المسح عىل الخفين، اقل: فما مسحت منذ نهاني عنه.
englishText: I asked Abu Ishaq about wiping, meaning wiping over leather socks, so he said: I found people wiping until I met a man from Bani Hashim the likes of whom I had never seen, called Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). I asked him about wiping and he forbade me from it, and said: Ali, Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), would not wipe over leather socks (khuffayn). And he used to say: The Book (Quran) preceded wiping over leather socks. He said: So I have not wiped since he forbade me from it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And there are many narrations about this, and in narrations about the manner of ablution and others that have passed and will come, there is evidence for this, and in the narrations about taqiyyah and necessity that are coming. A general inclusiveness for wiping over the leather socks with the specific text that preceded.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن الرضا عليه السالم عن الكسير تكون عليه الجبائر، أو تكون به الجراحة كيف يصنع ابلوضوء، وعند غسل الجنابة، وغسل الجمعة؟ فقال: يغسل ما وصل إليه الغسل مما ظهر مما ليس عليه الجبائر، ويدع ما سوى ذلك مما ال يستطيع غسله، وال ينزع الجبائر ويعبث بجراحته.
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about one who has splints or has a wound, how should he perform wudu, ritual bath from impurity (janabah), and Friday ghusl? He said: He should wash what can be washed from what is visible and not covered by splints, and leave what he cannot wash, and he should not remove the splints or tamper with his wound.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم أنه سئل عن الرجل تكون به القرحة في ذراعه أو نحو ذلك من موضع الوضوء، فيعصبها ابلخرقة ويتوضأ ويمسح عليها إذا توضأ، فقال: إذا كان يؤذيه الماء فليمسح عىل الخرقة، وإن كان ال يؤذيه الماء فلينزع الخرقة ثم ليغسلها، اقل: وسألته عن الجرح كيف أصنع به في غسله؟ اقل: اغسل ما حوله.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a man who has a wound in his forearm or similar places where ablution is required, and he wraps it with a cloth and performs ablution and wipes over it when performing ablution. He said: If water would harm him, then he should wipe over the cloth, and if water would not harm him, then he should remove the cloth and wash it. He said: And I asked him about how to wash a wound? He said: Wash what is around it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: عن عبد هللا بن سنان، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الجرح كيف يصنع صاحبه؟ اقل: يغسل ما حوله.
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about how someone with a wound should deal with it? He said: Wash around it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: وقد روي في الجبائر عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم أنه اقل: يغسل ما حولها.
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn said: It has been narrated regarding splints from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: Wash around them.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم عثرت افنقطع ظفري فجعلت عىل أصبعي مرارة، فكيف أصنع ابلوضوء؟ اقل: يعرف هذا وأشباهه من كتاب هللا عز وجل. اقل هللا تعالى: ما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج، امسح عليه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, I said: I stumbled and my nail broke off, so I put medicine on my finger. How should I perform ablution? He said: This and similar matters are known from the Book of Allah the Mighty and Majestic. Allah the Most High said: "He has not placed upon you any hardship in religion" [Quran, 22:78]. Wipe over it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: اقل: سئل أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل ينقطع ظفره هل يجوز له أن يجعل عليه علكا؟ اقل: ال وال يجعل إال ما يقدر عىل أخذه عنه عند الوضوء وال يجعل عليه إال ما (ال) يصل إليه الماء.
englishText: It was asked of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man whose nail breaks off - is it permissible for him to put gum on it? He said: No, and he should only put what he can remove during ablution, and only put on it what prevents water from reaching it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: The point here is that it is not permissible when there is a choice, but in case of necessity, there is no harm in it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: وابالسناد عن عمار، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في الرجل ينكسر ساعده أو موضع من مواضع الوضوء فال يقدر أن يحله لحال الجبر إذا جبر كيف يصنع؟ اقل: إذا أراد أن يتوضأ فليضع إانءا فيه ماء، ويضع موضع الجبر في الماء حتى يصل الماء إلى جلده وقد أجزأه ذلك من غير أن يحله.
englishText: With the chain of transmission from Ammar, from Abu Abdullah peace be upon him, regarding a man whose forearm breaks or any place requiring ablution, and he is unable to unwrap it due to the cast when it is set - what should he do? He said: When he wants to perform ablution, he should place a container with water in it, and place the area with the cast in the water until the water reaches his skin, and that will suffice him without having to unwrap it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is based on possibility and what was mentioned before on impossibility, and the Sheikh considered it recommendable when possible.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل إذا كان كسيرا، كيف يصنع ابلصالة؟ اقل: إن كان يتخوف عىل نفسه فليمسح عىل جبائره وليصل.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has a broken bone, how should he perform the prayer? He said: If he fears for himself, he should wipe over his splints and pray.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: سألت أاب الحسن عليه السالم عن الدواء إذا كان عىل يدي الرجل أيجزيه أن يمسح عىل طيل الدواء؟ فقال: نعم يجزيه أن يمسح عليه.
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about medicine when it is on a man's hands, is it sufficient for him to wipe over the medicinal coating? He said: Yes, it is sufficient for him to wipe over it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الرضا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن الدواء يكون عىل يد الرجل أيجزيه أن يمسح في الوضوء عىل الدواء المطيل عليه؟ فقال: نعم يمسح عليه ويجزيه.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about medicine that is on a man's hand, is it sufficient for him to wipe over the applied medicine during ablution? He said: Yes, he should wipe over it and it is sufficient.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are In Places Requiring Washing, When Removal Is Difficult And Water Cannot Reach Underneath
arabicText: عن عيل بن أبي طالب اقل: سألت رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله عن الجبائر تكون عىل الكسير كيف يتوضأ صاحبها؟ وكيف يغتسل إذا أجنب؟ اقل: يجزيه المسح عليها في الجنابة والوضوء، قلت: إفن كان في برد يخاف عىل نفسه إذا أفرغ الماء عىل جسده، فقرأ رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله "وال تقتلوا أنفسكم إن هللا كان بكم رحيم".
englishText: From Ali bin Abi Talib who said: I asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, about splints that are placed on broken bones - how should their wearer perform ablution? And how should he perform the ritual bath when in a state of major ritual impurity? He said: Wiping over them is sufficient for both major ritual impurity and ablution. I said: What if it is cold and he fears for himself if he pours water over his body? So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, recited "And do not kill yourselves, indeed Allah is Most Merciful to you" [Quran, Sufficiency Of Wiping Over Splints During Ablution Even If They Are...

chapter: Women Starting With The Inner Part Of The Forearm And Men With The Outer Part, In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن الرضا (عليه السالم اقل: فرض هللا عىل النساء في الوضوء للصالة أن يبدأن بباطن أذرعتهن وفي الرجال بظاهر الذراع.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: Allah prescribed for women in ablution for prayer to start with the inner part of their forearms, and for men with the outer part of the forearm.

chapter: Women Starting With The Inner Part Of The Forearm And Men With The Outer Part, In Ablution
arabicText: اقل الرضا (عليه السالم): فرض هللا عز وجل عىل الناس في الوضوء أن تبدأ المرأة بباطن ذراعيها والرجل بظاهر الذراع. أقول: حمله األصحاب عىل االستحباب ومعنى فرض: قدر، وبين، ال بمعنى أوجب، اقله المحقق في المعتبر وغيره.
englishText: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic prescribed in ablution that women should start with the inner part of their forearms and men with the outer part of the forearm. I (Hurr Amili) say: The companions interpreted this as recommended, and the meaning of 'prescribed' is 'determined' and 'clarified', not in the sense of 'obligated', as stated by Al-Muhaqqiq in Al-Mu'tabar and others.

chapter: Obligation Of Ensuring Water Reaches Under Rings, Bracelets, And Similar Items During Ablution
arabicText: عن عيل بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن المرأة عليها السوار والدملج في بعض ذراعها ال تدري يجرى الماء تحته أم ال كيف تصنع إذا توضأت أو اغتسلت؟ اقل: تحركه حتى يدخل الماء تحته أو تنزعه ، وعن الخاتم الضيق ال يدري هل يجرى الماء تحته إذا توضأ أم ال، كيف يصنع؟ اقل: إن علم أن الماء ال يدخله فليخرجه إذا توضأ.
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a woman who wears a bracelet and an armlet on part of her forearm and does not know if water flows beneath it or not - what should she do when performing wudu or ghusl? He said: She should move it until water enters beneath it or remove it. And about a tight ring when one does not know if water flows beneath it during wudu or not - what should one do? He said: If one knows that water does not reach beneath it, then remove it when performing wudu.

chapter: Obligation Of Ensuring Water Reaches Under Rings, Bracelets, And Similar Items During Ablution
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الخاتم إذا اغتسلت؟ اقل: حوله من مكانه واقل في الوضوء: تديره إفن نسيت حتى تقوم في الصالة فال آمرك أن تعيد الصالة.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about the ring when performing ghusl? He said: Move it from its place. And regarding wudu he said: Rotate it, but if you forget until you stand for prayer, I do not command you to repeat the prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Ensuring Water Reaches Under Rings, Bracelets, And Similar Items During Ablution
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: إذا كان مع الرجل خاتم فليدوره في الوضوء ويحوله عند الغسل، اقل: واقل الصادق عليه السالم: وإن نسيت حتى تقوم في (من) الصالة فال آمرك أن تعيد.
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: When a man has a ring, he should rotate it during wudu and move it during ghusl. He said: And Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: If you forget until you stand in prayer, I do not command you to repeat it.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: إذا كنت اقعدا عىل وضوئك فلم تدر أغسلت ذراعيك أم ال أفعد عليهما وعىل جميع ما شككت فيه أنك لم تغسله، أو تمسحه مما سمى هللا ما دمت في حال الوضوء، إفذا قمت من الوضوء وفرغت منه وقد صرت في حال أخرى في الصالة أو في غيرها فشككت في بعض ما سمى هللا مما أوجب هللا عليك فيه وضوئه ال شئ عليك فيه، إفن شككت في مسح رأسك أفصبت في لحيتك بلال افمسح بها عليه، وعىل ظهر قدميك، إفن لم تصب بلال فال تنقض الوضوء ابلشك وامض في صالتك، وإن تيقنت أنك لم تتم وضوءك أفعد عىل ما تركت يقينا حتى أتتي عىل الوضوء الحديث.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When you are sitting performing your ablution and you don't know whether you washed your forearms or not, repeat washing them and everything else you doubt that you didn't wash or wipe from what Allah has named, as long as you are still in the state of ablution. If you have stood up from ablution and finished it, and you have moved to another state like prayer or something else, and you doubt about some of what Allah has named from what He has made obligatory upon you in ablution, then nothing is upon you. If you doubt about wiping your head and you find moisture in your beard, then wipe your head and the top of your feet with it. If you don't find moisture, don't invalidate the ablution due to doubt and continue your prayer. If you are certain that you didn't complete your ablution, then repeat what you definitely left out until you complete the ablution.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إذا شككت في شئ من الوضوء وقد دخلت في غيره فليس شكك بشئ، إنما الشك إذا كنت في شئ لم تجزه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you doubt something in the ablution while you have moved on to something else, then your doubt is of no consequence. Doubt only matters when you are still in something you have not completed.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن ذكرت وأنت في صالتك انك قد تركت شيئا من وضوئك المفروض عليك افنصرف أفتم الذي نسيته من وضوئك واعد صالتك.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you remember while you are in prayer that you left out something from your obligatory ablution, then leave and complete what you forgot from your ablution and repeat your prayer.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: قلت: جعلت فداك أغسل وجهي ثم أغسل يدي ويشككني الشيطان أني لم اغسل ذراعي ويدي، اقل: إذا وجدت برد الماء عىل ذراعك فال تعد.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I said: May I be sacrificed for you, I wash my face then my hands, and Satan makes me doubt that I didn't wash my forearms and hands. He said: When you feel the coolness of water on your forearm, do not repeat.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: قلت ألبي عبد هللا عليه السالم: رجل شك في الوضوء بعدما فرغ من الصالة اقل: يمضي عىل صالته وال يعيد.
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man who doubts about his ablution after finishing the prayer. He said: He should continue with his prayer and not repeat.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: سمعت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم يقول: كل ما مضى من صالتك وطهورك فذكرته تذكرا افمضه وال إعادة عليك فيه.
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, saying: Whatever has passed from your prayer and your purification, and you later remembered it, continue and there is no need to repeat it.

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن بكير بن أعين اقل: قلت: له الرجل يشك بعدما يتوضأ؟ اقل: هو حين يتوضأ أذكر منه حين يشك.
englishText: From Bukayr ibn A'yan who said: I asked him: What about a man who doubts after performing ablution? He said: He was more aware when he performed ablution than when he is in doubt. If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They M...

chapter: If One Doubts About Any Acts Of Ablution Before Moving Away, They Must Perform What They Doubted About And What Comes After It, And If One Doubts After Moving Away, Nothing Is Obligatory Unless There Is Certainty
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالفي رجل نسي أن يمسح عىل رأسه فذكر وهو في الصالة فقال: إن كان استيقن ذلك انصرف فمسح عىل رأسه وعىل رجليه واستقبل الصالة، وإن شك فلم يدر مسح أو لم يمسح فليتناول من لحيته إن كانت مبتلة وليمسح عىل رأسه، وإن كان أمامه ماء فليتناوله منه فليمسح به رأسه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who forgot to wipe his head and remembered while he was in prayer, he said: If he is certain of that, he should turn away, wipe his head and feet, and restart the prayer. And if he doubts and does not know whether he wiped or did not wipe, then he should take moisture from his beard if it is wet and wipe his head with it, and if there is water in front of him, he should take from it and wipe his head with it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Some of the aforementioned cases are based on recommendation, and some narrations are general, interpreted according to the detail mentioned in the title of what has passed and what will come.

chapter: Whoever Forgets Part Of The Face, It Suffices To Wet It From Another Part Of The Body
arabicText: سئل أبو الحسن موسى بن جعفر عليه السال الرجل يبقى من وجهه إذا توضأ موضع لم يصبه الماء؟ فقال: يجزيه أن يبله من بعض جسده.
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him, was asked about a man who has a spot on his face that water did not reach when performing ablution? He said: It suffices him to wet (moisten) it from another part of his body.

chapter: Whoever Is Certain Of Being In A State Of Purity And Doubts About Having Lost It Is Not Obligated To Perform Ablution, And Vice Versa, They Are Obligated To Perform It
arabicText: عن أبيه، اقل: اقل لي أبو عبد هللا عليه السالم: إذا استيقنت أنك قد أحدثت فتوضأ وإايك أن تحدث وضوءا أبدا حتى تستيقن أنك قد أحدثت.
englishText: From his father who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: When you become certain that you have lost (invalidated) your ritual purity, then perform ablution, and beware of performing ablution again unless you become certain that you have lost your ritual purity. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What indicates this has been mentioned here and in the narrations about the nullifiers indicating that certainty is never overridden by doubt, but only by another certainty.

chapter: Whoever Is Certain Of Being In A State Of Purity And Doubts About Having Lost It Is Not Obligated To Perform Ablution, And Vice Versa, They Are Obligated To Perform It
arabicText: عن عيل ابن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم، اقل: سألته عن رجل يكون عىل وضوء ويشك عىل وضوء هو أم ال؟ اقل: إذا ذكر وهو في صالته انصرف فتوضأ وأعادها، وإن ذكر وقد فرغ من صالته أجزأه ذلك. أقول: هذا محمول عىل االستحباب لما مر وآخره قرينة ظاهرة عىل ذلك ويمكن حمله عىل أن المراد ابلوضوء االستنجاء فيكون تيقن حصول النجاسة وشك في إزالتها فيجب عليه أن يزيلها ويعيد الصالة إال أن يخرج الوقت لما أيتي.
englishText: From Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about a man who had performed ablution but doubts whether he still has ablution or not? He said: If he remembers while he is in prayer, he should leave, perform ablution and repeat the prayer. And if he remembers after completing his prayer, what he has done suffices. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as recommended based on what has preceded, and its end is clear evidence of that. It can also be interpreted that what is meant by ablution is cleaning oneself after using the toilet, so if one is certain of impurity and doubts its removal, they must remove it and repeat the prayer unless the prayer time has passed, as will be explained later.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن التمسح ابلمنديل قبل أن يجف اقل: ال أبس به.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about wiping with a towel before drying, he said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: ال أبس بمسح الرجل وجهه ابلثوب إذا توضأ إذا كان الثوب نظيفا.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem with a man wiping his face with cloth after performing ablution if the cloth is clean.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: رأيت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم توضأ للصالة ثم مسح وجهه أبسفل قميصه. ثم اقل: اي إسماعيل افعل هكذا إفني هكذا أفعل.
englishText: I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) perform ablution for prayer then wiped his face with the lower part of his shirt. Then he said: O Isma'il, do like this for this is how I do it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: رأيت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم وقد توضأ وهو محرم ثم أخذ منديال فمسح به وجهه.
englishText: I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) perform ablution while in the state of ihram, then he took a towel and wiped his face with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: اقل: واقل الصادق عليه السالم: من توضأ وتمندل كتبت له حسنة، ومن توضأ ولم يتمندل حتى يجف وضوؤه كتب له ثالثون حسنة.
englishText: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever performs ablution and dries with a towel, one good deed is written for him, and whoever performs ablution and does not dry with a towel until his ablution dries naturally, thirty good deeds are written for him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الرجل يمسح وجهه ابلمنديل اقل: ال أبس به.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man wiping his face with a towel, he said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن التمندل بعد الوضوء فقال: كان لعيل عليه السالم خرقة في المسجد ليس إال للوجه يتمندل بها.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about drying with a towel after ablution, so he said: Ali (peace be upon him) had a cloth in the mosque specifically for wiping the face after ablution.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: وبإسناده، اقل: كانت لعيل عليه السالم خرقة يعلقها في مسجد بيته لوجهه إذا توضأ يتمندل بها.
englishText: Through his chain, he said: Ali (peace be upon him) had a cloth which he would hang in his house mosque to wipe his face when he performed ablution.

chapter: Permissibility Of Drying With A Towel After Ablution And The Recommendation To Avoid It
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: كانت ألمير المؤمنين عليه السالم خرقة يمسح بها وجهه إذا توضأ للصالة ثم يعلقها عىل وتد وال يمسه غيره. أقول: أحاديث التمندل تحتمل التقية وتحتمل إرادة نفي التحريم، وبعضها يحتمل إرادة الوضوء بمعنى غسل اليدين والوجه لغير الصالة.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) had a cloth with which he would wipe his face when he performed ablution for prayer, then he would hang it on a peg and no one else would touch it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The hadiths about wiping (after ablution) could be interpreted as taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation), or could be interpreted as negating prohibition, and some of them could be interpreted as referring to ablution in the sense of washing hands and face for purposes other than prayer.

chapter: Not Having To Run Fingers Through Hair During Ablution
arabicText: عن أحدهما عليهما السالم، اقل: سألته عن الرجل يتوضأ أيبطن لحيته؟ اقل: ال.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about a man performing ablution, should he run his fingers through his beard? He said: No.

chapter: Not Having To Run Fingers Through Hair During Ablution
arabicText: عن زرارة، اقل: قلت له: أرأيت ما كان تحت الشعر؟ اقل: كل ما أحاط به الشعر فليس للعباد أن يغسلوه وال يبحثوا عنه ولكن يجري عليه الماء.
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I said to him: What do you think about what is under the hair? He said: Everything that is surrounded by hair, the servants (of Allah) do not have to wash it or search through it, but rather let the water flow over it.

chapter: Not Having To Run Fingers Through Hair During Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: قلت له: أرأيت ما أحاط به الشعر؟ فقال: كل ما أحاط به من الشعر فليس للعباد أن يطلبوه وال يبحثوا عنه ولكن يجري عليه الماء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I said to him: What do you think about what is surrounded by hair? He said: Whatever is surrounded by hair, the servants should not seek it out or search for it, but water should flow over it.

chapter: Dislike Of Seeking Assistance In Ablution
arabicText: دخلت عىل الرضا عليه السالم وبين يديه إبريق يريد أن يتهيأ منه للصالة فدنوت منه ألصب عليه، أفبى ذلك فقال: مه اي حسن فقلت له: لم تنهاني أن أصب عىل يديك، تكره أن أوجر اقل: توجر أنت واوزر أان فقلت: وكيف ذلك؟ فقال: أما سمعت هللا عز وجل يقول: "فمن كان يرجو لقاء ربه فليعمل عمال صالحا وال يشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا" وها أان ذا أتوضأ للصالة وهي العبادة، أفكره أن يشركني فيها أحد.
englishText: I entered upon Al-Ridha peace be upon him while there was a pitcher before him as he wanted to prepare for prayer. I approached to pour water for him but he refused and said: Stop, O Hasan. I said to him: Why do you prevent me from pouring water on your hands, do you dislike that I earn reward? He said: You would earn reward while I would bear sin. I asked: How is that? He said: Have you not heard Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, saying: Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him do righteous work and associate none in the worship of his Lord [Quran, 18:110]. Here I am performing ablution for prayer which is worship, and I dislike that anyone should associate with me in it.

chapter: Dislike Of Seeking Assistance In Ablution
arabicText: محمد بن عيل بن الحسين اقل: كان أمير المؤمنين إذا توضأ لم يدع أحدا يصب عليه الماء، فقيل له: اي أمير المؤمنين لم ال تدعهم يصبون عليك الماء؟ فقال: ال أحب أن أشرك في صالتي أحدا، واقل هللا تبارك وتعالى: "فمن كان يرجو لقاء ربه فليعمل عمال صالحا وال يشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا".
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: When Amir al-Mu'minin performed ablution, he would not let anyone pour water for him. He was asked: O Amir alMu'minin, why don't you let them pour water for you? He said: I do not like to involve anyone in my prayer. And Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord [Quran, 18:110].

chapter: Dislike Of Seeking Assistance In Ablution
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا، عن آابئه عن عيل عليهم السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: خصلتان ال أحب أن يشاركني فيها أحد: وضوئي إفنه من صالتي، وصدقتي إفنها من يدي إلى يد السائل إفنها تقع في يد الرحمان. وقد تقدم حديث أبي عبيدة في أحاديث كيفية الوضوء يدل عىل جواز االستعانة وصب الماء عىل يد المتوضي ويجب أن يحمل عىل بيان الجواز، أو عىل التقية، أو عىل الضرورة مثل كون الماء في ظرف يحتاج أخذه منه إلى المعونة كالقربة التي لو لم تحفظ لذهب ماؤها ونحو ذلك. وتقدم ما يدل عىل جواز االمر بإحضار ماء الوضوء.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "There are two traits in which I do not like anyone to share with me: my ablution, for it is part of my prayer, and my sadaqah, for it is from my hand to the beggar's hand, and it falls into the Hand of the Most Merciful." The previous hadith of Abu Ubaida in the chapters on the method of ablution indicates the permissibility of seeking assistance and pouring water on the hand of the one performing ablution. This must be interpreted as showing permissibility, or as taqiyyah, or necessity such as when water is in a container that needs assistance to draw from it, like a water-skin that would spill its water if not held, and similar situations. Previously mentioned was evidence allowing one to request the bringing of ablution water.

chapter: Dislike Of Seeking Assistance In Ablution
arabicText: دخل الرضا عليه السالم يوما والمأمون يتوضأ للصالة والغالم يصب عىل يده الماء، فقال: ال تشرك اي أمير المؤمنين بعبادة ربك أحدا، فصرف المأمون الغالم وتولى تمام وضوئه بنفسه.
englishText: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) entered one day while Al-Ma'mun was performing ablution for prayer and a servant was pouring water on his hand. He said, "O Amir alMu'minin, do not associate anyone in the worship of your Lord." So Al-Ma'mun dismissed the servant and completed his ablution by himself. Dislike Of Seeking Assistance In Ablution

chapter: Permissibility Of Having Others Assist With Purification When Unable
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم في حديث أنه كان وجعا شديد الوجع أفصابته جنابة وهو في مكان ابرد اقل: فدعوت الغلمة فقلت لهم: احملوني افغسلوني فحملوني ووضعوني عىل خشبات، ثم صبوا عىل الماء فغسلوني.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith that he was severely ill and became in a state of ritual impurity (janabah) while in a cold place. He said: So I called the servants and said to them: "Carry me and wash me." So they carried me and placed me on wooden planks, then they poured water over me and washed me. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is supported by the general context of other scattered narrations in the chapters.

chapter: Ruling Regarding One Whose Hand And Foot Are Amputated
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن األقطع فقال: يغسل ما قطع منه.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, about the amputee, and he said: He should wash what remains from it.

chapter: Ruling Regarding One Whose Hand And Foot Are Amputated
arabicText: عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن رجل قطعت يده من المرفق كيف يتوضأ؟ اقل: يغسل ما بقي من عضده.
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a man whose hand was cut from the elbow, how should he perform ablution? He said: He should wash what remains of his upper arm.

chapter: Ruling Regarding One Whose Hand And Foot Are Amputated
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن األقطع اليد والرجل، اقل: يغسلهما.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about one whose hand and foot are amputated. He said: He should wash them. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Washing the foot is interpreted as taqiyyah, or the hadith can be interpreted to refer to bathing, as well as the first one.

chapter: Ruling Regarding One Whose Hand And Foot Are Amputated
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: سألته عن األقطع اليد والرجل كيف يتوضأ؟ اقل: يغسل ذلك المكان الذي قطع منه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: I asked him about a person whose hand and foot are amputated, how does he perform ablution? He said: He should wash the location where it was cut from. Shaykh Hurr Amili: These narrations are interpreted as there being something remaining of the limb that must be washed or wiped, or as recommendable for what has been mentioned, as stated by a group of our scholars.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يتوضأ بمد ويغتسل بصاع والمد رطل ونصف، والصاع ستة أرطال. اقل الشيخ: يعني أرطال المدينة، ويكون تسعة أرطال ابلعراقي.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would perform ablution with one mudd and bathe with one sa', and the mudd is one and a half ratl, and the sa' is six ratls. The Shaykh said: This means the ratls of Medina, which equals nine Iraqi ratls. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh said: This means ratls of Medina, which would be equivalent to nine ratls in Iraqi measure. Translator: Mudd and Sa' are historical units of measurement for volume. A helpful analogy for understanding the size of a mudd might be a medium-sized bowl. Sa is traditionally considered to be equal to four mudds.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم أنهما سمعاه يقول: كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يغتسل بصاع من ماء ويتوضأ بمد من ماء.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that they both heard him saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would bathe with one sa' of water and perform ablution with one mudd of water.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: اقل أبو الحسن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم الغسل بصاع من ماء والوضوء بمد من ماء، وصاع النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله خمسة أمداد، والمد وزن مأتين وثمانين درهما، والدرهم وزن ستة دوانيق، والدانق وزن ستة حبات، والحبة وزن حبتي الشعير من أوسط الحب ال من صغائره وال من كباره.
englishText: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The bath is with one sa' of water and ablution with one mudd of water, and the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) sa' is five mudds, and the mudd weighs two hundred and eighty dirhams, and the dirham weighs six daniqs, and the daniq weighs six grains, and the grain weighs two medium-sized barley grains, neither from the small ones nor from the large ones.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر، عن أبيه، عن زرعة، عن سماعة، اقل: سألته عن الذي يجزي من الماء للغسل؟ فقال: اغتسل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله بصاع، وتوضأ بمد، وكان الصاع عىل عهده خمسة أمداد، وكان المد قدر رطل وثالث أواق.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, from his father, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about the sufficient amount of water for bathing? He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) bathed with one sa' and performed ablution with one mudd, and the sa' during his time was five mudds, and the mudd was equivalent to one ratl and three uqiyahs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا عليه السالم عن الوضوء؟ فقال: كان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله يتوضأ بمد من ماء ويغتسل بصاع.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ablution? He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would perform ablution with one mudd of water and bathe with one sa'.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Bath With One Sa' Of Water, And The Impermissibility Of Using Less
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: الوضوء مد والغسل صاع، وسيأتي أقوام بعدي يستقلون ذلك، أفولئك عىل خالف سنتي، والثابت عىل سنتي معي في حظيرة القدس.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Ablution is one mudd and bath is one sa', and there will come people after me who will consider this insufficient, those are against my tradition, and the one who remains firm on my tradition will be with me in the holy sanctuary. Recommendation Of Performing Ablution With One Mudd Of Water And Ba...

chapter: Requirement Of Water Purity For Ablution And Bathing, Their Invalidation With Impure Water, The Invalidation Of Prayer Performed With Such Purification, And The Obligation To Repeat Them
arabicText: عيل بن الحسين المرتضى في رسالة "المحكم والمتشابه" نقال من تفسير النعماني بإسناده اآلتي عن عيل عليه السالم اقل: وأما الرخصة التي هي االطالق بعد النهي إفن هللا تعالى فرض الوضوء عىل عباده ابلماء الطاهر وكذلك الغسل من الجنابة، فقال تعالى"اي أيها الذين آمنوا إذا قمتم إلى الصالة افغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم إلى المرافق وامسحوا برؤوسكم وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين وإن كنتم جنبا افطهروا وإن كنتم مرضى أو عىل سفر أو جاء أحد منكم من الغائط أو المستم النساء فلم تجدوا ماء فتيمموا صعيدا طيبا" افلفريضة من هللا عز وجل الغسل ابلماء عند وجوده ال يجوز غيره، والرخصة فيه إذا لم تجد الماء الطاهر - التيمم ابلتراب من الصعيد الطيب.
englishText: Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Murtadha in his treatise "Al-Muhkam wal-Mutashabih", citing from Tafsir Al-Nu'mani with his coming chain from Ali, peace be upon him, who said: As for the concession which is permission after prohibition, Allah the Exalted made ablution obligatory upon His servants with pure water, and likewise bathing from ritual impurity. The Almighty said: O you who believe! When you rise up for prayer, wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows, and wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles. And if you are in a state of major ritual impurity, then purify yourselves. And if you are ill or on a journey, or one of you comes from the privy, or you have had contact with women, and you find no water, then perform tayammum with clean earth [Quran, 5:6]. So the obligation from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is washing with water when it is available and nothing else is permissible. The concession in this when pure water cannot be found is tayammum with clean earth from good ground. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what supports this has been mentioned in the narrations about water, and what proves it will come in [the sections on] tayammum, impurities, and making up prayers.

chapter: Less Than A Mudd Suffices For Wudhu, Rather The Nominal Washing Suffices, Even If Like Oil, And The Dislike Of Excess And Excessiveness
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه السالم اقل: إنما الوضوء حد من حدود هللا ليعلم هللا من يطيعه ومن يعصيه، وإن المؤمن ال ينجسه شئ، إنما يكفيه مثل الدهن.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said: Ablution is merely one of Allah's limits to know who obeys Him and who disobeys Him. And indeed nothing makes a believer impure, and for him only a small amount like oil is sufficient.

chapter: Less Than A Mudd Suffices For Wudhu, Rather The Nominal Washing Suffices, Even If Like Oil, And The Dislike Of Excess And Excessiveness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم اقل: إن هلل ملكا يكتب سرف الوضوء كما يكتب عدوانه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, who said: Indeed Allah has an angel who records the waste in wudu just as he records its transgression.

chapter: Less Than A Mudd Suffices For Wudhu, Rather The Nominal Washing Suffices, Even If Like Oil, And The Dislike Of Excess And Excessiveness
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر (عليه السالم)، في الوضوء اقل: إذا مس جلدك الماء فحسبك.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding ablution he said: When water touches your skin, that is sufficient for you.

chapter: Less Than A Mudd Suffices For Wudhu, Rather The Nominal Washing Suffices, Even If Like Oil, And The Dislike Of Excess And Excessiveness
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم) اقل: أسبغ الوضوء إن وجدت ماء وإال إفنه يكفيك اليسير.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Perfect the wudu if you find water, otherwise a small amount will suffice you.

chapter: Less Than A Mudd Suffices For Wudhu, Rather The Nominal Washing Suffices, Even If Like Oil, And The Dislike Of Excess And Excessiveness
arabicText: عن جعفر، عن أبيه أن عليا عليه السالم كان يقول: الغسل من الجنابة والوضوء يجزي منه ما أجزى من الدهن الذي يبل الجسد.
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father that Ali, peace be upon him, used to say: For ghusl from janabah and wudu, what suffices of it is what suffices of oil that moistens the body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Opening The Eyes During Ablution And The Non-Obligation Of Water Reaching The Inner Parts
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: افتحوا عيونكم عند الوضوء لعلها ال ترى انر جهنم.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: Open your eyes while performing ablution so that perhaps they (the eyes) will not see the fire of Hell. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This hadith was also mentioned in "Al-Muqni'a" (The Sufficing) in a mursal form. And in "Thawab Al-A'mal" (The Reward of Actions) and "Al-Ilal" (The Reasons) from Muhammad bin Al-Hasan, through As-Saffar, from Al-Abbas bin Ma'ruf, and Abu Hammam, from Muhammad bin Said bin Ghazwan, from As-Sakuni, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata', from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, stated something similar. I say: What indicates the second ruling has been previously mentioned regarding mouth rinsing and nasal inhalation, and what supports this will be addressed.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: عن جعفر بن محمد، عن آابئه عليهم السالم في وصية النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله لعيل عليه السالم اقل: اي عيل ثالث درجات - إلى أن اقل: - إسباغ الوضوء في السبرات، وانتظار الصالة بعد الصالة والمشي ابلليل والنهار إلى الجماعات، اي عيل سبعة من كن فيه فقد استكمل حقيقة اإليمان وأبواب الجنة مفتحة له من أسبغ وضوءه، وأحسن صالته، وأدى زكاة ماله، وكف غضبه، وسجن لسانه، واستغفر لذنبه، وادى النصيحة ألهل بيت نبيه.
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers peace be upon them, in the Prophet's peace be upon him and his family advice to Ali peace be upon him, he said: O Ali, three degrees - then he said - performing ablution completely in cold times, waiting for prayer after prayer, and walking day and night to congregational prayers. O Ali, whoever has seven qualities has completed the reality of faith and the gates of Paradise are opened for him: one who performs his ablution completely, performs his prayer excellently, pays the zakat of his wealth, controls his anger, restrains his tongue, seeks forgiveness for his sins, and gives sincere advice to the household of his Prophet.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: وفي (ثواب األعمال) عن عيل بن جعفر، عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر، عن أبيه، جعفر بن محمد عليهما السالم اقل: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: من أسبغ وضوءه، وأحسن صالته، وأدى زكاة ماله، وكف غضبه، وسجن لسانه، واستغفر لذنبه، وأدى النصيحة ألهل بيت نبيه فقد استكمل حقائق اإليمان، وأبواب الجنة مفتحة له.
englishText: In Thawab al-A'mal from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Whoever performs his ablution completely, performs his prayer excellently, pays the zakat on his wealth, restrains his anger, controls his tongue, seeks forgiveness for his sins, and offers sincere advice to the household of his Prophet has indeed perfected the realities of faith, and the gates of Paradise will be opened for him.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: أال أدلكم عىل شئ يكفر هللا به الحطااي ويزيد في الحسنات؟ قيل: بىل اي رسول هللا، اقل: اسباغ الوضوء عىل المكاره، وكثرة الخطأ إلى هذه المساجد، وانتظار الصالة بعد الصالة.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: Shall I not guide you to something by which Allah erases sins and increases good deeds? They said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said: Performing ablution properly despite difficulties, taking many steps to these mosques, and waiting for the next prayer after prayer.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: عن الرضا، عن آابئه عليهم السالم، في حديث طويل اقل: اقل النبي صىل هللا عليه وآله: إان أهل بيت ال تحل لنا الصدقة، وأمران بإسباغ الطهور وال ننزي حمارا عىل عتيقه.
englishText: From Al-Ridha, from his forefathers peace be upon them, in a long hadith he said: The Prophet peace be upon him and his family said: We, the Ahl al-Bayt, sadaqah is not permissible for us, and we are commanded to perform ablution completely, and we do not mate a donkey with a purebred horse.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: عن أبي الحسن موسى بن جعفر عليه السالم في حديث أن رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله لما أسري به وصار عند عرش ربه اقل: اي محمد ادن من صاد افغسل مساجدك وطهرها وصل لربك فدان رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله من صاد فتوضأ واسبغ وضوءه.
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far, peace be upon him, in a hadith that when the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, was taken on the night journey and reached the throne of his Lord, He said: O Muhammad, approach Saad, wash your places of prostration, purify them, and pray to your Lord. So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, approached Saad and performed ablution, completing it perfectly.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: اقل رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله: أسبغ الوضوء تمر عىل الصراط مر السحاب، أفش السالم يكثر خير بيتك، أكثر من صدقة السر إفنها تطفئ غضب الرب.
englishText: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: Perfect your ablution and you will pass over the bridge as swift as a cloud. Spread the greeting of peace and the goodness of your home will increase. Give more in secret sadaqah, for it extinguishes the anger of the Lord.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: عن أبي جعفر عليه - السالم في حديث اقل: ثالث كفارات: اسباغ الوضوء ابلسبرات، والمشي ابلليل والنهار إلى الصالة، والمحافظة عىل الجماعات.
englishText: From Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, in a hadith he said: Three acts are expiations: performing ablution thoroughly in cold conditions, walking day and night to prayer, and being constant in attending congregational prayers.

chapter: Performing Ablution Thoroughly
arabicText: وعن أبيه، عن فضالة بن أيوب، عن الحسين بن أبي العالء، عن أبي عبد هللا عليه السالم السالم - في حديث - اقل: إن أول صالة صالها رسول هللا صىل هللا عليه وآله صالها في السماء بين يدي هللا تبارك وتعالى، مقابل عرشه جل جالله أوىح إليه وأمره يدنو من صاد فيتوضأ، واقل: أسبغ وضوءك، وطهر مساجدك، وصل لربك، قلت له: وما الصاد؟ اقل: عين تحت ركن من أركان العرش فتوضأ منها وأسبغ وضوءه، ثم استقبل عرش الرحمان.
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Ala, from Abu Abdullah peace be upon him - in a hadith - he said: The first prayer that the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him and his family prayed was in the heaven before Allah blessed and exalted, facing His throne glory be to Him. He revealed to him and commanded him to approach Sa'd and perform ablution, and said: Perfect your ablution, and purify your places of prostration, and pray to your Lord. I said to him: What is Sa'd? He said: A spring beneath a pillar from the pillars of the Throne, so he performed ablution from it and perfected his ablution, then faced the throne of the Most Merciful. Performing Ablution Thoroughly

chapter: Ruling Of Performing Ablution From A Vessel Containing Images Or Made Of Silver
arabicText: عن أبي عبد هللا (عليه السالم)، عن الطشت يكون فيه التماثيل، أو الكوز، أو التور يكون فيه التماثيل أو فضة، ال يتوضأ منه وال فيه.
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding the basin that has images on it, or the pitcher, or the container that has images or silver on it - one should not perform ablution from it nor in it.

chapter: Dislike Of Pouring Ablution Water Into The Latrine, And The Permissibility Of Directing It Into The Drain
arabicText: عن محمد بن الحسن يعني الصفار، إنه كتب إلى أبي محمد (عليه السالم): يجوز أن يغسل الميت وماؤه الذي يصب عليه يدخل إلى بئر كنيف؟ أو الرجل يتوضأ وضوء الصالة ينصب ماء وضوءه في كنيف؟ فوقع (عليه السالم): يكون ذلك في بالليع.
englishText: From Muhammad bin al-Hasan namely al-Saffar, that he wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): Is it permissible to wash the deceased while the water being poured on him flows into a latrine well? Or for a man performing ablution for prayer to pour his ablution water into a latrine? He (peace be upon him) wrote: That should be done in drains.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Ablution In The Mosque From Urination And Defecation, And Its Permissibility From Impurity Occurring In The Mosque
arabicText: سألت أاب عبد هللا (عليه السالم) عن الوضوء في المسجد؟ فكرهه من البول والغائط.
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about performing ablution in the mosque? He disliked it when it was due to urination and defecation.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Ablution In The Mosque From Urination And Defecation, And Its Permissibility From Impurity Occurring In The Mosque
arabicText: عن أحدهما (عليه السالم) اقل: إذا كان الحدث في المسجد فال أبس ابلوضوء في المسجد.
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon him) he said: If the impurity occurs in the mosque, then there is no problem with performing ablution in the mosque. END OF VOLUME 1
